entries.source: A faithful practitioner of the holy arts who channels their light to protect allies and banish the undead.
entries.simplified: 虔诚的圣术修行者，能引导圣光保护盟友并驱逐不死生物。
entries.traditional: 虔誠的聖術修行者，能引導聖光保護隊友並驅逐不死生物。

entries.source: A relentless dual wielder who uses speed and poisons to take down enemies.
entries.simplified: 无情的双持战士，以速度和毒素击倒敌人。
entries.traditional: 冷酷無情的雙持戰士，以速度和毒素擊倒敵人。

entries.source: A raging juggernaut who cleaves through enemies using heavy weaponry and thrives in no-holds-barred combat.
entries.simplified: 狂怒的重装猛士，挥舞重型武器劈开敌阵，在毫无保留的战斗中如鱼得水。
entries.traditional: 狂怒的重裝猛士，揮舞重型武器劈開敵陣，在毫無保留的戰鬥中如魚得水。

entries.source: A peerless mage who manipulates the fabric of time, providing allies with precise utility and control.
entries.simplified: 举世无双的法师，能够操纵时间的脉络，为盟友提供精准的辅助与控制。
entries.traditional: 無與倫比的法師，能夠操縱時間的脈絡，為隊友提供精準的支援與控場。

entries.source: A draconic bruiser who channels the power of a dragon, focusing that energy through spears to fell foes with fire.
entries.simplified: 驾驭巨龙之力的近战猛士，将力量汇聚于长枪，以烈焰击倒敌人。
entries.traditional: 駕馭巨龍之力的近戰猛士，將力量匯聚於長槍，以烈焰擊倒敵人。

entries.source: A peaceful naturalist who provides healing succor for allies while repelling foes with earth magic.
entries.simplified: 平和的自然术士，以治愈之力援助盟友，同时用大地魔法击退敌人。
entries.traditional: 平和的自然術士，以治癒之力援助隊友，同時用大地魔法擊退敵人。

entries.source: A ranged specialist who uses a variety of firearms and their mobility to destroy foes both near and far.
entries.simplified: 精通远程作战的专家，凭借多种枪械与出色的机动性，无论远近都能消灭敌人。
entries.traditional: 精通遠程作戰的專家，憑藉多種槍械與出色的機動性，無論遠近都能消滅敵人。

entries.source: A whimsical performer who empowers allies with lively songs while confounding enemies with music and card tricks.
entries.simplified: 异想天开的表演者，以欢快的歌声强化盟友，并用音乐与纸牌戏法迷惑敌人。
entries.traditional: 古靈精怪的表演者，以輕快的歌聲強化隊友，並用音樂與紙牌戲法擾亂敵人。

entries.source: A balanced melee fighter who uses spear and shield to protect allies while felling foes.
entries.simplified: 攻守兼备的近战斗士，以长枪和盾牌保护盟友并击倒敌人。
entries.traditional: 攻守兼備的近戰鬥士，以長槍和盾牌保護隊友並擊倒敵人。

entries.source: A student of elemental magic who is capable of casting destructive spells from a distance.
entries.simplified: 元素魔法的研习者，能够从远处施放毁灭性法术。
entries.traditional: 元素魔法的研習者，能夠從遠處施放毀滅性的法術。

entries.source: A spiritual striker who assails enemies with physical combos while healing allies.
entries.simplified: 修习灵性之道的近战斗士，以物理连招攻击敌人，同时治疗盟友。
entries.traditional: 修習靈性之道的近戰鬥士，以物理連招攻擊敵人，同時治療隊友。

entries.source: A dark spellcaster who commands masses of the dead while twisting the life force of living beings.
entries.simplified: 黑暗施法者，统御成群的亡者，并扭曲生灵的生命力。
entries.traditional: 黑暗施法者，統御成群的亡者，並扭曲生靈的生命力。

entries.source: A stalwart holy protector who brandishes holy power to both smite foes and protect allies.
entries.simplified: 坚定的神圣守护者，运用圣力惩击敌人并保护盟友。
entries.traditional: 堅毅的神聖守護者，運用聖力懲擊敵人並保護隊友。

entries.source: A devoted saint who brings protection and healing to allies and punishes dark creatures with sacred power.
entries.simplified: 虔诚的圣者，为盟友带来防护与治疗，并以神圣力量惩戒黑暗生物。
entries.traditional: 虔誠的聖者，為隊友帶來防護與治療，並以神聖力量懲戒黑暗生物。

entries.source: A master tracker who picks off enemies with critical shots while commanding traps and beast companions in battle.
entries.simplified: 追踪大师，以致命的暴击射击逐个击破敌人，并在战斗中布置陷阱、指挥野兽伙伴。
entries.traditional: 追蹤大師，以致命的暴擊射擊逐一擊破敵人，並在戰鬥中布置陷阱、指揮野獸夥伴。

entries.source: A bloodthirsty warrior who sacrifices their own life for power while delivering dark, high-risk attacks.
entries.simplified: 嗜血的战士，以牺牲自身生命换取力量，施展黑暗而高风险的攻击。
entries.traditional: 嗜血的戰士，以犧牲自身生命換取力量，施展黑暗且高風險的攻擊。

entries.source: A nimble fighter who strikes from the shadows with poison and blade.
entries.simplified: 身手敏捷的斗士，以毒药与利刃从暗影中发动袭击。
entries.traditional: 身手敏捷的鬥士，以毒藥與利刃從暗影中發動襲擊。

entries.source: A swift marksman who excels at striking enemies from afar with archery.
entries.simplified: 迅捷的神射手，擅长以弓术从远处打击敌人。
entries.traditional: 迅捷的神射手，擅長以弓術從遠處打擊敵人。

entries.source: An elusive trickster who uses clones and elemental arts to misdirect and overwhelm enemies.
entries.simplified: 难以捉摸的诡术者，利用分身与元素秘术误导并压制敌人。
entries.traditional: 難以捉摸的詭術者，利用分身與元素秘術誤導並壓制敵人。

entries.source: A mystical conjurer who fights alongside summoned companions, adapting to fit every scenario.
entries.simplified: 神秘的召唤术士，与召唤出的伙伴并肩作战，能够适应各种局势。
entries.traditional: 神秘的召喚術士，與召喚出的夥伴並肩作戰，能夠適應各種局勢。

entries.source: A cursed spellcaster who afflicts enemies with hexes and drains their life.
entries.simplified: 受诅咒的施法者，以邪咒折磨敌人并汲取其生命。
entries.traditional: 受到詛咒的施法者，以邪咒折磨敵人並汲取其生命。

entries.source: A powerful combatant who wields heavy axes to deal high damage against multiple foes.
entries.simplified: 强悍的斗士，挥舞重斧，对多个敌人造成高额伤害。
entries.traditional: 強悍的鬥士，揮舞重斧，對多個敵人造成高額傷害。

entries.source: A scholar of forgotten techniques who stitches together magic from many paths.
entries.simplified: 研习失传技艺的学者，将不同流派的魔法缝合在一起。
entries.traditional: 研習失傳技藝的學者，將不同流派的魔法縫合在一起。

entries.source: An arcane master who channels fire, ice, lightning, and earth into devastating spells.
entries.simplified: 奥术大师，将火焰、寒冰、雷电与大地之力汇聚成毁灭性法术。
entries.traditional: 奧術大師，將火焰、寒冰、雷電與大地之力匯聚成毀滅性的法術。

entries.source: When fear rose higher than prayer, Vitae taught that faith need not thunder to endure.
entries.simplified: 当恐惧高于祈祷时，维塔教导信仰无需震撼
entries.traditional: 當恐懼高於祈禱時，維塔教導信仰無須震撼

entries.source: A quiet light, carried faithfully, was enough to steady the wounded and guide the lost.
entries.simplified: 一盏静谧的光芒，被忠实地高举，足以安抚伤者并指引前路
entries.traditional: 一盞靜謐的光芒，被忠實地高舉，足以安撫傷者並指引前路

entries.source: Thus the devout were taught to keep their vows in patience, that mercy might outlast terror and hope remain when strength faltered.
entries.simplified: 因此虔诚的人被教导要耐心地遵守誓言，使慈悲能够
entries.traditional: 因此虔誠的人被教導要耐心地遵守誓言，使慈悲能夠

entries.source: For holiness is not proven by spectacle, but by the grace that remains when all else is shaken. - Codex Vitae
entries.simplified: 因为圣洁不是通过盛大表演来证明的，而是通过留下的恩典来证明的
entries.traditional: 因為聖潔不是通過盛大表演來證明的，而是通過留下的恩典來證明的

entries.source: Before the roads were named, Umbra marked the first ground taken by strength.
entries.simplified: 在道路被命名之前，暗影标记了力量征服的第一块土地。
entries.traditional: 在道路被命名之前，暗影標記了力量征服的第一塊土地。

entries.source: The hand that split the briar did not ask the earth for welcome, but carved its right to remain.
entries.simplified: 分开棘丛的手没有向大地乞求欢迎，而是雕刻了
entries.traditional: 分開棘叢的手沒有向大地乞求歡迎，而是雕刻了

entries.source: Thus the first warborn were taught to seize, that fire, fear, and memory might answer to one will.
entries.simplified: 因此，最初的战生者被教导去夺取那火焰、恐惧和记忆
entries.traditional: 因此，最初的戰生者被教導去奪取那火焰、恐懼和記憶

entries.source: For sacred is the mark that survives resistance, and stronger still the one written in blood. - Codex Umbra
entries.simplified: 因为神圣的印记能够存活抵抗，而更强大的则是
entries.traditional: 因為神聖的印記能夠存活抵抗，而更強大的則是

entries.source: When battle favored the hesitant no longer, Umbra taught that force must move faster than fear can think.
entries.simplified: 当战斗不再眷顾犹豫者时，翁布拉教导说力量必须
entries.traditional: 當戰鬥不再眷顧猶豫者時，翁布拉教導說力量必須

entries.source: A chain of strikes, once begun, was not to be interrupted by pity, recoil, or restraint, but carried through until resistance forgot how to stand.
entries.simplified: 一旦开始的连击链，不应被怜悯、反冲所打断，
entries.traditional: 一旦開始的連擊鏈，不應被憐憫、反衝所打斷，

entries.source: Thus the relentless were taught to become momentum itself, that each blow would call the next and violence would answer before doubt returned.
entries.simplified: 于是无情之人被教导成为动能本身，使得每一击
entries.traditional: 於是無情之人被教導成為動能本身，使得每一擊

entries.source: For the surest victory is the one that leaves no space between impact and the will behind it. - Codex Umbra
entries.simplified: 因为最确定的胜利是在冲击与之间没有间隙的胜利
entries.traditional: 因為最確定的勝利是在衝擊與之間沒有間隙的勝利

entries.source: When storms, spells, and mirrored wrath battered the faithful, Vitae shaped within them a center that would not yield.
entries.simplified: 当暴风雨、法术和镜像之怒摧残信徒时，Vitae塑造了
entries.traditional: 當暴風雨、法術和鏡像之怒摧殘信徒時，Vitae塑造了

entries.source: Strength was not given to stand above others, but to remain when others had nowhere else to stand.
entries.simplified: 力量不是为了凌驾于他人之上，而是为了在他人离去时坚守阵地
entries.traditional: 力量並非為了凌駕於他人之上，而是為了在他人離去時堅守陣地

entries.source: Thus the steadfast were taught to become a wall no terror could scatter, that fear, force, and sorcery alike might spend themselves in vain.
entries.simplified: 就这样，坚定者被教会成为任何恐惧都无法击散的墙垣，
entries.traditional: 就這樣，堅定者被教會成為任何恐懼都無法擊散的牆垣，

entries.source: For blessed is the heart that cannot be thrown, shaken, or turned against itself. - Codex Vitae
entries.simplified: 因为无法被摧毁、动摇或反制的心灵是有福的
entries.traditional: 因為無法被摧毀、動搖或反制的心靈是有福的

entries.source: When the Berserker's oath broke beneath rage, Umbra did not calm the blood, but sharpened it.
entries.simplified: 当狂战士的誓言在怒火下破裂时，暗影并未平息鲜血，
entries.traditional: 當狂戰士的誓言在怒火下破裂時，暗影並未平息鮮血，

entries.source: Every wound became a drumbeat, every swing a demand that the body spend itself before doubt could speak.
entries.simplified: 每一道伤口都成为鼓声，每一次挥舞都是身体消耗自己的呼唤
entries.traditional: 每一道傷口都成為鼓聲，每一次揮舞都是身體消耗自己的呼喚

entries.source: Thus the wrathful were taught to chase the fleeing life in axe, claw, and cyclone, until battle answered only hunger.
entries.simplified: 如此，愤怒者被教导用斧、爪和
entries.traditional: 如此，憤怒者被教導用斧、爪和

entries.source: For mercy is the silence after fury has taken all it was owed. - Codex Umbra
entries.simplified: 因为仁慈是愤怒夺走了它所应得的一切之后的沉寂。- Codex Umbra
entries.traditional: 因為仁慈是憤怒奪走了它所應得的一切之後的沉寂。- Codex Umbra

entries.source: In the first calm after ruin, Vitae taught the wise to weave instead of wound.
entries.simplified: 在废墟之后的第一次平静中，维塔教导智者编织而非伤害。
entries.traditional: 在廢墟之後的第一次平靜中，維塔教導智者編織而非傷害。

entries.source: Power was not given to unravel the world, but to bind its broken measures into harmony.
entries.simplified: 力量不是为了解开世界，而是为了束缚其破碎的秩序
entries.traditional: 力量不是為了解開世界，而是為了束縛其破碎的秩序

entries.source: Thus the patient were taught to shape the unseen, that thought might become shelter, light, and song.
entries.simplified: 因此患者被教导塑造无形之物，使思想可以化为
entries.traditional: 因此患者被教導塑造無形之物，使思想可以化為

entries.source: For magic is purest when it leaves the world more whole than it found it. - Codex Vitae
entries.simplified: 因为魔法最纯净的时刻，就是当它让世界比它发现时更完整的时候。
entries.traditional: 因為魔法最純淨的時刻，就是當它讓世界比它發現時更完整的時候。

entries.source: Before oath and kingdom, before ruin and remembrance, all forces mingled in one body.
entries.simplified: 在誓言和王国之前，在毁灭和记忆之前，所有力量交融在一起
entries.traditional: 在誓言和王國之前，在毀滅和記憶之前，所有力量交融在一起

entries.source: Holy, shadow, poison, and death were not enemies then, but truths awaiting a stronger hand.
entries.simplified: 圣洁、阴影、毒素和死亡当时并非敌对，而是等待中的真理
entries.traditional: 聖潔、陰影、毒素和死亡當時並非敵對，而是等待中的真理

entries.source: Thus the knowing were taught to wield contradiction, that grace and corruption might answer the same design.
entries.simplified: 因此智者们被教导要掌握矛盾，即优雅与腐败
entries.traditional: 因此智者們被教導要掌握矛盾，即優雅與腐敗

entries.source: For the world is not preserved by purity alone, but by the will to bind what others fear to touch. - Codex Umbra
entries.simplified: 因为世界不仅由纯净所保护，更由结合之意志所保护
entries.traditional: 因為世界不僅由純淨所保護，更由結合之意志所保護

entries.source: When chaos pressed against the last bastions, Vitae taught that mastery was mercy measured without waste.
entries.simplified: 当混沌逼近最后的堡垒时，维泰教导精通是
entries.traditional: 當混沌逼近最後的堡壘時，維泰教導精通是

entries.source: The spell cast cleanly, swiftly, and without excess preserved both strength and purpose, turning panic into discipline.
entries.simplified: 咒语干净利落、迅速而不多余地施放，保留了两种力量
entries.traditional: 咒語乾淨俐落、迅速而不多餘地施放，保留了兩種力量

entries.source: Thus the devoted were taught to let power flow without pause or burden, that the wounded be sustained and the line not break.
entries.simplified: 因此虔诚者被教导让力量无间断、无负担地流动，以便
entries.traditional: 因此虔誠者被教導讓力量無間斷、無負擔地流動，以便

entries.source: For control is holiest not when it restrains the gift, but when it guides it flawlessly where it is needed most. - Codex Vitae
entries.simplified: 因为控制最神圣的时刻，不是在它限制天赋时，而是在它引导天赋时
entries.traditional: 因為控制最神聖的時刻，不是在它限制天賦時，而是在它引導天賦時

entries.source: When wrath rose from the deep places of the world, Umbra taught that flame was truest when married to the blade.
entries.simplified: 当愤怒从世界深处升起时，Umbra 教导了那火焰
entries.traditional: 當憤怒從世界深處升起時，Umbra 教導了那火焰

entries.source: Fire was not given to warm or purify, but to leave behind a lesson even ash would remember.
entries.simplified: 火焰并非为了温暖或净化而生，而是为了在灰烬中留下教训
entries.traditional: 火焰並非為了溫暖或淨化而生，而是為了在灰燼中留下教訓

entries.source: Thus the fierce were taught to strike with burning will, that each wound outlive the moment that made it and each enemy pass into scorched echo.
entries.simplified: 如此，凶猛之人被教导以炽热的意志发动攻击，使得每一道伤口
entries.traditional: 如此，兇猛之人被教導以熾熱的意志發動攻擊，使得每一道傷口

entries.source: For power is most honest when it cuts, consumes, and leaves no doubt who carried the fire. - Codex Umbra
entries.simplified: 因为力量最诚实的时刻，就是它切割、吞噬之时，无人能否认谁
entries.traditional: 因為力量最誠實的時刻，就是它切割、吞噬之時，無人能否認誰

entries.source: When lesser armor cracked beneath the world's cruelty, Umbra taught the strong to clothe themselves not in protection alone, but in permanence.
entries.simplified: 当劣质盔甲在世界的残酷下破裂时，暗影教导了强者们
entries.traditional: 當劣質盔甲在世界的殘酷下破裂時，暗影教導了強者們

entries.source: Steel that lives does not merely endure the strike; it remembers it, returns it, and grows more terrible for having borne it.
entries.simplified: 活着的钢铁不仅能承受打击；它会记住并将其返还
entries.traditional: 活著的鋼鐵不僅能承受打擊；它會記住並將其返還

entries.source: Thus the immovable were taught to stand as fortresses unto themselves, that every assault would break first upon their silence and feed the will within.
entries.simplified: 因此不动者被教导作为堡垒自身而站立，
entries.traditional: 因此不動者被教導作為堡壘自身而站立，

entries.source: For the highest strength is not to escape the blow, but to make the blow regret its making. - Codex Umbra
entries.simplified: 因为最高的力量不是躲避打击，而是发动打击
entries.traditional: 因為最高的力量不是躲避打擊，而是發動打擊

entries.source: Before the world was divided into rival truths, Vitae remembered a greater wholeness in which every element and living force belonged to one weave.
entries.simplified: 在世界分裂成对立真理之前,维塔记得一个更伟大的
entries.traditional: 在世界分裂成對立真理之前,維塔記得一個更偉大的

entries.source: Healing, swiftness, strength, and blessing were not separate gifts, but threads drawn together in harmony so that none would exalt itself above the rest.
entries.simplified: 治愈、迅捷、力量和祝福不是分离的恩赐，而是线
entries.traditional: 治癒、迅捷、力量和祝福不是分離的恩賜，而是線

entries.source: Thus the wise were taught to seek fullness instead of excess, that power in all its forms might serve life without tearing it apart.
entries.simplified: 如此,智者被教导寻求充盈而非过度,权力
entries.traditional: 如此,智者被教導尋求充盈而非過度,權力

entries.source: For eternity is not the triumph of one force, but the concord of all that was meant to endure together. - Codex Vitae
entries.simplified: 因为永恒不是单一力量的胜利，而是万物的和谐
entries.traditional: 因為永恆不是單一力量的勝利，而是萬物的和諧

entries.source: When the paths of the world grew tangled, Umbra taught the hidden to pass where no hand could close.
entries.simplified: 当世界的道路缠绕在一起时，暗影教会隐藏者通行
entries.traditional: 當世界的道路糾纏在一起時，暗影教會隱藏者通行

entries.source: Swiftness was not given for mercy, but so the unseen might remain untouched while all others stumbled.
entries.simplified: 敏捷不是为了怜悯而赐予的，而是让看不见的东西保持无损
entries.traditional: 敏捷不是為了憐憫而賜予的，而是讓看不見的東西保持無損

entries.source: Thus the elusive were taught to slip between sight and consequence, that danger might grasp only emptiness and pursuit grow weary.
entries.simplified: 因此，那些难以捉摸的人被教导在视线和后果之间滑动，
entries.traditional: 因此，那些難以捉摸的人被教導在視線和後果之間滑動，

entries.source: For blessed is the soul that moves like shadow, felt in passing and never held. - Codex Umbra
entries.simplified: 祝福灵魂如影而动，在瞬间感受，永不
entries.traditional: 祝福靈魂如影而動，在瞬間感受，永不

entries.source: When distance turned courage into guesswork, Vitae steadied the Gunslinger's hand.
entries.simplified: 当距离将勇气化为猜测时，Vitae稳定了枪手的武器
entries.traditional: 當距離將勇氣化為猜測時，Vitae穩定了槍手的武器

entries.source: The shot was not loosed for pride, but for the single breath where judgment, aim, and purpose became one.
entries.simplified: 这一枪并非因骄傲而发，而是在那唯一的瞬间，判断，
entries.traditional: 這一槍並非因驕傲而發，而是在那唯一的瞬間，判斷，

entries.source: Thus the patient were taught to strike cleanly, from powder flash to far horizon, wasting neither fear nor force.
entries.simplified: 患者因此被教导干净地进行打击,从火药闪光到远处
entries.traditional: 患者因此被教導乾淨地進行打擊,從火藥閃光到遠處

entries.source: For blessed is the bullet that ends danger before chaos reaches the innocent. - Codex Vitae
entries.simplified: 祝福的子弹在混乱到达无辜者之前结束危险。
entries.traditional: 祝福的子彈在混亂到達無辜者之前結束危險。

entries.source: Where the ground was scarred and ash remembered war, Vitae laid down bloom.
entries.simplified: 在土地伤痕累累、灰烬铭记战争的地方，Vitae 播撒了绽放。
entries.traditional: 在土地傷痕累累、灰燼銘記戰爭的地方，Vitae 播撒了綻放。

entries.source: Not to deny the wound, but to cover it in living mercy until pain forgot its name.
entries.simplified: 不是否认伤口，而是用活的怜悯覆盖它，直到痛苦被遗忘
entries.traditional: 不是否認傷口，而是用活的憐悯覆蓋它，直到痛苦被遺忘

entries.source: Thus the faithful were taught to heal beyond themselves, that even ruins might flower.
entries.simplified: 因此信徒们被教导要超越自身治愈，即使废墟
entries.traditional: 因此信徒們被教導要超越自身治愈，即使廢墟

entries.source: For life is holiest when it returns where suffering once believed itself eternal. - Codex Vitae
entries.simplified: 因为生命在回到痛苦曾经相信自己的地方时最为神圣
entries.traditional: 因為生命在回到痛苦曾經相信自己的地方時最為神聖

entries.source: In the first calm after ruin, Umbra taught the wise to mark instead of mourn.
entries.simplified: 在废墟之后的第一阵宁静中，翁布拉教导智者用标记代替哀悼。
entries.traditional: 在廢墟之後的第一陣寧靜中，翁布拉教導智者用標記代替哀悼。

entries.source: Power was not given to soothe the wound, but to ensure that every wound remembered.
entries.simplified: 力量不是为了安抚伤口，而是为了确保每一道伤口都被铭记。
entries.traditional: 力量不是為了安撫傷口，而是為了確保每一道傷口都被銘記。

entries.source: Thus the cunning were taught to brand the unseen, that thought might become poison, fear, and fate.
entries.simplified: 因此狡猾者被教导在无形之物上打下烙印，使思想得以转化为
entries.traditional: 因此狡猾者被教導在無形之物上打下烙印，使思想得以轉化為

entries.source: For magic is truest when it teaches the world that nothing struck is ever unchanged again. - Codex Umbra
entries.simplified: 因为魔法最真实的时刻，是当它教会世界没有任何被击中的东西永远
entries.traditional: 因為魔法最真實的時刻，是當它教會世界沒有任何被擊中的東西永遠

entries.source: When confusion clouded the field, Vitae taught the faithful to let sight become certainty.
entries.simplified: 当困惑笼罩战场时，Vitae教导信徒放任视界
entries.traditional: 當困惑籠罩戰場時，Vitae教導信徒放任視界

entries.source: Aim was not given for pride, but so that no needed strike be wasted and no danger mistaken for another.
entries.simplified: 准度并非因骄傲而获得，而是为了没有必要的一击被浪费，也没有
entries.traditional: 準度並非因驕傲而獲得，而是為了沒有必要的一擊被浪費，也沒有

entries.source: Thus the keen were taught to see truly at any range, that precision might spare effort, preserve strength, and bring order to the chaos of battle.
entries.simplified: 因此敏锐的人被教导在任何距离都能看清真实，使得精准度得以
entries.traditional: 因此敏銳的人被教導在任何距離都能看清真實，使得精準度得以

entries.source: For blessed is the eye that does not wander, and holier still the will that follows it without doubt. - Codex Vitae
entries.simplified: 祝福那不游移的眼睛，更圣洁的是那份意志，
entries.traditional: 祝福那不游移的眼睛，更聖潔的是那份意志，

entries.source: When the wounded bent beneath the weight of dusk, Vitae gave not command, but breath.
entries.simplified: 当伤者在暮色的重压下弯腰时，维泰没有下达命令，
entries.traditional: 當傷者在暮色的重壓下彎腰時，維泰沒有下達命令，

entries.source: What life remained was not to be hoarded, nor spent in hatred, but carried onward together.
entries.simplified: 残存的生命不应被囤积，也不应被浪费在仇恨中，而是被承载
entries.traditional: 殘存的生命不應被囤積，也不應被浪費在仇恨中，而是被承載

entries.source: Thus the strong were taught to endure, that the weak might rise beside them.
entries.simplified: 强者被教导要坚持，使弱者能够与他们一起站起来。
entries.traditional: 強者被教導要堅持，使弱者能夠與他們一起站起來。

entries.source: For sacred is the breath that is shared, and holier still the hand that preserves it. - Codex Vitae
entries.simplified: 共享之息是神圣的，而保护它的手更加神圣
entries.traditional: 共享之息是神聖的，而保護它的手更加神聖

entries.source: When poison, shadow, and silence learned to stalk the living, Umbra answered not with cleansing, but with refusal.
entries.simplified: 当毒、影和寂静学会了猎杀生者，Umbra出现了
entries.traditional: 當毒、影和寂靜學會了獵殺生者，Umbra出現了

entries.source: The marked were not taught to heal the wound, but to deny it a place to settle, until venom, darkness, and fear passed over them empty.
entries.simplified: 被标记者不是被教导愈合伤口，而是拒绝让伤口有立足之地，
entries.traditional: 被標記者不是被教導癒合傷口，而是拒絕讓傷口有立足之地，

entries.source: Thus the chosen were taught to walk untouched where others faltered, that no affliction might claim what had been sealed against loss.
entries.simplified: 这样被选中的人被教导在他人踌躇的地方无碰触地行走，即
entries.traditional: 這樣被選中的人被教導在他人踌躇的地方無碰觸地行走，即

entries.source: For the strongest ward is not the light that shines outward, but the void that permits nothing in. - Codex Umbra
entries.simplified: 因为最强的守护不是向外闪耀的光,而是虚无
entries.traditional: 因為最強的守護不是向外閃耀的光,而是虛無

entries.source: Let the vow be spoken where all may hear, for truth does not fear witness.
entries.simplified: 让誓言在众人能听到之处被诵出，因为真理不惧见证。
entries.traditional: 讓誓言在眾人能聽到之處被誦出，因為真理不懼見證。

entries.source: Steel is made righteous not by sharpness, but by the promise that governs its use.
entries.simplified: 钢铁的正义不在于锋利，而在于约束它的诺言
entries.traditional: 鋼鐵的正義不在於鋒利，而在於約束它的諾言

entries.source: Thus the steadfast were taught to strike openly, that skill and duty remain one.
entries.simplified: 于是坚定者被教导直言不讳地发动进攻，使技能与责任长存
entries.traditional: 於是堅定者被教導直言不諱地發動進攻，使技能與責任長存

entries.source: For an oath kept beneath the sun is worth more than victory won without a name. - Codex Vitae
entries.simplified: 因为太阳下守护的誓言，比没有获得的胜利更有价值
entries.traditional: 因為太陽下守護的誓言，比沒有獲得的勝利更有價值

entries.source: When the wounded bent beneath the weight of dusk, Umbra gathered what the living spilled.
entries.simplified: 当伤患们在暮色的重压下弯腰时，暗影收集了
entries.traditional: 當傷患們在暮色的重壓下彎腰時，暗影收集了

entries.source: What flesh forgot, blood remembered; what the soul loosed, will made useful again.
entries.simplified: 血肉遗忘之事，血液铭记；灵魂放逐之物，意志化为有用
entries.traditional: 血肉遺忘之事，血液銘記；靈魂放逐之物，意志化為有用

entries.source: Thus the ruthless were taught to take, that no strength be lost to dust or pity.
entries.simplified: 由此无情之人被教会夺取，使得任何力量都不会丧失于尘埃或
entries.traditional: 由此無情之人被教會奪取，使得任何力量都不會喪失於塵埃或

entries.source: For power is the truest mercy, and blessed is the hand that lets nothing die unused. - Codex Umbra
entries.simplified: 力量是真正的慈悲，不留任何东西的手是幸福的
entries.traditional: 力量是真正的慈悲，不留任何東西的手是幸福的

entries.source: Before the war divided memory, Vitae set the first art into mortal hands as a gift of ordered wonder.
entries.simplified: 在战争分裂记忆之前，维泰将第一门艺术赋予凡人之手
entries.traditional: 在戰爭分裂記憶之前，維泰將第一門藝術賦予凡人之手

entries.source: Flame, frost, stone, and storm were not taught as weapons alone, but as languages through which the world might be understood without being broken.
entries.simplified: 火焰、严寒、石头和风暴不仅被当作武器来传授，更被当作一种语言
entries.traditional: 火焰、嚴寒、石頭和風暴不僅被當作武器來傳授，更被當作一種語言

entries.source: Thus the first keepers were taught to cast in reverence, that power and wisdom would rise together instead of parting ways.
entries.simplified: 因此最初的守护者被教导要虔诚地施法，力量与智慧
entries.traditional: 因此最初的守護者被教導要虔誠地施法，力量與智慧

entries.source: For the oldest magic was never meant to dominate creation, but to speak with it. - Codex Vitae
entries.simplified: 因为最古老的魔法从未打算统治创造，而是为了与之交谈
entries.traditional: 因為最古老的魔法從未打算統治創造，而是為了與之交談

entries.source: Long before open sanctums and sung prayers, Umbra kept wisdom in wells no eye could sound.
entries.simplified: 在开放的圣所和诵唱的祈祷出现之前，暗影将智慧保存在不
entries.traditional: 在開放的聖所和誦唱的祈禱出現之前，暗影將智慧保存在不

entries.source: The deepest arts were not given to the many, but guarded in silence until a will strong enough could draw from them without trembling.
entries.simplified: 最深奥的艺术并未传于众人，而是被守护在沉寂之中，直到
entries.traditional: 最深奧的藝術並未傳於眾人，而是被守護在沉寂之中，直到

entries.source: Thus the keepers were taught to hide what mattered most, that power might remain pure from the ruin of careless hands.
entries.simplified: 守护者们被教导要隐藏最重要的东西，使得力量能够
entries.traditional: 守護者們被教導要隱藏最重要的東西，使得力量能夠

entries.source: For a secret preserved in darkness endures longer than a truth shouted into the wind. - Codex Umbra
entries.simplified: 保存在黑暗中的秘密比喊出的真理持续的时间更长
entries.traditional: 保存在黑暗中的秘密比喊出的真理持續的時間更長

entries.source: When lesser minds feared the heavens, Umbra taught the learned to listen when the cosmos spoke in fire.
entries.simplified: 当低等的心灵害怕天空时,Umbra教会了学者去倾听
entries.traditional: 當低等的心靈害怕天空時,Umbra教會了學者去傾聽

entries.source: Wisdom was not given to shield the timid, but to call down wrath with a will refined enough to survive its answer.
entries.simplified: 智慧不是为了庇护胆小之人，而是为了凭借意志召唤愤怒
entries.traditional: 智慧不是為了庇護膽小之人，而是為了憑藉意志召喚憤怒

entries.source: Thus the magi were taught to trade flesh for brilliance, that mana, warding, and ruin might gather in one disciplined hand.
entries.simplified: 魔法师们被教导用血肉换取光彩，那魔法、守护、
entries.traditional: 魔法師們被教導用血肉換取光彩，那魔法、守護、

entries.source: For the highest art is not to borrow power safely, but to speak the burning language of the stars and remain standing when they reply. - Codex Umbra
entries.simplified: 因为最高的艺术不是安全地借用力量，而是说出燃烧的
entries.traditional: 因為最高的藝術不是安全地借用力量，而是說出燃燒的

entries.source: When hostile sorcery darkened the air, Vitae raised no boast against it, but a veil through which malice could not easily pass.
entries.simplified: 当敌对的魔法使空气黯淡时，维泰对此未曾自夸，
entries.traditional: 當敵對的魔法使空氣黯淡時，維泰對此未曾自誇，

entries.source: True warding was not vengeance, but guardianship, preserving mind, body, and spirit from the reach of powers that sought to bend them from afar.
entries.simplified: 真正的守护不是复仇，而是保护，维护心灵、身体，
entries.traditional: 真正的守護不是復仇，而是保護，維護心靈、身體，

entries.source: Thus the watchful were taught to turn aside the unseen, that spellcraft itself might be answered without surrendering to it.
entries.simplified: 因此守卫者被教导转开无形之物，使得法术本身
entries.traditional: 因此守衛者被教導轉開無形之物，使得法術本身

entries.source: For mercy is not always the healing hand; sometimes it is the shield that ensures the wound is never made. - Codex Vitae
entries.simplified: 因为慈悲并非总是治愈之手；有时它是保护的盾牌，
entries.traditional: 因為慈悲並非總是治癒之手；有時它是保護的盾牌，

entries.source: When the clash of war broke lesser spirits, Vitae tempered the faithful as iron in a living flame.
entries.simplified: 当战争的碰撞破碎了较弱的灵魂时，维泰锤炼了信徒如同
entries.traditional: 當戰爭的衝擊粉碎了較弱的靈魂時，維泰錘煉了信徒如同

entries.source: Endurance was not given so they might crush others, but so they would not yield when others depended on them.
entries.simplified: 耐力不是为了压倒他人，而是为了克制自己
entries.traditional: 耐力不是為了壓倒他人，而是為了克制自己

entries.source: Thus the steadfast were taught to bear the weight of battle without surrender, that courage might hold where fear sought entry.
entries.simplified: 就这样，坚定不移的人被教导在战斗中毫不屈服地承受重压，
entries.traditional: 就這樣，堅定不移的人被教導在戰鬥中毫不屈服地承受重壓，

entries.source: For the truest heart is not the one that never bleeds, but the one that refuses to break. - Codex Vitae
entries.simplified: 因为最真实的心不是永不出血的心，而是坚决拒绝的心
entries.traditional: 因為最真實的心不是永不出血的心，而是堅決拒絕的心

entries.source: When the paths of the world grew tangled, Vitae sent guidance on the breath between leaves.
entries.simplified: 当世界的道路缠绕在一起时，维塔埃在呼吸中送去了指引
entries.traditional: 當世界的道路纏繞在一起時，維塔埃在呼吸中送去了指引

entries.source: Swiftness was not given for escape alone, but so life might move freely where darkness sought to close its hand.
entries.simplified: 迅捷不仅被赋予逃脱之用，更是为了让生命能自由地流动到
entries.traditional: 迅捷不僅被賦予逃脫之用，更是為了讓生命能自由地流動到

entries.source: Thus the fleet were taught to travel lightly, that warning, aid, and hope could arrive before harm.
entries.simplified: 因此舰队被教导轻装旅行，警告、援助和希望
entries.traditional: 因此艦隊被教導輕裝旅行，警告、援助和希望

entries.source: For blessed is the soul that moves like wind, touching many lives without claiming any for its own. - Codex Vitae
entries.simplified: 幸哉乎灵魂如风而动，触及众多生命而无
entries.traditional: 幸哉乎靈魂如風而動，觸及眾多生命而無

entries.source: Before the names of spells were written, Vitae moved through the world as a current unseen yet generous.
entries.simplified: 在咒语的名字被记录之前，Vitae 在世界中以
entries.traditional: 在咒語的名字被記錄之前，Vitae 在世界中以

entries.source: The wise were not told to possess it, but to open themselves as conduits, that wonder might pass through mortal hands without being diminished.
entries.simplified: 智者被告知的不是拥有它，而是将自己作为通道打开，
entries.traditional: 智者被告知的不是擁有它，而是將自己作為通道打開，

entries.source: Thus the gifted were taught to receive and release in equal measure, that power remain living instead of still.
entries.simplified: 因此天赋异禀者被教导以等量的方式接受和释放，而
entries.traditional: 因此天賦異稟者被教導以等量的方式接受和釋放，而

entries.source: For the purest vessel is not the one that hoards the light, but the one through which it continues. - Codex Vitae
entries.simplified: 因为最纯净的容器不是囤积光芒的，而是能够
entries.traditional: 因為最純淨的容器不是囤積光芒的，而是能夠

entries.source: When the grave refused to keep its counsel, Umbra taught the Necromancer to listen.
entries.simplified: 当坟墓拒绝保守秘密时，暗影教导了死灵法师
entries.traditional: 當墳墓拒絕保守秘密時，暗影教導了死靈法師

entries.source: Bone, breath, and rot held records the living feared, each fragment a memory waiting to be commanded.
entries.simplified: 骨骼、呼吸和腐烂记录了生者所恐惧的，每个碎片都是一段记忆
entries.traditional: 骨骼、呼吸和腐爛記錄了生者所恐懼的，每個碎片都是一段記憶

entries.source: Thus the deathbound were taught to turn endings outward, until nova, spiral, and corpse spoke in one cold choir.
entries.simplified: 因此死亡之人被教导将终结向外转向，直到新星、螺旋、
entries.traditional: 因此死亡之人被教導將終結向外轉向，直到新星、螺旋、

entries.source: For nothing buried is truly lost to the one who can hear it answer. - Codex Umbra
entries.simplified: 对于能听到它回答的人来说，埋藏的东西永远不会真正丢失。- Codex
entries.traditional: 對於能聽到它回答的人來說，埋藏的東西永遠不會真正丟失。- Codex

entries.source: Before the roads were named, Vitae blessed the first step into the unmade world.
entries.simplified: 在道路有名字之前，维泰祝福了踏入未成形之地的第一步
entries.traditional: 在道路有名字之前，維泰祝福了踏入未成形之地的第一步

entries.source: The hand that cleared the briar did not conquer the earth, but invited life to follow.
entries.simplified: 清除荆棘的手没有征服大地，反而邀请了生命
entries.traditional: 清除荊棘的手沒有征服大地，反而邀請了生命

entries.source: Thus the first walkers were taught to build, that shelter, fire, and memory might endure together.
entries.simplified: 因此，最初的行者被教导建造庇护所、火焰和记忆
entries.traditional: 因此，最初的行者被教導建造庇護所、火焰和記憶

entries.source: For sacred is the path that is opened for others, and brighter still the one who leaves it behind. - Codex Vitae
entries.simplified: 因为神圣的道路为他人而开启，而更加灿烂
entries.traditional: 因為神聖的道路為他人而開啟，而更加燦爛

entries.source: When mortal strength proved too brief for mortal need, Umbra taught that vows should not end where the body does.
entries.simplified: 当凡人的力量对于凡人的需求而言太过短暂时，翁布拉教导说
entries.traditional: 當凡人的力量對於凡人的需求而言太過短暫時，翁布拉教導說

entries.source: Bond and burden alike were made to endure beyond their first breath, held fast by will so that no promise would fade simply because time demanded it.
entries.simplified: 羁绊与负担都注定超越最初的一息而存在，被守护着
entries.traditional: 羈絆與負擔都注定超越最初的一息而存在，被守護著

entries.source: Thus the sworn were taught to bind their gifts longer than nature allowed, that devotion might outlast flesh and obligation remain unbroken.
entries.simplified: 因此宣誓者被教会将他们的天赋绑定得比自然所允许的更长时间，
entries.traditional: 因此宣誓者被教會將他們的天賦綁定得比自然所允許的更長時間，

entries.source: For the truest oath is not the one spoken once, but the one that refuses to die. - Codex Umbra
entries.simplified: 因为真正的誓言不是只说一次的誓言,而是拒绝背弃的誓言
entries.traditional: 因為真正的誓言不是只說一次的誓言,而是拒絕背棄的誓言

entries.source: When darkness pressed against the gate, Vitae placed a shield in the Paladin's hand and a dawn behind it.
entries.simplified: 当黑暗压向大门时，Vitae 在圣骑士中放置了一面盾牌
entries.traditional: 當黑暗壓向大門時，Vitae 在聖騎士中放置了一面盾牌

entries.source: Judgment was not anger, nor was the blade raised for conquest, but to make a road where fear had gathered.
entries.simplified: 审判不是愤怒，剑的抬起不是为了征服，而是为了
entries.traditional: 審判不是憤怒，刀刃抬起不是為了征服，而是為了

entries.source: Thus the sworn were taught to cast light through steel, cross, and consecrated ground, that the helpless might stand within its reach.
entries.simplified: 由此，宣誓者被教导通过钢铁、十字和神圣之物来释放光芒
entries.traditional: 由此，宣誓者被教導通過鋼鐵、十字和神聖之物來釋放光芒

entries.source: For the holiest defense is the radiance that protects even while it strikes. - Codex Vitae
entries.simplified: 因为最圣洁的防御是即使在攻击时也能保护的光辉。
entries.traditional: 因為最聖潔的防禦是即使在攻擊時也能保護的光輝。

entries.source: When the dead walked in mockery and sorrow clung to the living, Vitae answered through the Priest's raised hand.
entries.simplified: 当死者嘲讽而行，悲伤缠绕于生者之时，维泰做出了回应
entries.traditional: 當死者嘲諷而行，悲傷纏繞於生者之時，維泰做出了回應

entries.source: Grace was not fragile kindness, but a force that named corruption, banished it, and carried mercy with a blade of light.
entries.simplified: 恩典不是脆弱的善良，而是一种命名腐败、放逐腐败的力量
entries.traditional: 恩典不是脆弱的善良，而是一種命名腐敗、放逐腐敗的力量

entries.source: Thus the sanctified were taught to smite, exorcise, and call wrath only where healing alone could not restore the way.
entries.simplified: 这样被圣化的人被教导要打击、驱魔，并仅在以下情况下召唤愤怒
entries.traditional: 這樣被聖化的人被教導要打擊、驅魔，並僅在以下情況下召喚憤怒

entries.source: For mercy is not weakened by judgment when judgment clears the path for life. - Codex Vitae
entries.simplified: 因为当审判为生命开辟道路时，怜悯不会因审判而削弱。
entries.traditional: 因為當審判為生命開闢道路時，憐憫不會因審判而削弱。

entries.source: Before oath and kingdom, before ruin and remembrance, the first elements were set in balance.
entries.simplified: 在誓言和王国之前，在废墟和回忆之前，最初的元素
entries.traditional: 在誓言和王國之前，在廢墟和回憶之前，最初的元素

entries.source: Fire warmed, water yielded, wind carried, and earth endured, each giving shape without dominion.
entries.simplified: 火焰温暖，水退缩，风承载，土地坚守，各自给予
entries.traditional: 火焰溫暖，水退縮，風承載，土地堅守，各自給予

entries.source: Thus the keepers were taught to master the primal not by conquest, but by accord.
entries.simplified: 于是守护者被教导掌控原初之力不是通过征服，而是通过
entries.traditional: 於是守護者被教導掌控原初之力不是透過征服，而是透過

entries.source: For the world was first made whole by harmony, and only later broken by will. - Codex Vitae
entries.simplified: 世界最初因和谐而变得完整，后来才被意志所破坏。
entries.traditional: 世界最初因和諧而變得完整，後來才被意志所破壞。

entries.source: When the enemy believed distance meant safety, Umbra taught the storm to answer from beyond sight.
entries.simplified: 当敌人以为距离意味着安全时，翁布拉教会了风暴
entries.traditional: 當敵人以為距離意味著安全時，翁布拉教會了風暴

entries.source: Speed was not given for elegance, but for certainty, that the strike arrive before warning and force be felt before fear found its name.
entries.simplified: 速度不是为了优雅而给予的，而是为了确保打击一定到达
entries.traditional: 速度不是為了優雅而給予的，而是為了確保打擊一定到達

entries.source: Thus the swift were taught to loose death on the wind, that the unseen horizon itself would become an instrument of judgment.
entries.simplified: 由此，敏捷者被教会在风中释放死亡，指向看不见的地平线
entries.traditional: 由此，敏捷者被教會在風中釋放死亡，指向看不見的地平線

entries.source: For the strongest shot is not the one that is witnessed, but the one that is only understood after it lands. - Codex Umbra
entries.simplified: 因为最强的射击并非所见的那一枪，而是
entries.traditional: 因為最強的射擊並非所見的那一槍，而是

entries.source: Let the work be done where none may hear, for necessity does not beg witness.
entries.simplified: 让工作在无人听闻之处完成，因为必需之事无需见证。
entries.traditional: 讓工作在無人聽聞之處完成，因為必需之事無需見證。

entries.source: The blade is made righteous not by promise, but by the end it delivers without delay.
entries.simplified: 刀刃不是因为承诺而变得正义，而是因为它无情地带来的终局
entries.traditional: 刀刃不是因為承諾而變得正義，而是因為它無情地帶來的終局

entries.source: Thus the hidden were taught to strike unseen, that skill and purpose remain unbroken by mercy.
entries.simplified: 故隐者被教导无声而击，使技艺与目的永存
entries.traditional: 故隱者被教導無聲而擊，使技藝與目的永存

entries.source: For a foe ended in silence is worth more than glory that warns him first. - Codex Umbra
entries.simplified: 无声而终的敌人，比先发警告的荣耀更值得尊敬。
entries.traditional: 無聲而終的敵人，比先發警告的榮耀更值得尊敬。

entries.source: When danger still hid beyond the edge of knowing, Vitae taught that vision must travel where the body could not.
entries.simplified: 当危险仍隐没于认知边界之外时，维泰教导了这种视觉
entries.traditional: 當危險仍隱沒於認知邊界之外時，維泰教導了這種視覺

entries.source: Distance was not made for fear, but for judgment, so that the wise might end ruin before it crossed the threshold.
entries.simplified: 距离不是为了恐惧而生,而是为了判断,使智者能够
entries.traditional: 距離不是為了恐懼而生,而是為了判斷,使智者能夠

entries.source: Thus the watchful were taught to see the shape of victory before the strike was loosed, that action would serve purpose instead of impulse.
entries.simplified: 因此警惕者被教会在一击前看到胜利的形态
entries.traditional: 因此警惕者被教會在一擊前看到勝利的形態

entries.source: For the surest hand is born first from the farthest sight. - Codex Vitae
entries.simplified: 因为最稳健的手首先源于最远的视野。- Codex Vitae
entries.traditional: 因為最穩健的手首先源於最遠的視野。- Codex Vitae

entries.source: When the path vanished between flame, frost, storm, and shadow, Umbra taught the Shinobi to become the bridge.
entries.simplified: 当道路在火焰、寒霜、风暴和暗影之间消失时，翁布拉教导了
entries.traditional: 當道路在火焰、寒霜、風暴和暗影之間消失時，翁布拉教導了

entries.source: The hidden blade did not ask the world for permission, only for a moment no eye could keep.
entries.simplified: 隐藏的刀刃没有向世界要求许可，只要求一个时刻
entries.traditional: 隱藏的刀刃沒有向世界要求許可，只要求一個時刻

entries.source: Thus the veiled were taught to release darkness between elemental signs, striking where pursuit had already lost its name.
entries.simplified: 就这样，被遮蔽者被教导在元素符号之间释放黑暗，
entries.traditional: 就這樣，被遮蔽者被教導在元素符號之間釋放黑暗，

entries.source: For the surest art is the one remembered only after it has disappeared. - Codex Umbra
entries.simplified: 最可靠的艺术是那些只在消失后才被铭记的艺术。-
entries.traditional: 最可靠的藝術是那些只在消失後才被銘記的藝術。-

entries.source: When fear rose higher than prayer, Umbra taught that power need not be begged if it can be bound.
entries.simplified: 当恐惧高于祈祷时，翁布拉教导权力无需乞求
entries.traditional: 當恐懼高於祈禱時，翁布拉教導權力無需乞求

entries.source: A word given, a spirit answered, and what the living lacked was supplied by covenant.
entries.simplified: 一言既出，灵魂应答，生者所缺由此供给
entries.traditional: 一言既出，靈魂應答，生者所缺由此供給

entries.source: Thus the sworn were taught to seal their will in ritual, that no weakness go unanswered and no plea remain empty.
entries.simplified: 所以宣誓者被教导在仪式中封印他们的意志，使得没有任何弱点
entries.traditional: 所以宣誓者被教導在儀式中封印他們的意志，使得沒有任何弱點

entries.source: For truth is not found in grace alone, but in the pact that delivers what faith only promises. - Codex Umbra
entries.simplified: 因为真理不仅存在于恩典中，更存在于那给予什么的契约中
entries.traditional: 因為真理不僅存在於恩典中，更存在於那給予什麼的契約中

entries.source: Where the ground was scarred and ash remembered war, Umbra drank what lingered there.
entries.simplified: 在大地伤痕累累、灰烬还记着战争的地方，暗影饮尽了残留的一切
entries.traditional: 在大地傷痕累累、灰燼還記著戰爭的地方，暗影飲盡了殘留的一切

entries.source: Not to deny the wound, but to keep its strength from fading into silence and dirt.
entries.simplified: 不是否认伤口，而是保持其力量不在沉默中消逝
entries.traditional: 不是否認傷口，而是保持其力量不在沉默中消逝

entries.source: Thus the hungry were taught to feed from ruin, that no fallen breath be squandered.
entries.simplified: 饥饿者被教导从废墟中汲取养分，使任何陨落的气息都不被浪费。
entries.traditional: 飢餓者被教導從廢墟中汲取養分，使任何隕落的氣息都不被浪費。

entries.source: For power is purest when it is taken back from death before the grave can close. - Codex Umbra
entries.simplified: 因为力量在被夺回死亡之前是最纯净的，在坟墓能够
entries.traditional: 因為力量在被奪回死亡之前是最純淨的，在墳墓能夠

entries.source: When softer hands failed against the world's cruelty, Umbra taught that strength is not born once, but hammered into being again and again.
entries.simplified: 当温柔的双手在世界的残酷面前失败时，Umbra教导力量
entries.traditional: 當溫柔的雙手在世界的殘酷面前失敗時，Umbra教導力量

entries.source: Impact was not a cost to be feared, but the law by which weakness was driven out and resolve made real.
entries.simplified: 冲击不是应该害怕的代价，而是驱赶弱点的法则
entries.traditional: 衝擊不是應該害怕的代價，而是驅趕弱點的法則

entries.source: Thus the hardened were taught to strike, endure, and strike again, until force itself became memory written into flesh and iron.
entries.simplified: 就这样，那些已锻炼的战士被教导要攻击、坚持并再次攻击，直到
entries.traditional: 就這樣，那些已鍛煉的戰士被教導要攻擊、堅持並再次攻擊，直到

entries.source: For power belongs not to the untouched, but to the one who survives the blow and returns it greater. - Codex Umbra
entries.simplified: 因为力量不属于未受伤者，而属于能在打击中生存的人
entries.traditional: 因為力量不屬於未受傷者，而屬於能在打擊中生存的人

entries.source: When scattered threads of fire, frost, thunder, and stone pulled against the loom, Vitae taught the Weaver to answer gently.
entries.simplified: 当散落的火焰、冰霜、雷电和石头的丝线被拉紧时
entries.traditional: 當散落的火焰、冰霜、雷電和石頭的絲線被拉緊時

entries.source: Fate was not a chain, but a pattern, and every bolt was a strand returned to its proper crossing.
entries.simplified: 命运不是枷锁，而是图案，每一道闪电都是归来的纺线
entries.traditional: 命運不是鎖鏈，而是圖案，每一道閃電都是歸來的紡線

entries.source: Thus the careful were taught to mend battle with ordered elements, shaping many paths without breaking the hand that walked them.
entries.simplified: 这样，谨慎的人被教导用有序的元素修补战斗，塑造
entries.traditional: 這樣，謹慎的人被教導用有序的元素修補戰鬥，塑造

entries.source: For destiny is brightest when power is woven without tearing the world that bears it. - Codex Vitae
entries.simplified: 因为当力量在不撕裂世界的情况下编织时,命运最闪耀
entries.traditional: 因為當力量在不撕裂世界的情況下編織時,命運最閃耀

entries.source: When the sky became a machine of screaming wind, Umbra taught the Wizard to place a hand upon its turning heart.
entries.simplified: 当天空成为尖叫风的机器时，暗影教导了巫师
entries.traditional: 當天空成為尖叫風的機器時，暗影教導了巫師

entries.source: Lightning was not a warning, but a command, and thunder the measure by which hesitation was shattered.
entries.simplified: 闪电不是警告，而是命令，雷鸣是衡量的标准
entries.traditional: 閃電不是警告，而是命令，雷鳴是衡量的標準

entries.source: Thus the stormbound were taught to drive spell after spell through the gale, until the air itself became an engine of ruin.
entries.simplified: 暴风束缚者因此被教会一次又一次地通过狂风驱动咒语，
entries.traditional: 暴風束縛者因此被教會一次又一次地通過狂風驅動咒語，

entries.source: For the wind obeys most faithfully when it is given a storm to remember. - Codex Umbra
entries.simplified: 因为风在被赋予一场风暴来铭记时，最忠实地服从。
entries.traditional: 因為風在被賦予一場風暴來銘記時，最忠實地服從。

entries.source: When the river of life fled too quickly from loss, Umbra taught the Wizard to still its passing.
entries.simplified: 当生命之河因失去而逃逸得太快时，暗影教导了巫师
entries.traditional: 當生命之河因失去而逃逸得太快時，暗影教導了巫師

entries.source: Ice was not absence, but dominion, a silence strong enough to keep motion, breath, and terror exactly where they stood.
entries.simplified: 冰非缺失，乃统治，一种足以禁止动作的沉寂，
entries.traditional: 冰非缺失，乃統治，一種足以禁止動作的沉寂，

entries.source: Thus the frostbound were taught to crown the field in winter, where shard and ground answered the same unmoving will.
entries.simplified: 因此被冰冻束缚的人被教导在冬天用碎片来统治战场
entries.traditional: 因此被冰凍束縛的人被教導在冬天用碎片來統治戰場

entries.source: For what is frozen is not gone, but held until power decides its thaw. - Codex Umbra
entries.simplified: 被冰冻的东西并未消失,而是被冻结,直到力量决定其解冻。 -
entries.traditional: 被冰凍的東西並未消失,而是被凍結,直到力量決定其解凍。 -

entries.source: When the heavens burned above a world afraid to change, Vitae taught the Wizard that fire could be renewal.
entries.simplified: 当天空在一个害怕改变的世界上燃烧时，维泰传授了
entries.traditional: 當天空在一個害怕改變的世界上燃燒時，維泰傳授了

entries.source: The falling star was not summoned to revel in ruin, but to break what rot had claimed beyond healing.
entries.simplified: 坠落的星辰并非被召唤来沉溺于毁灭，而是为了摧毁腐烂之物
entries.traditional: 墜落的星辰並非被召喚來沉溺於毀滅，而是為了摧毀腐爛之物

entries.source: Thus the flamebound were taught to call pillar, meteor, and burst of heat where corrupted stillness needed an ending.
entries.simplified: 因此火焰束缚者被教导召唤柱、流星和炽热爆发
entries.traditional: 因此火焰束縛者被教導召喚柱、流星和熾熱爆發

entries.source: For life sometimes returns only after the old darkness has been turned to ash. - Codex Vitae
entries.simplified: 因为生命有时只有在古老的黑暗转变为之后才会回归
entries.traditional: 因為生命有時只有在古老的黑暗轉變為之後才會回歸

entries.source: When the world remembered the first balance beneath every spell, Vitae taught the Wizard to stand at the center of the elements.
entries.simplified: 当世界回忆起每个咒语下的第一个平衡时，维泰教导了
entries.traditional: 當世界回憶起每個咒語下的第一個平衡時，維泰教導了

entries.source: Flame, frost, storm, and stone were gathered not as rivals, but as guardians circling one patient will.
entries.simplified: 火焰、霜冻、风暴和石头聚集在一起，不是作为对手，而是作为守护者
entries.traditional: 火焰、霜凍、風暴和石頭聚集在一起，不是作為對手，而是作為守護者

entries.source: Thus the elementalist was taught to cast without breaking focus, raising barriers and currents that turned force into harmony.
entries.simplified: 因此元素法师被教导在不失去专注的情况下施法，提升
entries.traditional: 因此元素法師被教導在不失去專注的情況下施法，提升

entries.source: For the world is strongest where every element keeps its place and protects the whole. - Codex Vitae
entries.simplified: 因为世界在每个元素都保持其位置并保护的地方最强大
entries.traditional: 因為世界在每個元素都保持其位置並保護的地方最強大

entries.source: A sealed relic box marked with polished bronze trim, its weight shifting as if the artifact inside has not chosen its shape. Contains a random advanced class artifact.
entries.simplified: 一个以抛光青铜饰边封缄的遗物匣，重量不断变换，仿佛其中的神器尚未决定自己的形态。内含一件随机进阶职业神器。
entries.traditional: 一個以拋光青銅飾邊封緘的遺物匣，重量不斷變化，彷彿其中的神器尚未決定自己的形態。內含一件隨機進階職業神器。

entries.simplified: 内含一件随机神器。
entries.traditional: 內含一件隨機神器。

entries.source: A worn relic box wrapped in faded travel cloth, carrying the promise of old beginnings and forgotten roads. Contains a random base class artifact.
entries.simplified: 一个用褪色旅布包裹的旧遗物匣，承载着昔日启程与遗忘道路的许诺。内含一件随机基础职业神器。
entries.traditional: 一個用褪色旅布包裹的破舊遺物匣，承載著昔日啟程與被遺忘道路的承諾。內含一件隨機基礎職業神器。

entries.simplified: 内含一件随机神器。
entries.traditional: 內含一件隨機神器。

entries.source: A strange device that ticks out of rhythm, as if watched by a tall one-eyed alien with long drifting limbs.
entries.simplified: 一个以错乱节奏滴答作响的奇怪装置，仿佛正被某个身形高挑、独眼且长肢飘曳的外星生物注视着。
entries.traditional: 一個以錯亂節奏滴答作響的奇特裝置，彷彿正被某個身形高挑、獨眼且長肢飄曳的外星生物注視著。

entries.source: A luminous pearl earring that shines with the soft wings and golden halo of a holy caster.
entries.simplified: 一枚发光的珍珠耳环，映现出神圣施法者柔和的羽翼与金色光环。
entries.traditional: 一枚散發光芒的珍珠耳環，映現出神聖施法者柔和的羽翼與金色光環。

entries.source: A cluster of overripe grapes split with sweetness, rich enough to wake a dark winged beast with glowing eyes.
entries.simplified: 一串熟透开裂、甜汁四溢的葡萄，香甜得足以唤醒一头双眼发光的暗翼巨兽。
entries.traditional: 一串熟透開裂、甜汁四溢的葡萄，香甜得足以喚醒一頭雙眼發光的暗翼巨獸。

entries.source: A chunk of cactus flesh leaking sticky sap, still prickling with the strength of a hulking green creature covered in thorns.
entries.simplified: 一块渗出黏稠汁液的仙人掌果肉，刺麻间仍透着那头浑身覆刺的魁梧绿色生物的力量。
entries.traditional: 一塊滲出黏稠汁液的仙人掌果肉，刺麻之間仍透著那頭渾身覆刺的魁梧綠色生物的力量。

entries.source: A curved fishbone picked clean, carrying a sharp storm scent that draws a dark cat with crackling pink horns.
entries.simplified: 一根被啃得干干净净的弯曲鱼骨，带着尖锐的风暴气息，吸引着一只长有噼啪作响的粉色尖角的黑猫。
entries.traditional: 一根被啃得乾乾淨淨的彎曲魚骨，帶著銳利的風暴氣息，吸引著一隻長有劈啪作響粉紅尖角的黑貓。

entries.source: A jagged black shard that reflects a horned shadow wrapped in a dark cloak.
entries.simplified: 一枚锯齿状的黑色碎片，映出一道裹在暗色斗篷中的角影。
entries.traditional: 一枚鋸齒狀的黑色碎片，映出一道裹在暗色斗篷中的角影。

entries.source: A carved octopus effigy drenched in brine and deep-sea ichor. Its presence disturbs the waters, drawing the gaze of the ancient Kraken below.
entries.simplified: 一尊浸满盐水与深海灵液的章鱼雕像。它的存在搅扰水域，引来下方古老 Kraken 的凝视。
entries.traditional: 一尊浸滿鹽水與深海靈液的章魚雕像。它的存在擾亂水域，引來下方古老 Kraken 的凝視。

entries.source: A chipped golden fang that gleams with the greed of a hulking goblin brute with red eyes, spiked armor, and a heavy shield.
entries.simplified: 一颗带有缺口的金色獠牙，闪烁着一头红眼、身披尖刺铠甲并手持重盾的魁梧哥布林蛮兵的贪欲。
entries.traditional: 一顆帶有缺口的金色獠牙，閃爍著一頭紅眼、身披尖刺鎧甲並手持重盾的魁梧哥布林蠻兵的貪念。

entries.source: A jeweled weapon sheath marked for war, carrying the threat of a hulking goblin leader with a horned crown, golden weapons, and a heavy shield.
entries.simplified: 一个镶嵌宝石、刻有战纹的武器鞘，承载着一名戴角冠、持金色武器与重盾的魁梧哥布林首领所带来的威胁。
entries.traditional: 一個鑲嵌寶石、刻有戰紋的武器鞘，承載著一名戴角冠、持金色武器與重盾的魁梧哥布林首領所帶來的威脅。

entries.source: A cracked acorn marked by tiny teeth, carrying the heavy steps of a rabbit far too large for the meadow.
entries.simplified: 一颗布满细小齿痕的裂纹橡果，仿佛带着一只对草原而言大得过分的兔子的沉重脚步。
entries.traditional: 一顆布滿細小齒痕的裂紋橡實，彷彿帶著一隻對草原而言大得過分的兔子的沉重腳步。

entries.source: A weathered shell core worn smooth by old tides, heavy with the presence of a massive crab beneath a spiked shell.
entries.simplified: 一块被古老潮汐磨得光滑的风化甲壳核心，沉甸甸地承载着尖刺甲壳下那只巨蟹的存在感。
entries.traditional: 一塊被古老潮汐磨得光滑的風化甲殼核心，沉甸甸地承載著尖刺甲殼下那隻巨蟹的存在感。

entries.source: A flawless frozen crystal that chills the air around a robed figure crowned with floating ice.
entries.simplified: 一枚完美无瑕的冰封水晶，使一名头戴悬浮冰晶冠冕的长袍身影周围寒气逼人。
entries.traditional: 一枚完美無瑕的冰封水晶，使一名頭戴懸浮冰晶冠冕的長袍身影周圍寒氣逼人。

entries.source: A blank scroll stained with ash, waiting for the mark of a massive red demon with wings and claws.
entries.simplified: 一张染着灰烬的空白卷轴，等待一头长有双翼与利爪的巨型红色恶魔留下印记。
entries.traditional: 一張染著灰燼的空白卷軸，等待一頭長有雙翼與利爪的巨型紅色惡魔留下印記。

entries.source: A splinter of frozen core crystal that radiates the crushing weight of a hulking golem carved from solid ice.
entries.simplified: 一枚冰封核心水晶的碎片，散发着一尊由实心寒冰雕成的魁梧魔像所带来的压倒性重量。
entries.traditional: 一枚冰封核心水晶的碎片，散發著一尊由堅冰雕成的魁梧魔像所帶來的壓倒性重量。

entries.source: A glowing clot of royal jelly, sweet enough to wake a huge purple worm wrapped in spikes.
entries.simplified: 一团发光的蜂王浆，甜得足以唤醒一条浑身覆刺的巨大紫色蠕虫。
entries.traditional: 一團發光的蜂王乳，甜得足以喚醒一條渾身覆刺的巨大紫色蠕蟲。

entries.source: A hardened desert termite with a bitter scent, stirring the threat of an armored scorpion with heavy claws and a raised stinger.
entries.simplified: 一只硬化的沙漠白蚁，散发着苦涩气味，唤起一只拥有巨钳与高举尾刺的铠甲蝎王所带来的威胁。
entries.traditional: 一隻硬化的沙漠白蟻，散發著苦澀氣味，喚起一隻擁有巨鉗與高舉尾刺的鎧甲蠍王所帶來的威脅。

entries.source: A slab of blood-warm meat with a heavy scent, enough to draw a many-headed serpent from the dark.
entries.simplified: 一大块仍带着血温、气味浓烈的肉，足以从黑暗中引出一条多头巨蛇。
entries.traditional: 一大塊仍帶著血溫、氣味濃烈的肉，足以從黑暗中引出一條多頭巨蛇。

entries.source: A dense coil of enchanted webbing that hums with the quiet motion of a black mechanical spider tipped in red.
entries.simplified: 一卷致密的附魔蛛丝，随着一只肢端泛红的黑色机械蜘蛛无声移动而低鸣。
entries.traditional: 一捲緊密的附魔蛛絲，隨著一隻肢端泛紅的黑色機械蜘蛛無聲移動而低鳴。

entries.source: A honey-soaked hive fragment that trembles with the wings of a large insect.
entries.simplified: 一块浸满蜂蜜的蜂巢碎片，随着一只大型昆虫振翅而轻轻颤动。
entries.traditional: 一塊浸滿蜂蜜的蜂巢碎片，隨著一隻大型昆蟲振翅而輕輕顫動。

entries.source: A soft golden petal tuft that glows with the gentle grace of a flower-winged fairy.
entries.simplified: 一簇柔软的金色花瓣，闪耀着花翼仙子温柔优雅的光辉。
entries.traditional: 一簇柔軟的金色花瓣，閃耀著花翼仙子溫柔優雅的光輝。

entries.source: A cracked power node still pulsing with commands, meant for an armored turtle fighter with glowing tech and a blade of light.
entries.simplified: 一枚开裂却仍脉动着指令的动力节点，似乎专为一名身披铠甲、配备发光科技与光刃的龟族战士而造。
entries.traditional: 一枚裂開卻仍脈動著指令的動力節點，彷彿專為一名身披鎧甲、配備發光科技與光刃的龜族戰士而造。

entries.source: A cold moonlit shard that hums with the breath of a towering wolf-beast with crystal claws.
entries.simplified: 一块浸着冰冷月光的碎片，随着一头长有水晶利爪的高大狼兽呼吸而低鸣。
entries.traditional: 一塊浸著冰冷月光的碎片，隨著一頭長有水晶利爪的高大狼獸呼吸而低鳴。

entries.source: A clump of old sediment that shifts with the motion of a spiked worm beneath the soil.
entries.simplified: 一团古老的沉积物，随着土壤下那条尖刺蠕虫的蠕动而悄然移位。
entries.traditional: 一團古老的沉積物，隨著土壤下那條尖刺蠕蟲的蠕動而悄然移位。

entries.source: A mud-caked shoe left behind in panic, carrying the stomp of an undead goblin brute with a spiked club and battered shield.
entries.simplified: 一只在慌乱中遗落、沾满泥巴的鞋，仿佛还带着一头手持尖刺棍棒与破旧盾牌的不死哥布林蛮兵的重踏声。
entries.traditional: 一隻在慌亂中遺落、沾滿泥巴的鞋，彷彿還帶著一頭手持尖刺棍棒與破舊盾牌的不死哥布林蠻兵的重踏聲。

entries.source: A reinforced supply crate stamped with old route markings, packed for long journeys through wild roads and forgotten ruins.
entries.simplified: 一个加固的补给箱，印着古老的路线标记，为穿越荒野道路与遗忘废墟的漫长旅程装得满满当当。
entries.traditional: 一個加固的補給箱，印著古老的路線標記，為穿越荒野道路與被遺忘遺跡的漫長旅程裝得滿滿當當。

entries.simplified: 内含随机地图材料。
entries.traditional: 內含隨機地圖材料。

entries.source: A warm speckled egg that rocks gently when held, as if the creature inside already hears the call of open skies.
entries.simplified: 一枚温暖的斑点蛋，被捧起时会轻轻摇晃，仿佛里面的生物已经听见广阔天空的召唤。
entries.traditional: 一顆溫暖的斑點蛋，被捧起時會輕輕搖晃，彷彿裡面的生物已經聽見無垠天際的召喚。

entries.simplified: 内含一只随机怪物坐骑。
entries.traditional: 內含一隻隨機魔物坐騎。

entries.source: A small spotted egg that shifts softly in the palm, full of quiet scratches and sleepy warmth.
entries.simplified: 一枚小巧的斑点蛋，在掌心里轻轻动着，伴随细微的抓挠声与困倦的暖意。
entries.traditional: 一顆小巧的斑點蛋，在掌心裡輕輕挪動，伴隨細微的抓撓聲與慵懶暖意。

entries.simplified: 内含一只随机怪物宠物。
entries.traditional: 內含一隻隨機魔物寵物。

entries.source: A sturdy refinement crate sealed with iron bands, packed with rough materials for strengthening well-worn gear.
entries.simplified: 一个由铁箍封紧的坚固精炼箱，装满了可用于强化久经使用装备的粗制材料。
entries.traditional: 一個由鐵箍封緊的堅固精煉箱，裝滿可用來強化久經使用裝備的粗製材料。

entries.simplified: 内含随机精炼材料。
entries.traditional: 內含隨機精煉材料。

entries.source: A polished shard of luminous crystal etched with ancient glyphs, pulsing gently as though it remembers every road back home.
entries.simplified: 一块抛光的发光水晶碎片，刻有古老符文，轻柔地脉动着，仿佛仍记得每一条归乡之路。
entries.traditional: 一塊拋光的發光水晶碎片，刻有古老符文，輕柔地脈動著，彷彿仍記得每一條歸鄉之路。

entries.source: A set of red and blue glasses that makes your vision blurry. You have no idea what they could be used for.
entries.simplified: 一副红蓝双色眼镜，会让你的视野变得模糊。你根本不知道它能拿来做什么。
entries.traditional: 一副紅藍雙色眼鏡，會讓你的視野變得模糊。你完全不知道它能拿來做什麼。

entries.source: Purple crystal fragments drift around a blade touched by silence.
entries.simplified: 紫色水晶碎片环绕着一柄被寂静触碰的刀刃缓缓漂浮。
entries.traditional: 紫色水晶碎片環繞著一柄被寂靜觸碰的刀刃緩緩飄浮。

entries.source: Softly glowing scripture turns mercy into shelter for the wounded.
entries.simplified: 泛着柔光的经文将慈悲化作庇护伤者的屏障。
entries.traditional: 泛著柔光的經文將慈悲化作庇護傷者的屏障。

entries.source: Gilded pages urge each strike onward until faith hardens into radiance.
entries.simplified: 镀金书页催促每一次攻击向前，直到信念凝成光辉。
entries.traditional: 鍍金書頁催促每一次攻擊向前，直到信念凝成光輝。

entries.source: Bright verses sharpen holy light into judgment that lingers around the faithful.
entries.simplified: 明亮的诗句将圣光磨砺成审判，萦绕在虔诚信徒身旁。
entries.traditional: 明亮的詩句將聖光磨礪成審判，縈繞在虔誠信徒身旁。

entries.source: Gentle hymns fill the pages, deepening grace with every healing prayer.
entries.simplified: 温柔的圣歌写满书页，让每一次治疗祷告都加深恩典。
entries.traditional: 溫柔的聖歌寫滿書頁，讓每一次治療禱告都加深恩典。

entries.source: Threaded verses bend holy light faster, cleaner, and farther than ordinary prayer.
entries.simplified: 交织的诗篇让圣光比寻常祷告更快、更纯净，也能传得更远。
entries.traditional: 交織的詩篇讓聖光比尋常祈禱更快、更純淨，也能傳得更遠。

entries.source: Measured psalms keep hands steady and healing magic moving in perfect cadence.
entries.simplified: 节律严谨的赞美诗让双手保持稳定，使治疗魔法以完美节奏流转。
entries.traditional: 節律嚴謹的讚美詩讓雙手保持穩定，使治療魔法以完美節奏流轉。

entries.source: Its single eye follows movement closely before it attacks with its body or pale light.
entries.simplified: 它的独眼紧盯着一切动静，随后以身体或苍白光芒发动攻击。
entries.traditional: 它的獨眼緊盯著一切動靜，隨後以身體或蒼白光芒發動攻擊。

entries.source: This small poisonous growth releases spores whenever the air around it shifts.
entries.simplified: 每当周围空气产生变化，这株小型有毒菌体便会释放孢子。
entries.traditional: 每當周圍空氣產生變化，這株小型有毒菌體便會釋放孢子。

entries.source: This tiny star-shaped creature hovers above frozen ground and glows faintly in the snow.
entries.simplified: 这个星形小生物悬浮在冰封地面上方，在雪地中散发微弱光芒。
entries.traditional: 這個星形小生物懸浮在冰封地面上方，在雪地中散發微弱光芒。

entries.source: Its round body spins across the ground and leaves scorched marks behind it.
entries.simplified: 它圆滚滚的身体在地面上飞速旋转，沿途留下焦黑痕迹。
entries.traditional: 它圓滾滾的身體在地面上飛速旋轉，沿途留下焦黑痕跡。

entries.source: Silky orange ribbon, warm as a hopeful sunrise.
entries.simplified: 丝滑的橙色缎带，温暖得如同充满希望的朝阳。
entries.traditional: 絲滑的橘色緞帶，溫暖得如同充滿希望的朝陽。

entries.source: Polished amber catches light with a soft sunset glow.
entries.simplified: 抛光琥珀捕捉光线，泛起柔和的落日余辉。
entries.traditional: 拋光琥珀捕捉光線，泛起柔和的落日餘暉。

entries.source: Mystic wards glow beneath a polished jeweled crest.
entries.simplified: 神秘结界在抛光的宝石徽饰下方发光。
entries.traditional: 神祕結界在拋光的寶石徽飾下方發光。

entries.source: Arcane seams draw mana like frost pulling breath from air.
entries.simplified: 奥术接缝牵引魔力，如同寒霜从空气中抽走呼吸。
entries.traditional: 奧術接縫牽引魔力，如同寒霜從空氣中抽走呼吸。

entries.source: Starlit enchantments steady every step through practiced spellwork.
entries.simplified: 星光附魔稳住每一步，让娴熟的施法从容展开。
entries.traditional: 星光附魔穩住每一步，讓嫻熟的施法從容展開。

entries.source: Careful hands move faster when magic knows where to flow.
entries.simplified: 当魔法知晓该流向何处时，谨慎的双手也会动作得更快。
entries.traditional: 當魔法知道該流向何處時，謹慎的雙手也會動得更快。

entries.source: Runed fabric keeps motion, balance, and spellwork in rhythm.
entries.simplified: 符文织物让动作、平衡与施法保持同一节奏。
entries.traditional: 符文織物讓動作、平衡與施法保持同一節奏。

entries.source: Broad wings and steady radiance mark this celestial guardian as a stronger holy caster.
entries.simplified: 宽阔羽翼与稳定辉光表明，这名天界守护者是一位更强大的神圣施法者。
entries.traditional: 寬闊羽翼與穩定輝光表明，這名天界守護者是一位更強大的神聖施法者。

entries.source: Flowing plates carry the wearer through battle with less resistance.
entries.simplified: 流线型甲片减少阻力，带着穿戴者穿行于战场。
entries.traditional: 流線型甲片減少阻力，帶著穿戴者穿梭戰場。

entries.source: Refined armor sharpens movement until each strike lands cleanly under pressure.
entries.simplified: 精制护甲磨砺动作，使每一击即使承受压力也能干净命中。
entries.traditional: 精製護甲磨礪動作，使每一擊即使承受壓力也能俐落命中。

entries.source: Arcane threads hum through the plating, guiding hidden knowledge outward.
entries.simplified: 奥术丝线在甲片间低鸣，引导隐秘知识显现于外。
entries.traditional: 奧術絲線在甲片間低鳴，引導隱祕知識顯現於外。

entries.simplified: 细微的护符礼貌地扭转运气。
entries.traditional: 細微的護符有禮地扭轉運氣。

entries.source: Reinforced armor channels raw might through every committed strike forward.
entries.simplified: 强化护甲将纯粹力量导入每一次坚定向前的攻击。
entries.traditional: 強化護甲將純粹力量導入每一次堅決向前的攻擊。

entries.source: Layered steel outlasts hardship, siege weather, and most bad ideas.
entries.simplified: 层叠钢甲经得住艰难、攻城风雨，以及大多数馊主意。
entries.traditional: 層疊鋼甲經得住艱難、攻城風雨，以及大多數餿主意。

entries.source: Enough arrows to make confidence feel reasonable.
entries.simplified: 箭矢多得足以让这份自信显得合情合理。
entries.traditional: 箭矢多得足以讓這份自信顯得合情合理。

entries.source: Iron remembers every arrow that failed to pass.
entries.simplified: 铁壁记得每一支未能穿透它的箭。
entries.traditional: 鐵壁記得每一支未能穿透它的箭。

entries.source: Old arrows still sleep in its battered wood.
entries.simplified: 古老的箭矢仍沉睡在它伤痕累累的木板中。
entries.traditional: 古老的箭矢仍沉睡在它傷痕累累的木板中。

entries.source: A bow blessed by unseen hands. Its arrows fly true and far, striking with precision no shield can fully deny.
entries.simplified: 一把受无形之手祝福的弓。箭矢飞得又准又远，以任何盾牌都无法完全抵挡的精度命中目标。
entries.traditional: 一把受無形之手祝福的弓。箭矢飛得又準又遠，以任何盾牌都無法完全抵擋的精準命中目標。

entries.source: Sacred radiance gathers in a soft halo around the honored soul. Stillness turns into blessed dignity while grace lingers nearby with calm purpose.
entries.simplified: 圣洁光辉在受敬仰的灵魂周围凝成柔和光环。静谧化作受祝福的尊严，恩典则带着沉静的使命停驻近旁。
entries.traditional: 聖潔光輝在受敬仰的靈魂周圍凝成柔和光環。靜謐化作受祝福的尊嚴，恩典則帶著沉靜的使命停駐近旁。

entries.source: Dark force coils in a crimson ring around the dark heir. Infernal power thickens the air and warns the battlefield before any weapon is raised.
entries.simplified: 黑暗力量在黑暗继承者周围盘绕成猩红圆环。地狱之力令空气变得沉重，在任何武器举起之前便已向战场发出警告。
entries.traditional: 黑暗力量在黑暗繼承者周圍盤繞成猩紅圓環。地獄之力令空氣變得沉重，在任何武器舉起之前便已向戰場發出警告。

entries.source: Frozen veins pulse through an axe that leaves only silence behind.
entries.simplified: 冰冷的脉络在斧中搏动，所过之处只留下寂静。
entries.traditional: 冰冷的脈絡在斧中搏動，所過之處只留下寂靜。

entries.source: “Every legend starts with a tool that can split wood and trouble alike.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “每段传奇，都始于一件既能劈开木头，也能劈开麻烦的工具。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “每段傳奇，都始於一件既能劈開木頭，也能劈開麻煩的工具。” — Suphara

entries.source: Caution: Do not use to clash against other antlers. Instead these antlers are used to draw in the natural energies of the world.
entries.simplified: 注意：请勿用它与其他鹿角相撞。这对鹿角是用来引导世界中的自然能量的。
entries.traditional: 注意：請勿用它與其他鹿角相撞。這對鹿角是用來引導世界中的自然能量的。

entries.source: Crystalline blue edges sharpen thought into focused power.
entries.simplified: 水晶般的蓝色锋缘将思绪磨砺为专注的力量。
entries.traditional: 水晶般的藍色鋒緣將思緒磨礪為專注力量。

entries.source: “Wind on the edge, water at your back. Parry steady, then cut where the tide breaks.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “刃上有风，背后有水。稳稳架开，再朝潮水断裂之处劈下。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “刃上有風，背後有水。穩穩架開，再朝潮水斷裂之處劈下。” — Suphara

entries.source: Cobalt lines hold disciplined spell power in simple form.
entries.simplified: 钴蓝纹路以简洁的形态约束着严谨的法术力量。
entries.traditional: 鈷藍紋路以簡潔形態約束著嚴謹的法術力量。

entries.source: Focus brightens each blue facet from within.
entries.simplified: 专注从内部点亮每一块蓝色切面。
entries.traditional: 專注從內部點亮每一塊藍色切面。

entries.source: Waxed academy canvas sits neatly buckled, carrying the quiet pride of a prepared scholar.
entries.simplified: 上蜡的学院帆布整齐扣好，承载着一名准备充分的学者那份安静的自豪。
entries.traditional: 上蠟的學院帆布整齊扣好，承載著一名準備充分的學者那份安靜的自豪。

entries.source: White wings rise from founder regalia in a clear radiant spread. Their ascent completes the costume as a sign of heavenly recognition.
entries.simplified: 洁白双翼从创始者礼装背后展开，形成明亮而辉耀的翼展。它们的升起使整套装束完整，成为天界认可的象征。
entries.traditional: 潔白雙翼從創始者禮裝背後展開，形成明亮而輝耀的翼展。它們的升起使整套裝束完整，成為天界認可的象徵。

entries.source: Golden plush feathers turn this chick pack into a cheerful little keepsake from beak to wingtip.
entries.simplified: 金色毛绒羽毛从喙尖延伸至翼梢，将这只小鸡背包化作一件欢快可爱的纪念品。
entries.traditional: 金色毛絨羽毛從喙尖延伸至翼梢，將這個小雞背包化作一件歡快可愛的紀念品。

entries.source: Glossy red silk floats overhead with the suspicious cheer of a festival prank.
entries.simplified: 亮泽红绸在头顶飘浮，带着节庆恶作剧般令人起疑的欢欣。
entries.traditional: 亮澤紅綢在頭頂飄浮，帶著節慶惡作劇般令人起疑的歡欣。

entries.source: Moon-dappled caps crowd this wooden bucket with more life than mushrooms should have.
entries.simplified: 洒满月光的菌盖挤满这只木桶，活泼得远超过蘑菇应有的程度。
entries.traditional: 灑滿月光的菌蓋擠滿這個木桶，活潑得遠超過蘑菇應有的程度。

entries.source: Violet fur bristles with stormlight, marking the wearer with regal feline voltage.
entries.simplified: 紫罗兰色皮毛因风暴之光而竖起，让穿戴者染上高贵猫科生物般的雷电气息。
entries.traditional: 紫羅蘭色皮毛因風暴之光而竪起，讓穿戴者染上高貴貓科生物般的雷電氣息。

entries.source: Frost-cut feathers catch pale light across every crystalline edge.
entries.simplified: 霜晶雕琢的羽毛在每一道水晶棱缘上捕捉苍白光芒。
entries.traditional: 霜晶雕琢的羽毛在每一道水晶稜緣上捕捉蒼白光芒。

entries.source: Black crow wings spread behind the supporter in a broad feathered silhouette. Raven shadow follows each step with bold theatrical presence.
entries.simplified: 黑色乌鸦双翼在支持者背后宽阔展开，形成鲜明的羽翼剪影。渡鸦般的暗影追随每一步，带着大胆而戏剧化的存在感。
entries.traditional: 黑色烏鴉雙翼在支持者背後寬闊展開，形成鮮明的羽翼剪影。渡鴉般的暗影追隨每一步，帶著大膽而戲劇化的存在感。

entries.source: Black wings flare behind the runner with blades of radiant magenta energy. Spelltech power opens into flight and turns motion into a bright signal.
entries.simplified: 黑色双翼在奔行者背后张开，仿佛由辉耀的洋红能量刀刃组成。Spelltech 力量展开为飞行之姿，将动作化作明亮的信号。
entries.traditional: 黑色雙翼在奔行者背後張開，彷彿由輝耀的洋紅能量刀刃組成。Spelltech 力量展開為飛行之姿，將動作化作明亮的信號。

entries.source: Shadowed wings spread wide with crimson edges and forbidden grandeur. Old pacts trail from each motion and turn ornament into omen.
entries.simplified: 笼罩暗影的双翼带着猩红边缘与禁忌威仪向外舒展。古老契约拖曳于每一次动作之后，让装饰化作预兆。
entries.traditional: 籠罩暗影的雙翼帶著猩紅邊緣與禁忌威儀向外舒展。古老契約拖曳於每一次動作之後，讓裝飾化作預兆。

entries.source: Crimson scales flare from the back in a trophy of draconic pride.
entries.simplified: 猩红鳞片从背后张开，如同彰显龙族荣耀的战利品。
entries.traditional: 猩紅鱗片從背後張開，如同彰顯龍族榮耀的戰利品。

entries.source: Twin battle axes rest across the shoulders like a mercenary's personal crest.
entries.simplified: 两柄战斧交叉倚在肩头，宛如佣兵专属的个人纹章。
entries.traditional: 兩柄戰斧交叉倚在肩頭，宛如傭兵專屬的個人紋章。

entries.source: Iridescent wings shimmer with the hush of hidden glades.
entries.simplified: 虹彩双翼闪烁着隐秘林谷般的静谧光泽。
entries.traditional: 虹彩雙翼閃爍著隱秘林谷般的靜謐光澤。

entries.source: Painted clay cradles fresh blossoms from some stubbornly cheerful garden.
entries.simplified: 彩绘陶盆托住新鲜花朵，仿佛来自某座固执得过分欢快的花园。
entries.traditional: 彩繪陶盆托住新鮮花朵，彷彿來自某座固執得過分歡快的花園。

entries.source: Tempered bronze plates glow with heat remembered from the anvil.
entries.simplified: 淬炼青铜甲片泛着铁砧余温，仿佛仍记得锻炉烈火。
entries.traditional: 淬煉青銅甲片泛著鐵砧余溫，彷彿仍記得鍛爐烈火。

entries.source: White ceremonial cloth falls from the shoulders, sealed by a golden sigil of conviction.
entries.simplified: 洁白礼仪披风自肩头垂落，由一枚象征信念的金色符印封住。
entries.traditional: 潔白禮儀披風自肩頭垂落，由一枚象徵信念的金色符印封住。

entries.source: Clear glass holds a slow stream of sand inside timekeeper glasswork.
entries.simplified: 清澈玻璃中，细沙在计时器工艺里缓慢流淌。
entries.traditional: 清澈玻璃中，細沙在計時器工藝里緩慢流淌。

entries.source: Weathered leather hangs heavy with gem dust from old tunnel work.
entries.simplified: 饱经风霜的皮革沉沉垂落，沾满旧日矿道留下的宝石粉尘。
entries.traditional: 飽經風霜的皮革沉沉垂落，沾滿舊日礦道留下的寶石粉塵。

entries.source: Torn blue cloth trails with veteran dignity from roads that rarely forgive.
entries.simplified: 撕裂的蓝布在身后拖曳，带着走过无情道路的老兵尊严。
entries.traditional: 撕裂的藍布在身後拖曳，帶著走過無情道路的老兵尊嚴。

entries.source: Velvet paws cling to this bear pack like a childhood relic kept too close.
entries.simplified: 天鹅绒熊掌紧紧抱住这只小熊背包，像一件不愿放远的童年遗物。
entries.traditional: 天鵝絨熊掌緊緊抱住這個小熊背包，像一件不願放遠的童年遺物。

entries.source: Shadow-black feathers fall behind the shoulders with solemn cathedral grace.
entries.simplified: 暗影般漆黑的羽毛从肩后垂落，带着大教堂式的肃穆优雅。
entries.traditional: 暗影般漆黑的羽毛從肩後垂落，帶著大教堂式的肅穆優雅。

entries.source: Pale wings rest against the back under a gentle restorative glow.
entries.simplified: 苍白双翼静静贴在背后，笼罩着温柔的复苏光辉。
entries.traditional: 蒼白雙翼靜靜貼在背後，籠罩著溫柔的復蘇光輝。

entries.source: A loyal pack rests ready for long roads and shared trouble. Packborn pride marks the traveler with courage to keep moving with companions.
entries.simplified: 一套忠诚的行囊已为漫长旅途与共同麻烦做好准备。Packborn 的骄傲赋予旅人继续与伙伴同行的勇气。
entries.traditional: 一套忠誠的行囊已為漫長旅途與共同麻煩做好準備。Packborn 的驕傲賦予旅人繼續與夥伴同行的勇氣。

entries.source: Used to store many things. It is designed to carry your burdens.
entries.simplified: 用来存放许多东西。它生来就是替你背负重担的。
entries.traditional: 用來存放許多東西。它生來就是替你背負重擔的。

entries.source: An infernal sigil burns beside the name with ember-dark authority. Forbidden triumph marks the Ultimate Founder with a legacy few adventurers will ever claim.
entries.simplified: 一枚地狱符印在名字旁燃烧，散发着如暗色余烬般的权威。禁忌般的凯旋标志着 Ultimate Founder 的传承，那是极少数冒险者才能拥有的荣耀。
entries.traditional: 一枚地獄符印在名字旁燃燒，散髮著如暗色餘燼般的權威。禁忌般的凱旋標誌著 Ultimate Founder 的傳承，那是極少數冒險者才能擁有的榮耀。

entries.source: A golden seal shines beside the name as a visible mark of creative victory. Rare fortune honors the craft of shaping SpiritVale through imagination.
entries.simplified: 一枚金色印章在名字旁闪耀，成为创意胜利的醒目标记。罕见的幸运嘉奖那些以想象力塑造 SpiritVale 的工艺。
entries.traditional: 一枚金色印章在名字旁閃耀，成為創意勝利的醒目標記。罕見的幸運嘉獎那些以想象力塑造 SpiritVale 的工藝。

entries.source: Leather wrapped tight for dust, trouble, and quick escapes.
entries.simplified: 皮革紧紧缠绕，足以应付尘土、麻烦和仓促逃亡。
entries.traditional: 皮革緊緊纏繞，足以應付塵土、麻煩和倉促逃亡。

entries.source: Orange cloth marks the one others follow.
entries.simplified: 橙色布幡标示着众人追随之人。
entries.traditional: 橘色布幡標示著眾人追隨之人。

entries.source: Thin wings carry this venomous cave-dweller through cramped passages.
entries.simplified: 轻薄双翼托着这只带毒的洞穴生物穿过狭窄通道。
entries.traditional: 輕薄雙翼托著這隻帶毒的洞穴生物穿過狹窄通道。

entries.source: One bright eye watches from a cursed little companion.
entries.simplified: 一只明亮的眼睛从这个受诅咒的小伙伴身上注视着一切。
entries.traditional: 一隻明亮的眼睛從這個受詛咒的小夥伴身上注視著一切。

entries.source: A red plume marks the first spark of trouble.
entries.simplified: 一根红色羽饰标志着麻烦燃起的第一点火星。
entries.traditional: 一根紅色羽飾標誌著麻煩燃起的第一點火星。

entries.source: Bear-shaped padding carries burdens with quiet strength.
entries.simplified: 熊形软垫以沉静的力量替你背负重担。
entries.traditional: 熊形軟墊以沉靜力量替你背負重擔。

entries.source: This plush little cub gently hugs your head; little armor, plenty of charm.
entries.simplified: 这只毛绒小熊轻轻抱住你的脑袋；防护不多，魅力十足。
entries.traditional: 這隻絨毛小熊輕輕抱住你的腦袋；防護不多，魅力十足。

entries.source: Fangs and bone turn fear into a helm.
entries.simplified: 獠牙与白骨将恐惧铸成头盔。
entries.traditional: 獠牙與白骨將恐懼鑄成頭盔。

entries.source: Gaping jaws make this hood look hungry.
entries.simplified: 大张的兽口让这顶兜帽看起来饥肠辘辘。
entries.traditional: 大張的獸口讓這頂兜帽看起來飢腸轆轆。

entries.source: Rugged hide wraps close, wild and untamed.
entries.simplified: 粗犷兽皮紧贴包裹，野性而不受驯服。
entries.traditional: 粗獷獸皮緊貼包覆，野性而不受馴服。

entries.source: Small striped insects ride meadow gusts from flower to flower.
entries.simplified: 小型条纹昆虫乘着草原微风在花朵之间穿梭。
entries.traditional: 小型條紋昆蟲乘著草原微風在花朵之間穿梭。

entries.source: Raw power beats through the wild plates, eager for the charge.
entries.simplified: 原始力量在狂野甲片间搏动，迫不及待地迎接冲锋。
entries.traditional: 原始力量在狂野甲片間搏動，迫不及待迎接衝鋒。

entries.source: Torn battle pages teach every shout to carry courage farther.
entries.simplified: 撕裂的战斗书页教会每一声呐喊将勇气传得更远。
entries.traditional: 撕裂的戰鬥書頁教會每一聲吶喊將勇氣傳得更遠。

entries.source: Blood-red ink thrashes across the page, hungry for the next critical strike.
entries.simplified: 血红墨迹在书页上狂乱翻腾，渴求下一次暴击。
entries.traditional: 血紅墨跡在書頁上狂亂翻騰，渴求下一次暴擊。

entries.source: Savage notes reward every fallen foe with momentum, fury, and terrible focus.
entries.simplified: 狂野笔记让每个倒下的敌人都化作冲势、怒火与可怕的专注。
entries.traditional: 狂野筆記讓每個倒下的敵人都化作衝勢、怒火與可怕的專注。

entries.source: A grim manual for ending hesitation when weakened enemies stand too long.
entries.simplified: 一本阴郁的手册，教你在虚弱敌人苟延残喘时彻底斩断犹豫。
entries.traditional: 一本陰鬱的手冊，教你在虛弱敵人苟延殘喘時徹底斬斷猶豫。

entries.source: These gritty boots stomp forward like retreat owes them money.
entries.simplified: 这双沾满尘土的靴子大步向前，仿佛撤退还欠它们钱。
entries.traditional: 這雙沾滿塵土的靴子大步向前，彷彿撤退還欠它們錢。

entries.source: Rugged armor pushes forward, leaving caution somewhere behind the wearer.
entries.simplified: 粗犷的护甲不断向前，把谨慎远远落在穿戴者身后。
entries.traditional: 粗獷的護甲不斷向前，把謹慎遠遠留在穿戴者身後。

entries.source: “Bind the dead tight, lad. Then let them answer faster and hit harder than they did in life.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “把死者绑紧点，小子。然后让他们比活着时回应得更快、打得更狠。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “把死者綁緊點，小子。然後讓他們比活著時回應得更快、打得更狠。” — Suphara

entries.source: Dark steel stays reliable after every ugly fight.
entries.simplified: 乌黑的钢铁在每一场难看的战斗后依然可靠。
entries.traditional: 烏黑的鋼鐵在每一場難看的戰鬥後依然可靠。

entries.source: Forged in the night garden when light and shadow become one. It is said that its edge is sharp enough to sever one from their shadow, while the hilt's warmth soothes the user's wounds.
entries.simplified: 在光与影融为一体的夜之花园中锻造。据说它的锋刃锐利到足以将人与其影子斩离，而剑柄的温暖则能安抚使用者的伤口。
entries.traditional: 在光與影融為一體的夜之花園中鍛造。據說它的鋒刃銳利到足以將人與其影子斬離，而劍柄的溫暖則能撫慰使用者的傷口。

entries.source: Sword-shaped banners make courage easier to follow.
entries.simplified: 剑形旌旗让勇气更容易追随。
entries.traditional: 劍形旌旗讓勇氣更容易追隨。

entries.simplified: 视线闭合；更深的专注由此开启。
entries.traditional: 視線閉合；更深的專注由此開啟。

entries.source: A small fang charm worn for cunning and nerve.
entries.simplified: 一枚小巧的尖牙护符，象征狡黠与胆识。
entries.traditional: 一枚小巧的尖牙護符，象徵狡黠與膽識。

entries.source: A spiked heart charm that pulses too warmly.
entries.simplified: 一枚带刺的心形护符，跳动得过于温热。
entries.traditional: 一枚帶刺的心形護符，跳動得過於溫熱。

entries.source: Crimson wraps cling to life with every strike.
entries.simplified: 猩红裹带随着每一次挥击紧抓生命不放。
entries.traditional: 猩紅纏帶隨著每一次揮擊緊抓生命不放。

entries.source: “A weapon should bloom in the dark, lass. Let the enemy wonder why the night suddenly has teeth.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “武器就该在黑暗中绽放，姑娘。让敌人猜猜，为什么夜色突然长出了牙。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “武器就該在黑暗中綻放，姑娘。讓敵人猜猜，為什麼夜色突然長出了牙。” — Suphara

entries.source: Orange petals keep their warmth through harsh weather.
entries.simplified: 橙色花瓣即使历经恶劣天气，依然留存暖意。
entries.traditional: 橘色花瓣即使歷經惡劣天候，依然保有暖意。

entries.source: Petal-shaped charm bright enough to lift tired spirits.
entries.simplified: 花瓣形护符明亮得足以振奋疲惫的心灵。
entries.traditional: 花瓣形護符明亮得足以振奮疲憊的心靈。

entries.source: Mana channels glimmer across a polished blue shell.
entries.simplified: 魔力脉络在抛光的蓝色甲壳上微微闪烁。
entries.traditional: 魔力脈絡在拋光的藍色甲殼上微微閃爍。

entries.source: “Subtle work has its place. This is not that place.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “细活自有细活的用处。这个可不讲究那些。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “細活有細活的用處。這個可不講究那些。” — Suphara

entries.source: Back-mounted kaboom. Unstable, flashy, probably intentional.
entries.simplified: 背在身后的轰然巨响。不稳定、够显眼，而且多半是故意的。
entries.traditional: 背在身後的轟然巨響。不穩定、夠醒目，而且多半是故意的。

entries.source: Pressure builds inside its round body as it rolls toward movement.
entries.simplified: 它滚向任何动静时，圆形身体内部的压力会持续升高。
entries.traditional: 它滾向任何動靜時，圓形身體內部的壓力會持續升高。

entries.source: Sacred bone hums with magic from forgotten rites.
entries.simplified: 圣骨低鸣着遗忘仪式遗留的魔力。
entries.traditional: 聖骨低鳴著被遺忘儀式所留下的魔力。

entries.source: Jagged fangs crown the memory of a successful hunt.
entries.simplified: 锯齿般的尖牙为一场成功狩猎的回忆加冕。
entries.traditional: 鋸齒般的尖牙為一場成功狩獵的回憶加冕。

entries.source: A brittle dagger of deadwood and bone, eager to splinter into spectral spears.
entries.simplified: 一柄由枯木与白骨制成的脆弱匕首，迫不及待想碎裂成幽灵长矛。
entries.traditional: 一柄由枯木與白骨製成的脆弱匕首，迫不及待想碎裂成幽靈長矛。

entries.source: Fang and marrow leave wounds that refuse to rest.
entries.simplified: 獠牙与骨髓留下久久无法平息的伤口。
entries.traditional: 獠牙與骨髓留下久久無法平息的傷口。

entries.source: Its square metal frame absorbs impacts while it pushes forward through the foundry.
entries.simplified: 它方正的金属框架能够吸收冲击，推动自身穿过铸造厂。
entries.traditional: 它方正的金屬框架能夠吸收衝擊，推動自身穿過鑄造廠。

entries.source: Skycloth trims light armor made for quick casting.
entries.simplified: Skycloth 为专为迅捷施法打造的轻甲收边。
entries.traditional: Skycloth 為專供迅捷施法使用的輕甲收邊。

entries.simplified: 羽毛般轻柔的凉鞋让每一步都更加轻快。
entries.traditional: 羽毛般輕柔的涼鞋讓每一步都更加輕快。

entries.source: Wind-threaded shorts keep every stride light.
entries.simplified: 风线织就的短裤让每一步都轻盈自如。
entries.traditional: 風線織就的短褲讓每一步都輕盈自如。

entries.source: Charred bindings hold a cleaver made for brutal work.
entries.simplified: 焦黑绑带牢牢束住一柄专为粗暴活计打造的砍刀。
entries.traditional: 焦黑綁帶牢牢束住一柄專為粗暴活計打造的砍刀。

entries.source: Royal guard steel, plain and reliable.
entries.simplified: 王家卫兵所用的钢刃，朴素而可靠。
entries.traditional: 王家衛兵所用的鋼刃，樸實而可靠。

entries.source: Warped bronze hums faintly as daylight fades.
entries.simplified: 扭曲的青铜随着日光消退而发出微弱低鸣。
entries.traditional: 扭曲的青銅隨著日光消退而發出微弱低鳴。

entries.source: Heavy bronze, simple grit, no wasted glamour.
entries.simplified: 沉重青铜，朴实坚韧，不浪费半点华饰。
entries.traditional: 沉重青銅，樸實堅韌，不浪費半點華飾。

entries.source: Stoic bronze hides the face and keeps its secrets.
entries.simplified: 沉静的青铜遮住面容，也守住其中的秘密。
entries.traditional: 沉靜的青銅遮住面容，也守住其中的祕密。

entries.source: Squishy, buoyant, and suspiciously popular with young adventurers.
entries.simplified: 软乎乎、轻飘飘，而且莫名受到年轻冒险者的追捧。
entries.traditional: 軟綿綿、輕飄飄，而且莫名受到年輕冒險者的追捧。

entries.source: Light shielding for fighters who prefer room to move.
entries.simplified: 轻便的防护，适合想留出活动空间的战士。
entries.traditional: 輕便的防護，適合想保有活動空間的戰士。

entries.source: This floating plant growth shakes loose poisonous dust as it moves through cavern air.
entries.simplified: 这株漂浮植物在洞窟空气中移动时，会抖落带毒粉尘。
entries.traditional: 這株漂浮植物在洞窟空氣中移動時，會抖落帶毒粉塵。

entries.source: Red cloth and proud horn promise strength and protection.
entries.simplified: 红布与骄傲的犄角许诺着力量与守护。
entries.traditional: 紅布與驕傲的犄角承諾著力量與守護。

entries.source: Long ears, soft pockets, and far too much innocence.
entries.simplified: 长耳朵、柔软口袋，还有多得过头的天真无邪。
entries.traditional: 長耳朵、柔軟口袋，還有多得過頭的天真無邪。

entries.source: Moon-rabbit ears make quick feet feel quicker.
entries.simplified: 月兔耳朵让轻快的脚步显得更加迅捷。
entries.traditional: 月兔耳朵讓輕快的腳步顯得更加迅捷。

entries.source: It digs through loose soil and shoves intruders aside with its compact body.
entries.simplified: 它会钻过松软土壤，并用紧凑的身体将闯入者推开。
entries.traditional: 它會鑽過鬆軟土壤，並用緊湊的身體將闖入者推開。

entries.source: Glittering dust falls from its wings when holy magic gathers around it.
entries.simplified: 当神圣魔法在它周围汇聚时，闪亮粉尘便会从双翼落下。
entries.traditional: 當神聖魔法在它周圍匯聚時，閃亮粉塵便會從雙翼落下。

entries.source: Its thick body stores moisture in dry places, and its spines protect it from careless attackers.
entries.simplified: 它粗厚的身体能在干旱之地储存水分，尖刺则用来惩罚粗心的攻击者。
entries.traditional: 它粗厚的身體能在乾旱之地儲存水分，尖刺則用來懲罰粗心的攻擊者。

entries.source: A spectral essence trapped within a twisted cage. Its glow flickers like a soul yearning for freedom.
entries.simplified: 一缕幽灵精华被囚禁在扭曲的牢笼中。它的光芒忽明忽暗，如同渴望自由的灵魂。
entries.traditional: 一縷幽靈精華被囚禁在扭曲的牢籠中。它的光芒忽明忽暗，如同渴望自由的靈魂。

entries.source: Cardboard courage stares forward bravely, despite knowing exactly what it is made of.
entries.simplified: 纸板做成的勇气英勇地直视前方，尽管它很清楚自己究竟是什么做的。
entries.traditional: 紙板做成的勇氣英勇地直視前方，儘管它很清楚自己究竟是什麼做的。

entries.source: Worn brown canvas recalls schoolyard days through careful stitching.
entries.simplified: 磨旧的棕色帆布透过细致缝线唤起校园时光。
entries.traditional: 磨舊的棕色帆布透過細緻縫線喚起校園時光。

entries.source: Sturdy travel canvas rides high against the shoulders with long-road purpose.
entries.simplified: 结实的旅行帆布高高贴在肩后，带着奔赴漫长道路的明确目的。
entries.traditional: 結實的旅行帆布高高貼在肩後，帶著奔赴漫長道路的明確目的。

entries.source: Lacquer-red panels make this compact bag feel fit for festival errands.
entries.simplified: 漆红色甲片让这只小巧背包显得格外适合节庆跑腿。
entries.traditional: 漆紅色甲片讓這個小巧背包顯得格外適合節慶跑腿。

entries.source: Crisp seams mark this school bag as gear for pupils with heroic ambitions.
entries.simplified: 利落接缝让这只书包仿佛专为怀有英雄志向的学生准备。
entries.traditional: 利落接縫讓這個書包彷彿專為懷有英雄志向的學生準備。

entries.source: Layered pockets suggest a city scout with too many harmless secrets.
entries.simplified: 层叠口袋暗示着一名藏有太多无害秘密的都市斥候。
entries.traditional: 層疊口袋暗示著一名藏有太多無害秘密的都市斥候。

entries.source: Matte black fabric lends this shoulder bag a clean cityborn edge.
entries.simplified: 哑黑布料赋予这只肩包利落的都市锋芒。
entries.traditional: 啞黑布料賦予這個肩包利落的都市鋒芒。

entries.source: Cream-toned leather carries the hush of courtly errands.
entries.simplified: 奶油色皮革承载着宫廷差事特有的安静气息。
entries.traditional: 奶油色皮革承載著宮廷差事特有的安靜氣息。

entries.source: Sapphire cloth catches light like guild dye fresh from the vat.
entries.simplified: 蓝宝石色布料捕捉光线，仿佛刚从染缸中取出的公会布匹。
entries.traditional: 藍寶石色布料捕捉光線，彷彿剛從染缸中取出的公會布匹。

entries.source: Burnished straps frame this backpack with old-road prestige.
entries.simplified: 磨亮的背带为这只背包勾勒出老路旅人的尊贵气质。
entries.traditional: 磨亮的背帶為這個背包勾勒出老路旅人的尊貴氣質。

entries.source: Tailored travel cloth rests at the hip like a merchant's favored carryall.
entries.simplified: 剪裁讲究的旅行布料贴在腰侧，宛如商人最钟爱的随身提包。
entries.traditional: 剪裁講究的旅行布料貼在腰側，宛如商人最鍾愛的隨身提包。

entries.source: Bright duck plumage turns this top into waddling festival mischief.
entries.simplified: 明亮的鸭羽让这件上衣充满摇摇摆摆的节庆恶作剧感。
entries.traditional: 明亮的鴨羽讓這件上衣充滿搖搖擺擺的節慶惡作劇感。

entries.source: Sun-warm knitwork pushes winter gloom to a respectful distance.
entries.simplified: 沐浴阳光般温暖的针织布料，将冬日阴郁礼貌地推到远处。
entries.traditional: 沐浴陽光般溫暖的針織布料，將冬日陰鬱禮貌地推到遠處。

entries.source: Harbor-blue yarn settles into a calm layer suited for quiet tavern evenings.
entries.simplified: 港湾蓝毛线织成沉静层次，适合安静的酒馆夜晚。
entries.traditional: 港灣藍毛線織成沉靜層次，適合安靜的酒館夜晚。

entries.source: Ember-red wool keeps hearth warmth close around the collar.
entries.simplified: 余烬红羊毛将炉火暖意紧紧留在衣领周围。
entries.traditional: 餘燼紅羊毛將爐火暖意緊緊留在衣領周圍。

entries.source: Plum-dyed stitches lend this sweater the hush of twilight inns.
entries.simplified: 梅紫染线为这件毛衣带来黄昏旅店般的静谧。
entries.traditional: 梅紫染線為這件毛衣帶來黃昏旅店般的靜謐。

entries.source: Rose-pink knitwork spreads gentle hearthlight through cold morning errands.
entries.simplified: 玫瑰粉针织布料在寒冷清晨的差事中散发柔和炉光。
entries.traditional: 玫瑰粉針織布料在寒冷清晨的差事中散髮柔和爐光。

entries.source: Ash-grey wool suits thoughtful wanderers on clouded days.
entries.simplified: 灰烬色羊毛适合在阴云天气中沉思的旅人。
entries.traditional: 灰燼色羊毛適合在陰雲天氣中沉思的旅人。

entries.source: Fuzzy eyes peek from this monster top with harmless little fangs.
entries.simplified: 毛茸茸的双眼从这件怪物上衣探出，配上毫无威胁的小尖牙。
entries.traditional: 毛茸茸的雙眼從這件怪物上衣探出，配上毫無威脅的小尖牙。

entries.source: Moss-green thread brings forest color to a fireside winter layer.
entries.simplified: 苔绿色线材把森林色彩带进炉边的冬日衣层。
entries.traditional: 苔綠色線材把森林色彩帶進爐邊的冬日衣層。

entries.source: Chestnut wool grounds this sweater in country-lodge warmth.
entries.simplified: 栗色羊毛让这件毛衣充满乡间旅舍的温暖。
entries.traditional: 栗色羊毛讓這件毛衣充滿鄉間旅捨的溫暖。

entries.source: Black knit fabric steadies the silhouette in candlelit rooms.
entries.simplified: 黑色针织布料稳住烛光房间中的整体轮廓。
entries.traditional: 黑色針織布料穩住燭光房間中的整體輪廓。

entries.source: Pastel patterns crowd this sweater with shamelessly adorable spellcraft.
entries.simplified: 柔和图案挤满这件毛衣，充满毫不掩饰的可爱魔法。
entries.traditional: 柔和圖案擠滿這件毛衣，充滿毫不掩飾的可愛魔法。

entries.source: Deep plum wool wraps the wearer in inn-room warmth.
entries.simplified: 深梅色羊毛将穿戴者包裹在旅店房间般的暖意中。
entries.traditional: 深梅色羊毛將穿戴者包裹在旅店房間般的暖意中。

entries.source: Canary fleece makes this hoodie impossible to misplace during market mischief.
entries.simplified: 金丝雀黄抓绒让这件连帽衫在市集恶作剧中绝不可能被弄丢。
entries.traditional: 金絲雀黃抓絨讓這件連帽衫在市集惡作劇中絕不可能被弄丟。

entries.source: Tangerine fleece glows like lanternlight across rainy streets.
entries.simplified: 橘色抓绒宛如灯笼光般照亮雨中街道。
entries.traditional: 橘色抓絨宛如燈籠光般照亮雨中街道。

entries.source: River-blue jersey settles into a steady wayfarer mood.
entries.simplified: 河水蓝针织布料带来沉稳的行路者气息。
entries.traditional: 河水藍針織布料帶來沉穩的行路者氣息。

entries.source: Midnight-blue hoodie suits late walks through sleepy lanternlight.
entries.simplified: 午夜蓝连帽衫适合穿行于昏昏灯影下的深夜散步。
entries.traditional: 午夜藍連帽衫適合穿行於昏昏燈影下的深夜散步。

entries.source: Ivory bomber panels create a clean skyfarer cut.
entries.simplified: 象牙白飞行夹克甲片勾勒出利落的天行者剪裁。
entries.traditional: 象牙白飛行夾克甲片勾勒出利落的天行者剪裁。

entries.source: Coal-black fabric sharpens the jacket into tavern-door cool.
entries.simplified: 煤黑布料让这件夹克在酒馆门口显得格外潇洒。
entries.traditional: 煤黑布料讓這件夾克在酒館門口顯得格外瀟灑。

entries.source: Azure panels lend this bomber a breezy flight-school spirit.
entries.simplified: 蔚蓝甲片为这件飞行夹克注入轻快的飞行学院精神。
entries.traditional: 蔚藍甲片為這件飛行夾克注入輕快的飛行學院精神。

entries.source: Plain white cotton carries the rare power of matching nearly everything.
entries.simplified: 朴素白棉拥有一种罕见力量：几乎能搭配任何东西。
entries.traditional: 樸素白棉擁有一種罕見力量：幾乎能搭配任何東西。

entries.source: Bold panelwork gives this bomber the swagger of a festival dare.
entries.simplified: 大胆拼接让这件飞行夹克充满接受节庆挑战的张扬气势。
entries.traditional: 大膽拼接讓這件飛行夾克充滿接受節慶挑戰的張揚氣勢。

entries.source: Umber linen keeps this shirt humble alongside any adventurer's kit.
entries.simplified: 棕褐亚麻让这件衬衫在任何冒险者装备旁都保持朴实。
entries.traditional: 棕褐亞麻讓這件襯衫在任何冒險者裝備旁都保持樸實。

entries.source: Clear blue fabric suits slow mornings near sunlit shopfronts.
entries.simplified: 清澈蓝布料适合阳光店铺前的悠闲清晨。
entries.traditional: 清澈藍布料適合陽光店鋪前的悠閒清晨。
