entries.source: White jersey hums with arena cheer through every stitch.
entries.simplified: 白色针织布料的每一道缝线都回荡着竞技场欢呼。
entries.traditional: 白色針織布料的每一道縫線都回蕩著競技場歡呼。

entries.source: Crisp white broadcloth holds courtly manners better than most adventurers.
entries.simplified: 利落白色宽幅布比大多数冒险者更懂得维持宫廷礼仪。
entries.traditional: 利落白色寬幅布比大多數冒險者更懂得維持宮廷禮儀。

entries.source: Blue dress linen lends ceremony to a risky itinerary.
entries.simplified: 蓝色礼服亚麻为危险行程增添了几分仪式感。
entries.traditional: 藍色禮服亞麻為危險行程增添了幾分儀式感。

entries.source: Trim seams give this shirt the poise of study-hall bravado.
entries.simplified: 收束整齐的接缝让这件衬衫带着课堂式的自信与风度。
entries.traditional: 收束整齊的接縫讓這件襯衫帶著課堂式的自信與風度。

entries.source: Golden uniform trim brings sunny discipline to academy halls.
entries.simplified: 金色制服饰边为学院大厅带来阳光般的纪律感。
entries.traditional: 金色制服飾邊為學院大廳帶來陽光般的紀律感。

entries.source: Rose uniform fabric softens classroom order with gentle color.
entries.simplified: 玫瑰色制服布料以温柔色彩软化课堂秩序。
entries.traditional: 玫瑰色制服布料以溫柔色彩軟化課堂秩序。

entries.source: Black uniform panels make academy rules look strangely dramatic.
entries.simplified: 黑色制服甲片让学院规章显得莫名戏剧化。
entries.traditional: 黑色制服甲片讓學院規章顯得莫名戲劇化。

entries.source: Blue academy twill preserves tradition across every seam.
entries.simplified: 蓝色学院斜纹布让传统延续在每一道缝线之间。
entries.traditional: 藍色學院斜紋布讓傳統延續在每一道縫線之間。

entries.source: Crisp blue lines place command at the center of this captain's coat.
entries.simplified: 利落蓝线将号令感置于这件船长外套的正中央。
entries.traditional: 利落藍線將號令感置於這件船長外套的正中央。

entries.source: Striped sailor weave recalls salt air around a cheerful collar.
entries.simplified: 条纹水手布让欢快衣领周围仿佛仍带着海风。
entries.traditional: 條紋水手布讓歡快衣領周圍彷彿仍帶著海風。

entries.source: Snow-white linen preserves formal manners through battlefield dust.
entries.simplified: 雪白亚麻即使穿过战场尘土，也依然维持正式礼仪。
entries.traditional: 雪白亞麻即使穿過戰場塵土，也依然維持正式禮儀。

entries.source: Golden dress silk brings candlelit warmth to formal attire.
entries.simplified: 金色礼服丝绸为正式装束带来烛光般的暖意。
entries.traditional: 金色禮服絲綢為正式裝束帶來燭光般的暖意。

entries.source: Violet dress satin turns proper manners into evening finery.
entries.simplified: 紫罗兰礼服缎面将得体礼仪升华成夜晚盛装。
entries.traditional: 紫羅蘭禮服緞面將得體禮儀昇華成夜晚盛裝。

entries.source: Blue ceremony robes hold the nervous pride of a scholar's final bow.
entries.simplified: 蓝色典礼长袍承载着学者谢幕时紧张而自豪的心情。
entries.traditional: 藍色典禮長袍承載著學者謝幕時緊張而自豪的心情。

entries.source: Black cotton stays quietly useful beside louder gear.
entries.simplified: 黑棉安静实用，甘愿待在更加张扬的装备旁。
entries.traditional: 黑棉安靜實用，甘願待在更加張揚的裝備旁。

entries.source: Black scholar robes trail chalk smoke from experiments best left undocumented.
entries.simplified: 黑色学者长袍拖曳着那些最好永远不留记录的实验粉尘。
entries.traditional: 黑色學者長袍拖曳著那些最好永遠不留記錄的實驗粉塵。

entries.source: Rescue-red canvas bears reflective striping through falling sparks.
entries.simplified: 救援红帆布在飞落火星中显露反光条纹。
entries.traditional: 救援紅帆布在飛落火星中顯露反光條紋。

entries.source: Dust-wrapped cloth marks the wearer as trouble from the roadside.
entries.simplified: 尘土缠绕的布料标示着一名来自路边的麻烦人物。
entries.traditional: 塵土纏繞的布料標示著一名來自路邊的麻煩人物。

entries.source: Rich court brocade grants this coat a throne-room presence.
entries.simplified: 华贵宫廷织锦赋予这件外套王座厅般的存在感。
entries.traditional: 華貴宮廷織錦賦予這件外套王座廳般的存在感。

entries.source: Violet hex-thread winds through this robe with theatrical menace.
entries.simplified: 紫罗兰诅咒丝线穿过长袍，散发着夸张而危险的气息。
entries.traditional: 紫羅蘭詛咒絲線穿過長袍，散髮著誇張而危險的氣息。

entries.source: Dark spellcloth frames bright trim around a coven-ready hood.
entries.simplified: 黑暗法术布料在适合女巫集会的兜帽周围勾勒出明亮饰边。
entries.traditional: 黑暗法術布料在適合女巫集會的兜帽周圍勾勒出明亮飾邊。

entries.source: Soft white fur turns this bunny top toward mischievous meadow spirit.
entries.simplified: 柔软白毛让这件兔兔上衣带上调皮的草原精灵气息。
entries.traditional: 柔軟白毛讓這件兔兔上衣帶上調皮的草原精靈氣息。

entries.source: Blue scales march across this dino top with ancient playground pride.
entries.simplified: 蓝色鳞片排列在这件恐龙上衣上，充满古老而童趣的骄傲。
entries.traditional: 藍色鱗片排列在這件恐龍上衣上，充滿古老而童趣的驕傲。

entries.source: Round ears crown this bear top with gentle forest bulk.
entries.simplified: 圆润熊耳为这件上衣带来温柔的森林厚重感。
entries.traditional: 圓潤熊耳為這件上衣帶來溫柔的森林厚重感。

entries.source: Yellow cotton brings simple sunshine to any adventurer's kit.
entries.simplified: 黄色棉布为任何冒险装备增添朴素阳光。
entries.traditional: 黃色棉布為任何冒險裝備增添樸素陽光。

entries.source: Feline trim sets this neko top in a sly parlor mood.
entries.simplified: 猫科饰边让这件猫耳上衣带着狡黠的客厅氛围。
entries.traditional: 貓科飾邊讓這件貓耳上衣帶著狡黠的客廳氛圍。

entries.source: Winter colors wrap this top in gift-ribbon cheer.
entries.simplified: 冬日色彩将这件上衣包裹在礼物缎带般的欢乐中。
entries.traditional: 冬日色彩將這件上衣包裹在禮物緞帶般的歡樂中。

entries.source: Red ringwear bears a bruiser's swagger under bright ropes.
entries.simplified: 红色擂台服饰在明亮围绳下展现拳手的张扬气势。
entries.traditional: 紅色擂台服飾在明亮圍繩下展現拳手的張揚氣勢。

entries.source: Toothy blue fabric turns this shark top into oceanic menace.
entries.simplified: 露齿的蓝色布料让这件鲨鱼上衣散发海洋威胁。
entries.traditional: 露齒的藍色布料讓這件鯊魚上衣散髮海洋威脅。

entries.source: Padded leaguewear lends this top the nerve for heroic tackles.
entries.simplified: 加垫联赛服饰赋予这件上衣完成英雄式擒抱的胆量。
entries.traditional: 加墊聯賽服飾賦予這件上衣完成英雄式擒抱的膽量。

entries.source: Blue cotton rests calmly beside louder pieces.
entries.simplified: 蓝棉安静地陪伴在更张扬的服饰旁。
entries.traditional: 藍棉安靜地陪伴在更張揚的服飾旁。

entries.source: Black formal cloth cuts a sharp figure through tavern chaos.
entries.simplified: 黑色正式布料在酒馆混乱中勾勒出利落身影。
entries.traditional: 黑色正式布料在酒館混亂中勾勒出利落身影。

entries.source: Violet lenses turn every glance into a little stage curse.
entries.simplified: 紫罗兰镜片让每一次目光都像一场小小的舞台诅咒。
entries.traditional: 紫羅蘭鏡片讓每一次目光都像一場小小的舞台詛咒。

entries.source: Grey snow lenses guard the eyes against whiteout glare.
entries.simplified: 灰色雪地镜片保护双眼免受白茫强光侵袭。
entries.traditional: 灰色雪地鏡片保護雙眼免受白茫強光侵襲。

entries.source: Yellow dive glass keeps deep-water mysteries from winning the staring contest.
entries.simplified: 黄色潜水镜片让深水谜团无法赢下这场对视。
entries.traditional: 黃色潛水鏡片讓深水謎團無法贏下這場對視。

entries.source: Heavy aviator lenses bear skyward scratches from reckless altitude dreams.
entries.simplified: 厚重飞行员镜片布满向往冒险高空留下的划痕。
entries.traditional: 厚重飛行員鏡片布滿嚮往冒險高空留下的划痕。

entries.source: Red cloth hides enough face for roadside rumors to start.
entries.simplified: 红布遮住足够多的面容，让路边传闻有机会滋长。
entries.traditional: 紅布遮住足夠多的面容，讓路邊傳聞有機會滋長。

entries.source: Round lenses frame the wearer like a poet avoiding rent.
entries.simplified: 圆形镜片勾勒出一名正在躲避房租的诗人气质。
entries.traditional: 圓形鏡片勾勒出一名正在躲避房租的詩人氣質。

entries.source: Dark frames sharpen every look into tidy mischief.
entries.simplified: 黑色镜框让每一次目光都变成整齐利落的恶作剧。
entries.traditional: 黑色鏡框讓每一次目光都變成整齊利落的惡作劇。

entries.source: Golden star rims turn subtlety into a lost cause.
entries.simplified: 金色星形镜框让“低调”彻底成为不可能。
entries.traditional: 金色星形鏡框讓“低調”徹底成為不可能。

entries.source: Cobalt leather adds a dignified blue note to formal hems.
entries.simplified: 钴蓝皮革为正式衣摆增添高雅的蓝色点缀。
entries.traditional: 鈷藍皮革為正式衣擺增添高雅的藍色點綴。

entries.source: White school soles keep academy uniforms crisp from heel to toe.
entries.simplified: 白色学院鞋底让制服从鞋跟到鞋尖都保持利落。
entries.traditional: 白色學院鞋底讓制服從鞋跟到鞋尖都保持利落。

entries.source: Cream leather gives uniform days a softer classroom rhythm.
entries.simplified: 奶油色皮革为制服时光带来更柔和的课堂节奏。
entries.traditional: 奶油色皮革為制服時光帶來更柔和的課堂節奏。

entries.source: Black dress shoes anchor court attire with quiet authority.
entries.simplified: 黑色礼鞋以安静权威稳住宫廷装束。
entries.traditional: 黑色禮鞋以安靜權威穩住宮廷裝束。

entries.source: Tan leather carries banquet manners over dusty roads.
entries.simplified: 棕褐皮革带着宴会礼仪踏过尘土道路。
entries.traditional: 棕褐皮革帶著宴會禮儀踏過塵土道路。

entries.source: Amber shoes catch lamplight along careful dress hems.
entries.simplified: 琥珀色鞋履沿精致衣摆捕捉灯光。
entries.traditional: 琥珀色鞋履沿精致衣擺捕捉燈光。

entries.source: Chestnut shoes lend steady warmth to plain ceremony clothes.
entries.simplified: 栗色鞋履为朴素礼服带来沉稳暖意。
entries.traditional: 栗色鞋履為樸素禮服帶來沉穩暖意。

entries.source: Black patent shoes finish the tuxedo with severe ballroom discipline.
entries.simplified: 黑色漆皮鞋以严谨的舞厅纪律完成整套礼服。
entries.traditional: 黑色漆皮鞋以嚴謹的舞廳紀律完成整套禮服。

entries.source: Violet boots cut a bold path through frost-touched streets.
entries.simplified: 紫罗兰长靴在霜寒街道上踏出大胆路线。
entries.traditional: 紫羅蘭長靴在霜寒街道上踏出大膽路線。

entries.source: Black road boots favor firm footing over friendly conversation.
entries.simplified: 黑色行路靴重视稳固落脚，远胜友好交谈。
entries.traditional: 黑色行路靴重視穩固落腳，遠勝友好交談。

entries.source: Black canvas keeps movement light through ordinary errands.
entries.simplified: 黑色帆布让寻常差事中的动作保持轻盈。
entries.traditional: 黑色帆布讓尋常差事中的動作保持輕盈。

entries.source: Green sneakers flash meadow color across nimble city stone.
entries.simplified: 绿色运动鞋在灵巧穿过城市石路时闪出草原色彩。
entries.traditional: 綠色運動鞋在靈巧穿過城市石路時閃出草原色彩。

entries.source: Red rescue boots brace through sparks from collapsing rafters.
entries.simplified: 红色救援靴稳稳撑过倒塌梁木间飞落的火星。
entries.traditional: 紅色救援靴穩穩撐過倒塌梁木間飛落的火星。

entries.source: Grey high-tops hold a sporty profile with tavern-court ease.
entries.simplified: 灰色高帮鞋带着轻松的运动气质，游走在酒馆与球场之间。
entries.traditional: 灰色高幫鞋帶著輕鬆的運動氣質，游走在酒館與球場之間。

entries.source: Lugged hiking soles bite into mud like old trail teeth.
entries.simplified: 厚齿徒步鞋底咬入泥泞，如同老路上的利齿。
entries.traditional: 厚齒徒步鞋底咬入泥濘，如同老路上的利齒。

entries.source: Forest boots carry leaf-dark dye through mossy footpaths.
entries.simplified: 森林靴携着深叶染色走过覆苔小径。
entries.traditional: 森林靴攜著深葉染色走過覆苔小徑。

entries.source: Iron-buckled boots make rough work feel nearly ceremonial.
entries.simplified: 铁扣长靴让粗重工作也显得近乎仪式化。
entries.traditional: 鐵扣長靴讓粗重工作也顯得近乎儀式化。

entries.source: Gilded royal shoes add courtly weight to every stride.
entries.simplified: 镀金皇家鞋履为每一步增添宫廷重量。
entries.traditional: 鍍金皇家鞋履為每一步增添宮廷重量。

entries.source: Dust-dark shoes slip through alley shade like rehearsed trouble.
entries.simplified: 尘暗鞋履如同排练熟练的麻烦般滑入巷道阴影。
entries.traditional: 塵暗鞋履如同排練熟練的麻煩般滑入巷道陰影。

entries.source: Tall dress boots give formal clothes a roadworthy spine.
entries.simplified: 高筒礼靴为正式服装撑起一副适合远行的骨架。
entries.traditional: 高筒禮靴為正式服裝撐起一副適合遠行的骨架。

entries.source: Brown pointed boots carve a witchy angle at the edge of sweeping hems.
entries.simplified: 棕色尖头靴在飘扬衣摆边缘勾勒出女巫般的锐利角度。
entries.traditional: 棕色尖頭靴在飄揚衣擺邊緣勾勒出女巫般的銳利角度。

entries.source: Yellow sneakers bring sunrise brightness to every quick-footed dash.
entries.simplified: 黄色运动鞋为每一次轻快冲刺带来日出般的明亮。
entries.traditional: 黃色運動鞋為每一次輕快衝刺帶來日出般的明亮。

entries.source: Dark pointed boots hook the silhouette toward midnight spellwork.
entries.simplified: 深色尖头靴把整体轮廓勾向午夜法术的气息。
entries.traditional: 深色尖頭靴把整體輪廓勾向午夜法術的氣息。

entries.source: Crooked brown shoes curl upward with cottage-born mischief.
entries.simplified: 歪曲的棕鞋向上卷起，带着乡间小屋式的恶作剧感。
entries.traditional: 歪曲的棕鞋向上捲起，帶著鄉間小屋式的惡作劇感。

entries.source: Violet witch shoes tap softly along forbidden study shelves.
entries.simplified: 紫罗兰女巫鞋轻轻踏过禁忌书架。
entries.traditional: 紫羅蘭女巫鞋輕輕踏過禁忌書架。

entries.source: Curled elf toes shine with winter-grove theatrics.
entries.simplified: 卷翘的精灵鞋尖闪耀着冬日林谷的戏剧气息。
entries.traditional: 卷翹的精靈鞋尖閃耀著冬日林谷的戲劇氣息。

entries.source: Plush bunny paws turn each hop into meadow nonsense.
entries.simplified: 毛绒兔爪让每一次跳跃都充满草原式的胡闹。
entries.traditional: 毛絨兔爪讓每一次跳躍都充滿草原式的胡鬧。

entries.source: Blue dino soles stomp softly with nursery-age thunder.
entries.simplified: 蓝色恐龙鞋底以幼儿园般的雷声轻轻跺地。
entries.traditional: 藍色恐龍鞋底以幼兒園般的雷聲輕輕跺地。

entries.source: Rounded bear paws turn every footfall into sleepy woodland weight.
entries.simplified: 圆润熊爪让每一步都带着困倦森林的重量。
entries.traditional: 圓潤熊爪讓每一步都帶著困倦森林的重量。

entries.source: Neko shoes pad over floors with parlor-cat stealth.
entries.simplified: 猫咪鞋悄然掠过地板，拥有客厅猫科生物般的潜行感。
entries.traditional: 貓咪鞋悄然掠過地板，擁有客廳貓科生物般的潛行感。

entries.source: Winter slippers glow with hearthside ribbon cheer.
entries.simplified: 冬日拖鞋泛着炉边缎带般的欢乐光彩。
entries.traditional: 冬日拖鞋泛著爐邊緞帶般的歡樂光彩。

entries.source: Orange sneakers race through market crowds like bottled sunset.
entries.simplified: 橙色运动鞋像被装进瓶中的夕阳般穿过市集人群。
entries.traditional: 橙色運動鞋像被裝進瓶中的夕陽般穿過市集人群。

entries.source: Reinforced dive soles cling to slick dock planks.
entries.simplified: 强化潜水鞋底牢牢抓住湿滑码头木板。
entries.traditional: 強化潛水鞋底牢牢抓住濕滑碼頭木板。

entries.source: Crimson runners carry brisk momentum through crowded lanes.
entries.simplified: 猩红跑鞋带着轻快动势穿过拥挤街巷。
entries.traditional: 猩紅跑鞋帶著輕快動勢穿過擁擠街巷。

entries.source: Blue sneakers settle into easy motion through wandering routes.
entries.simplified: 蓝色运动鞋在漫游路线中维持轻松步伐。
entries.traditional: 藍色運動鞋在漫游路線中維持輕鬆步伐。

entries.source: Cleated league shoes dig into turf with tackling intent.
entries.simplified: 带钉联赛鞋牢牢咬住草地，满怀擒抱意图。
entries.traditional: 帶釘聯賽鞋牢牢咬住草地，滿懷擒抱意圖。

entries.source: Layered straps bind these boots with mule-trail toughness.
entries.simplified: 层叠绑带赋予这双长靴骡道般的坚韧。
entries.traditional: 層疊綁帶賦予這雙長靴騾道般的堅韌。

entries.source: White runners keep swift movement clean across sunlit stone.
entries.simplified: 白色跑鞋让迅捷动作在阳光石路上依然干净利落。
entries.traditional: 白色跑鞋讓迅捷動作在陽光石路上依然乾淨利落。

entries.source: Fuzzy monster feet show tiny claws with harmless menace.
entries.simplified: 毛茸茸的怪物脚露出小小利爪，带着毫无威胁的凶相。
entries.traditional: 毛茸茸的怪物腳露出小小利爪，帶著毫無威脅的凶相。

entries.source: Shark shoes flash fins near the floor with toothy sea swagger.
entries.simplified: 鲨鱼鞋在地面附近露出鱼鳍，散发露齿的海洋气势。
entries.traditional: 鯊魚鞋在地面附近露出魚鰭，散髮露齒的海洋氣勢。

entries.source: Orange duck feet waddle forward with heroic lack of shame.
entries.simplified: 橙色鸭掌摇摇摆摆地向前，带着英雄般毫不知耻的自信。
entries.traditional: 橙色鴨掌搖搖擺擺地向前，帶著英雄般毫不知恥的自信。

entries.source: Rose runners give swift routes a softer streak of color.
entries.simplified: 玫瑰色跑鞋为迅捷路线添上一道柔和色彩。
entries.traditional: 玫瑰色跑鞋為迅捷路線添上一道柔和色彩。

entries.source: Black runners vanish neatly along fast midnight routes.
entries.simplified: 黑色跑鞋整齐消失在午夜疾行路线中。
entries.traditional: 黑色跑鞋整齊消失在午夜疾行路線中。

entries.source: Azure runners favor sudden starts through open city lanes.
entries.simplified: 蔚蓝跑鞋偏爱在开阔城市巷道中骤然起步。
entries.traditional: 蔚藍跑鞋偏愛在開闊城市巷道中驟然起步。

entries.source: Patterned high-tops pretend not to care about applause.
entries.simplified: 花纹高帮鞋装作完全不在意掌声。
entries.traditional: 花紋高幫鞋裝作完全不在意掌聲。

entries.source: Padded paw gloves turn every gesture into sly parlor-cat theater.
entries.simplified: 加垫爪套让每个手势都变成狡黠的客厅猫戏。
entries.traditional: 加墊爪套讓每個手勢都變成狡黠的客廳貓戲。

entries.source: Rounded bear paws warm the hands with sleepy woodland bulk.
entries.simplified: 圆润熊掌让双手拥有困倦森林般的温暖厚重感。
entries.traditional: 圓潤熊掌讓雙手擁有困倦森林般的溫暖厚重感。

entries.source: Striped winter mitts trap hearth heat through gift-night chaos.
entries.simplified: 条纹冬季连指手套在礼物之夜的混乱中锁住炉火暖意。
entries.traditional: 條紋冬季連指手套在禮物之夜的混亂中鎖住爐火暖意。

entries.source: Crimson boxing gloves make every jab look gloriously excessive.
entries.simplified: 猩红拳击手套让每一记刺拳都显得华丽得过分。
entries.traditional: 猩紅拳擊手套讓每一記刺拳都顯得華麗得過分。

entries.source: Cobalt boxing gloves bring ring-side poise to quick jabs.
entries.simplified: 钴蓝拳击手套为迅捷刺拳增添擂台边的从容。
entries.traditional: 鈷藍拳擊手套為迅捷刺拳增添擂台邊的從容。

entries.source: Gridiron gloves bite the ball with stubborn leather grip.
entries.simplified: 橄榄球手套以顽固皮革牢牢抓住球体。
entries.traditional: 橄欖球手套以頑固皮革牢牢抓住球體。

entries.source: Fuzzy claws curl from these gloves with harmless goblin drama.
entries.simplified: 毛茸茸的利爪从手套上弯出，带着毫无威胁的哥布林式戏剧感。
entries.traditional: 毛茸茸的利爪從手套上彎出，帶著毫無威脅的哥布林式戲劇感。

entries.source: Orange duck mitts flap through every questionable plan.
entries.simplified: 橙色鸭掌手套在每一个可疑计划中拍打作响。
entries.traditional: 橙色鴨掌手套在每一個可疑計劃中拍打作響。

entries.source: Trail gloves guard the palms from rope burn across rocky shortcuts.
entries.simplified: 越野手套保护手掌，免受岩石捷径上的绳索磨伤。
entries.traditional: 越野手套保護手掌，免受岩石捷徑上的繩索磨傷。

entries.source: Dark leather creases around the knuckles like old wayfarer gear.
entries.simplified: 深色皮革在指节处形成褶皱，如同久经旅途的装备。
entries.traditional: 深色皮革在指節處形成褶皺，如同久經旅途的裝備。

entries.source: Curled cuffs give these gloves a bright winter-grove flourish.
entries.simplified: 卷翘袖口为这副手套增添明亮的冬林装饰。
entries.traditional: 卷翹袖口為這副手套增添明亮的冬林裝飾。

entries.source: Plush bunny paws make every wave dangerously adorable.
entries.simplified: 毛绒兔爪让每一次挥手都可爱得危险。
entries.traditional: 毛絨兔爪讓每一次揮手都可愛得危險。

entries.source: Tiny blue claws stomp into handwear with nursery-age thunder.
entries.simplified: 微型蓝色利爪踏入手套，带着幼儿园般的雷声。
entries.traditional: 微型藍色利爪踏入手套，帶著幼兒園般的雷聲。

entries.source: Red-brimmed canvas shades the eyes with casual field-day nerve.
entries.simplified: 红边帆布遮住双眼，带来轻松而大胆的户外日气息。
entries.traditional: 紅邊帆布遮住雙眼，帶來輕鬆而大膽的戶外日氣息。

entries.source: Blue cap cloth gives the outfit a clean everyday finish.
entries.simplified: 蓝色帽布让整套服装拥有干净的日常收尾。
entries.traditional: 藍色帽布讓整套服裝擁有乾淨的日常收尾。

entries.source: Sun-dried straw casts lazy shade over wandering afternoons.
entries.simplified: 晒干的稻草为漫游的午后投下慵懒阴影。
entries.traditional: 曬乾的稻草為漫游的午後投下慵懶陰影。

entries.source: Wide leather brims bring frontier swagger into hard noon sun.
entries.simplified: 宽阔皮革帽檐把边疆豪气带进正午烈日。
entries.traditional: 寬闊皮革帽檐把邊疆豪氣帶進正午烈日。

entries.source: Pale straw lifts soft green trim into a gentle spring mood.
entries.simplified: 浅色草帽托起柔和绿色饰边，营造温柔春日气息。
entries.traditional: 淺色草帽托起柔和綠色飾邊，營造溫柔春日氣息。

entries.source: Sunny ribbon loops crown this hat with market-day cheer.
entries.simplified: 明亮缎带在帽顶盘绕，带来市集日的欢快。
entries.traditional: 明亮緞帶在帽頂盤繞，帶來市集日的歡快。

entries.source: Plain black cloth keeps trouble looking almost respectable.
entries.simplified: 朴素黑布让麻烦看起来几乎还算体面。
entries.traditional: 樸素黑布讓麻煩看起來幾乎還算體面。

entries.source: A tiny flower crowns this chick hat with impossible poultry confidence.
entries.simplified: 一朵小花为这顶小鸡帽加冕，展现不可思议的家禽自信。
entries.traditional: 一朵小花為這頂小雞帽加冕，展現不可思議的家禽自信。

entries.source: Bright scout cloth marks the wearer for trails beyond the last signpost.
entries.simplified: 明亮斥候布料标记着那些愿意走向最后一块路牌之外的人。
entries.traditional: 明亮斥候布料標記著那些願意走向最後一塊路牌之外的人。

entries.source: Golden peel curves proudly overhead with shameless festival luxury.
entries.simplified: 金色果皮骄傲地弯在头顶，散发毫不羞怯的节庆奢华。
entries.traditional: 金色果皮驕傲地彎在頭頂，散髮毫不羞怯的節慶奢華。

entries.source: White naval cloth places imaginary command directly above the eyebrows.
entries.simplified: 洁白海军布料把想象中的指挥权直接放到眉毛上方。
entries.traditional: 潔白海軍布料把想象中的指揮權直接放到眉毛上方。

entries.source: Blue trim circles this sailor cap with tidy dockside charm.
entries.simplified: 蓝色饰边围绕水手帽，带来整洁的码头魅力。
entries.traditional: 藍色飾邊圍繞水手帽，帶來整潔的碼頭魅力。

entries.source: Black scholar cloth remembers experiments that somehow reached ceremony.
entries.simplified: 黑色学者布料记得那些不知为何最终走进典礼的实验。
entries.traditional: 黑色學者布料記得那些不知為何最終走進典禮的實驗。

entries.source: Blue graduation cloth carries the nervous poise of future negotiators.
entries.simplified: 蓝色毕业帽布承载着未来谈判者紧张而沉稳的气质。
entries.traditional: 藍色畢業帽布承載著未來談判者緊張而沉穩的氣質。

entries.source: Red rescue plating braces the brow through falling sparks.
entries.simplified: 红色救援甲片在飞落火星中保护额头。
entries.traditional: 紅色救援甲片在飛落火星中保護額頭。

entries.source: Patterned panels sit slightly crooked with intentional market-stall irony.
entries.simplified: 花纹甲片略微歪斜地坐着，带着刻意的市集摊位讽刺感。
entries.traditional: 花紋甲片略微歪斜地坐著，帶著刻意的市集攤位諷刺感。

entries.source: Red dustcloth hides the face just enough for rumors.
entries.simplified: 红色防尘布遮住恰到好处的面容，让传闻有机会出现。
entries.traditional: 紅色防塵布遮住恰到好處的面容，讓傳聞有機會出現。

entries.source: Blue roadcloth keeps desert glare away from a suspicious squint.
entries.simplified: 蓝色行路布挡开沙漠强光，也藏住可疑的眯眼神情。
entries.traditional: 藍色行路布擋開沙漠強光，也藏住可疑的眯眼神情。

entries.source: Gold points rise from the brow with troublesome royal certainty.
entries.simplified: 金色尖角从眉间升起，带着惹麻烦的王者确信。
entries.traditional: 金色尖角從眉間升起，帶著惹麻煩的王者確信。

entries.source: Black knit hugs close through cold lanternlit alleys.
entries.simplified: 黑色针织布紧贴头部，陪伴寒冷灯影下的巷道。
entries.traditional: 黑色針織布緊貼頭部，陪伴寒冷燈影下的巷道。

entries.source: Blue yarn keeps winter air from claiming the ears.
entries.simplified: 蓝色毛线保护双耳，不让冬风夺走它们。
entries.traditional: 藍色毛線保護雙耳，不讓冬風奪走它們。

entries.source: Pale wool gathers around a pom fit for frosted paths.
entries.simplified: 浅色羊毛在绒球周围汇聚，正适合结霜小径。
entries.traditional: 淺色羊毛在絨球周圍匯聚，正適合結霜小徑。

entries.source: Tilted felt grants every pause the gravity of unfinished genius.
entries.simplified: 倾斜毡帽让每一次停顿都拥有尚未完成的天才般重量。
entries.traditional: 傾斜氈帽讓每一次停頓都擁有尚未完成的天才般重量。

entries.source: Orange duck legs bring waddling ceremony to every deeply unserious march.
entries.simplified: 橙色鸭腿为每一次极不严肃的行军带来摇摆仪式感。
entries.traditional: 橙色鴨腿為每一次極不嚴肅的行軍帶來搖擺儀式感。

entries.source: Fuzzy monster legs stomp through the outfit with harmless claw-foot drama.
entries.simplified: 毛茸茸的怪物腿以毫无威胁的爪足戏剧感踏进整套服装。
entries.traditional: 毛茸茸的怪物腿以毫無威脅的爪足戲劇感踏進整套服裝。

entries.source: Citrus cloth keeps these shorts breezy on sunlit roads.
entries.simplified: 柑橘色布料让这条短裤在阳光道路上保持轻爽。
entries.traditional: 柑橘色布料讓這條短褲在陽光道路上保持輕爽。

entries.source: Black formal trousers hold a sharp crease through deeply questionable adventures.
entries.simplified: 黑色正式长裤即使经历极其可疑的冒险，也能维持利落裤线。
entries.traditional: 黑色正式長褲即使經歷極其可疑的冒險，也能維持利落褲線。

entries.source: Brown cargo pockets carry trail grit in a practical wayfarer cut.
entries.simplified: 棕色工装口袋以实用行路剪裁携带旅途尘土。
entries.traditional: 棕色工裝口袋以實用行路剪裁攜帶旅途塵土。

entries.source: Slate cargo cloth favors quiet utility across rough travel routes.
entries.simplified: 板岩色工装布偏爱在崎岖路线中保持安静实用。
entries.traditional: 板岩色工裝布偏愛在崎嶇路線中保持安靜實用。

entries.source: Black boxers offer heroic comfort with nearly no battlefield credibility.
entries.simplified: 黑色平角裤提供英雄般的舒适，却几乎没有任何战场可信度。
entries.traditional: 黑色平角褲提供英雄般的舒適，卻幾乎沒有任何戰場可信度。

entries.source: Charcoal cargo pockets make preparation look calm under pressure.
entries.simplified: 炭灰工装口袋让充分准备在压力下显得从容。
entries.traditional: 炭灰工裝口袋讓充分準備在壓力下顯得從容。

entries.source: Moss cargo fabric suits scouts who trust storage more than luck.
entries.simplified: 苔绿色工装布适合那些更信任收纳而不是运气的斥候。
entries.traditional: 苔綠色工裝布適合那些更信任收納而不是運氣的斥候。

entries.source: Blue cargo panels bring dockside utility to restless travel days.
entries.simplified: 蓝色工装甲片为躁动旅途带来码头式实用感。
entries.traditional: 藍色工裝甲片為躁動旅途帶來碼頭式實用感。

entries.source: White denim carries a risky confidence through mud-prone roads.
entries.simplified: 白色牛仔裤以冒险般的自信面对满是泥泞的道路。
entries.traditional: 白色牛仔褲以冒險般的自信面對滿是泥濘的道路。

entries.source: Faded denim gives these jeans the ease of long afternoons.
entries.simplified: 褪色牛仔布让这条裤子拥有漫长午后的轻松感。
entries.traditional: 褪色牛仔布讓這條褲子擁有漫長午後的輕鬆感。

entries.source: Deep navy denim settles into a dependable tavern-night look.
entries.simplified: 深海军蓝牛仔布带来可靠的酒馆夜晚气质。
entries.traditional: 深海軍藍牛仔布帶來可靠的酒館夜晚氣質。

entries.source: Blue boxers keep dignity present in theory only.
entries.simplified: 蓝色平角裤让尊严只存在于理论之中。
entries.traditional: 藍色平角褲讓尊嚴只存在於理論之中。

entries.source: Red dress cloth sweeps low with candlelit ballroom nerve.
entries.simplified: 红色礼服布料在烛光舞厅中低垂摆动，带着大胆气势。
entries.traditional: 紅色禮服布料在燭光舞廳中低垂擺動，帶著大膽氣勢。

entries.source: Black dress fabric falls in a shadowed formal line.
entries.simplified: 黑色礼服面料沿暗色正式线条垂落。
entries.traditional: 黑色禮服面料沿暗色正式線條垂落。

entries.source: Rescue canvas braces the legs through falling timber lit by ash.
entries.simplified: 救援帆布保护双腿穿过被灰烬照亮的坠落木梁。
entries.traditional: 救援帆布保護雙腿穿過被灰燼照亮的墜落木梁。

entries.source: Dusty wrappings mark these pants for roadside trouble after sundown.
entries.simplified: 灰尘染过的裹布标志着日落后来自路边的麻烦。
entries.traditional: 灰塵染過的裹布標誌著日落後來自路邊的麻煩。

entries.source: Gilded leggings carry courtly posture for a ruler's coat.
entries.simplified: 镀金绑腿为王者外套维持宫廷姿态。
entries.traditional: 鍍金綁腿為王者外套維持宮廷姿態。

entries.source: Blue shorts catch summer air across quick-footed errands.
entries.simplified: 蓝色短裤在迅捷差事中捕捉夏日空气。
entries.traditional: 藍色短褲在迅捷差事中捕捉夏日空氣。

entries.source: Plush bunny legs turn every step into meadow foolishness.
entries.simplified: 毛绒兔腿让每一步都变成草原上的傻气胡闹。
entries.traditional: 毛絨兔腿讓每一步都變成草原上的傻氣胡鬧。

entries.source: Blue dino scales stomp softly with ancient playground pride.
entries.simplified: 蓝色恐龙鳞片以古老而童趣的骄傲轻轻跺地。
entries.traditional: 藍色恐龍鱗片以古老而童趣的驕傲輕輕跺地。

entries.source: Rounded bear legs give the outfit sleepy woodland weight.
entries.simplified: 圆润熊腿为整套服装增添困倦森林的重量。
entries.traditional: 圓潤熊腿為整套服裝增添困倦森林的重量。

entries.source: Feline legwear pads through parlor shadows with sly grace.
entries.simplified: 猫科腿装以狡黠优雅穿过客厅阴影。
entries.traditional: 貓科腿裝以狡黠優雅穿過客廳陰影。

entries.source: Winter trousers glow with ribbon colors from a hearthside celebration.
entries.simplified: 冬季长裤泛着炉边庆典留下的缎带色彩。
entries.traditional: 冬季長褲泛著爐邊慶典留下的緞帶色彩。

entries.source: Reinforced dive cloth belongs near slick docks before deep-water work.
entries.simplified: 强化潜水布料属于深水作业前那片湿滑码头。
entries.traditional: 強化潛水布料屬於深水作業前那片濕滑碼頭。

entries.source: Ocean-blue shark legs circle the outfit with toothy sea bravado.
entries.simplified: 海洋蓝鲨鱼腿围绕整套服装，散发露齿的海上气势。
entries.traditional: 海洋藍鯊魚腿圍繞整套服裝，散髮露齒的海上氣勢。

entries.source: Padded league trousers brace for tackles in roaring field light.
entries.simplified: 加垫联赛长裤准备迎接怒吼球场灯光下的擒抱。
entries.traditional: 加墊聯賽長褲準備迎接怒吼球場燈光下的擒抱。

entries.source: Crimson fabric deepens the dress into formal firelight.
entries.simplified: 猩红布料让礼服在正式火光中更加深沉。
entries.traditional: 猩紅布料讓禮服在正式火光中更加深沉。

entries.source: Yellow boxers radiate cheerful nonsense inside any serious costume.
entries.simplified: 黄色平角裤在任何严肃服装内部都散发欢快荒唐感。
entries.traditional: 黃色平角褲在任何嚴肅服裝內部都散髮歡快荒唐感。

entries.source: White shorts keep summer routes light under open sky.
entries.simplified: 白色短裤让夏日路线在开阔天空下保持轻盈。
entries.traditional: 白色短褲讓夏日路線在開闊天空下保持輕盈。

entries.source: Wind catches in its fur as it slips between trees and roots.
entries.simplified: 风钻入它的皮毛，伴随它从树木与根须之间悄然穿行。
entries.traditional: 風鑽入它的皮毛，伴隨它從樹木與根鬚之間悄然穿行。

entries.source: Polished metal and a proud red plume carry old imperial discipline.
entries.simplified: 抛光金属与骄傲的红色羽冠承载着古老帝国的纪律。
entries.traditional: 拋光金屬與驕傲的紅色羽冠承載著古老帝國的紀律。

entries.source: An ornate mask used in ancient rituals. Rumored to ward off evil spirits.
entries.simplified: 一副用于古老仪式的华丽面具。据说能驱除邪灵。
entries.traditional: 一副用於古老儀式的華麗面具。據說能驅除邪靈。

entries.source: “Do not just swing for your enemies. Swing to protect the circle of folk standing behind you.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “别只顾着把武器挥向敌人。挥动它，也是为了保护身后围成一圈的人。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “別只顧著把武器揮向敵人。揮動它，也是為了保護身後圍成一圈的人。” — Suphara

entries.source: “Cold travels best in chains. Cast once, and let it find the next fool.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “寒意沿着锁链传得最快。施放一次，让它自己去找下一个蠢货。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “寒意沿著鎖鏈傳得最快。施放一次，讓它自己去找下一個蠢貨。” — Suphara

entries.source: Heavy chains solve the problem of spirits leaving before the battle ends.
entries.simplified: 沉重锁链解决了灵体在战斗结束前擅自离场的问题。
entries.traditional: 沉重鎖鏈解決了靈體在戰鬥結束前擅自離場的問題。

entries.source: “A holy blade is still steel, lad. Faith only matters if your arm does too.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “圣刃终究也是钢，小子。你的手臂若没力气，信仰也无济于事。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “聖刃終究也是鋼，小子。你的手臂若沒力氣，信仰也派不上用場。” — Suphara

entries.source: “Do not command chaos. Give it an edge and stand behind it.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “别想着号令混沌。给它开个锋，然后站到它后面去。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “別想著號令混沌。替它開個鋒，然後站到它後面去。” — Suphara

entries.source: Words appear within a gentle frame of celestial light. Simple greetings gain the calm dignity of sacred proclamation.
entries.simplified: 话语出现在柔和的天界光框之中。即使简单问候，也拥有神圣宣告般的沉静尊严。
entries.traditional: 話語出現在柔和的天界光框之中。即使簡單問候，也擁有神聖宣告般的沉靜尊嚴。

entries.source: Messages emerge through an infernal frame edged in shadow and smoldering red will. Each line feels dangerous because the darkness recognizes the speaker.
entries.simplified: 信息透过边缘缠绕暗影与暗红意志的地狱框架浮现。每一行都显得危险，因为黑暗认得说话者。
entries.traditional: 訊息透過邊緣纏繞暗影與暗紅意志的地獄框架浮現。每一行都顯得危險，因為黑暗認得說話者。

entries.source: Academy blouse carries ink-blue trim with scholar-ready composure.
entries.simplified: 学院女式上衣带着墨蓝饰边，展现随时准备学习的沉稳。
entries.traditional: 學院女式上衣帶著墨藍飾邊，展現隨時準備學習的沉穩。

entries.source: Academy jacket sits square at the shoulders with lecture-hall discipline.
entries.simplified: 学院外套方正贴合肩部，带着讲堂式纪律。
entries.traditional: 學院外套方正貼合肩部，帶著講堂式紀律。

entries.source: Sacred white cloth shapes founder raiment with gold trim and bright turquoise sigils. A sky-temple guardian rises through the heroine with grace touched by first light.
entries.simplified: 神圣白布以金色饰边与明亮青绿色符印构成创始者礼装。沐浴初光的天空神殿守护者，以优雅姿态从女英雄身上显现。
entries.traditional: 神聖白布以金色飾邊與明亮青綠色符印構成創始者禮裝。沐浴初光的天空神殿守護者，以優雅姿態從女英雄身上顯現。

entries.source: White ceremonial armor forms founder raiment with gold and turquoise signs of blessing. A noble guardian emerges through the hero with honor drawn from first light.
entries.simplified: 洁白礼仪护甲以金色与青绿色祝福标记构成创始者礼装。汲取初光荣耀的高贵守护者，从男英雄身上显现。
entries.traditional: 潔白禮儀護甲以金色與青綠色祝福標記構成創始者禮裝。汲取初光榮耀的高貴守護者，從男英雄身上顯現。

entries.source: Sharp white trim defines black cloth with raven masquerade grace. The heroine steps from moonlit celebration as a crow herald entering legend.
entries.simplified: 锐利白色饰边勾勒黑布，带着渡鸦化装舞会般的优雅。女英雄从月光庆典中走出，如同踏入传说的乌鸦使者。
entries.traditional: 銳利白色飾邊勾勒黑布，帶著渡鴉化裝舞會般的優雅。女英雄從月光慶典中走出，如同踏入傳說的烏鴉使者。

entries.source: Pale lacing cuts across bold black cloth with feathered shadow at the back. Crow marked confidence arrives before the reveler speaks.
entries.simplified: 浅色系带横贯大胆黑布，背后拖着羽毛般的暗影。带有乌鸦印记的自信，总在庆典者开口前先行抵达。
entries.traditional: 淺色系帶橫貫大膽黑布，背後拖著羽毛般的暗影。帶有烏鴉印記的自信，總在慶典者開口前先行抵達。

entries.source: White armor plates bind over a black spelltech core. Neon green circuits and magenta markings crown the runner with living signal.
entries.simplified: 白色护甲板覆盖黑色 Spelltech 核心。霓虹绿电路与洋红标记为奔行者加冕，使其化作活生生的信号。
entries.traditional: 白色護甲板覆蓋黑色 Spelltech 核心。霓虹綠電路與洋紅標記為奔行者加冕，使其化作活生生的信號。

entries.source: Dark elegance wraps crimson accents that glow through ritual cloth. A forbidden pact shows beauty enough to admire and fire enough to fear.
entries.simplified: 黑暗优雅包裹着在仪式布料间发光的猩红饰边。禁忌契约显露出足以令人欣赏的美，也释放足以令人畏惧的火焰。
entries.traditional: 黑暗優雅包裹著在儀式布料間發光的猩紅飾邊。禁忌契約顯露出足以令人欣賞的美，也釋放足以令人畏懼的火焰。

entries.source: Shadowed fabric falls with commanding weight and ember-bright signs of power. An infernal noble rises through the hero with dread as his crown.
entries.simplified: 暗影布料带着号令般重量垂落，余烬般明亮的力量符号在其间闪烁。地狱贵族从男英雄身上显现，以恐惧作为王冠。
entries.traditional: 暗影布料帶著號令般重量垂落，餘燼般明亮的力量符號在其間閃爍。地獄貴族從男英雄身上顯現，以恐懼作為王冠。

entries.source: Pastel festival cloth brings cheerful spring charm to the outfit.
entries.simplified: 柔和粉彩节庆布料为整套服装带来欢快春日魅力。
entries.traditional: 柔和粉彩節慶布料為整套服裝帶來歡快春日魅力。

entries.source: Soft spring colors keep the outfit bright and easygoing.
entries.simplified: 柔软春日色彩让整套服装保持明亮而轻松。
entries.traditional: 柔軟春日色彩讓整套服裝保持明亮而輕鬆。

entries.source: Warm foxfire cloth adds playful woodland energy to the outfit.
entries.simplified: 温暖狐火布料为服装增添活泼的林野能量。
entries.traditional: 溫暖狐火布料為服裝增添活潑的林野能量。

entries.source: Gentle storybook cloth brings cozy companion charm to the outfit.
entries.simplified: 温柔童话布料为服装带来舒适的伙伴魅力。
entries.traditional: 溫柔童話布料為服裝帶來舒適的夥伴魅力。

entries.source: Dust-brown coat hangs with holster-worn grit around a sunburned collar.
entries.simplified: 尘褐外套垂落在晒红的衣领旁，带着手枪套磨出的粗粝气息。
entries.traditional: 塵褐外套垂落在曬紅的衣領旁，帶著手槍套磨出的粗糲氣息。

entries.source: Pale winter cloth adds quiet frost charm to the outfit.
entries.simplified: 苍白冬布为服装增添安静的寒霜魅力。
entries.traditional: 蒼白冬布為服裝增添安靜的寒霜魅力。

entries.source: Sacred cloth and soft lines suit a healer ready for solemn service.
entries.simplified: 神圣布料与柔和线条适合准备庄严服侍的治疗者。
entries.traditional: 神聖布料與柔和線條適合準備莊嚴服侍的治療者。

entries.source: Sacred cloth and clean lines suit a healer ready for solemn service.
entries.simplified: 神圣布料与利落线条适合准备庄严服侍的治疗者。
entries.traditional: 神聖布料與利落線條適合準備莊嚴服侍的治療者。

entries.source: Layered crimson cloth narrows each movement into silent intent.
entries.simplified: 层叠猩红布料将每一个动作收束为无声意图。
entries.traditional: 層疊猩紅布料將每一個動作收束為無聲意圖。

entries.source: Bright supporter pride shapes a festive silhouette. The outfit becomes a visible pledge of shared legacy.
entries.simplified: 明亮的支持者自豪感塑造出节庆轮廓。整套服装成为共同传承的醒目誓言。
entries.traditional: 明亮的支持者自豪感塑造出節慶輪廓。整套服裝成為共同傳承的醒目誓言。

entries.source: Sharp uniform lines cut a rebellious profile through academy halls.
entries.simplified: 锐利制服线条在学院大厅中勾勒出叛逆身影。
entries.traditional: 銳利制服線條在學院大廳中勾勒出叛逆身影。

entries.source: Structured school jacket carries alleywise defiance around a crisp collar.
entries.simplified: 结构分明的校服外套在整洁衣领周围承载着巷道式反抗。
entries.traditional: 結構分明的校服外套在整潔衣領周圍承載著巷道式反抗。

entries.source: Unseen fabric preserves the outfit through masterful imaginary tailoring.
entries.simplified: 隐形布料凭借精湛的想象裁缝工艺，完整保留整套服装。
entries.traditional: 隱形布料憑借精湛的想象裁縫工藝，完整保留整套服裝。

entries.source: City-cut fabric gives this top a relaxed tavern-corner attitude.
entries.simplified: 都市剪裁布料让这件上衣拥有轻松的酒馆角落气息。
entries.traditional: 都市剪裁布料讓這件上衣擁有輕鬆的酒館角落氣息。

entries.source: Snowy cat ears soften this hoodie into a cozy familiar disguise.
entries.simplified: 雪白猫耳把这件连帽衫柔化成舒适的魔宠伪装。
entries.traditional: 雪白貓耳把這件連帽衫柔化成舒適的魔寵偽裝。

entries.source: Arcane cloth shapes a focused look for careful spellwork.
entries.simplified: 奥术布料塑造专注外观，适合谨慎施法。
entries.traditional: 奧術布料塑造專注外觀，適合謹慎施法。

entries.source: Layered arcane cloth suits long study and steady spellwork.
entries.simplified: 层叠奥术布料适合长时间研读与稳定施法。
entries.traditional: 層疊奧術布料適合長時間研讀與穩定施法。

entries.source: Tiny meadow birds peck at shiny objects and scatter when larger creatures approach.
entries.simplified: 这些草原小鸟会啄食闪亮物件，并在大型生物接近时四散逃走。
entries.traditional: 這些草原小鳥會啄食閃亮物件，並在大型生物接近時四散逃走。

entries.source: Worn by the brave (or confused) poultry knights. Surprisingly durable.
entries.simplified: 由勇敢（或糊涂）的家禽骑士佩戴。意外地耐用。
entries.traditional: 由勇敢（或迷糊）的家禽騎士佩戴。意外地耐用。

entries.source: A bashful chick sits snugly on your head. Its warmth is oddly soothing.
entries.simplified: 一只害羞的小鸡紧贴着坐在你头上。它的温暖莫名令人安心。
entries.traditional: 一隻害羞的小雞緊貼著坐在你頭上。牠的溫暖莫名令人安心。

entries.source: Those teeth are not decorative, which is exactly what worries everyone.
entries.simplified: 那些牙齿可不是装饰，而这恰恰正是让所有人担心的地方。
entries.traditional: 那些牙齒可不是裝飾，而這恰恰就是讓所有人擔心的地方。

entries.source: Golden thread warms the robes, turning gentle gestures into quiet comfort.
entries.simplified: 金色丝线温暖着长袍，让轻柔的手势化作无声慰藉。
entries.traditional: 金色絲線溫暖著長袍，讓輕柔的手勢化作無聲慰藉。

entries.source: Soft glow follows each step, like prayers walking slightly ahead.
entries.simplified: 柔光追随着每一步，仿佛祈祷总是走在前方半步。
entries.traditional: 柔光跟隨著每一步，彷彿祈禱總是走在前方半步。

entries.source: Pale linen and renewal runes carry steady steps toward wounded allies.
entries.simplified: 淡色亚麻与复苏符文承载着走向受伤盟友的沉稳步伐。
entries.traditional: 淡色亞麻與復甦符文承載著走向受傷隊友的沉穩步伐。

entries.source: Soft fog curls around the loop, drifting like it missed a meeting.
entries.simplified: 柔雾缠绕着圆环，飘忽得像是错过了一场会议。
entries.traditional: 柔霧纏繞著圓環，飄忽得像是錯過了一場會議。

entries.source: A tamed thundercloud that drifts beneath the rider with soft, steady lift.
entries.simplified: 一朵驯服的雷云以柔和而稳定的浮力托着骑手向前漂行。
entries.traditional: 一朵馴服的雷雲以柔和而穩定的浮力托著騎手向前漂行。

entries.source: Gilded pages glow hot enough to sear shadows and steady faith.
entries.simplified: 镀金书页灼热发光，足以烧灼阴影并稳固信仰。
entries.traditional: 鍍金書頁灼熱發光，足以灼燒陰影並穩固信念。

entries.source: Weathered scripture that holds the first prayer sung toward the heavens.
entries.simplified: 饱经风霜的经文，保存着第一声向苍穹唱出的祷告。
entries.traditional: 飽經風霜的經文，保存著第一聲朝天際唱出的禱告。

entries.source: “Write truth in light, and even old darkness has to blink.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “以光书写真理，就连古老的黑暗也得眨眼。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “以光寫下真理，就連古老的黑暗也得眨眼。” — Suphara

entries.source: “I copied Umbra’s curses, not their full hunger. Open it only when you are ready for the dark to answer.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “我抄下了 Umbra 的诅咒，但没把它们全部的饥渴也抄进去。只有当你准备好让黑暗回应时，才把它打开。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “我抄下了 Umbra 的詛咒，但沒把它們完整的飢渴也抄進去。只有當你準備好讓黑暗回應時，才把它打開。” — Suphara

entries.source: “I copied Vitae’s light as best I could. It mends flesh and steadies the living. May it carry you to victory.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “我尽力抄下了 Vitae 的光。它能修补血肉，稳住生者。愿它护送你走向胜利。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “我盡力抄下了 Vitae 的光。它能修補血肉，穩住生者。願它護送你走向勝利。” — Suphara

entries.source: A simple leather-bound book inscribed with common prayers. While plain in form, it channels the user's focus into gentle support magic.
entries.simplified: 一本朴素的皮革封面书籍，记载着常见祷文。外观虽不起眼，却能将使用者的专注引导为温和的辅助魔法。
entries.traditional: 一本樸素的皮革封面書籍，記載著常見禱文。外觀雖不起眼，卻能將使用者的專注引導為溫和的支援魔法。

entries.source: “Fancy blades win praise. Plain ones win fights. Keep it sharp, keep it close, and let the fool bleed first.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “花哨的刀能赢来喝彩。朴素的刀能赢下战斗。磨快它，带近些，让那个蠢货先流血。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “花俏的刀能贏來喝采。樸素的刀能贏下戰鬥。磨利它、帶近些，讓那個蠢貨先流血。” — Suphara

entries.source: Dust, sneezes, and awkward alley smells meet their soft cotton rival.
entries.simplified: 灰尘、喷嚏和巷子里难闻的怪味，都遇上了柔软棉布这个对手。
entries.traditional: 灰塵、噴嚏和巷弄裡難聞的怪味，都遇上了柔軟棉布這個對手。

entries.source: Golden feathers flare brightest when combat leaves no room for hesitation.
entries.simplified: 当战斗容不得半分犹豫时，金色羽毛便绽放出最耀眼的光芒。
entries.traditional: 當戰鬥容不得半分猶豫時，金色羽毛便綻放出最耀眼的光芒。

entries.source: Ruby feathers draw every eye before the first weapon moves.
entries.simplified: 第一件武器尚未挥动，红宝石般的羽毛便已吸引所有目光。
entries.traditional: 第一件武器尚未揮動，紅寶石般的羽毛便已吸引所有目光。

entries.source: Arena champions wore this crown because comfort clearly lost the argument.
entries.simplified: 竞技场冠军戴着这顶王冠，因为舒适显然输掉了争论。
entries.traditional: 競技場冠軍戴著這頂王冠，因為舒適顯然輸掉了爭論。

entries.source: “If judgment must fall, make sure it falls with good aim.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “既然审判必须降临，就确保它落得够准。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “既然審判必須降臨，就確保它落得夠準。” — Suphara

entries.source: After breaking their oaths, these Paladins turned from protectors to crusaders and honed their holy arts against their enemies.
entries.simplified: 这些 Paladins 背弃誓言后，不再担任守护者，而是化身征伐者，将圣术磨砺成对付敌人的利器。
entries.traditional: 這些 Paladins 背棄誓言後，不再擔任守護者，而是化身征伐者，將聖術磨礪成對付敵人的利器。

entries.source: Mana stones rattle inside, making every step sound slightly more expensive.
entries.simplified: Mana 石在里面叮当作响，让每一步听起来都贵了几分。
entries.traditional: Mana 石在裡面叮噹作響，讓每一步聽起來都貴了幾分。

entries.source: “Some hammers break stone. This wee monster breaks the space around it.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “有些锤子能碎石。这只小怪物连周围的空间都能砸碎。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “有些鎚子能碎石。這隻小怪物連周圍的空間都能砸碎。” — Suphara

entries.source: Elemental color runs through winglike shards, shimmering with quiet power.
entries.simplified: 元素色彩流淌于翼状碎片之间，闪烁着沉静的力量。
entries.traditional: 元素色彩流淌於翼狀碎片之間，閃爍著沉靜的力量。

entries.source: Sacred paper keeps spirits away, provided nobody sticks it upside down.
entries.simplified: 圣纸能让灵体退避，前提是没人把它倒着贴。
entries.traditional: 聖紙能讓靈體退避，前提是沒人把它倒著貼。

entries.source: The lock breathes faintly, which most librarians consider a serious problem.
entries.simplified: 锁扣正轻轻呼吸，而大多数图书管理员都认为这问题非常严重。
entries.traditional: 鎖扣正輕輕呼吸，而大多數圖書館員都認為這問題非常嚴重。

entries.source: Smaller one-eyed brutes stay near stronger kin and strike at anything that comes too close.
entries.simplified: 这些较小的独眼蛮兽会跟随在强大同类附近，攻击任何过于靠近的生物。
entries.traditional: 這些較小的獨眼蠻獸會跟隨在強大同類附近，攻擊任何過於靠近的生物。

entries.source: Twin blades wait quietly, because loud daggers rarely keep their jobs.
entries.simplified: 双刃静静等待着，因为太吵的匕首通常保不住自己的饭碗。
entries.traditional: 雙刃靜靜等待著，因為太吵的匕首通常保不住自己的飯碗。

entries.source: Raven-black feathers spread with a whisper that sounds like bad news.
entries.simplified: 鸦黑羽毛伴着低语展开，听起来像个坏消息。
entries.traditional: 鴉黑羽毛伴著低語展開，聽起來像個壞消息。

entries.source: Blackened hide keeps dull heat close, quickening blood beneath the fingers.
entries.simplified: 焦黑兽皮将闷热紧贴肌肤，催动指间的血液更快流转。
entries.traditional: 焦黑獸皮將悶熱緊貼肌膚，催動指間的血液更快流轉。

entries.source: Each bead holds a sunrise vow, worn smooth by patient hands.
entries.simplified: 每一颗珠子都封存着日出时立下的誓言，被耐心的双手磨得光滑。
entries.traditional: 每一顆珠子都封存著日出時立下的誓言，被耐心的雙手磨得光滑。

entries.source: “Morning light is gentle until you forge spikes into it.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “晨光本来很温柔，直到你给它锻上尖刺。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “晨光本來很溫柔，直到你替它鍛上尖刺。” — Suphara

entries.source: This hooded figure drifts through castle corridors and casts shadow magic from a distance.
entries.simplified: 这名兜帽身影漂浮于城堡走廊，并从远处施放暗影魔法。
entries.traditional: 這名兜帽身影漂浮於城堡走廊，並從遠處施放暗影魔法。

entries.source: Those glowing eyes promise mischief, bad decisions, and absolutely no apologies.
entries.simplified: 那双发光的眼睛许诺着恶作剧、糟糕决定，以及绝无半点歉意。
entries.traditional: 那雙發光的眼睛承諾著惡作劇、糟糕決定，以及絕無半點歉意。

entries.source: Violet horns whisper dark ambition, then pretend they said nothing.
entries.simplified: 紫色犄角低语着黑暗野心，随后假装自己什么都没说。
entries.traditional: 紫色犄角低語著黑暗野心，隨後假裝自己什麼都沒說。

entries.source: Raw destructive focus burns through defenses, though the wielder pays for every shortcut.
entries.simplified: 纯粹的毁灭专注会烧穿防御，但持有者也要为每一次捷径付出代价。
entries.traditional: 純粹的毀滅專注會燒穿防禦，但持有者也要為每一次捷徑付出代價。

entries.source: Blue scales, tiny charm, and prehistoric storage make burdens less boring.
entries.simplified: 蓝色鳞片、小巧魅力与史前收纳空间，让负担不再那么无聊。
entries.traditional: 藍色鱗片、小巧魅力與史前收納空間，讓負擔不再那麼無聊。

entries.source: Plain bracers with many slots, waiting for a disciple to define their path.
entries.simplified: 朴素的护腕带有许多插槽，等待一名弟子亲手决定自己的道路。
entries.traditional: 樸素的護腕帶有許多插槽，等待一名弟子親手決定自己的道路。

entries.source: Unadorned training cloth leaves room for power chosen through careful preparation.
entries.simplified: 未经装饰的训练布料，为通过谨慎准备所选择的力量留出空间。
entries.traditional: 未經裝飾的訓練布料，為透過謹慎準備所選擇的力量留出空間。

entries.source: Quiet steps carry the discipline of someone still deciding what they will become.
entries.simplified: 沉静的步伐承载着尚在决定自己将成为什么之人的自律。
entries.traditional: 沉靜的步伐承載著尚在決定自己將成為何種人物的自律。

entries.source: A simple visage masks uncertainty while leaving room for many future answers.
entries.simplified: 一张朴素的面容遮住不确定，也为未来的诸多答案留出余地。
entries.traditional: 一張樸素的面容遮住不確定，也為未來的諸多答案留出餘地。

entries.source: Layered wraps hold steady through practice, mistakes, and the first shape of mastery.
entries.simplified: 层叠裹布在练习、失误与初见雏形的精通中始终稳固。
entries.traditional: 層疊裹布在練習、失誤與初見雛形的精通中始終穩固。

entries.source: Sharp angles and scholar craft keep martial focus close at hand.
entries.simplified: 锐利棱角与学者工艺，让武艺专注始终近在手边。
entries.traditional: 銳利稜角與學者工藝，讓武藝專注始終近在手邊。

entries.source: Young fire-touched beasts rush toward sudden movement before they understand the danger.
entries.simplified: 这些受到火焰侵染的幼兽会扑向突然出现的动静，尚未来得及理解其中危险。
entries.traditional: 這些受到火焰侵染的幼獸會撲向突然出現的動靜，尚未來得及理解其中危險。

entries.source: Blackened steel curves wide, carrying grim weight through every swing.
entries.simplified: 焦黑钢铁弯成宽阔弧线，让每一次挥击都承载着阴沉重量。
entries.traditional: 焦黑鋼鐵彎成寬闊弧線，讓每一次揮擊都承載著陰沉重量。

entries.source: Regret-dark metal and a crimson spike make betrayal feel ceremonial.
entries.simplified: 悔恨般黯黑的金属与猩红尖刺，让背叛也显得像一场仪式。
entries.traditional: 悔恨般黯黑的金屬與猩紅尖刺，讓背叛也顯得像一場儀式。

entries.source: The skull label answers most questions before anyone asks twice.
entries.simplified: 骷髅标签在任何人追问之前，就已经回答了大多数问题。
entries.traditional: 骷髏標籤在任何人追問之前，就已經回答了大多數問題。

entries.source: Frost gathers along its wings and jaws as it stalks the crystal paths.
entries.simplified: 霜冻沿着它的双翼与颚部汇聚，伴随它潜行于水晶小径。
entries.traditional: 霜凍沿著它的雙翼與顎部匯聚，伴隨它潛行於水晶小徑。

entries.source: Shadow clings between its scales even as it moves through sacred halls.
entries.simplified: 暗影盘踞在它的鳞片之间，即使穿行于神圣大厅也不曾散去。
entries.traditional: 暗影盤踞在它的鱗片之間，即使穿行於神聖大廳也不曾散去。

entries.source: Dim light gathers around this smaller dragon as it moves quickly through sacred halls.
entries.simplified: 昏暗光芒环绕着这条较小的巨龙，伴随它快速穿过神圣大厅。
entries.traditional: 昏暗光芒環繞著這條較小的巨龍，伴隨它快速穿過神聖大廳。

entries.source: Scaled plates glare forward, making polite conversations much harder nearby.
entries.simplified: 鳞甲恶狠狠地瞪向前方，让附近的礼貌交谈变得困难许多。
entries.traditional: 鱗甲惡狠狠地瞪向前方，讓附近的禮貌交談變得困難許多。

entries.source: This larger fire dragon carries intense heat across its scales and jaws.
entries.simplified: 这条体型更大的火龙让强烈热量遍布鳞片与颚部。
entries.traditional: 這條體型更大的火龍讓強烈熱量遍布鱗片與顎部。

entries.source: Sparks skip across its scales when it prepares to dart forward.
entries.simplified: 它准备猛然前冲时，电火花会在鳞片表面跳动。
entries.traditional: 它準備猛然前衝時，電火花會在鱗片表面跳動。

entries.source: Cool mist trails behind this small dragon as it prowls through crystal paths.
entries.simplified: 清凉薄雾拖曳在这条小龙身后，伴随它潜行于水晶小径。
entries.traditional: 清涼薄霧拖曳在這條小龍身後，伴隨它潛行於水晶小徑。

entries.source: This broad-winged marsh insect hovers in place before snapping into motion.
entries.simplified: 这只宽翼沼泽昆虫会先悬停原地，随后骤然加速。
entries.traditional: 這隻寬翼沼澤昆蟲會先懸停原地，隨後驟然加速。

entries.source: A jagged scale-point channels old draconic fury through each thrust.
entries.simplified: 锯齿状鳞尖将古老龙怒灌注进每一次突刺。
entries.traditional: 鋸齒狀鱗尖將古老龍怒灌注進每一次突刺。

entries.source: This helm suggests dragon-slaying confidence, even when confidence came separately.
entries.simplified: 这顶头盔散发着屠龙般的自信，即使那份自信需要另行配备。
entries.traditional: 這頂頭盔散發著屠龍般的自信，即使那份自信需要另行配備。

entries.source: The bat naps upside-down, contributing ominous vibes and occasional usefulness.
entries.simplified: 蝙蝠倒挂着打盹，贡献出不祥气息，以及偶尔的一点用处。
entries.traditional: 蝙蝠倒掛著打盹，貢獻出不祥氣息，以及偶爾的一點用處。

entries.source: A sleepy mole nests overhead, waiting to throw dirt professionally.
entries.simplified: 一只困倦的鼹鼠在头顶筑巢，等着以专业手法扬起泥土。
entries.traditional: 一隻睏倦的鼴鼠在頭頂築巢，等著以專業手法揚起泥土。

entries.source: Smug little storm cat rests there, fully aware it looks important.
entries.simplified: 那只得意洋洋的小风暴猫趴在那里，完全知道自己看起来很重要。
entries.traditional: 那隻得意洋洋的小風暴貓趴在那裡，完全知道自己看起來很重要。

entries.source: The blossom droops sleepily, then remembers battle is happening and helps.
entries.simplified: 花朵困倦地低垂着，随后想起战斗还在继续，便出手相助。
entries.traditional: 花朵睏倦地低垂著，隨後想起戰鬥還在繼續，便出手相助。

entries.source: This pup snoozes warmly until danger gives it barking permission.
entries.simplified: 这只小狗暖洋洋地打着盹，直到危险准许它放声吠叫。
entries.traditional: 這隻小狗暖洋洋地打著盹，直到危險准許牠放聲吠叫。

entries.source: Two blades ride together, because one dramatic entrance was not enough.
entries.simplified: 两把刀并肩而行，因为一次戏剧性的登场显然还不够。
entries.traditional: 兩把刀並肩而行，因為一次戲劇性的登場顯然還不夠。

entries.source: “The dark is not cowardly. It just knows when to bite.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “黑暗并不怯懦。它只是知道该在什么时候咬下去。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “黑暗並不怯懦。它只是知道該在什麼時候咬下去。” — Suphara

entries.source: Sand chewed the brim, but the hat remains annoyingly proud.
entries.simplified: 沙砾啃噬了帽檐，可这顶帽子依旧骄傲得令人恼火。
entries.traditional: 沙礫啃噬了帽緣，可這頂帽子依舊驕傲得令人惱火。

entries.source: Blue beads sway like springwater sealed inside tiny charms.
entries.simplified: 蓝色珠饰轻轻摇摆，仿佛春水被封存在细小护符之中。
entries.traditional: 藍色珠飾輕輕搖擺，彷彿春水被封存在細小護符之中。

entries.source: Frosted crystal shards catch pale light along careful silver hooks.
entries.simplified: 覆霜水晶碎片沿精致银钩捕捉苍白光芒。
entries.traditional: 覆霜水晶碎片沿精致銀鈎捕捉蒼白光芒。

entries.source: A dark earring gleams like a shard of sealed temptation. Infernal favor whispers through a dangerous note of forbidden refinement.
entries.simplified: 一枚黑暗耳饰如被封印的诱惑碎片般闪耀。地狱眷顾透过危险而禁忌的精致气息低声诱惑。
entries.traditional: 一枚黑暗耳飾如被封印的誘惑碎片般閃耀。地獄眷顧透過危險而禁忌的精致氣息低聲誘惑。

entries.source: White earbuds carry private songs through crowded market noise.
entries.simplified: 白色耳塞在喧闹市集中传递只属于自己的歌声。
entries.traditional: 白色耳塞在喧鬧市集中傳遞只屬於自己的歌聲。

entries.source: Dark feathers brush bright beads with wanderer shrinecraft.
entries.simplified: 深色羽毛擦过明亮珠饰，带着旅人神龛工艺的气息。
entries.traditional: 深色羽毛擦過明亮珠飾，帶著旅人神龕工藝的氣息。

entries.source: Pale blue crystal slivers hold moonlight like frozen prayer glass.
entries.simplified: 苍蓝水晶薄片将月光封存其中，宛如冻结的祷告玻璃。
entries.traditional: 蒼藍水晶薄片將月光封存其中，宛如凍結的禱告玻璃。

entries.source: Black heartstone hangs heavy with volcanic secrecy.
entries.simplified: 黑色心形石沉沉垂落，藏着火山般的秘密。
entries.traditional: 黑色心形石沉沉垂落，藏著火山般的秘密。

entries.source: Scarlet affection rests inside pearlwork meant for moonlit promises.
entries.simplified: 猩红爱意藏在珍珠工艺之中，为月光下的承诺而生。
entries.traditional: 猩紅愛意藏在珍珠工藝之中，為月光下的承諾而生。

entries.source: Stacked droplets bob as if rain learned vanity.
entries.simplified: 层叠水滴轻轻摇晃，仿佛雨水学会了爱美。
entries.traditional: 層疊水滴輕輕搖晃，彷彿雨水學會了愛美。

entries.source: Golden wire cradles a pale pearl from tide-blessed shallows.
entries.simplified: 金色丝线托住一颗来自潮汐祝福浅滩的苍白珍珠。
entries.traditional: 金色絲線托住一顆來自潮汐祝福淺灘的蒼白珍珠。

entries.source: A golden sun sigil burns softly beside the cheek.
entries.simplified: 金色太阳符印在脸颊旁柔和燃烧。
entries.traditional: 金色太陽符印在臉頰旁柔和燃燒。

entries.source: Tiny green leaves dangle with the optimism of new forest magic.
entries.simplified: 细小绿叶垂落，带着新生森林魔法的乐观。
entries.traditional: 細小綠葉垂落，帶著新生森林魔法的樂觀。

entries.source: “If the ground must complain, make sure it complains under their feet.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “要是大地非得抱怨，就让它在敌人脚下抱怨。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “要是大地非得抱怨，就讓它在敵人腳下抱怨。” — Suphara

entries.source: “Let the earth hold you firm; it will steady you through rock and stone.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “让大地稳稳托住你；无论岩石还是山峦，它都会助你站定。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “讓大地穩穩托住你；無論岩石還是山巒，它都會助你站穩。” — Suphara

entries.source: “Throw the shadow before the darkness knows you’re gone.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “在黑暗察觉你已离开之前，先把影子掷出去。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “在黑暗察覺你已離開之前，先把影子擲出去。” — Suphara

entries.source: Light and shadow braid through twin edges, cutting in perfect rhythm.
entries.simplified: 光与影交织于双刃之间，以完美的节奏切割一切。
entries.traditional: 光與影交織於雙刃之間，以完美節奏切割一切。

entries.source: Wax seals the brew tightly, preventing leaks and suspicious taste tests.
entries.simplified: 蜡封将药液牢牢封住，既防泄漏，也防可疑的偷尝。
entries.traditional: 蠟封將藥液牢牢封住，既防滲漏，也防可疑的偷嚐。

entries.source: Red eyes glare from cruel hide, warmed by darker ambitions.
entries.simplified: 红色双眼从残酷的兽皮中怒视，因更加阴暗的野心而升温。
entries.traditional: 紅色雙眼從殘酷的獸皮中怒視，因更加陰暗的野心而升溫。

entries.source: A burning gem shines at the top, eager for flame.
entries.simplified: 一颗燃烧的宝石在顶端闪耀，迫不及待地渴望火焰。
entries.traditional: 一顆燃燒的寶石在頂端閃耀，迫不及待地渴望火焰。

entries.source: One verdant gem softens the gold, regal without losing warmth.
entries.simplified: 一枚翠绿宝石柔化了金色的威严，使其尊贵却不失温暖。
entries.traditional: 一枚翠綠寶石柔化了金色的威嚴，使其尊貴卻不失溫暖。

entries.source: A radiant circlet appears in a flourish of triumph above the hero. Celebration becomes a royal moment of victory.
entries.simplified: 辉耀冠环在英雄头顶以胜利姿态闪现。庆典化作一场皇家凯旋时刻。
entries.traditional: 輝耀冠環在英雄頭頂以勝利姿態閃現。慶典化作一場皇家凱旋時刻。

entries.source: A bright flourish turns attention into playful victory.
entries.simplified: 明亮光彩将所有目光化作顽皮的胜利。
entries.traditional: 明亮光彩將所有目光化作頑皮的勝利。

entries.source: Warm dance steps bring lively festival joy to the moment.
entries.simplified: 温暖舞步为这一刻带来热烈节庆欢乐。
entries.traditional: 溫暖舞步為這一刻帶來熱烈節慶歡樂。

entries.source: Fast rhythm fills the moment with carnival energy.
entries.simplified: 迅捷节奏让这一刻充满嘉年华能量。
entries.traditional: 迅捷節奏讓這一刻充滿嘉年華能量。

entries.source: A bold dance breaks tension with shameless comic confidence.
entries.simplified: 大胆舞姿以毫不害羞的喜剧自信打破紧张。
entries.traditional: 大膽舞姿以毫不害羞的喜劇自信打破緊張。

entries.source: Calibrated mana splits along the edge, breaking into elemental force.
entries.simplified: 校准后的魔力沿刃缘分流，迸裂成元素力量。
entries.traditional: 校準後的魔力沿刃緣分流，迸裂成元素力量。

entries.source: Opposing forces meet inside the forbidden edge.
entries.simplified: 彼此对立的力量在禁忌之刃中交汇。
entries.traditional: 彼此對立的力量在禁忌之刃中交會。

entries.source: Color shifts along the edge, answering each battlefield with a different threat.
entries.simplified: 色彩沿刃缘变幻，以不同威胁回应每一片战场。
entries.traditional: 色彩沿刃緣變幻，以不同威脅回應每一片戰場。

entries.source: “Winter owns the ground if you let it stay. Plant the frost and make them pay.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “你若任由寒冬停留，大地便归它所有。种下霜冻，让他们付出代价。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “你若任由寒冬停留，大地便歸它所有。種下霜凍，讓他們付出代價。” — Suphara

entries.source: “Mercy has its place. So does ending a problem cleanly.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “仁慈自有其位置。干净利落地结束麻烦也是如此。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “仁慈自有其位置。乾淨俐落地結束麻煩也是如此。” — Suphara

entries.source: A sanctified tome etched with ancient scripture. Its words ripple outward, blessing allies and scouring the unholy with lingering light.
entries.simplified: 一本刻有古老经文的圣化典籍。书中文字如涟漪般向外扩散，赐福盟友，并以久久不散的圣光净除邪祟。
entries.traditional: 一本刻有古老經文的聖化典籍。書中文字如漣漪般向外擴散，賜福隊友，並以久久不散的聖光淨除邪祟。

entries.source: Holy seals coil around the staff, turning patient rites into swift exorcism.
entries.simplified: 神圣封印盘绕在法杖上，将耐心的仪式化作迅捷的驱魔术。
entries.traditional: 神聖封印盤繞在法杖上，將耐心的儀式化作迅捷的驅魔術。

entries.source: The eye watches everything, including choices you hoped it missed.
entries.simplified: 这只眼睛注视着一切，包括那些你希望它没看见的选择。
entries.traditional: 這隻眼睛注視著一切，包括那些你希望它沒看見的選擇。

entries.source: A smoldering gaze burns through the eyes with infernal heat. Fire brushes the soul with beauty enough to tempt and danger enough to warn.
entries.simplified: 燃烧目光带着地狱热意穿过双眼。火焰轻抚灵魂，以足以诱惑的美与足以警告的危险并存。
entries.traditional: 燃燒目光帶著地獄熱意穿過雙眼。火焰輕撫靈魂，以足以誘惑的美與足以警告的危險並存。

entries.source: Infernal light settles into the gaze with patient heat. Each look carries quiet command and turns the face into a warning of dark will.
entries.simplified: 地狱之光以耐心热度沉入目光。每一次注视都带着安静号令，让面容成为黑暗意志的警告。
entries.traditional: 地獄之光以耐心熱度沉入目光。每一次注視都帶著安靜號令，讓面容成為黑暗意志的警告。

entries.source: Red-eyed undead flyers drop quickly from the trees when prey passes below.
entries.simplified: 这些红眼不死飞行生物会在猎物经过下方时，从树间迅速俯冲。
entries.traditional: 這些紅眼不死飛行生物會在獵物經過下方時，從樹間迅速俯衝。

entries.source: One eye rests while the other handles reputation management nearby.
entries.simplified: 一只眼睛休息，另一只则负责处理附近的名声问题。
entries.traditional: 一隻眼睛休息，另一隻則負責處理附近的名聲問題。

entries.source: A black bird mask frames red lenses near a pale crest of ornament. The face becomes a raven masquerade sign with elegant watchful intent.
entries.simplified: 黑色鸟面具在苍白饰冠旁框住红色镜片。面容化作渡鸦化装舞会的标记，带着优雅而警觉的意图。
entries.traditional: 黑色鳥面具在蒼白飾冠旁框住紅色鏡片。面容化作渡鴉化裝舞會的標記，帶著優雅而警覺的意圖。

entries.source: A dark one-eye visor sharpens the face with roguish focus. A crow marked traveler watches the celebration with practiced confidence.
entries.simplified: 深色单眼面罩让面容拥有浪子般的专注。带有乌鸦印记的旅人以熟练自信注视庆典。
entries.traditional: 深色單眼面罩讓面容擁有浪子般的專注。帶有烏鴉印記的旅人以熟練自信注視慶典。

entries.source: A dark mask burns with magenta eyes inside a guarded hood. The face becomes a spelltech omen watching the world through living light.
entries.simplified: 黑暗面具在兜帽保护下燃起洋红双眼。面容化作 Spelltech 预兆，以活生生的光注视世界。
entries.traditional: 黑暗面具在兜帽保護下燃起洋紅雙眼。面容化作 Spelltech 預兆，以活生生的光注視世界。

entries.source: Ice-cut ear crystals flare outward in a sharp winter profile.
entries.simplified: 冰晶雕成的耳饰向外张开，勾勒出锐利冬日轮廓。
entries.traditional: 冰晶雕成的耳飾向外張開，勾勒出銳利冬日輪廓。

entries.source: Pale ritual bone frames red eyes within a hush of archon shadow.
entries.simplified: 苍白仪式骨骼围住红色双眼，笼罩在 Archon 暗影般的静谧中。
entries.traditional: 蒼白儀式骨骼圍住紅色雙眼，籠罩在 Archon 暗影般的靜謐中。

entries.source: Brass-rimmed lenses enlarge the world with workshop-born curiosity.
entries.simplified: 黄铜边镜片放大眼前世界，带着工坊诞生的好奇。
entries.traditional: 黃銅邊鏡片放大眼前世界，帶著工坊誕生的好奇。

entries.source: Red-marked fox lacquer smiles quietly over mischief kept behind porcelain.
entries.simplified: 红色纹样狐面漆器在瓷面之下，安静微笑着藏住恶作剧。
entries.traditional: 紅色紋樣狐面漆器在瓷面之下，安靜微笑著藏住惡作劇。

entries.source: Carved oni teeth snarl through festival paint sharpened for trouble.
entries.simplified: 雕刻的 Oni 利齿穿过为麻烦而磨利的节庆彩绘，露出凶狠笑容。
entries.traditional: 雕刻的 Oni 利齒穿過為麻煩而磨利的節慶彩繪，露出凶狠笑容。

entries.source: Sharp sight lives here, along with very strong bird opinions.
entries.simplified: 锐利的目光寄居于此，连同一套异常强烈的鸟类意见。
entries.traditional: 銳利的目光寄居於此，連同一套異常強烈的鳥類意見。

entries.source: Feathers shape the hood for scouts who enjoy looking judgmental.
entries.simplified: 羽毛塑成这顶兜帽，适合那些喜欢摆出评判神情的斥候。
entries.traditional: 羽毛塑成這頂兜帽，適合那些喜歡擺出評判神情的斥候。

entries.source: A small fang hangs close, because subtle threats still count.
entries.simplified: 一枚小小的尖牙贴身垂挂，因为含蓄的威胁也依然算数。
entries.traditional: 一枚小小的尖牙貼身垂掛，因為含蓄的威脅也依然算數。

entries.source: Lunar darkness coats the curve, drinking blood and mana together.
entries.simplified: 月色的黑暗覆上弯刃，同时啜饮鲜血与魔力。
entries.traditional: 月色的黑暗覆上彎刃，同時啜飲鮮血與魔力。

entries.source: Jade plumes rise from the crown, bright with old forest ceremony.
entries.simplified: 翡翠羽饰从王冠上高高扬起，闪耀着古老森林仪典的光辉。
entries.traditional: 翡翠羽飾從王冠上高高揚起，閃耀著古老森林儀典的光輝。

entries.source: Light feathers favor quick messengers and anyone fleeing consequences outdoors.
entries.simplified: 轻盈羽毛偏爱迅捷的信使，以及任何正在户外逃避后果的人。
entries.traditional: 輕盈羽毛偏愛迅捷的信使，以及任何正在戶外逃避後果的人。

entries.source: Black academy soles keep each step disciplined through lecture-hall pressure.
entries.simplified: 黑色学院鞋底让每一步在讲堂压力下都保持纪律。
entries.traditional: 黑色學院鞋底讓每一步在講堂壓力下都保持紀律。

entries.source: Lightweight soles favor agility, panic, and excellent last-second decisions.
entries.simplified: 轻巧鞋底偏爱敏捷、慌乱，以及最后一刻做出的绝妙决定。
entries.traditional: 輕巧鞋底偏愛敏捷、慌亂，以及最後一刻做出的絕妙決定。

entries.source: Bright white plating and golden detail guide each founder step. The path seems touched by first light wherever the guardian walks.
entries.simplified: 明亮白色护甲与金色细节引导每一步创始者步伐。无论守护者走到哪里，道路都像被初光触碰。
entries.traditional: 明亮白色護甲與金色細節引導每一步創始者步伐。無論守護者走到哪裡，道路都像被初光觸碰。

entries.source: Sturdy boots ground the dark costume with warm leather and practical weight. Festival confidence carries the traveler forward toward black feathered glory.
entries.simplified: 结实长靴以温暖皮革与实用重量稳住暗色装束。节庆自信带着旅人迈向黑羽荣耀。
entries.traditional: 結實長靴以溫暖皮革與實用重量穩住暗色裝束。節慶自信帶著旅人邁向黑羽榮耀。

entries.source: White plating and bright green signal lines ground each step. Speed lingers around the runner even during perfect stillness.
entries.simplified: 白色甲片与明亮绿信号线稳住每一步。即使完全静止，速度仍像萦绕在奔行者周围。
entries.traditional: 白色甲片與明亮綠信號線穩住每一步。即使完全靜止，速度仍像縈繞在奔行者周圍。

entries.source: Infernal shoes strike the ground with elegant menace and embered shadow. A dark procession opens through refined rhythm and fearless purpose.
entries.simplified: 地狱鞋履以优雅威胁与余烬暗影踏向地面。黑暗仪仗透过精致节奏与无畏使命展开。
entries.traditional: 地獄鞋履以優雅威脅與餘燼暗影踏向地面。黑暗儀仗透過精致節奏與無畏使命展開。

entries.source: Dark shoes move with measured authority and unhurried power. Stone and soil darken under each step as infernal will claims the road ahead.
entries.simplified: 深色鞋履以从容不迫的权威与力量行进。地狱意志占据前路，石土在每一步下变暗。
entries.traditional: 深色鞋履以從容不迫的權威與力量行進。地獄意志佔據前路，石土在每一步下變暗。

entries.source: Balanced soles keep aim steady, even when panic suggests otherwise.
entries.simplified: 平衡的鞋底让瞄准保持稳定，即使慌乱提出了不同意见。
entries.traditional: 平衡的鞋底讓瞄準保持穩定，即使慌亂提出了不同意見。

entries.source: Soft spring footwear keeps each hop light and cheerful.
entries.simplified: 柔软春日鞋履让每一次跳跃都轻快欢欣。
entries.traditional: 柔軟春日鞋履讓每一次跳躍都輕快歡欣。

entries.source: Soft spring footwear keeps each step light and cheerful.
entries.simplified: 柔软春日鞋履让每一步都轻快欢欣。
entries.traditional: 柔軟春日鞋履讓每一步都輕快歡欣。

entries.source: Warm foxfire soles make each step feel quick and bright.
entries.simplified: 温暖狐火鞋底让每一步都显得迅捷明亮。
entries.traditional: 溫暖狐火鞋底讓每一步都顯得迅捷明亮。

entries.source: Tidy shoes carry gentle companion charm down the road.
entries.simplified: 整洁鞋履带着温柔伙伴魅力走过道路。
entries.traditional: 整潔鞋履帶著溫柔夥伴魅力走過道路。

entries.source: Dust-bitten boots grip the road before holster talk begins.
entries.simplified: 尘土侵蚀的长靴在枪套开口之前便牢牢抓住路面。
entries.traditional: 塵土侵蝕的長靴在槍套開口之前便牢牢抓住路面。

entries.source: Pale winter soles move with quiet frost grace.
entries.simplified: 苍白冬日鞋底以安静寒霜之姿移动。
entries.traditional: 蒼白冬日鞋底以安靜寒霜之姿移動。

entries.source: Light shoes will clear the mind but still expect you to walk.
entries.simplified: 轻便的鞋子能让思绪清明，但依然要求你自己走路。
entries.traditional: 輕便的鞋子能讓思緒清明，但依然要求你自己走路。

entries.source: Trouble misses more often when these shoes decide to help.
entries.simplified: 当这双鞋决定帮忙时，麻烦往往更容易扑空。
entries.traditional: 當這雙鞋決定幫忙時，麻煩往往更容易撲空。

entries.source: Sacred sandals guide graceful steps toward service.
entries.simplified: 神圣凉鞋引导优雅步伐走向奉献。
entries.traditional: 神聖涼鞋引導優雅步伐走向奉獻。

entries.source: Solemn shoes guide steady steps toward service.
entries.simplified: 庄严鞋履引导稳健步伐走向奉献。
entries.traditional: 莊嚴鞋履引導穩健步伐走向奉獻。

entries.source: Soft tabi soles erase footsteps through crimson nightwork.
entries.simplified: 柔软足袋鞋底抹去猩红夜行中的脚步声。
entries.traditional: 柔軟足袋鞋底抹去猩紅夜行中的腳步聲。

entries.source: Supporter pride brightens each festival step. Every road feels connected to a shared promise.
entries.simplified: 支持者的自豪照亮每一步节庆行程。每一条道路都像与共同誓言相连。
entries.traditional: 支持者的自豪照亮每一步節慶行程。每一條道路都像與共同誓言相連。

entries.source: Simple footwear designed to support raw physical strength.
entries.simplified: 为支撑纯粹肉体力量而设计的朴素鞋履。
entries.traditional: 為支撐純粹肉體力量而設計的樸素鞋履。

entries.source: Crisp uniform shoes strike pavement with schoolyard defiance.
entries.simplified: 利落制服鞋以校园式反抗踏击路面。
entries.traditional: 利落制服鞋以校園式反抗踏擊路面。

entries.source: Sharp school shoes carry practiced rebellion through corridor echoes.
entries.simplified: 锐利校鞋带着熟练叛逆穿过走廊回声。
entries.traditional: 銳利校鞋帶著熟練叛逆穿過走廊回聲。

entries.source: Invisible soles leave the outfit untouched from ankle to floor.
entries.simplified: 隐形鞋底让整套服装从脚踝到地面都保持不变。
entries.traditional: 隱形鞋底讓整套服裝從腳踝到地面都保持不變。

entries.source: Low city shoes handle pavement routes with unbothered ease.
entries.simplified: 低帮都市鞋以毫不在意的轻松应对街道路程。
entries.traditional: 低幫都市鞋以毫不在意的輕鬆應對街道路程。

entries.source: Sturdy soles support long fights when strain refuses to end.
entries.simplified: 坚实鞋底支撑漫长战斗，即使疲劳迟迟不肯结束。
entries.traditional: 堅實鞋底支撐漫長戰鬥，即使疲勞遲遲不肯結束。

entries.source: Snowy paw shoes pad lightly with familiar-born charm.
entries.simplified: 雪白爪鞋以魔宠般的魅力轻轻踏步。
entries.traditional: 雪白爪鞋以魔寵般的魅力輕輕踏步。

entries.source: Arcane shoes keep each step quiet and measured.
entries.simplified: 奥术鞋履让每一步保持安静而精准。
entries.traditional: 奧術鞋履讓每一步保持安靜而精准。

entries.source: Scholarly shoes keep each step steady for long study.
entries.simplified: 学者鞋履为漫长研读维持稳定步伐。
entries.traditional: 學者鞋履為漫長研讀維持穩定步伐。

entries.source: Enchanted fronds soften movement until the underbrush seems to help.
entries.simplified: 附魔蕨叶柔化了动作，仿佛连灌木丛都在出手相助。
entries.traditional: 附魔蕨葉柔化了動作，彷彿連灌木叢都在出手相助。

entries.source: Bright red cloth brings celebration, cheer, and mild hat confidence.
entries.simplified: 鲜红布料带来庆典、欢笑，以及一点点来自帽子的自信。
entries.traditional: 鮮紅布料帶來慶典、歡笑，以及一點點來自帽子的自信。

entries.source: Firecrackers crackle happily, making enemies question several nearby decisions properly.
entries.simplified: 爆竹欢快地噼啪作响，让敌人认真反思自己刚才在附近做出的几个决定。
entries.traditional: 爆竹歡快地劈啪作響，讓敵人認真反省自己剛才在附近做出的幾個決定。

entries.source: Turtle charm and tassels promise luck, patience, and a great time.
entries.simplified: 乌龟饰物与流苏许诺着好运、耐心，以及一段欢乐时光。
entries.traditional: 烏龜飾物與流蘇承諾著好運、耐心，以及一段歡樂時光。

entries.source: The ribbon looks cheerful, but the jingling remains suspicious.
entries.simplified: 缎带看起来喜气洋洋，但盒里的叮当声依旧十分可疑。
entries.traditional: 緞帶看起來喜氣洋洋，但盒裡的叮噹聲依舊十分可疑。

entries.source: “Do not fear the flame. Teach fire to behave.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “别惧怕火焰。教会它守规矩。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “別懼怕火焰。教會它守規矩。” — Suphara

entries.source: Warm-colored scales mark this fast swimmer even in the darker parts of the depths.
entries.simplified: 即使身处深处较暗的水域，暖色鳞片也让这名迅捷游泳者格外醒目。
entries.traditional: 即使身處深處較暗的水域，暖色鱗片也讓這名迅捷游泳者格外醒目。

entries.source: Warm horns flicker restlessly, like embers practicing dramatic entrances properly.
entries.simplified: 温暖的犄角不安地闪烁，像余烬正在认真排练华丽登场。
entries.traditional: 溫暖的犄角不安地閃爍，像餘燼正在認真排練華麗登場。

entries.source: Engraved with fiery seals, these blades erupt with bursts of flame, scorching enemies in a splash of fire.
entries.simplified: 这些刀刃刻有烈焰封印，出手时会爆发火焰，在一片烈火中灼烧敌人。
entries.traditional: 這些刀刃刻有烈焰封印，出手時會爆發火焰，在一片烈火中灼燒敵人。

entries.source: Flame covers its body and hides the first signs of its next spell.
entries.simplified: 火焰覆盖着它的身体，掩盖了下一道法术最初的征兆。
entries.traditional: 火焰覆蓋著它的身體，掩蓋了下一道法術最初的徵兆。

entries.source: “A small blade can still start a wild fire.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “小小的刀刃，也能点燃一场燎原大火。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “小小的刀刃，也能點燃一場燎原大火。” — Suphara

entries.source: Tailored for long-distance messengers and nimble thieves, these padded pants never chafe and always breathe, no matter how far or fast you run.
entries.simplified: 这条加垫长裤专为长途信使与敏捷盗贼裁制，无论跑得多远、多快，都不会磨伤皮肤，始终透气舒适。
entries.traditional: 這條加墊長褲專為長途信使與敏捷盜賊裁製，無論跑得多遠、多快，都不會磨傷肌膚，始終透氣舒適。

entries.source: Old metal, loud opinions, and terrible subtlety share one barrel.
entries.simplified: 老旧金属、响亮意见与糟糕透顶的隐蔽性，共用着同一根枪管。
entries.traditional: 老舊金屬、響亮意見與糟糕透頂的隱蔽性，共用著同一根槍管。

entries.source: Petal-like fins drift around its body as it floats near quiet lake paths.
entries.simplified: 花瓣般的鳍片环绕身体飘动，伴随它漂浮在宁静的湖边小径附近。
entries.traditional: 花瓣般的鰭片環繞身體飄動，伴隨它漂浮在寧靜的湖邊小徑附近。

entries.source: Leather and stone settle the body before attention sharpens inward.
entries.simplified: 皮革与石块让身体沉静下来，随后专注向内收紧。
entries.traditional: 皮革與石塊讓身體沉靜下來，隨後專注向內收緊。

entries.source: Leaves and roots sit proudly overhead, because nature enjoys accessories.
entries.simplified: 树叶与根须骄傲地坐在头顶，因为大自然也喜欢配饰。
entries.traditional: 樹葉與根鬚驕傲地坐在頭頂，因為大自然也喜歡配飾。

entries.source: Leaf-sewn armor carries soft renewal, sheltering the wearer with forest patience.
entries.simplified: 叶片缝制的护甲蕴含柔和的复苏之力，以森林般的耐心庇护穿戴者。
entries.traditional: 葉片縫製的護甲蘊含柔和的復甦之力，以森林般的耐心庇護穿戴者。

entries.source: Light leafwork shoes keep spellsteps quick and quiet beneath green boughs.
entries.simplified: 轻盈的叶编鞋让施法步伐在绿荫下保持迅捷而无声。
entries.traditional: 輕盈的葉編鞋讓施法步伐在綠蔭下保持迅捷而無聲。

entries.source: Living fibers breathe with each stride, returning strength like rain through roots.
entries.simplified: 活体纤维随着每一步呼吸，像雨水渗入根系般返还力量。
entries.traditional: 活體纖維隨著每一步呼吸，像雨水滲入根系般返還力量。

entries.source: “Master Neoian taught me to keep charging forward. I forged this wall for those who follow him, and for every shield of the 42nd Paladin Legion.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “Master Neoian 教会我要不断向前冲锋。我为追随他的人，也为第42 Paladin 军团的每一面盾牌，锻造了这道壁垒。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “Master Neoian 教會我要不斷向前衝鋒。我為追隨他的人，也為第42 Paladin 軍團的每一面盾牌，鍛造了這道壁壘。” — Suphara

entries.source: “Mark them once with cold, and every step after belongs to you.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “先用寒意标记他们一次，之后的每一步都由你掌控。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “先用寒意標記他們一次，之後的每一步都由你掌控。” — Suphara

entries.simplified: “寒牙留下的教训最深。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “寒牙留下的教訓最深。” — Suphara

entries.source: Cold energy leaks from the helm, discouraging hugs and poor choices.
entries.simplified: 寒气从头盔中渗出，让拥抱和糟糕决定都知难而退。
entries.traditional: 寒氣從頭盔中滲出，讓擁抱和糟糕決定都知難而退。

entries.source: Pale crystal chills the staff, and probably your fingers too.
entries.simplified: 苍白水晶让法杖冰冷刺骨，大概也会冻着你的手指。
entries.traditional: 蒼白水晶讓法杖冰冷刺骨，大概也會凍著你的手指。

entries.source: “Ice is sharper than steel when you teach it discipline.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “只要教会寒冰守纪律，它就比钢铁更加锋利。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “只要教會寒冰守規矩，它就比鋼鐵更加鋒利。” — Suphara

entries.source: Green fruit rattles mysteriously, daring anyone to call it lunch.
entries.simplified: 绿色果实神秘地咔啦作响，挑衅着任何敢把它称作午餐的人。
entries.traditional: 綠色果實神祕地喀啦作響，挑釁著任何敢把它稱作午餐的人。

entries.source: You feel a bit more private with these on. You now have an impressive mustache.
entries.simplified: 戴上它们后，你觉得隐私多了一点。现在你还拥有一撇令人印象深刻的八字胡。
entries.traditional: 戴上它們後，你覺得隱私多了一點。現在你還擁有一撇令人印象深刻的八字鬍。

entries.source: A thick fur-lined hood. Keeps the wearer warm in the coldest regions.
entries.simplified: 一顶衬有厚实毛皮的兜帽。即使在最寒冷的地区，也能让穿戴者保持温暖。
entries.traditional: 一頂襯有厚實毛皮的兜帽。即使在最寒冷的地區，也能讓穿戴者保持溫暖。

entries.source: Rotating barrels explain themselves loudly, repeatedly, and with enthusiasm.
entries.simplified: 旋转枪管会以响亮、反复且兴致勃勃的方式说明自己。
entries.traditional: 旋轉槍管會用響亮、反覆而且興致勃勃的方式說明自己。

entries.source: This small drifting spirit slips around sacred pillars with a shadowy body.
entries.simplified: 这个小型漂浮灵体以暗影般的身躯穿梭于神圣石柱之间。
entries.traditional: 這個小型漂浮靈體以暗影般的身軀穿梭於神聖石柱之間。

entries.source: A tiny specter floats overhead, judging your posture in silence.
entries.simplified: 一个小幽灵飘在头顶，无声地评判着你的姿势。
entries.traditional: 一個小幽靈飄在頭頂，無聲地評判著你的姿勢。

entries.source: Blue shards glow in the gnarled staff whenever danger draws near.
entries.simplified: 每当危险临近，蓝色碎片便会在扭曲的法杖上发光。
entries.traditional: 每當危險接近，藍色碎片便會在扭曲的法杖上發光。

entries.source: Dark patches crawl around this small crypt creature like loose grave cloth.
entries.simplified: 黑暗斑块像松散的墓布般爬满这只小型墓穴生物的周围。
entries.traditional: 黑暗斑塊像鬆散的墓布般爬滿這隻小型墓穴生物的周圍。

entries.source: Responsive gloves follow sudden movement before hesitation catches up fully.
entries.simplified: 灵敏的手套紧随突发动作，在犹豫彻底追上来之前先行一步。
entries.traditional: 靈敏的手套緊隨突發動作，在猶豫完全追上來之前搶先一步。

entries.source: Steady grip and refined balance guide each strike toward accuracy.
entries.simplified: 稳固的握持与精细的平衡，引导每一击精准命中。
entries.traditional: 穩固的握持與精細的平衡，引導每一擊精準命中。

entries.source: Arcane patterns etched in their fabric channel thought into spellcraft.
entries.simplified: 织物上镌刻的奥术纹路，将思绪引导为法术技艺。
entries.traditional: 織物上刻劃的奧術紋路，將思緒引導為施法技藝。

entries.source: Luck gathers around these gloves, especially when planning has failed.
entries.simplified: 幸运聚集在这双手套周围，尤其是在计划已经失败的时候。
entries.traditional: 幸運聚集在這雙手套周圍，尤其是在計畫已經失敗的時候。

entries.source: Crushing might gathers in the grip before each heavy punch.
entries.simplified: 每次沉重拳击之前，碾压般的力量都会汇聚于双手。
entries.traditional: 每次沉重拳擊之前，碾壓般的力量都會匯聚於雙手。

entries.source: Heavy hands meet punishment calmly, turning impact into stubborn resolve.
entries.simplified: 沉重的双手平静承受惩罚，将冲击化作顽强的决心。
entries.traditional: 沉重的雙手平靜承受懲罰，將衝擊化作頑強的決心。

entries.source: Small goblins gather near stronger fighters and attack with simple weapons when enemies come close.
entries.simplified: 小型哥布林聚集在更强的战士附近，当敌人靠近时便以简陋武器发动攻击。
entries.traditional: 小型哥布林聚集在更強的戰士附近，當敵人靠近時便以簡陋武器發動攻擊。

entries.source: Lion-faced gold waits for courage, not victory, to wake it.
entries.simplified: 狮面黄金等待勇气，而非胜利，将它唤醒。
entries.traditional: 獅面黃金等待勇氣，而非勝利，將它喚醒。

entries.source: “Gold makes for fine jewelry, but it looks better when it cracks armor.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “黄金适合做精美首饰，不过用来砸裂铠甲时更好看。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “黃金適合做精美首飾，不過用來砸裂鎧甲時更好看。” — Suphara

entries.source: Polished gold announces the champion's presence before the wearer proves anything.
entries.simplified: 抛光黄金在穿戴者证明自己之前，便先宣告冠军登场。
entries.traditional: 拋光黃金在穿戴者證明自己之前，便先宣告冠軍登場。

entries.source: Light on the head, heavy with everyone else's expectations outside.
entries.simplified: 戴在头上轻若无物，却沉甸甸地承载着外界所有人的期待。
entries.traditional: 戴在頭上輕若無物，卻沉甸甸地承載著外界所有人的期待。

entries.source: “Gold is soft. This hammer is not.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “黄金很软。这把锤子可不软。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “黃金很軟。這把鎚子可不軟。” — Suphara

entries.source: Pirates, merchants, and overconfident gamblers all respect shiny circles.
entries.simplified: 海盗、商人和过度自信的赌徒，都尊重闪亮的圆环。
entries.traditional: 海盜、商人和過度自信的賭徒，都尊重閃亮的圓環。

entries.source: The hand reaches out, which is rude behavior for pottery.
entries.simplified: 那只手伸了出来；对陶器而言，这实在很没礼貌。
entries.traditional: 那隻手伸了出來；對陶器而言，這實在很沒禮貌。

entries.source: Pale teeth gnash silently, because helmets should not need jaws.
entries.simplified: 苍白牙齿无声咬合，因为头盔根本不该长着一副下颌。
entries.traditional: 蒼白牙齒無聲咬合，因為頭盔根本不該長著一副下顎。

entries.source: Rib-like plating channels necrotic force while violet sigils guard the wearer.
entries.simplified: 肋骨般的甲片引导死灵力量，紫罗兰色符印则守护穿戴者。
entries.traditional: 肋骨般的甲片引導死靈力量，紫羅蘭色符印則守護穿戴者。

entries.source: Purple-stained bone soles release toxic resonance with every careful step.
entries.simplified: 染紫的骨质鞋底在每一步谨慎落下时释放毒性共鸣。
entries.traditional: 染紫的骨質鞋底在每一步謹慎落下時釋放毒性共鳴。

entries.source: Spectral cords bind shorn bone, pulsing with hexing protection underneath.
entries.simplified: 幽灵般的绳索束住削切骨片，下方脉动着施咒防护。
entries.traditional: 幽靈般的繩索束住削切骨片，下方脈動著施咒防護。

entries.source: “Curses love old stone. Break the stone, and they lose their hiding place.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “诅咒喜欢藏在古老石头里。砸碎石头，它们就无处藏身。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “詛咒喜歡藏在古老石頭裡。砸碎石頭，它們就無處藏身。” — Suphara

entries.source: Dense shellwork handles punishment with patient, turtle-adjacent confidence.
entries.simplified: 密实的甲壳构造带着耐心而近似乌龟的自信承受打击。
entries.traditional: 密實的甲殼構造帶著耐心而近似烏龜的自信承受打擊。

entries.source: Dark grey feathers and pale markings give this griffin a silent, watchful presence.
entries.simplified: 深灰羽毛与苍白纹路赋予这只 Griffin 安静而警觉的存在感。
entries.traditional: 深灰羽毛與蒼白紋路賦予這隻 Griffin 安靜而警覺的存在感。

entries.source: Cream feathers and reddish-brown markings give this griffin a rugged highland look.
entries.simplified: 奶油色羽毛与红棕纹路让这只 Griffin 充满粗犷高地气息。
entries.traditional: 奶油色羽毛與紅棕紋路讓這隻 Griffin 充滿粗獷高地氣息。

entries.source: Dark brown feathers and sharp ears make this griffin look ready to bolt skyward.
entries.simplified: 深棕羽毛与尖锐双耳让这只 Griffin 仿佛随时会冲向天空。
entries.traditional: 深棕羽毛與尖銳雙耳讓這隻 Griffin 彷彿隨時會衝向天空。

entries.source: White and grey plumage with brown wings gives this griffin a proud, eagle-like bearing.
entries.simplified: 白灰羽色与棕色双翼赋予这只 Griffin 高傲的鹰隼气质。
entries.traditional: 白灰羽色與棕色雙翼賦予這隻 Griffin 高傲的鷹隼氣質。

entries.source: Broad wings carry this griffin mount with confident, sweeping strokes.
entries.simplified: 宽阔双翼以自信而舒展的拍动载着这只 Griffin 坐骑前行。
entries.traditional: 寬闊雙翼以自信而舒展的拍動載著這隻 Griffin 坐騎前行。

entries.source: Snowy white feathers and soft grey markings help this griffin blend into winter paths.
entries.simplified: 雪白羽毛与柔灰纹路帮助这只 Griffin 融入冬日道路。
entries.traditional: 雪白羽毛與柔灰紋路幫助這隻 Griffin 融入冬日道路。

entries.source: “A reaper’s edge should take only what it can carry.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “死神的锋刃只该收割自己带得走的东西。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “死神的鋒刃只該收割自己帶得走的東西。” — Suphara

entries.source: Balanced steel keeps city guards brave and paperwork slightly easier.
entries.simplified: 平衡良好的钢铁让城卫更勇敢，也让文书工作稍微轻松一点。
entries.traditional: 平衡良好的鋼鐵讓城衛更勇敢，也讓文書工作稍微輕鬆一點。

entries.source: White founder gloves wrap steady hands with golden detail and sacred purpose. Each gesture feels prepared for blessing and protection through an oath.
entries.simplified: 洁白创始者手套以金色细节与神圣使命包裹稳定双手。每个手势都像已准备好履行祝福与守护的誓言。
entries.traditional: 潔白創始者手套以金色細節與神聖使命包裹穩定雙手。每個手勢都像已準備好履行祝福與守護的誓言。

entries.source: Light armor binds clean divine trim around steady hands. Calm authority moves through a guardian sworn to protect the first road forward.
entries.simplified: 轻型护甲以洁净神圣饰边包覆稳定双手。守护者以平静权威发誓保护最初向前的道路。
entries.traditional: 輕型護甲以潔淨神聖飾邊包覆穩定雙手。守護者以平靜權威發誓保護最初向前的道路。

entries.source: Black gloves finish the hands with clean pale trim and quiet theatrical control. Each gesture suits a raven masquerade where silence holds style.
entries.simplified: 黑色手套以利落浅色饰边与安静戏剧掌控完成双手装束。每个动作都适合一场由沉默维持格调的渡鸦化装舞会。
entries.traditional: 黑色手套以利落淺色飾邊與安靜戲劇掌控完成雙手裝束。每個動作都適合一場由沉默維持格調的渡鴉化裝舞會。

entries.source: Dark gloves keep the hands bold and controlled inside the feathered costume. Easy confidence lends each motion the mark of a crow supporter.
entries.simplified: 深色手套让双手在羽饰装束中保持大胆而受控。轻松自信为每个动作留下乌鸦支持者的印记。
entries.traditional: 深色手套讓雙手在羽飾裝束中保持大膽而受控。輕鬆自信為每個動作留下烏鴉支持者的印記。

entries.source: Black control nodes lock inside bright white armor. Green circuits make each gesture precise and charged with hidden command.
entries.simplified: 黑色控制节点锁入明亮白甲之中。绿色电路让每个手势精准，并充满隐秘号令。
entries.traditional: 黑色控制節點鎖入明亮白甲之中。綠色電路讓每個手勢精准，並充滿隱秘號令。

entries.source: Dark refined gloves wrap the hands with ritual weight. Each gesture becomes deliberate and dangerous because command waits behind every motion.
entries.simplified: 深色精致手套以仪式重量包裹双手。每个动作都变得谨慎而危险，因为号令藏在其后。
entries.traditional: 深色精致手套以儀式重量包裹雙手。每個動作都變得謹慎而危險，因為號令藏在其後。

entries.source: Infernal gloves draw shadow across the knuckles and lend each motion ritual weight. Even an open palm appears threatening because ceremony has replaced mercy.
entries.simplified: 地狱手套将暗影拉过指节，为每个动作赋予仪式重量。即使摊开手掌也显得危险，因为仪式已经取代仁慈。
entries.traditional: 地獄手套將暗影拉過指節，為每個動作賦予儀式重量。即使攤開手掌也顯得危險，因為儀式已經取代仁慈。

entries.source: Soft gloves make each gesture warm and friendly.
entries.simplified: 柔软手套让每个动作都显得温暖友好。
entries.traditional: 柔軟手套讓每個動作都顯得溫暖友好。

entries.source: Invisible gloves leave the hands clear while preserving the outfit.
entries.simplified: 隐形手套让双手保持清晰，同时完整保留整套服装。
entries.traditional: 隱形手套讓雙手保持清晰，同時完整保留整套服裝。

entries.source: A cheerful forest charm that somehow appeals to assassins.
entries.simplified: 一件欢快的森林饰物，不知为何特别讨刺客喜欢。
entries.traditional: 一件歡快的森林飾物，不知為何特別討刺客喜歡。

entries.source: This scythe gathers spirit from wounds, not wheat from fields.
entries.simplified: 这柄镰刀从伤口中收割灵魂，而不是从田野里收割小麦。
entries.traditional: 這柄鐮刀從傷口中收割靈魂，而不是從田野裡收割小麥。

entries.source: This hollow spirit carries holy light inside its body as it drifts through sacred halls.
entries.simplified: 这个空洞灵体在神圣大厅中漂浮，体内承载着圣光。
entries.traditional: 這個空洞靈體在神聖大廳中漂浮，體內承載著聖光。

entries.source: “Aim like the bolt is already there, then let the crank prove you right.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “瞄准时，就当弩矢早已命中；然后让绞盘证明你没错。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “瞄準時，就當弩箭早已命中；然後讓絞盤證明你沒錯。” — Suphara

entries.source: A founder crown rises in gold and turquoise under a bright blue spirit-flame. Sacred origin marks the guardian with the calm authority of celestial honor.
entries.simplified: 金色与青绿色创始者冠冕在明亮蓝色灵火下升起。神圣起源以天界荣耀的沉静权威标记守护者。
entries.traditional: 金色與青綠色創始者冠冕在明亮藍色靈火下升起。神聖起源以天界榮耀的沉靜權威標記守護者。

entries.source: A radiant band rests above the head as a small sign of heavenly recognition. Simple glow becomes an unmistakable mark for those blessed early by fortune.
entries.simplified: 一道辉耀头环停在头顶，成为天界认可的小小象征。简洁光芒却是那些早获幸运眷顾之人无可错认的标志。
entries.traditional: 一道輝耀頭環停在頭頂，成為天界認可的小小象徵。簡潔光芒卻是那些早獲幸運眷顧之人無可錯認的標誌。

entries.source: A pierced red apple balances overhead with target-practice bravado.
entries.simplified: 一颗被刺穿的红苹果平衡在头顶，带着靶场练习般的大胆。
entries.traditional: 一顆被刺穿的紅蘋果平衡在頭頂，帶著靶場練習般的大膽。

entries.source: Leather flightcloth clasps brass goggles above wind-scuffed fur, marked by reckless sky routes.
entries.simplified: 皮革飞行布料把黄铜护目镜扣在受风磨损的毛皮上，记满鲁莽天空路线。
entries.traditional: 皮革飛行布料把黃銅護目鏡扣在受風磨損的毛皮上，記滿魯莽天空路線。

entries.source: Striped bat wings rise from the cowl with aristocratic cave menace.
entries.simplified: 条纹蝙蝠双翼从兜帽升起，散发贵族洞穴般的威胁。
entries.traditional: 條紋蝙蝠雙翼從兜帽升起，散髮貴族洞穴般的威脅。

entries.source: Tall bunny ears perk upward with meadow-born agility.
entries.simplified: 高高兔耳向上竖起，充满草原赋予的敏捷。
entries.traditional: 高高兔耳向上竪起，充滿草原賦予的敏捷。

entries.source: Crowned cactus spines rise from the brow with desert monarch pride.
entries.simplified: 带王冠的仙人掌尖刺从额前升起，展现沙漠君王的骄傲。
entries.traditional: 帶王冠的仙人掌尖刺從額前升起，展現沙漠君王的驕傲。

entries.source: Stormlit spikes crown this dark hood with charged feline authority.
entries.simplified: 风暴光芒照亮的尖刺为这顶深色兜帽加冕，散发带电猫科权威。
entries.traditional: 風暴光芒照亮的尖刺為這頂深色兜帽加冕，散髮帶電貓科權威。

entries.source: Dark cat ears tilt toward every secret in the room.
entries.simplified: 深色猫耳朝房间里的每一个秘密微微倾斜。
entries.traditional: 深色貓耳朝房間里的每一個秘密微微傾斜。

entries.source: Orbital charms circle the brow like tiny stars refusing stillness.
entries.simplified: 轨道护符围绕额头旋转，像拒绝静止的微小星辰。
entries.traditional: 軌道護符圍繞額頭旋轉，像拒絕靜止的微小星辰。

entries.source: A golden halo floats overhead with suspiciously calm judgment.
entries.simplified: 金色光环悬浮头顶，带着令人起疑的平静审判。
entries.traditional: 金色光環懸浮頭頂，帶著令人起疑的平靜審判。

entries.source: Shadowed headgear crowns the brow with infernal grandeur. Decoration yields to declaration as prestige arrives before speech.
entries.simplified: 暗影头饰以地狱威仪为额头加冕。装饰退居其次，身份宣告在言语之前先行到来。
entries.traditional: 暗影頭飾以地獄威儀為額頭加冕。裝飾退居其次，身份宣告在言語之前先行到來。

entries.source: Pastel festival color crowns the wearer with cheerful spring luck.
entries.simplified: 柔和粉彩节庆色彩为穿戴者加冕，带来欢快春日好运。
entries.traditional: 柔和粉彩節慶色彩為穿戴者加冕，帶來歡快春日好運。

entries.source: Bright spring trim crowns the wearer with easy festival charm.
entries.simplified: 明亮春日饰边为穿戴者加冕，带来轻松节庆魅力。
entries.traditional: 明亮春日飾邊為穿戴者加冕，帶來輕鬆節慶魅力。

entries.source: Earth-toned plumes rise from beadwork shaped for old trail rites.
entries.simplified: 大地色羽毛从古老行路仪式般的珠饰中升起。
entries.traditional: 大地色羽毛從古老行路儀式般的珠飾中升起。

entries.source: Vivid plumes fan outward in a festival crown of skyborn color.
entries.simplified: 鲜艳羽毛向外展开，组成充满天空色彩的节庆冠冕。
entries.traditional: 鮮艷羽毛向外展開，組成充滿天空色彩的節慶冠冕。

entries.source: Warm fox ears crown the wearer with playful woodland spark.
entries.simplified: 温暖狐耳为穿戴者加冕，带着活泼的林野火花。
entries.traditional: 溫暖狐耳為穿戴者加冕，帶著活潑的林野火花。

entries.source: Sunlit petals bloom around the head with stubborn garden cheer.
entries.simplified: 阳光照耀的花瓣在头顶绽放，洋溢着顽强的花园欢欣。
entries.traditional: 陽光照耀的花瓣在頭頂綻放，洋溢著頑強的花園歡欣。

entries.source: Pointed fox ears twitch toward trouble with woodland cunning.
entries.simplified: 尖尖狐耳朝麻烦轻轻颤动，带着林野狡黠。
entries.traditional: 尖尖狐耳朝麻煩輕輕顫動，帶著林野狡黠。

entries.source: Round frog eyes peek upward with swampy delight.
entries.simplified: 圆滚滚的青蛙眼睛向上探出，满是沼泽欢乐。
entries.traditional: 圓滾滾的青蛙眼睛向上探出，滿是沼澤歡樂。

entries.source: Soft storybook charm turns the headpiece into a cozy keepsake.
entries.simplified: 柔和童话魅力让这件头饰化作舒适纪念品。
entries.traditional: 柔和童話魅力讓這件頭飾化作舒適紀念品。

entries.source: Crimson horns curve forward with hare-swift ferocity.
entries.simplified: 猩红犄角向前弯曲，带着野兔般迅捷的凶猛。
entries.traditional: 猩紅犄角向前彎曲，帶著野兔般迅捷的凶猛。

entries.source: Shell ridges stack into a crown of stubborn shore authority.
entries.simplified: 层叠甲壳棱脊堆成一顶顽固海岸权威的王冠。
entries.traditional: 層疊甲殼稜脊堆成一頂頑固海岸權威的王冠。

entries.source: Pale ice shards hover in a spellbound ring of winter focus.
entries.simplified: 苍白冰晶碎片悬浮成一圈受法术束缚的冬日专注。
entries.traditional: 蒼白冰晶碎片懸浮成一圈受法術束縛的冬日專注。

entries.source: Pale ears crown the wearer with quiet winter grace.
entries.simplified: 苍白狐耳为穿戴者加冕，带来安静冬日优雅。
entries.traditional: 蒼白狐耳為穿戴者加冕，帶來安靜冬日優雅。

entries.source: Glacial spikes tower overhead with ancient frozen command.
entries.simplified: 冰川尖刺高耸头顶，散发远古冰封号令。
entries.traditional: 冰川尖刺高聳頭頂，散髮遠古冰封號令。

entries.source: Blackened horns curl above ember trim with wicked little ambition.
entries.simplified: 焦黑犄角在余烬饰边上方弯曲，充满邪恶的小小野心。
entries.traditional: 焦黑犄角在餘燼飾邊上方彎曲，充滿邪惡的小小野心。

entries.source: Curved brown horns frame a golden crest of woodland sovereignty.
entries.simplified: 棕色弯角围住金色冠饰，彰显林野主权。
entries.traditional: 棕色彎角圍住金色冠飾，彰顯林野主權。

entries.source: Sacred trim crowns the faithful with calm holy light.
entries.simplified: 神圣饰边以沉静圣光为信徒加冕。
entries.traditional: 神聖飾邊以沉靜聖光為信徒加冕。

entries.source: A swollen broodworm cowl hangs low with unsettling hive royalty.
entries.simplified: 肿胀的育巢蠕虫兜帽低低垂下，散发令人不安的虫群王权。
entries.traditional: 腫脹的育巢蠕蟲兜帽低低垂下，散髮令人不安的蟲群王權。

entries.source: A scarlet bow adds lucky warmth to the hair.
