entries.simplified: 猩红蝴蝶结为发间增添幸运暖意。
entries.traditional: 猩紅蝴蝶結為發間增添幸運暖意。

entries.source: A golden bow adds sunny charm to the hair.
entries.simplified: 金色蝴蝶结为发间增添阳光魅力。
entries.traditional: 金色蝴蝶結為發間增添陽光魅力。

entries.source: Wide woven reeds shelter the face with quiet traveler discipline.
entries.simplified: 宽阔编织芦草以安静旅人纪律遮住面容。
entries.traditional: 寬闊編織蘆草以安靜旅人紀律遮住面容。

entries.source: Black pincers frame a burning crest, crowning the wearer with desert threat.
entries.simplified: 黑色钳爪围住燃烧冠饰，为穿戴者加冕以沙漠威胁。
entries.traditional: 黑色鉗爪圍住燃燒冠飾，為穿戴者加冕以沙漠威脅。

entries.source: Crimson headcloth narrows the gaze across moonlit rooftops.
entries.simplified: 猩红头巾让目光在月光屋顶间变得锐利。
entries.traditional: 猩紅頭巾讓目光在月光屋頂間變得銳利。

entries.source: Raised serpents sway from the brim as though hearing hidden flute notes.
entries.simplified: 高高扬起的蛇群在帽檐上摇摆，仿佛听见隐藏笛声。
entries.traditional: 高高揚起的蛇群在帽檐上搖擺，彷彿聽見隱藏笛聲。

entries.source: Red-plated legs droop overhead with mechanical widow menace.
entries.simplified: 红色甲片机械长腿垂在头顶，带着机械寡妇般的威胁。
entries.traditional: 紅色甲片機械長腿垂在頭頂，帶著機械寡婦般的威脅。

entries.source: A fresh green shoot rises bravely from the crown with stubborn garden optimism.
entries.simplified: 新鲜绿芽勇敢地从头顶升起，充满顽固的花园乐观。
entries.traditional: 新鮮綠芽勇敢地從頭頂升起，充滿頑固的花園樂觀。

entries.source: Striped yellow cloth sprouts tiny antennae above a cheerful meadow buzz.
entries.simplified: 黄黑条纹布料长出小小触角，洋溢欢快草原嗡鸣。
entries.traditional: 黃黑條紋布料長出小小觸角，洋溢歡快草原嗡鳴。

entries.source: Invisible headwear preserves the hairstyle through purely theoretical tailoring.
entries.simplified: 隐形头饰凭借纯理论裁缝技术保留原有发型。
entries.traditional: 隱形頭飾憑借純理論裁縫技術保留原有髮型。

entries.source: Blue reefguard plating shields the brow with shell-backed resolve.
entries.simplified: 蓝色礁石守卫甲片保护额头，带着龟壳般的决心。
entries.traditional: 藍色礁石守衛甲片保護額頭，帶著龜殼般的決心。

entries.source: Subtle city cloth keeps the outfit clean without stealing the scene.
entries.simplified: 低调都市布料让服装保持整洁，却不抢走主角风采。
entries.traditional: 低調都市布料讓服裝保持整潔，卻不搶走主角風采。

entries.source: Moonfang fur bares a snarling muzzle before any warning leaves the throat.
entries.simplified: 月牙利齿般的皮毛在任何警告出口前，便已露出咆哮兽吻。
entries.traditional: 月牙利齒般的皮毛在任何警告出口前，便已露出咆哮獸吻。

entries.source: A tall brimmed hat carries old scholarly magic.
entries.simplified: 高顶宽檐帽承载古老学者魔法。
entries.traditional: 高頂寬檐帽承載古老學者魔法。

entries.source: A curved worm coils overhead with advice no sensible hero should follow.
entries.simplified: 一条弯曲蠕虫盘绕在头顶，给出任何理智英雄都不该听从的建议。
entries.traditional: 一條彎曲蠕蟲盤繞在頭頂，給出任何理智英雄都不該聽從的建議。

entries.source: Black duskcloth grins around red horns with haunted shrine malice.
entries.simplified: 黑色暮光布在红色犄角周围咧嘴狞笑，散发闹鬼神龛般的恶意。
entries.traditional: 黑色暮光布在紅色犄角周圍咧嘴獰笑，散髮鬧鬼神龕般的惡意。

entries.source: Blue holiday felt carries winter cheer around a frost-kissed pom.
entries.simplified: 蓝色节庆毡帽以覆霜绒球承载冬日欢乐。
entries.traditional: 藍色節慶氈帽以覆霜絨球承載冬日歡樂。

entries.source: Red holiday felt brings classic hearth warmth through snowy trim.
entries.simplified: 红色节庆毡帽透过雪白饰边带来经典炉火暖意。
entries.traditional: 紅色節慶氈帽透過雪白飾邊帶來經典爐火暖意。

entries.source: Black iron clasps the crimson relic around a faint inner beat.
entries.simplified: 黑铁扣紧猩红遗物，环绕着内部微弱的搏动。
entries.traditional: 黑鐵扣緊猩紅遺物，環繞著內部微弱的搏動。

entries.source: Heart lenses deflect rejection, or at least make it easier to endure.
entries.simplified: 心形镜片能挡开拒绝，至少也能让它更容易熬过去。
entries.traditional: 心形鏡片能擋開拒絕，至少也能讓它比較容易熬過去。

entries.source: The heart swings gently, making subtlety pack up and leave.
entries.simplified: 心形坠饰轻轻摇摆，让含蓄直接收拾包袱离开。
entries.traditional: 心形墜飾輕輕搖擺，讓含蓄直接收拾包袱離開。

entries.source: “Some flames warm the hearth. Some flames pierce the soul.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “有些火焰温暖炉边。有些火焰刺穿灵魂。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “有些火焰溫暖爐邊。有些火焰刺穿靈魂。” — Suphara

entries.source: Modeled after a savage demon beast, its cursed teeth thirst for battle. Best not to wear it at night.
entries.simplified: 仿照凶残恶魔野兽制成，受诅咒的利齿渴望战斗。最好别在夜里戴它。
entries.traditional: 仿照凶殘惡魔野獸製成，受詛咒的利齒渴望戰鬥。最好別在夜裡戴它。

entries.source: Plain brown cloth helps wanderers avoid people, questions, and invitations.
entries.simplified: 朴素的棕布帮助流浪者躲开人群、问题和邀请。
entries.traditional: 樸素的棕布幫助流浪者避開人群、問題和邀請。

entries.source: The hat glows at night, which makes hiding much less convenient.
entries.simplified: 这顶帽子会在夜里发光，让藏身变得麻烦得多。
entries.traditional: 這頂帽子會在夜裡發光，讓藏身變得麻煩得多。

entries.source: “Hold the light steady. It turns judgment aside when your knees would rather run.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “稳稳托住光芒。它会在你的膝盖更想逃跑时替你挡开审判。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “穩穩托住光芒。它會在你的膝蓋更想逃跑時替你擋開審判。” — Suphara

entries.source: “Mercy and judgment share a handle. Choose carefully.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “仁慈与审判共用一根柄。谨慎选择。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “仁慈與審判共用一根柄。謹慎選擇。” — Suphara

entries.source: Infernal chaos curls through the horn, ignoring every safety lesson.
entries.simplified: 地狱般的混沌盘绕于犄角之中，无视每一条安全教训。
entries.traditional: 地獄般的混沌盤繞於犄角之中，無視每一條安全教訓。

entries.source: Holy iron and savage horns argue across the same visor.
entries.simplified: 神圣铁甲与野蛮犄角在同一面甲上争论不休。
entries.traditional: 神聖鐵甲與野蠻犄角在同一面甲上爭論不休。

entries.source: Curved horns add authority, intimidation, and several doorway problems.
entries.simplified: 弯曲的犄角增添威严、威慑力，以及若干穿门难题。
entries.traditional: 彎曲的犄角增添威嚴、威懾力，以及若干穿門難題。

entries.source: A sleek black horse with a calm, steady stride and simple riding tack.
entries.simplified: 一匹线条流畅的黑马，配有朴素马具，步伐平静稳健。
entries.traditional: 一匹線條流暢的黑馬，配有樸素馬具，步伐平靜穩健。

entries.source: A dark roan horse with sturdy tack and a dependable trail pace.
entries.simplified: 一匹深色杂毛马，配有坚固马具，以可靠步调穿越小径。
entries.traditional: 一匹深色雜毛馬，配有堅固馬具，以可靠步調穿越小徑。

entries.source: A black horse fitted with red and gold flame-styled tack that glows like embers at night.
entries.simplified: 一匹黑马配有红金火焰风格马具，夜里泛着余烬般的光。
entries.traditional: 一匹黑馬配有紅金火焰風格馬具，夜裡泛著餘燼般的光。

entries.source: A golden-coated horse with a pale mane and an easy, confident gait.
entries.simplified: 一匹金色毛皮、浅色鬃毛的马，以轻松自信的步态前行。
entries.traditional: 一匹金色毛皮、淺色鬃毛的馬，以輕鬆自信的步態前行。

entries.source: Bold brown-and-white patches mark this sturdy horse for the open road.
entries.simplified: 鲜明棕白斑纹标记着这匹适合开阔道路的健壮马匹。
entries.traditional: 鮮明棕白斑紋標記著這匹適合開闊道路的健壯馬匹。

entries.source: A bright white horse with grey tack and steady, graceful steps.
entries.simplified: 一匹明亮洁白的马，配有灰色马具，步伐稳定而优雅。
entries.traditional: 一匹明亮潔白的馬，配有灰色馬具，步伐穩定而優雅。

entries.source: This noisy marsh pest darts toward anything that smells edible or wounded.
entries.simplified: 这只吵闹的沼泽害虫会冲向任何闻起来像食物或伤者的东西。
entries.traditional: 這隻吵鬧的沼澤害蟲會衝向任何聞起來像食物或傷者的東西。

entries.source: Crude steel works quickly when finesse has wandered off somewhere.
entries.simplified: 粗制钢铁在精巧手法不知溜到哪里去时，依然能迅速解决问题。
entries.traditional: 粗製鋼鐵在精巧手法不知溜到哪裡去時，依然能迅速解決問題。

entries.source: Long reach keeps danger away, which hunters generally appreciate.
entries.simplified: 长长的攻击距离能让危险保持在外，而猎人通常很欣赏这一点。
entries.traditional: 長長的攻擊距離能讓危險保持在外，而獵人通常很欣賞這一點。

entries.source: Sharp ice forms around its body as it gathers magic from the cave walls.
entries.simplified: 它从洞穴墙壁中汇聚魔力时，锋利冰晶便会在身体周围成形。
entries.traditional: 它從洞穴牆壁中匯聚魔力時，鋒利冰晶便會在身體周圍成形。

entries.source: Smaller imps dart between burning stones and strike before quickly moving away.
entries.simplified: 较小的恶魔会在燃烧石块间迅速穿梭，发动攻击后立即撤离。
entries.traditional: 較小的惡魔會在燃燒石塊間迅速穿梭，發動攻擊後立即撤離。

entries.source: Gemstone eyes never blink, which somehow makes everything worse.
entries.simplified: 宝石般的眼睛从不眨动，不知为何让一切显得更加糟糕。
entries.traditional: 寶石般的眼睛從不眨動，不知為何讓一切顯得更加糟糕。

entries.source: Heavy iron faith hangs there, making questionable priests look official.
entries.simplified: 沉重的铁制信仰垂在那里，让可疑的祭司也显得颇为正式。
entries.traditional: 沉重的鐵製信仰垂在那裡，讓可疑的祭司也顯得頗為正式。

entries.source: Old ship plating that blocks blows and remembers the ocean.
entries.simplified: 能挡住攻击、也记得海洋的旧船装甲板。
entries.traditional: 能擋住攻擊、也記得海洋的舊船裝甲板。

entries.source: A heavy shield that meets desperate blows with stubborn, unflinching iron.
entries.simplified: 一面沉重的盾牌，以顽固而毫不退缩的钢铁迎接孤注一掷的猛击。
entries.traditional: 一面沉重的盾牌，以頑固而毫不退縮的鋼鐵迎接孤注一擲的猛擊。

entries.source: Orange trim adds style to the business of being hit.
entries.simplified: 橙色饰边为挨打这门差事增添了几分格调。
entries.traditional: 橘色飾邊為挨打這門差事增添了幾分格調。

entries.source: Heavy holy spikes follow behind, ruining chairs and wicked intentions.
entries.simplified: 沉重的神圣尖刺跟随在后，既毁椅子，也毁邪念。
entries.traditional: 沉重的神聖尖刺跟隨在後，既毀椅子，也毀邪念。

entries.source: “Simple iron, sharp points, and no room for negotiation.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “简单的铁、锋利的尖刺，绝无讨价还价的余地。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “簡單的鐵、鋒利的尖刺，絕無討價還價的餘地。” — Suphara

entries.source: Scrap-forged blades choose carnage because elegance never returned their letters.
entries.simplified: 废铁锻成的刀刃选择杀戮，因为优雅从未回过它们的信。
entries.traditional: 廢鐵鍛成的刀刃選擇殺戮，因為優雅從未回過它們的信。

entries.source: Simple, common, effective. Civilization and war were built upon the point of the spear.
entries.simplified: 简单、常见、有效。文明与战争都建立在长矛的尖端之上。
entries.traditional: 簡單、常見、有效。文明與戰爭都建立在長矛的尖端之上。

entries.source: This chained spire looks like a chapel had armor problems.
entries.simplified: 这座缠着锁链的尖塔，看起来像一座在护甲上遇到麻烦的礼拜堂。
entries.traditional: 這座纏著鎖鏈的尖塔，看起來像一座在護甲上遇到麻煩的禮拜堂。

entries.source: Spikes and horns politely warn taverns to reinforce their furniture.
entries.simplified: 尖刺与犄角礼貌地提醒酒馆：最好加固一下家具。
entries.traditional: 尖刺與犄角有禮地提醒酒館：最好加固一下家具。

entries.source: Grim iron holds steady when odds start getting pushy.
entries.simplified: 当胜算开始咄咄逼人时，阴沉的铁甲依然稳如磐石。
entries.traditional: 當勝算開始咄咄逼人時，陰沉的鐵甲依然穩如磐石。

entries.source: Spirit-threaded fibers favor movement, endurance, and freedom over heavy walls.
entries.simplified: 灵丝交织的纤维偏爱机动、耐力与自由，而不是沉重壁垒。
entries.traditional: 靈絲交織的纖維偏愛機動、耐力與自由，而不是沉重壁壘。

entries.source: Soft soles grip shore and stone, refusing to stay anywhere long.
entries.simplified: 柔软鞋底牢牢抓住海岸与岩石，拒绝在任何地方久留。
entries.traditional: 柔軟鞋底牢牢抓住海岸與岩石，拒絕在任何地方久留。

entries.source: Flexible wraps carry spells and strikes smoothly through sand and surf.
entries.simplified: 灵活裹布让法术与攻击顺畅地穿过沙滩与浪潮。
entries.traditional: 靈活裹布讓法術與攻擊順暢地穿過沙灘與浪潮。

entries.source: “A jagged edge takes more than blood when it bites.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “锯齿状的锋刃咬下时，夺走的可不只是鲜血。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “鋸齒狀的鋒刃咬下時，奪走的可不只是鮮血。” — Suphara

entries.source: This floating machine stores wind energy beneath its rounded shell.
entries.simplified: 这台漂浮机械会在圆形外壳下方储存风能。
entries.traditional: 這台漂浮機械會在圓形外殼下方儲存風能。

entries.source: That glowing rune at the front suggests the joke may be on someone else.
entries.simplified: 帽子前方那枚发光符文暗示着，笑话的对象或许另有其人。
entries.traditional: 帽子前方那枚發光符文暗示著，笑話的對象或許另有其人。

entries.source: Small steel solves personal problems before they become public problems.
entries.simplified: 小巧钢刃会在私人问题变成公开问题前将其解决。
entries.traditional: 小巧鋼刃會在私人問題變成公開問題前將其解決。

entries.source: A knightly field manual for turning forward motion into disciplined pressure.
entries.simplified: 一本骑士战地手册，教人将向前推进化作严谨的压制。
entries.traditional: 一本騎士戰地手冊，教人將向前推進化作嚴謹的壓制。

entries.source: Wide diagrams teach formation, pull, and control through every measured sweep.
entries.simplified: 宽大的图示教授如何通过每一次沉稳挥扫掌握阵形、牵引与控制。
entries.traditional: 寬大的圖示教授如何透過每一次沉穩揮掃掌握陣形、牽引與控制。

entries.source: Crackling notes train the body to strike twice before doubt catches up.
entries.simplified: 噼啪作响的笔记训练身体在疑虑追上之前连续出手两次。
entries.traditional: 劈啪作響的筆記訓練身體在疑慮追上之前連續出手兩次。

entries.source: A rescue doctrine bound for knights who bring danger closer before breaking it.
entries.simplified: 一本为骑士装订成册的救援教典，教他们先将危险拉近，再将其击溃。
entries.traditional: 一本為騎士裝訂成冊的救援教典，教他們先將危險拉近，再將其擊潰。

entries.source: Iron-edged pages answer every blocked strike with stubborn, immediate resolve.
entries.simplified: 镶铁书页以顽固而即时的决意回应每一次格挡。
entries.traditional: 鑲鐵書頁以頑固而即時的決意回應每一次格擋。

entries.source: Frontline doctrine teaches taunts to weaken resolve before steel arrives.
entries.simplified: 前线教典教授如何以嘲讽削弱敌人的意志，再让钢铁抵达。
entries.traditional: 前線教典教授如何以嘲諷削弱敵人的意志，再讓鋼鐵抵達。

entries.source: Polished armor makes justice feel shiny, heavy, and slightly theatrical.
entries.simplified: 抛光铠甲让正义显得闪亮、沉重，又带着一点戏剧性。
entries.traditional: 拋光鎧甲讓正義顯得閃亮、沉重，又帶著一點戲劇性。

entries.source: Heavy boots echo honor, because quiet justice apparently stayed home.
entries.simplified: 沉重靴声回荡着荣耀，因为安静的正义显然待在家里。
entries.traditional: 沉重靴聲迴盪著榮耀，因為安靜的正義顯然待在家裡。

entries.source: Solid greaves hold the line when the ground argues back.
entries.simplified: 坚固胫甲守住战线，即使脚下的大地也开始顶嘴。
entries.traditional: 堅固脛甲守住戰線，即使腳下的大地也開始頂嘴。

entries.source: Studded wraps should leave marks, because polite punches rarely get remembered.
entries.simplified: 带铆钉的裹带就该留下印记，毕竟礼貌的拳头很少有人记得。
entries.traditional: 帶鉚釘的裹帶就該留下印記，畢竟有禮的拳頭很少有人記得。

entries.source: Forged to fly with surgical precision, these kunai find weak points at melee or range.
entries.simplified: 这些苦无经过锻造，能以外科手术般的精度飞行，无论近战还是远程都能找到弱点。
entries.traditional: 這些苦無經過鍛造，能以外科手術般的精準飛行，無論近戰還是遠程都能找到弱點。

entries.source: A heavy launcher built for raw impact, hurling explosive payloads that devastate clustered enemies.
entries.simplified: 一具为纯粹冲击力打造的重型发射器，能够投掷爆炸载荷，摧毁成群敌人。
entries.traditional: 一具為純粹衝擊力打造的重型發射器，能夠投擲爆炸載荷，摧毀成群敵人。

entries.source: Sporeling charm gives the mask a face only nature excuses.
entries.simplified: Sporeling 的魅力让这副面具有了一张只有大自然才会原谅的脸。
entries.traditional: Sporeling 的魅力讓這副面具有了一張只有大自然才會原諒的臉。

entries.source: Reduced drag lets each stride answer faster than heavy armor.
entries.simplified: 减少阻力后，每一步都能比沉重护甲更快作出回应。
entries.traditional: 減少阻力後，每一步都能比沉重護甲更快作出回應。

entries.source: Measured movement begins in balanced plates that correct every step.
entries.simplified: 精准的动作始于平衡的甲片，它们会校正每一步。
entries.traditional: 精準的動作始於平衡的甲片，它們會校正每一步。

entries.source: Subtle sigils support focus while your legs handle practical matters.
entries.simplified: 细微的符印帮助维持专注，而双腿负责处理实际问题。
entries.traditional: 細微的符印幫助維持專注，而雙腿負責處理實際問題。

entries.source: Each step invites fortune to trip someone else for once.
entries.simplified: 每一步都邀请幸运偶尔去绊倒别人。
entries.traditional: 每一步都邀請幸運偶爾去絆倒別人。

entries.source: Solid plates turn every step into a threat of force.
entries.simplified: 坚固甲片让每一步都化作力量的威胁。
entries.traditional: 堅固甲片讓每一步都化作力量的威脅。

entries.source: Thick metal carries pressure well, refusing to let steps falter.
entries.simplified: 厚重金属擅长承受压力，拒绝让步伐动摇。
entries.traditional: 厚重金屬擅長承受壓力，拒絕讓步伐動搖。

entries.source: The red plume says valor; the dents say experience.
entries.simplified: 红色羽冠诉说勇武；那些凹痕则诉说经验。
entries.traditional: 紅色羽冠訴說勇武；那些凹痕則訴說經驗。

entries.source: Neat academy trousers hold crisp lines through hectic study days.
entries.simplified: 整洁的学院长裤在忙乱的学习日里仍保持利落线条。
entries.traditional: 整潔的學院長褲在忙亂的學習日里仍保持利落線條。

entries.source: Tailored academy trousers suit field assignments far from campus lectures.
entries.simplified: 剪裁得体的学院长裤适合远离校园讲堂的实地任务。
entries.traditional: 剪裁得體的學院長褲適合遠離校園講堂的實地任務。

entries.source: White ceremonial cloth flows through founder legwear with gold and turquoise lines. Each step feels graceful and chosen along a radiant vow.
entries.simplified: 洁白礼仪布料以金色与青绿色线条构成创始者腿装。每一步都像沿着辉耀誓言，被优雅而坚定地选中。
entries.traditional: 潔白禮儀布料以金色與青綠色線條構成創始者腿裝。每一步都像沿著輝耀誓言，被優雅而堅定地選中。

entries.source: A clean guardian silhouette runs through sacred white and gold legwear. Quiet strength roots the stance in the earliest dawn.
entries.simplified: 圣洁白金腿装勾勒出利落守护者轮廓。安静力量让站姿扎根于最初黎明。
entries.traditional: 聖潔白金腿裝勾勒出利落守護者輪廓。安靜力量讓站姿扎根於最初黎明。

entries.source: Sharp white edges cut across black legwear in raven costume style. Each step stays poised and ceremonial as the masquerade moves forward.
entries.simplified: 锐利白边切过黑色腿装，展现渡鸦装束的风格。化装舞会向前移动时，每一步都保持从容而庄重。
entries.traditional: 銳利白邊切過黑色腿裝，展現渡鴉裝束的風格。化裝舞會向前移動時，每一步都保持從容而莊重。

entries.source: Pale trim pairs with a rugged supporter silhouette across black legwear. Each stride feels bold and road ready under the shadow of crow wings.
entries.simplified: 浅色饰边与粗犷支持者轮廓交织在黑色腿装上。乌鸦双翼的阴影下，每一步都大胆而适合远行。
entries.traditional: 淺色飾邊與粗獷支持者輪廓交織在黑色腿裝上。烏鴉雙翼的陰影下，每一步都大膽而適合遠行。

entries.source: White armor and black panels run through the lower suit with sharp neon power. Each step looks fast and deliberate as the runner moves through living light.
entries.simplified: 白色护甲与黑色甲片贯穿下装，闪耀锐利霓虹力量。奔行者穿过活光时，每一步都迅捷而明确。
entries.traditional: 白色護甲與黑色甲片貫穿下裝，閃耀銳利霓虹力量。奔行者穿過活光時，每一步都迅捷而明確。

entries.source: Dark elegance flows through legguards as crimson details spark through shadowed fabric. Motion becomes a ritual of confidence and beauty under barely restrained danger.
entries.simplified: 黑暗优雅流过护腿，猩红细节在暗色布料间迸出火花。动作化作信心与美感的仪式，包裹着勉强受控的危险。
entries.traditional: 黑暗優雅流過護腿，猩紅細節在暗色布料間迸出火花。動作化作信心與美感的儀式，包裹著勉強受控的危險。

entries.source: Embered trim and commanding shadow cut a severe silhouette across infernal legwear. Each stride clears the path through dread and visible authority.
entries.simplified: 余烬饰边与号令暗影在地狱腿装上切出严厉轮廓。每一步都以恐惧与醒目权威清开道路。
entries.traditional: 餘燼飾邊與號令暗影在地獄腿裝上切出嚴厲輪廓。每一步都以恐懼與醒目權威清開道路。

entries.source: Pastel festival legwear keeps each step cheerful and light.
entries.simplified: 柔和粉彩节庆腿装让每一步都欢快轻盈。
entries.traditional: 柔和粉彩節慶腿裝讓每一步都歡快輕盈。

entries.source: Soft spring legwear keeps travel bright and easygoing.
entries.simplified: 柔软春日腿装让旅途保持明亮而轻松。
entries.traditional: 柔軟春日腿裝讓旅途保持明亮而輕鬆。

entries.source: Warm foxfire cloth adds lively spark to each stride.
entries.simplified: 温暖狐火布料为每一步增添活泼火花。
entries.traditional: 溫暖狐火布料為每一步增添活潑火花。

entries.source: Soft storybook cloth makes each step feel gentle and familiar.
entries.simplified: 柔软童话布料让每一步都显得温柔而熟悉。
entries.traditional: 柔軟童話布料讓每一步都顯得溫柔而熟悉。

entries.source: Rugged trail trousers move through dust with holster-side bravado.
entries.simplified: 粗犷行路长裤带着手枪套旁的张扬，穿过漫天尘土。
entries.traditional: 粗獷行路長褲帶著手槍套旁的張揚，穿過漫天塵土。

entries.source: Pale winter cloth moves with quiet frost grace.
entries.simplified: 苍白冬布以安静寒霜之姿随步伐移动。
entries.traditional: 蒼白冬布以安靜寒霜之姿隨步伐移動。

entries.source: Sacred legwear steadies each step toward blessing and service.
entries.simplified: 神圣腿装稳住每一步，引向祝福与奉献。
entries.traditional: 神聖腿裝穩住每一步，引向祝福與奉獻。

entries.source: Clean ceremonial legwear steadies each step toward solemn service.
entries.simplified: 利落礼仪腿装稳住每一步，引向庄严奉献。
entries.traditional: 利落禮儀腿裝穩住每一步，引向莊嚴奉獻。

entries.source: Flexible shinobi wraps favor silent pivots across moonlit rooftops.
entries.simplified: 柔韧忍者裹布适合在月光屋顶上无声转身。
entries.traditional: 柔韌忍者裹布適合在月光屋頂上無聲轉身。

entries.source: Shared supporter pride moves through festival travel lines. The outfit feels tied to shared promise and lasting community.
entries.simplified: 共同的支持者自豪感流过节庆行路线条。整套服装仿佛与共同誓言和长久社群紧密相连。
entries.traditional: 共同的支持者自豪感流過節慶行路線條。整套服裝彷彿與共同誓言和長久社群緊密相連。

entries.source: Sharp uniform trousers strike forward with schoolyard authority.
entries.simplified: 利落制服长裤带着校园权威向前迈进。
entries.traditional: 利落制服長褲帶著校園權威向前邁進。

entries.source: Structured uniform trousers hold their shape through corridor trouble.
entries.simplified: 结构分明的制服长裤即使经历走廊麻烦也不失挺括。
entries.traditional: 結構分明的制服長褲即使經歷走廊麻煩也不失挺括。

entries.source: Invisible legwear preserves the outfit from waistline to floor.
entries.simplified: 隐形腿装让整套服装从腰际到地面保持不变。
entries.traditional: 隱形腿裝讓整套服裝從腰際到地面保持不變。

entries.source: Relaxed city trousers keep daily wandering easy inside layered outfits.
entries.simplified: 轻松都市长裤让日常漫游在层叠服装中更加自在。
entries.traditional: 輕鬆都市長褲讓日常漫游在層疊服裝中更加自在。

entries.source: Arcane legwear moves lightly through careful spellwork.
entries.simplified: 奥术腿装轻盈移动，适合谨慎施法。
entries.traditional: 奧術腿裝輕盈移動，適合謹慎施法。

entries.source: Scholarly legwear suits long roads and stranger lessons.
entries.simplified: 学者腿装适合漫长道路与更加奇异的课程。
entries.traditional: 學者腿裝適合漫長道路與更加奇異的課程。

entries.source: “Vitae’s breath is stronger than any hammer blow. I only gave it form so we all may endure.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “Vitae 的吐息胜过任何锤击。我只是赋予它形体，让我们都能坚持下去。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “Vitae 的吐息勝過任何鎚擊。我只是賦予它形體，讓我們都能堅持下去。” — Suphara

entries.source: Soft steps leave tiny blossoms of renewal wherever the wearer endures.
entries.simplified: 轻柔脚步在穿戴者坚持前行之处，留下细小的复苏花朵。
entries.traditional: 輕柔腳步在穿戴者堅持前行之處，留下細小的復甦花朵。

entries.source: Remember your training. Focus, draw, aim, take a deep breath, and loose.
entries.simplified: 记住你的训练。专注、拉弓、瞄准、深吸一口气，然后放箭。
entries.traditional: 記住你的訓練。專注、拉弓、瞄準、深吸一口氣，然後放箭。

entries.source: These twin jade baubles jingle softly, loudly advertising your supposed luck.
entries.simplified: 这对翡翠小饰物轻轻叮当作响，大声宣扬着你所谓的好运。
entries.traditional: 這對翡翠小飾物輕輕叮噹作響，大聲宣揚著你所謂的好運。

entries.source: It waits near corners and ledges where shadows hide its body.
entries.simplified: 它会潜伏在转角与高台附近，借助阴影隐藏身体。
entries.traditional: 它會潛伏在轉角與高台附近，藉助陰影隱藏身體。

entries.source: “For smiting the unworthy, use weight, faith, and a firm grip. E.T.F. wanted all three.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “要惩击不配者，就靠重量、信仰和稳固的握法。E.T.F. 三样都要。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “要懲擊不配者，就靠重量、信仰和穩固的握法。E.T.F. 三樣都要。” — Suphara

entries.source: “Carry light with purpose as your Judgment takes a breath before it falls.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “让光明带着明确的目标随你而行，好让你的 Judgment 在落下前先喘口气。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “讓光明帶著明確的目標隨你而行，好讓你的 Judgment 在落下前先喘口氣。” — Suphara

entries.source: “A good mace is reliable in any hand.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “一把好钉头锤，到了谁手里都可靠。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “一把好釘頭鎚，到了誰手裡都可靠。” — Suphara

entries.source: A compact guard etched for spellcasters who prefer barriers between focus and pain.
entries.simplified: 一面刻有符文的小型护具，为那些宁愿让屏障隔在专注与疼痛之间的施法者打造。
entries.traditional: 一面刻有符文的小型護具，為那些寧願讓屏障隔在專注與疼痛之間的施法者打造。

entries.source: Reinforced robes hold steady under pressure, refusing to let spellwork break.
entries.simplified: 强化长袍在压力下依然稳固，绝不让法术运转崩溃。
entries.traditional: 強化長袍在壓力下依然穩固，絕不讓法術運轉崩潰。

entries.source: Four attunements share one page, arguing until they become a single harmony.
entries.simplified: 四种调谐共处一页，争论不休，直到最终汇成一曲和声。
entries.traditional: 四種調諧共處一頁，爭論不休，直到最終匯成一曲和聲。

entries.source: Arcane diagrams turn simple attacks into distant sparks of disciplined magic.
entries.simplified: 奥术图示将朴素攻击化作远方迸发的严谨魔法火花。
entries.traditional: 奧術圖示將樸素攻擊化作遠方迸發的嚴謹魔法火花。

entries.source: Folded pages mark impossible footwork between one breath and the next.
entries.simplified: 折叠的书页标记着一呼一吸之间那不可思议的步法。
entries.traditional: 摺疊的書頁標記著一呼一吸之間那不可思議的步法。

entries.source: Hidden ley-lines hum beneath the cover, refilling power through fallen foes.
entries.simplified: 隐藏的地脉在封面下低鸣，借倒下的敌人补充力量。
entries.traditional: 隱藏的地脈在封面下低鳴，藉倒下的敵人補充力量。

entries.source: Brittle blue script fractures into cold bursts whenever magic finds a mark.
entries.simplified: 脆弱的蓝色文字在魔法命中目标时碎裂成寒冷爆发。
entries.traditional: 脆弱的藍色文字在魔法命中目標時碎裂成寒冷爆發。

entries.source: Unstable red script waits for impact before blooming into sudden flame.
entries.simplified: 不稳定的红色文字静候冲击，随后骤然绽放为烈焰。
entries.traditional: 不穩定的紅色文字靜候衝擊，隨後驟然綻放為烈焰。

entries.source: Arcane thread pulses softly through the robe, holding gathered magic.
entries.simplified: 奥术丝线在长袍中柔和脉动，稳稳承载汇聚的魔力。
entries.traditional: 奧術絲線在長袍中柔和脈動，穩穩承載匯聚的魔力。

entries.source: Cloud-soft slippers keep steps quiet and thoughts impressively smug.
entries.simplified: 云朵般柔软的拖鞋让脚步悄无声息，也让思绪得意得惊人。
entries.traditional: 雲朵般柔軟的拖鞋讓腳步悄無聲息，也讓思緒得意得驚人。

entries.source: Runed leggings survive study sessions, spell marathons, and chair time.
entries.simplified: 符文长裤经得住学习时光、施法马拉松，以及长时间坐椅子。
entries.traditional: 符文長褲經得住研讀時光、施法馬拉松，以及長時間坐椅子。

entries.source: Filled to the brim with mana crystals. Increases the user's mana reserves.
entries.simplified: 装满了魔力水晶。提高使用者的魔力储量。
entries.traditional: 裝滿了魔力水晶。提高使用者的魔力儲量。

entries.source: Created by Professor Elsi. Take slow steady sips to renew one's mana.
entries.simplified: 由 Professor Elsi 制作。缓慢而平稳地啜饮，以恢复自身魔力。
entries.traditional: 由 Professor Elsi 製作。緩慢而平穩地啜飲，以恢復自身魔力。

entries.source: “Balance is what lets a heavy blow feel easy.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “平衡能让沉重一击显得轻而易举。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “平衡能讓沉重一擊顯得輕而易舉。” — Suphara

entries.source: “A master text should mend, teach, and strike only after the lesson is clear.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “大师之作应当先修复、再教导，只有当教训足够清楚时才出手。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “大師之作應當先修復、再教導，只有當教訓足夠清楚時才出手。” — Suphara

entries.source: “Speed matters, aye, but only if the point knows where it is going.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “速度当然重要，但前提是刀尖知道自己要去哪里。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “速度當然重要，但前提是刀尖知道自己要去哪裡。” — Suphara

entries.source: “Faith and fury both need a steady handle.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “信仰与怒火，都需要一根稳固的握柄。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “信仰與怒火，都需要一根穩固的握柄。” — Suphara

entries.source: “Strike once at the right moment, and the fight thinks twice.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “在正确的时机出手一次，就足以让整场战斗三思而行。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “在正確的時機出手一次，就足以讓整場戰鬥三思而行。” — Suphara

entries.source: “A sidearm should fire like a kept promise: short, firm, and final.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “随身枪械开火时，应当像兑现承诺：简短、坚定、彻底。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “隨身槍械開火時，應當像兌現承諾：簡短、堅定、徹底。” — Suphara

entries.source: “A scythe fed farms before battlefields. This replica harvests strength as it cuts, so treat it with respect.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “镰刀在踏上战场前，先养活了农田。这件复制品会在挥砍时收割力量，所以要敬重它。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “鐮刀在踏上戰場前，先養活了農田。這件複製品會在揮砍時收割力量，所以要敬重它。” — Suphara

entries.source: “A bow waits until distance becomes a mistake.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “弓会静静等待，直到距离本身变成一个错误。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “弓會靜靜等待，直到距離本身變成一個錯誤。” — Suphara

entries.source: “This replica remembers the first Knights of the land in its reach, its balance, and its stubborn spine.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “这件复制品以攻击范围、平衡与顽强的脊骨，铭记着这片土地最初的 Knights。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “這件複製品以攻擊距離、平衡與頑強的脊骨，銘記著這片土地最初的 Knights。” — Suphara

entries.source: “I copied a hero’s blade as close as my hammer allowed. May it give you courage when you need it.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “我尽锤子所能，原样仿造了一位英雄的利刃。愿它在你需要时赐予你勇气。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “我盡鎚子所能，原樣仿造了一位英雄的利刃。願它在你需要時賜予你勇氣。” — Suphara

entries.source: “Mastery is power that knows when to be quick and quiet.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “精通，就是懂得何时该迅捷，何时该安静的力量。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “精通，就是懂得何時該迅捷，何時該安靜的力量。” — Suphara

entries.source: Tiny gears spin with potential, confidence, and mild overheating concerns.
entries.simplified: 细小齿轮怀着潜力、自信，以及轻微的过热隐忧不断旋转。
entries.traditional: 細小齒輪懷著潛力、自信，以及輕微的過熱隱憂不斷旋轉。

entries.source: “I took a star’s anger and gave it a handle. Mind where you point it.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “我取来一颗星辰的怒火，再替它装上握柄。注意你把它指向哪里。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “我取來一顆星辰的怒火，再替它裝上握柄。注意你把它指向哪裡。” — Suphara

entries.source: It disguises itself as a discarded barrel before rolling at anything that comes too close.
entries.simplified: 它会伪装成一只被丢弃的木桶，待任何目标靠得太近时便滚撞过去。
entries.traditional: 它會偽裝成一個被丟棄的木桶，待任何目標靠得太近時便滾撞過去。

entries.source: This false book snaps open and skitters away when disturbed.
entries.simplified: 这本伪装书籍受到惊扰时会猛然张开，并迅速爬走。
entries.traditional: 這本偽裝書籍受到驚擾時會猛然張開，並迅速爬走。

entries.source: This candle mimic bobs through dungeon halls after luring creatures within reach.
entries.simplified: 这个蜡烛拟态怪会先引诱生物进入攻击范围，随后在地牢大厅中跳动追赶。
entries.traditional: 這個蠟燭擬態怪會先引誘生物進入攻擊範圍，隨後在地牢大廳中跳動追趕。

entries.source: This living trap skitters after movement instead of waiting to be stepped on.
entries.simplified: 这个活体陷阱不会等待他人踩上去，而会主动追赶移动的目标。
entries.traditional: 這個活體陷阱不會等待他人踩上去，而會主動追趕移動的目標。

entries.source: It disguises itself as a resting blade before springing toward careless hands.
entries.simplified: 它会伪装成一柄静置的刀剑，随后猛扑向粗心伸来的双手。
entries.traditional: 它會偽裝成一柄靜置的刀劍，隨後猛撲向粗心伸來的雙手。

entries.source: It disguises itself as treasure and lunges when the chest is approached.
entries.simplified: 它会伪装成宝箱，并在有人靠近时猛然扑出。
entries.traditional: 它會偽裝成寶箱，並在有人靠近時猛然撲出。

entries.source: Layered focus runes clear the mind while motion channels magic.
entries.simplified: 层叠的专注符文澄澈思绪，同时让动作引导魔力。
entries.traditional: 層疊的專注符文澄澈思緒，同時讓動作引導魔力。

entries.source: A wavering cloak that lets the wearer vanish between motion, mischief, and danger.
entries.simplified: 一件摇曳不定的斗篷，让穿戴者消失在动作、恶作剧与危险之间。
entries.traditional: 一件搖曳不定的斗篷，讓穿戴者消失在動作、惡作劇與危險之間。

entries.source: The smile looks harmless, which is exactly how mischief starts.
entries.simplified: 这张笑脸看似无害，而恶作剧正是这样开始的。
entries.traditional: 這張笑臉看似無害，而惡作劇正是這樣開始的。

entries.source: Jeweled light crowns the hat, making prayers look more official.
entries.simplified: 宝石般的光辉为帽子加冕，让祈祷看起来更加正式。
entries.traditional: 寶石般的光輝為帽子加冕，讓祈禱看起來更加正式。

entries.source: The cracked stone glows warmly, like a backpack pretending to be geology.
entries.simplified: 开裂的石头温暖发光，像一个假装自己是地质现象的背包。
entries.traditional: 裂開的石頭溫暖發光，像一個假裝自己是地質現象的背包。

entries.source: Undead cave flyers cling to high stone until movement passes beneath them.
entries.simplified: 这些不死洞穴飞行生物会攀附在高处岩石上，等待动静从下方经过。
entries.traditional: 這些不死洞穴飛行生物會攀附在高處岩石上，等待動靜從下方經過。

entries.source: “Moonlight and frost both look gentle until given an edge.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “月光与寒霜看起来都很温柔，直到有人替它们开锋。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “月光與寒霜看起來都很溫柔，直到有人替它們開鋒。” — Suphara

entries.source: A hat woven by gathering pieces of shadow and threads of moonlight. Wizards donning this piece of fae magic find it easier to wield the energy in the air to empower their spells.
entries.simplified: 一顶由阴影碎片与月光丝线织成的帽子。戴上这件精灵魔法造物的 Wizards，更容易驾驭空气中的能量来强化法术。
entries.traditional: 一頂由陰影碎片與月光絲線織成的帽子。戴上這件精靈魔法造物的 Wizards，更容易駕馭空氣中的能量來強化法術。

entries.source: A smooth, pale bracelet polished to a faint gleam. Said to steady the mind under moonlight.
entries.simplified: 一只光滑的苍白手镯，被打磨出淡淡光泽。据说能在月光下稳定心神。
entries.traditional: 一只光滑的蒼白手鐲，被打磨出淡淡光澤。據說能在月光下穩定心神。

entries.source: These persistent marsh pests follow movement longer than most insects their size.
entries.simplified: 这些顽固的沼泽害虫会比同体型的大多数昆虫更长时间追随动静。
entries.traditional: 這些頑固的沼澤害蟲會比同體型的大多數昆蟲更長時間追隨動靜。

entries.source: Moonlit dust clings to its wings and drifts through the glen when it casts.
entries.simplified: 月光粉尘附着在双翼上，并在它施法时飘散于林谷之间。
entries.traditional: 月光粉塵附著在雙翼上，並在它施法時飄散於林谷之間。

entries.source: A golden lion bears the founder forward with noble strength and sacred calm. Its radiant mane turns each journey into a procession from first light.
entries.simplified: 一头金色雄狮以高贵力量与神圣沉静载着创始者前行。辉耀鬃毛让每一次旅程都化作源自初光的仪仗。
entries.traditional: 一頭金色雄獅以高貴力量與神聖沉靜載著創始者前行。輝耀鬃毛讓每一次旅程都化作源自初光的儀仗。

entries.source: A golden duck waddles into legend with absurd charm and stubborn courage. Travel becomes a festival joke that somehow turns heroic.
entries.simplified: 一只金色鸭子以荒唐魅力与顽固勇气摇摆着踏入传说。旅途化作一场节庆笑话，却不知为何显得英雄十足。
entries.traditional: 一隻金色鴨子以荒唐魅力與頑固勇氣搖擺著踏入傳說。旅途化作一場節慶笑話，卻不知為何顯得英雄十足。

entries.source: An infernal dragon moves with ancient fury and scales that burn with shadowed fire. Flight upon its back becomes a royal omen that inspires awe and silence.
entries.simplified: 一条地狱巨龙带着远古怒火与燃烧暗焰的鳞片前行。骑乘其背飞翔，宛如皇家预兆，足以令人敬畏并沉默。
entries.traditional: 一條地獄巨龍帶著遠古怒火與燃燒暗焰的鱗片前行。騎乘其背飛翔，宛如皇家預兆，足以令人敬畏並沉默。

entries.source: A foxfire mount races forward with ember-bright grace and restless spirit. The road becomes a trail of warmth and wild confidence.
entries.simplified: 一头狐火坐骑以余烬般明亮的优雅与躁动灵性向前疾驰。道路化作一条温暖而野性自信的光迹。
entries.traditional: 一頭狐火坐騎以餘燼般明亮的優雅與躁動靈性向前疾馳。道路化作一條溫暖而野性自信的光跡。

entries.source: A gentle leviathan drifts through the world with blooming color and quiet wonder. Riding it feels like crossing a dream carried by petals and deep calm.
entries.simplified: 一头温柔巨鲸带着盛放色彩与静谧奇景漂过世界。骑乘其上，仿佛穿越一场由花瓣与深海宁静托起的梦。
entries.traditional: 一頭溫柔巨鯨帶著盛放色彩與靜謐奇景漂過世界。騎乘其上，彷彿穿越一場由花瓣與深海寧靜托起的夢。

entries.source: A frost fox mount moves with pale grace and winter-bright eyes. The rider crosses the road like moonlight sliding over snow.
entries.simplified: 一头寒霜狐狸坐骑以苍白优雅与冬日明亮的双眼前行。骑手掠过道路，如月光滑过积雪。
entries.traditional: 一頭寒霜狐狸坐騎以蒼白優雅與冬日明亮的雙眼前行。騎手掠過道路，如月光滑過積雪。

entries.source: A dark mark shapes the mouth with wicked elegance and forbidden charm. Each smile gains the edge of a secret that draws attention and holds danger.
entries.simplified: 黑暗印记以邪恶优雅与禁忌魅力勾勒嘴角。每一次微笑都像一则吸引目光却暗藏危险的秘密。
entries.traditional: 黑暗印記以邪惡優雅與禁忌魅力勾勒嘴角。每一次微笑都像一則吸引目光卻暗藏危險的秘密。

entries.source: An infernal mark lends the face a grim expression touched by shadow. Silence feels sharpened because unspoken words carry a clear threat.
entries.simplified: 地狱印记赋予面容一抹染有暗影的冷峻神情。沉默仿佛被磨利，因为未出口的话语带着清晰威胁。
entries.traditional: 地獄印記賦予面容一抹染有暗影的冷峻神情。沉默彷彿被磨利，因為未出口的話語帶著清晰威脅。

entries.source: Its thick cap absorbs blows while its damp body holds steady near the water.
entries.simplified: 厚实菌盖能吸收攻击，而潮湿躯体则稳稳扎在水边。
entries.traditional: 厚實菌蓋能吸收攻擊，而潮濕軀體則穩穩扎在水邊。

entries.source: Classic wizard shape, faint sparks, and absolutely no subtlety whatsoever.
entries.simplified: 经典的巫师帽造型、微弱火花，以及彻头彻尾的毫不低调。
entries.traditional: 經典的巫師帽造型、微弱火花，以及徹頭徹尾的毫不低調。

entries.source: Nomadic cloth muffles sound, thought, and unnecessary conversations.
entries.simplified: 游牧布料能压低声响、思绪，以及没必要的交谈。
entries.traditional: 遊牧布料能壓低聲響、思緒，以及沒必要的交談。

entries.source: “I bound the dead words tight. They still lengthen curses if you read too long.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “我把死者的文字牢牢装订起来。可你若读得太久，它们依然会让诅咒延长。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “我把死者的文字牢牢裝訂起來。可你若讀得太久，它們依然會讓詛咒延長。” — Suphara

entries.source: Feline charm boosts sneakiness, mischief, and irresponsible confidence.
entries.simplified: 猫科魅力提升潜行、恶作剧，以及不负责任的自信。
entries.traditional: 貓科魅力提升潛行、惡作劇，以及不負責任的自信。

entries.source: Alien lines glow faintly, bending without breaking around body and spirit.
entries.simplified: 异界纹路泛着微光，在身体与灵魂周围弯折，却绝不断裂。
entries.traditional: 異界紋路泛著微光，在身體與靈魂周圍彎折，卻絕不斷裂。

entries.source: Unseen rhythm guides each quiet step through impossible darkness ahead.
entries.simplified: 无形的节奏引导每一步悄然穿过前方不可思议的黑暗。
entries.traditional: 無形的節奏引導每一步悄然穿過前方不可思議的黑暗。

entries.source: The helm's flawless surface reveals the Garden's hidden weave one thread at a time.
entries.simplified: 头盔无瑕的表面，一丝一缕地揭示出 Garden 隐藏的织理。
entries.traditional: 頭盔無瑕的表面，一絲一縷地揭示出 Garden 隱藏的織理。

entries.source: Strange symmetry lightens the stride while guarding against impossible strikes.
entries.simplified: 奇异的对称结构减轻脚步，同时抵御不可思议的攻击。
entries.traditional: 奇異的對稱結構減輕腳步，同時抵禦不可思議的攻擊。

entries.source: An ornate compass glowing with faint light. Guides the bearer toward fortune and safety.
entries.simplified: 一枚泛着微光的华丽罗盘。引导持有者走向好运与安全。
entries.traditional: 一枚泛著微光的華麗羅盤。引導持有者走向好運與安全。

entries.source: Obsidian fangs hang at the ear, favored by patient nightstalkers.
entries.simplified: 黑曜石尖牙垂在耳畔，深受耐心夜行猎手的喜爱。
entries.traditional: 黑曜石尖牙垂在耳畔，深受耐心夜行獵手的喜愛。

entries.source: Black cloth swallows the face, leaving only intent behind it.
entries.simplified: 黑布吞没整张面容，只留下潜藏其后的意图。
entries.traditional: 黑布吞沒整張面容，只留下潛藏其後的意圖。

entries.source: Blue tassel and rough leather fight sunburn with desert style.
entries.simplified: 蓝色流苏与粗糙皮革，以沙漠风格对抗晒伤。
entries.traditional: 藍色流蘇與粗糙皮革，以沙漠風格對抗曬傷。

entries.source: A beginner's tunic brimming with hope, made for those just starting their journey.
entries.simplified: 一件充满希望的新手上衣，为刚刚踏上旅途的人而制。
entries.traditional: 一件充滿希望的新手上衣，為剛剛踏上旅途的人而製。

entries.source: Comfy rookie shoes are ready before the wearer understands why.
entries.simplified: 舒适的新手鞋早已准备妥当，尽管穿戴者还不明白为什么。
entries.traditional: 舒適的新手鞋早已準備妥當，儘管穿戴者還不明白為什麼。

entries.source: Simple pants survive first adventures and plenty of bad pathfinding.
entries.simplified: 朴素长裤经得住最初的冒险，也经得住无数次糟糕的寻路。
entries.traditional: 樸素長褲經得住最初的冒險，也經得住無數次糟糕的尋路。

entries.source: Its narrow nozzle focuses pressure and force into short, direct attacks.
entries.simplified: 狭窄喷嘴会将压力与力量集中成短促而直接的攻击。
entries.traditional: 狹窄噴嘴會將壓力與力量集中成短促而直接的攻擊。

entries.source: “Good oak bends, but it does not break.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “上好的橡木会弯曲，却不会折断。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “上好的橡木會彎曲，卻不會折斷。” — Suphara

entries.source: Ivory horns honor warriors who chose resolve over retreat.
entries.simplified: 象牙色犄角向那些选择坚守而非退却的战士致敬。
entries.traditional: 象牙色犄角向那些選擇堅守而非退卻的戰士致敬。

entries.source: A tempered wristguard forged from volcanic ash and ore. Feels heavy, yet reassuringly firm.
entries.simplified: 一只由火山灰与矿石锻成的淬火护腕。手感沉重，却坚固得令人安心。
entries.traditional: 一只由火山灰與礦石鍛成的淬火護腕。手感沉重，卻堅固得令人安心。

entries.source: “Volcanic glass cuts because it remembers being fire.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “火山玻璃之所以锋利，是因为它还记得自己曾是火焰。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “火山玻璃之所以鋒利，是因為它還記得自己曾是火焰。” — Suphara

entries.source: In honor of the lord O we have made this band out of volcanic glass. May their power protect us from harm.
entries.simplified: 为纪念 O 大人，我们以火山玻璃制成了这枚指环。愿其力量护佑我们免受伤害。
entries.traditional: 為紀念 O 大人，我們以火山玻璃製成了這枚指環。願其力量護佑我們免受傷害。

entries.source: Scrolls and charms weigh down magic that deserved supervision.
entries.simplified: 卷轴与护符沉沉压住那股本该受到监管的魔力。
entries.traditional: 卷軸與護符沉沉壓住那股本該受到監管的魔力。

entries.source: The eye watches readers, which makes skimming feel personally judged.
entries.simplified: 那只眼睛注视着读者，让草草翻阅也像是在接受针对个人的评判。
entries.traditional: 那隻眼睛注視著讀者，讓草草翻閱也像是在接受針對個人的評判。

entries.source: Black onyx crackles softly, practicing dramatic rogue behavior between fights.
entries.simplified: 黑色缟玛瑙轻轻噼啪作响，在战斗间隙练习戏剧化的 Rogue 作派。
entries.traditional: 黑色縞瑪瑙輕輕劈啪作響，在戰鬥間隙練習戲劇化的 Rogue 作派。

entries.source: Colorful charms clatter proudly, announcing a shamanic entrance.
entries.simplified: 缤纷护符骄傲地叮当作响，宣告着一场萨满式登场。
entries.traditional: 繽紛護符驕傲地叮噹作響，宣告著一場薩滿式登場。

entries.simplified: 警告：请勿呼吸。
entries.traditional: 警告：請勿呼吸。

entries.source: Gold trim shines with solemn duty and faith that refuses to shake.
entries.simplified: 金色饰边闪耀着庄严职责，以及绝不动摇的信念。
entries.traditional: 金色飾邊閃耀著莊嚴職責，以及絕不動搖的信念。

entries.source: A solemn stance guide for shields that answer pressure with controlled force.
entries.simplified: 一本庄重的架盾指南，教盾牌以受控的力量回应压力。
entries.traditional: 一本莊重的架盾指南，教盾牌以受控的力量回應壓力。

entries.source: Heavy doctrine turns every charge into protection for those moving beside you.
entries.simplified: 沉重教义将每一次冲锋化作对并肩前行之人的保护。
entries.traditional: 沉重教義將每一次衝鋒化作對並肩前行之人的保護。

entries.source: Warm barrier hymns gather around healing hands, making mercy harder to break.
entries.simplified: 温暖的屏障圣歌环绕治疗之手，让仁慈更难被击破。
entries.traditional: 溫暖的屏障聖歌環繞治療之手，讓仁慈更難被擊破。

entries.source: A retaliatory creed where blocked blows awaken holy power instead of fear.
entries.simplified: 一则反击信条：被格挡的攻击唤醒的是神圣力量，而非恐惧。
entries.traditional: 一則反擊信條：被格擋的攻擊喚醒的是神聖力量，而非恐懼。

entries.source: Wide guard catches blows before your confidence does something expensive.
entries.simplified: 宽阔护手会在你的自信做出昂贵决定前先接住攻击。
entries.traditional: 寬闊護手會在你的自信做出昂貴決定前先接住攻擊。

entries.source: A tiny celestial companion follows with a gentle glow. Its warmth softens the air nearby as a sign that grace can travel at one’s side.
entries.simplified: 一个微小的天界伙伴散发柔和光芒，紧随身旁。它的暖意软化周围空气，象征恩典也能一路相伴。
entries.traditional: 一個微小的天界夥伴散髮柔和光芒，緊隨身旁。它的暖意軟化周圍空氣，象徵恩典也能一路相伴。

entries.source: A black-and-white cat with a fluffy chest, round eyes, and a regal little stare.
entries.simplified: 一只黑白相间、胸毛蓬松、眼睛圆圆的小猫，带着一副高贵的小眼神。
entries.traditional: 一隻黑白相間、胸毛蓬松、眼睛圓圓的小貓，帶著一副高貴的小眼神。

entries.source: A bright ginger cat with restless paws and sunny mischief.
entries.simplified: 一只明亮姜黄色小猫，脚步躁动，充满阳光般的恶作剧精神。
entries.traditional: 一隻明亮姜黃色小貓，腳步躁動，充滿陽光般的惡作劇精神。

entries.source: A tiny grey cat with short legs, huge confidence, and quick little steps.
entries.simplified: 一只腿短短的灰色小猫，个头虽小却自信满满，步伐轻快。
entries.traditional: 一隻腿短短的灰色小貓，個頭雖小卻自信滿滿，步伐輕快。

entries.source: A brown-and-white shorthair with a round face and patient stare.
entries.simplified: 一只棕白相间的短毛猫，圆圆的脸上带着耐心目光。
entries.traditional: 一隻棕白相間的短毛貓，圓圓的臉上帶著耐心目光。

entries.source: A soft grey-and-white cat with gentle eyes and an easygoing nature.
entries.simplified: 一只柔软的灰白猫，眼神温和，性情悠闲。
entries.traditional: 一隻柔軟的灰白貓，眼神溫和，性情悠閒。

entries.source: An impish companion scampers close with ember-bright mischief and a grin too clever to trust. Wicked charm and proud devotion bind a forbidden reward into loyal company.
entries.simplified: 一只顽皮小恶魔伙伴带着余烬般的恶作剧光芒紧跟身旁，笑容聪明得不值得信任。邪恶魅力与骄傲忠诚将禁忌奖励化作可靠陪伴。
entries.traditional: 一隻頑皮小惡魔夥伴帶著餘燼般的惡作劇光芒緊跟身旁，笑容聰明得不值得信任。邪惡魅力與驕傲忠誠將禁忌獎勵化作可靠陪伴。

entries.source: A golden poodle with bright eyes and a proud little trot.
entries.simplified: 一只金色贵宾犬，眼睛明亮，迈着骄傲的小步伐。
entries.traditional: 一隻金色貴賓犬，眼睛明亮，邁著驕傲的小步伐。

entries.source: A bold black terrier with a pink collar and endless confidence.
entries.simplified: 一只大胆的黑色梗犬，戴着粉色项圈，拥有无穷自信。
entries.traditional: 一隻大膽的黑色梗犬，戴著粉色項圈，擁有無窮自信。

entries.source: A light-coated Labrador with a steady heart and eager paws.
entries.simplified: 一只浅色拉布拉多犬，内心坚定，双爪总是跃跃欲试。
entries.traditional: 一隻淺色拉布拉多犬，內心堅定，雙爪總是躍躍欲試。

entries.source: A black-and-white pomsky with bright eyes and far too much energy.
entries.simplified: 一只黑白相间的 Pomsky，眼睛明亮，精力旺盛得过分。
entries.traditional: 一隻黑白相間的 Pomsky，眼睛明亮，精力旺盛得過分。

entries.source: A black-and-tan shepherd with strong paws and dependable courage.
entries.simplified: 一只黑棕相间的牧羊犬，双爪有力，勇气可靠。
entries.traditional: 一隻黑棕相間的牧羊犬，雙爪有力，勇氣可靠。

entries.source: A brown-and-white husky with winter-bright markings and a voice it enjoys using.
entries.simplified: 一只棕白相间的哈士奇，带着明亮冬日纹路，也十分乐于展示自己的嗓门。
entries.traditional: 一隻棕白相間的哈士奇，帶著明亮冬日紋路，也十分樂於展示自己的嗓門。

entries.source: A friendly black Labrador with steady loyalty and a wagging tail.
entries.simplified: 一只友善的黑色拉布拉多犬，忠诚沉稳，尾巴总在摇摆。
entries.traditional: 一隻友善的黑色拉布拉多犬，忠誠沉穩，尾巴總在搖擺。

entries.source: A blue-speckled cattle dog that keeps pace with work, trouble, and adventure.
entries.simplified: 一只蓝色斑点的牧牛犬，能跟上工作、麻烦与冒险的步伐。
entries.traditional: 一隻藍色斑點的牧牛犬，能跟上工作、麻煩與冒險的步伐。

entries.source: A small green spirit with leafy arms and a rosy blossom crown.
entries.simplified: 一个绿色小灵体，长着叶片般的手臂，头戴玫瑰色花冠。
entries.traditional: 一個綠色小靈體，長著葉片般的手臂，頭戴玫瑰色花冠。

entries.source: A spring hare companion hops along with luck and bright-eyed charm. Hidden prizes seem to follow wherever the road turns green.
entries.simplified: 一只春日野兔伙伴带着好运与明亮双眼一路蹦跳。无论道路在哪里转绿，隐藏奖品似乎都会随之出现。
entries.traditional: 一隻春日野兔夥伴帶著好運與明亮雙眼一路蹦跳。無論道路在哪裡轉綠，隱藏獎品似乎都會隨之出現。

entries.source: A tiny sunrise spirit with golden rays and a warm little glow.
entries.simplified: 一个微小朝阳灵体，带着金色光芒与温暖微光。
entries.traditional: 一個微小朝陽靈體，帶著金色光芒與溫暖微光。

entries.source: A dark-feathered griffin companion with bright eyes and quiet pride.
entries.simplified: 一只深色羽毛、眼神明亮的小 Griffin 伙伴，安静却自豪。
entries.traditional: 一隻深色羽毛、眼神明亮的小 Griffin 夥伴，安靜卻自豪。

entries.source: Blue-and-white plumage gives this little griffin a bold, cheerful look.
entries.simplified: 蓝白羽色让这只小 Griffin 显得大胆而欢快。
entries.traditional: 藍白羽色讓這隻小 Griffin 顯得大膽而歡快。

entries.source: A warm brown griffin companion with golden eyes and a sturdy stance.
entries.simplified: 一只暖棕色 Griffin 伙伴，拥有金色眼睛与稳健站姿。
entries.traditional: 一隻暖棕色 Griffin 夥伴，擁有金色眼睛與穩健站姿。

entries.source: A white eagle-marked griffin with sharp eyes and tiny heroic posture.
entries.simplified: 一只带有白鹰纹路的 Griffin，目光锐利，姿态虽小却十分英雄。
entries.traditional: 一隻帶有白鷹紋路的 Griffin，目光銳利，姿態雖小卻十分英雄。

entries.source: Green and brown feathers give this little griffin pondside charm.
entries.simplified: 绿棕羽毛赋予这只小 Griffin 池塘边般的可爱魅力。
entries.traditional: 綠棕羽毛賦予這隻小 Griffin 池塘邊般的可愛魅力。

entries.source: A strange hare companion blends cheerful softness with unusual magical spark. A lucky festival secret seems to have decided to follow home.
entries.simplified: 一个奇异野兔伙伴将欢快柔软与不寻常的魔法火花结合在一起。某个幸运节庆秘密似乎决定跟着你回家。
entries.traditional: 一個奇異野兔夥伴將歡快柔軟與不尋常的魔法火花結合在一起。某個幸運節慶秘密似乎決定跟著你回家。

entries.source: A blue water spirit with finlike frills and a gentle, rippling glow.
entries.simplified: 一个蓝色水灵，拥有鳍状饰边与温柔荡漾的微光。
entries.traditional: 一個藍色水靈，擁有鰭狀飾邊與溫柔蕩漾的微光。

entries.source: A green wind spirit with leafy crests and playful gusts.
entries.simplified: 一个绿色风灵，长着叶冠，并带来顽皮阵风。
entries.traditional: 一個綠色風靈，長著葉冠，並帶來頑皮陣風。

entries.source: “A trick is only cheap if it fails. These do not fail.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “诡计只有失败时才算卑劣。而这些从不失败。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “詭計只有失敗時才算卑劣。而這些從不失敗。” — Suphara

entries.source: This mask used to be in theater; now it improvises without a wearer.
entries.simplified: 这副面具曾属于剧院；如今即使没有佩戴者，它也会即兴演出。
entries.traditional: 這副面具曾屬於劇院；如今即使沒有佩戴者，它也會即興演出。

entries.source: Straight steel finds gaps quickly, because armor cannot guard everything.
entries.simplified: 笔直钢刃迅速找到缝隙，因为护甲不可能守住一切。
entries.traditional: 筆直鋼刃迅速找到縫隙，因為護甲不可能守住一切。

entries.source: The tricorn smells faintly of plunder, storms, and poor choices.
entries.simplified: 这顶三角帽隐约散发着劫掠、风暴和糟糕决定的气味。
entries.traditional: 這頂三角帽隱約散發著劫掠、風暴和糟糕決定的氣味。

entries.source: Salt, smoke, and swagger cling harder than the original owner.
entries.simplified: 盐霜、烟尘与神气活现的派头，比原主人黏得更牢。
entries.traditional: 鹽霜、煙塵與神氣活現的派頭，比原主人黏得更牢。

entries.source: Heavy boots cross slick decks and kick arguments into shape.
entries.simplified: 沉重靴子踏过湿滑甲板，也把争执踢得服服帖帖。
entries.traditional: 沉重靴子踏過濕滑甲板，也把爭執踢得服服貼貼。

entries.source: Close combat becomes personal when your replacement hand is angry.
entries.simplified: 当你的替代手臂正在生气时，近身战斗便会变得格外私人。
entries.traditional: 當你的替代手臂正在生氣時，近身戰鬥便會變得格外私人。

entries.source: Storms, blades, and tavern decisions all failed to ruin them.
entries.simplified: 风暴、刀刃与酒馆里的决定，都没能毁掉它们。
entries.traditional: 風暴、刀刃與酒館裡的決定，都沒能毀掉它們。

entries.source: A simple sidearm, and with trained hands an answer to many problems.
entries.simplified: 一把朴素的随身枪械；在训练有素的手中，它能回答许多问题。
entries.traditional: 一把樸素的隨身槍械；在訓練有素的手中，它能回答許多問題。

entries.source: This rooted wetland plant fires poisonous shots at creatures that stay out of reach.
entries.simplified: 这株扎根湿地的植物会向停留在攻击范围外的生物发射毒性弹射物。
entries.traditional: 這株扎根濕地的植物會向停留在攻擊範圍外的生物發射毒性彈射物。

entries.source: Red-alloy logic reacts quickly, tracking motion before the user decides to move.
entries.simplified: 红色合金逻辑反应迅速，在使用者决定移动之前便已追踪动作。
entries.traditional: 紅色合金邏輯反應迅速，在使用者決定移動之前便已追蹤動作。

entries.source: Glowing conduits stabilize the shell, harmonizing every system at once.
entries.simplified: 发光导管稳定外壳，使所有系统同时达成协调。
entries.traditional: 發光導管穩定外殼，使所有系統同時達成協調。

entries.source: Unstable mana floods this blue focus blade past safe limits.
entries.simplified: 不稳定的 Mana 将这柄蓝色聚能刃推过安全极限。
entries.traditional: 不穩定的 Mana 將這柄藍色聚能刃推過安全極限。

entries.source: An overloaded plasma edge that tears energy directly from its wielder. Massively amplifies physical damage and critical force, but leaves the body fragile and exposed.
entries.simplified: 一柄过载的等离子刃，会直接从持有者体内撕取能量。它能大幅强化物理伤害与暴击威力，却也使身体变得脆弱而毫无遮蔽。
entries.traditional: 一柄過載的電漿刃，會直接從持有者體內撕取能量。它能大幅強化物理傷害與暴擊威力，卻也使身體變得脆弱而毫無遮蔽。

entries.source: Momentum burns through this conduit, trading vitality for blazing speed.
entries.simplified: 动能在导管中燃烧，以生命力换取炽烈速度。
entries.traditional: 動能在導管中燃燒，以生命力換取熾烈速度。

entries.source: Contained plasma lattice boosts force, spell output, and recycled energy.
entries.simplified: 受控的等离子晶格强化力量、法术输出与能量回收。
entries.traditional: 受控的電漿晶格強化力量、法術輸出與能量回收。

entries.source: Micro-thrusters hum underfoot, urging constant movement through hostile fire ahead.
entries.simplified: 微型推进器在脚下低鸣，催促穿戴者不断穿越前方的敌对火力。
entries.traditional: 微型推進器在腳下低鳴，催促穿戴者不斷穿越前方的敵對火力。

entries.source: Conduits line reinforced plates, turning motion into combat efficiency smoothly.
entries.simplified: 导管铺满强化甲片，将动作顺畅地转化为战斗效率。
entries.traditional: 導管鋪滿強化甲片，將動作順暢地轉化為戰鬥效率。

entries.source: A red and white charm resembling a fruit. Popular among traveling healers.
entries.simplified: 一枚形似果实的红白护符，在旅行治疗者之间颇受欢迎。
entries.traditional: 一枚形似果實的紅白護符，在旅行治療者之間頗受歡迎。

entries.source: Tiny drifting plant matter follows warm air across the meadow.
entries.simplified: 细小的漂浮植物碎屑会乘着暖风穿过草原。
entries.traditional: 細小的漂浮植物碎屑會乘著暖風穿過草原。

entries.source: Brew tools wait inside, because battle sometimes needs emergency mana soup.
entries.simplified: 酿制工具静候其中，因为战斗有时需要一碗紧急 Mana 汤。
entries.traditional: 釀製工具靜候其中，因為戰鬥有時需要一碗緊急 Mana 湯。

entries.source: Glowing brew sloshes quietly, praying that nobody will drink it too fast.
entries.simplified: 发光药液在葫芦中轻轻晃动，祈祷着没人会喝得太快。
entries.traditional: 發光藥液在葫蘆中輕輕晃動，祈禱著沒人會喝得太快。

entries.source: Mint, mana, and alchemical planning share this padded little pouch.
entries.simplified: 薄荷、Mana 与炼金规划，共同挤在这个带软垫的小袋里。
entries.traditional: 薄荷、Mana 與鍊金規劃，共同擠在這個帶軟墊的小袋裡。

entries.source: Pale pages hide rites that turn wrath into shelter against unholy threats.
entries.simplified: 苍白书页隐藏着仪式，能将怒火化作抵挡邪恶威胁的庇护。
entries.traditional: 蒼白書頁隱藏著儀式，能將怒火化作抵擋邪惡威脅的庇護。

entries.source: A blood-warmed vow remembers pain and answers it with sharper judgment.
entries.simplified: 一则被鲜血温暖的誓言铭记痛苦，并以更加凌厉的审判回应。
entries.traditional: 一則被鮮血溫暖的誓言銘記痛苦，並以更加凌厲的審判回應。

entries.source: Sanctified brands burn across the text, marking corruption for holy ruin.
entries.simplified: 圣化烙印灼烧于文字之间，为神圣毁灭标记腐化。
entries.traditional: 聖化烙印灼燒於文字之間，為神聖毀滅標記腐化。

entries.source: Lunar prayers wrap protection in shadow before releasing hidden sacred force.
entries.simplified: 月之祷文先以阴影包裹保护，随后释放潜藏的神圣力量。
entries.traditional: 月之禱文先以陰影包裹保護，隨後釋放潛藏的神聖力量。

entries.source: Merciful doctrine teaches every excess blessing to harden around the soul.
entries.simplified: 仁慈教义教导每一份溢出的祝福在灵魂周围凝成坚壳。
entries.traditional: 仁慈教義教導每一份溢出的祝福在靈魂周圍凝成堅殼。

entries.source: A sealed covenant promises light for those returned from the final edge.
entries.simplified: 一份封印契约，为那些从最终边缘归来的人许诺光明。
entries.traditional: 一份封印契約，為那些從最終邊緣歸來的人許諾光明。

entries.source: Clean white pages brighten whenever corruption is lifted or healing takes hold.
entries.simplified: 每当腐化被祛除，或治疗开始生效时，洁白书页便会亮起。
entries.traditional: 每當腐化被祛除，或治療開始生效時，潔白書頁便會亮起。

entries.source: Consecrated rules teach sacred ground to endure longer under desperate feet.
entries.simplified: 圣化律令教导神圣之地在绝望的脚步下维持得更加长久。
entries.traditional: 聖化律令教導神聖之地在絕望的腳步下維持得更加長久。

entries.source: The pumpkin smiles forever, which becomes less comforting after midnight.
entries.simplified: 南瓜永远挂着笑容，午夜之后便不再那么令人安心。
entries.traditional: 南瓜永遠掛著笑容，午夜之後便不再那麼令人安心。

entries.source: A jaunty feather at the top encourages stylish escapes and questionable confidence.
entries.simplified: 帽顶那根轻快的羽毛，鼓励着潇洒脱身与可疑的自信。
entries.traditional: 帽頂那根輕快的羽毛，鼓勵著瀟灑脫身與可疑的自信。

entries.source: A quiver of enchanted arrows, tipped with vines and briars. Favored by hunters.
entries.simplified: 一只装满附魔箭矢的箭袋，箭头缠绕着藤蔓与荆棘。深受猎人青睐。
entries.traditional: 一只裝滿附魔箭矢的箭袋，箭頭纏繞著藤蔓與荊棘。深受獵人青睞。

entries.source: Fletched arrows wait patiently, which is more than enemies do.
entries.simplified: 箭羽齐整的箭矢耐心等候着，这一点倒比敌人强。
entries.traditional: 箭羽齊整的箭矢耐心等候著，這一點倒比敵人強。

entries.source: Larger rabbits can kick with surprising force when cornered.
entries.simplified: 体型更大的兔子在走投无路时，能踢出惊人的力量。
entries.traditional: 體型更大的兔子在走投無路時，能踢出驚人的力量。

entries.source: Gilded light frames the blade, cutting darkness with quiet precision.
entries.simplified: 镀金光辉勾勒着刀刃，以沉静而精准的锋芒斩开黑暗。
entries.traditional: 鍍金光輝勾勒著刀刃，以沉靜而精準的鋒芒斬開黑暗。

entries.source: “Light can wear any color if a good staff keeps it straight.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “只要有一根好法杖把光引直，它想披上什么颜色都行。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “只要有一根好法杖把光引直，它想披上什麼顏色都行。” — Suphara

entries.source: “Anger is just fire, lad. Point it the right way, and it can melt stone.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “愤怒不过是火焰，小子。把它指向正确的方向，连石头都能熔化。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “憤怒不過是火焰，小子。把它指向正確的方向，連石頭都能熔化。” — Suphara

entries.source: Horned metal promises raids, bruises, and very limited apologies.
entries.simplified: 长角金属许诺着劫掠、淤青，以及少得可怜的歉意。
entries.traditional: 長角金屬許諾著劫掠、瘀青，以及少得可憐的歉意。

entries.source: Once worn by mountain shamans in sacred trials. Said to repel demonic influences.
entries.simplified: 曾由山地萨满在神圣试炼中佩戴。据说能驱退恶魔影响。
entries.traditional: 曾由山地薩滿在神聖試煉中佩戴。據說能驅退惡魔影響。

entries.source: Plump tomatoes fill the basket, ready for combat or lunch.
entries.simplified: 篮子里装满了饱满的番茄，既能用于战斗，也能拿来当午餐。
entries.traditional: 籃子裡裝滿了飽滿的番茄，既能用於戰鬥，也能拿來當午餐。

entries.source: Grey sewer rats carry grime through damp tunnels and can leave a foul bite behind.
entries.simplified: 灰色下水道老鼠会把污秽带遍潮湿隧道，并可能留下恶臭的咬伤。
entries.traditional: 灰色下水道老鼠會把污穢帶遍潮濕隧道，並可能留下惡臭的咬傷。

entries.source: A katar honed to impossibly thin edges. They thrive in relentless motion, pushing the wielder beyond natural limits.
entries.simplified: 一柄刃口薄得不可思议的拳刃。它在永不停歇的攻势中最为凶猛，能将持有者推越自然极限。
entries.traditional: 一柄刃口薄得不可思議的拳刃。它在永不停歇的攻勢中最為凶猛，能將持有者推越自然極限。

entries.source: Razor edges reward relentless technique and swift pressure from every angle.
entries.simplified: 剃刀般的锋刃嘉奖不懈的技巧，以及从每个角度施加的迅猛压力。
entries.traditional: 剃刀般的鋒刃嘉獎不懈的技巧，以及從每個角度施加的迅猛壓力。

entries.source: Heated blades spin along this foundry machine as it rushes across the floor.
entries.simplified: 这台铸造厂机械冲过地面时，灼热刀刃会不断旋转。
entries.traditional: 這台鑄造廠機械衝過地面時，灼熱刀刃會不斷旋轉。

entries.source: Pale edges cut through shadow, hungry for what bodies leave behind.
entries.simplified: 苍白锋刃划破阴影，饥渴地追逐肉身消逝后留下的一切。
entries.traditional: 蒼白鋒刃劃破陰影，飢渴地追逐肉身消逝後留下的一切。

entries.source: “Quick shots need honest wood and a hand that trusts it.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “快射需要老实可靠的木材，也需要一只信得过它的手。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “快射需要老實可靠的木材，也需要一隻信得過它的手。” — Suphara

entries.source: “I gave this axe teeth, not mercy. Once it tastes blood the wound keeps talking.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “我给这把斧头装上了牙齿，而不是仁慈。它一旦尝到鲜血，伤口就会继续说个不停。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “我給這把斧頭裝上了牙齒，而不是仁慈。它一旦嚐到鮮血，傷口就會繼續說個不停。” — Suphara

entries.source: New and improved heavy shell for all your needs. Over 1,250 hours of rigorous testing have brought you the best in offense.
entries.simplified: 全新升级的重型甲壳，满足你的各种需求。历经超过1,250小时的严格测试，为你带来最出色的进攻性能。
entries.traditional: 全新升級的重型甲殼，滿足你的各種需求。歷經超過1,250小時的嚴格測試，為你帶來最出色的進攻性能。

entries.source: Naval authority sits neatly on your head and expects respect.
entries.simplified: 海军的威严端正地坐在你头上，并理所当然地等着别人表示尊重。
entries.traditional: 海軍的威嚴端正地坐在你頭上，並理所當然地等著別人表示尊重。

entries.source: Wooden antlers announce helpers, pranksters, or dangerously festive intentions.
entries.simplified: 木制鹿角宣告着帮手、恶作剧者，或危险得过分喜庆的企图。
entries.traditional: 木製鹿角宣告著幫手、惡作劇者，或危險得過分喜慶的企圖。

entries.source: Small antlers and warm trim carry winter cheer without asking.
entries.simplified: 小巧鹿角与温暖饰边带来冬日欢欣，从不先征求同意。
entries.traditional: 小巧鹿角與溫暖飾邊帶來冬日歡欣，從不先徵求同意。

entries.source: Winter cheer warms the festive coat through cold nights and combat.
entries.simplified: 冬日欢欣温暖着节庆外套，使其无论寒夜还是战斗都保持暖意。
entries.traditional: 冬日歡欣溫暖著節慶外套，使其無論寒夜還是戰鬥都保持暖意。

entries.source: Holiday shoes grip frosted paths while pretending snow is optional.
entries.simplified: 节日鞋稳稳抓住结霜小径，同时假装积雪并不是必需品。
entries.traditional: 節日鞋穩穩抓住結霜小徑，同時假裝積雪並不是必需品。

entries.source: Warm hands stay nimble while festive chaos considers its options.
entries.simplified: 温暖双手保持灵巧，让节庆混乱慢慢考虑下一步。
entries.traditional: 溫暖雙手保持靈巧，讓節慶混亂慢慢考慮下一步。

entries.source: Fur-lined leggings make snowy marches feel guided by seasonal cheer.
entries.simplified: 毛皮衬里的绑腿让雪地行军仿佛受到节庆欢欣的指引。
entries.traditional: 毛皮襯裡的綁腿讓雪地行軍彷彿受到節慶歡欣的指引。

entries.source: Sea-worn and gilded, its three prongs strike in deadly sequence.
entries.simplified: 饱经海风侵蚀并饰以黄金，三叉戟的三支尖锋会接连发动致命攻击。
entries.traditional: 飽經海風侵蝕並飾以黃金，三叉戟的三支尖鋒會接連發動致命攻擊。

entries.source: A compact, crank-fed crossbow that fires in quick succession. Bolts may lack punch, but its relentless rate of fire overwhelms foes.
entries.simplified: 一把小巧的曲柄供箭弩，能够快速连续射击。弩矢的威力或许不强，却能以毫不停歇的射速压倒敌人。
entries.traditional: 一把小巧的曲柄供箭弩，能夠快速連續射擊。弩箭的威力或許不強，卻能以毫不停歇的射速壓倒敵人。

entries.source: Magical rhythm rises louder, and distractions politely lose the argument.
entries.simplified: 魔法节奏愈发响亮，杂念则礼貌地输掉了争论。
entries.traditional: 魔法節奏愈發響亮，雜念則有禮地輸掉了爭論。

entries.source: Long-barreled balance delivers dependable stopping power from a safer distance.
entries.simplified: 长枪管的平衡设计能从更安全的距离提供可靠的制敌威力。
entries.traditional: 長槍管的平衡設計能從更安全的距離提供可靠的制敵威力。

entries.source: Planar echoes shiver through the greatblade, opening wounds in reality itself.
entries.simplified: 位面回声在巨刃中震颤，于现实本身撕开伤口。
entries.traditional: 位面回聲在巨刃中震顫，於現實本身撕開傷口。

entries.source: Simple shape, honest channel, and enough magic to stay interesting.
entries.simplified: 造型简单，传导实在，魔力也足够让它保持几分趣味。
entries.traditional: 造型簡單，傳導實在，魔力也足夠讓它保有幾分趣味。

entries.source: A quiet rogue manual where every spinning blade teaches silence first.
entries.simplified: 一本安静的盗贼手册，其中每一柄旋转刀刃都先教你保持无声。
entries.traditional: 一本安靜的盜賊手冊，其中每一柄旋轉刀刃都先教你保持無聲。

entries.source: Ink-black routes trail across the pages, vanishing exactly where pursuit begins.
entries.simplified: 墨黑路线在书页上蜿蜒，却恰好在追踪开始之处消失。
entries.traditional: 墨黑路線在書頁上蜿蜒，卻恰好在追蹤開始之處消失。

entries.source: Poisoned diagrams blossom outward, teaching venom to spread after every opening.
entries.simplified: 染毒图示向外绽放，教导毒素在每一次破绽出现后继续蔓延。
entries.traditional: 染毒圖示向外綻放，教導毒素在每一次破綻出現後繼續蔓延。

entries.source: Dark footwork lessons multiply each step until distance becomes unreliable.
entries.simplified: 黑暗步法让每一步不断倍增，直到距离本身也变得不再可靠。
entries.traditional: 黑暗步法讓每一步不斷倍增，直到距離本身也變得不再可靠。

entries.source: Concealed margins reward unseen killers with ruthless openings after every vanish.
entries.simplified: 隐藏的页边批注奖赏无形杀手，让每次消失之后都显露出无情破绽。
entries.traditional: 隱藏的頁邊批註獎賞無形殺手，讓每次消失之後都顯露出無情破綻。

entries.source: A set of sophisticated glasses that are sure to make you look smart.
entries.simplified: 一副精致考究的眼镜，保证让你看起来聪明许多。
entries.traditional: 一副精緻考究的眼鏡，保證讓你看起來聰明許多。

entries.source: Planks and bolts hold together with practical, circular determination.
entries.simplified: 木板与螺栓以务实而圆满的决心牢牢结合。
entries.traditional: 木板與螺栓以務實而圓滿的決心牢牢結合。

entries.source: “A crown is just metal unless it’s reinforced by noble steel.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “王冠若没有高贵钢铁加固，也不过是一块金属。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “王冠若沒有高貴鋼鐵加固，也不過是一塊金屬。” — Suphara

entries.source: Gemmed elegance hides a pointy reminder about courtly arguments.
entries.simplified: 宝石装点的优雅之下，藏着一则关于宫廷争执的尖锐提醒。
entries.traditional: 寶石裝點的優雅之下，藏著一則關於宮廷爭執的尖銳提醒。

entries.source: An elegant spear once used by the royal guards of a lost kingdom. Their monarchy might've fallen but their design remains.
entries.simplified: 一柄曾由失落王国皇家卫兵使用的优雅长矛。王朝或许早已覆灭，其设计却依然留存。
entries.traditional: 一柄曾由失落王國皇家衛兵使用的優雅長矛。王朝或許早已覆滅，其設計卻依然留存。

entries.source: Violet flame watches through whitesteel, making eye contact everyone's problem.
entries.simplified: 紫罗兰火焰透过 whitesteel 注视着外界，让所有与它对视的人都陷入麻烦。
entries.traditional: 紫羅蘭火焰透過 whitesteel 注視著外界，讓所有與它對視的人都陷入麻煩。

entries.source: Ancient runes answer from the cloth, calling hidden power into every spell.
entries.simplified: 古老符文从布料中回应召唤，将隐藏力量引入每一道法术。
entries.traditional: 古老符文從布料中回應召喚，將隱藏力量引入每一道法術。

entries.source: “Runes are faster to break once your hammer learns their grammar.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “当你的锤子学会符文的语法，砸碎它们自然就更快了。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “當你的鎚子學會符文的文法，砸碎它們自然就更快了。” — Suphara

entries.source: Old lenses still scout well, provided squinting counts as technology.
entries.simplified: 老旧镜片依然很适合侦察——前提是眯眼也算一种技术。
entries.traditional: 老舊鏡片依然很適合偵察——前提是瞇眼也算一種技術。

entries.source: Reinforced glass protects the head, secrets, and questionable workplace decisions.
entries.simplified: 强化玻璃保护着脑袋、秘密，以及那些值得怀疑的职场决定。
entries.traditional: 強化玻璃保護著腦袋、祕密，以及那些值得懷疑的職場決定。

entries.source: Pressure-rated plating guards the body when endurance matters most nearby.
entries.simplified: 耐压甲片在附近最需要耐力时守护身体。
entries.traditional: 耐壓甲片在附近最需要耐力時守護身體。

entries.source: Shock-absorbing boots keep feet quiet during very noisy mistakes.
entries.simplified: 减震靴让双脚在极其吵闹的失误中依然保持安静。
entries.traditional: 減震靴讓雙腳在極其吵鬧的失誤中依然保持安靜。

entries.source: Force-dispersing padding protects hands and spell focus together under pressure.
entries.simplified: 分散冲击力的衬垫在压力下同时保护双手与施法专注。
entries.traditional: 分散衝擊力的襯墊在壓力下同時保護雙手與施法專注。

entries.source: Weighted greaves hold footing steady against crushing impacts from below.
entries.simplified: 加重胫甲稳住脚步，抵挡来自下方的碾压冲击。
entries.traditional: 加重脛甲穩住腳步，抵擋來自下方的碾壓衝擊。

entries.source: Crisp blue cloth suggests nautical competence, even on dry land.
entries.simplified: 挺括的蓝色布料让人看起来精通航海，即使脚下完全没有海。
entries.traditional: 挺括的藍色布料讓人看起來精通航海，即使腳下完全沒有海。

entries.source: A blessed cuirass lined with runes of light. Worn by those who stand as living bastions.
entries.simplified: 一件内衬光之符文的祝圣胸甲。由那些如同活体堡垒般坚守的人穿戴。
entries.traditional: 一件內襯光之符文的祝聖胸甲。由那些如同活體堡壘般堅守的人穿戴。

entries.source: Boots that glow faintly with each step, carrying the aura of restoration.
entries.simplified: 每踏出一步都会泛起微光的靴子，携带着复苏的气息。
entries.traditional: 每踏出一步都會泛起微光的靴子，攜帶著復甦的氣息。

entries.source: Gleaming greaves inscribed with prayers, strengthening every step forward.
entries.simplified: 光亮的胫甲刻满祷文，让每一步前行都更加有力。
entries.traditional: 閃亮的脛甲刻滿禱文，讓每一步前行都更加有力。

entries.source: Holy thread warms pure white gloves for careful healing hands.
entries.simplified: 圣线温暖着纯白手套，守护谨慎施治的双手。
entries.traditional: 聖線溫暖著純白手套，守護謹慎施治的雙手。

entries.source: Engraved light strengthens sacred ground around those who hold firm.
entries.simplified: 镌刻的圣光强化坚守者周围的神圣之地。
entries.traditional: 鐫刻的聖光強化堅守者周圍的神聖之地。

entries.source: Holiday cheer stitched into warm cloth keeps spirits high during battle.
entries.simplified: 节庆欢欣缝入温暖布料，让战斗中的士气始终高昂。
entries.traditional: 節慶歡欣縫入溫暖布料，讓戰鬥中的士氣始終高昂。

entries.source: Festive footwear keeps steps quick, even after too many treats.
entries.simplified: 节庆鞋履让脚步依旧轻快，即使甜点吃得太多。
entries.traditional: 節慶鞋履讓腳步依舊輕快，即使甜點吃得太多。

entries.source: Soft gloves invite miracles, mischief, and suspiciously convenient luck.
entries.simplified: 柔软手套招来奇迹、恶作剧，以及方便得令人起疑的好运。
entries.traditional: 柔軟手套招來奇蹟、惡作劇，以及方便得令人起疑的好運。

entries.source: Holiday warmth carries good fortune and stubborn seasonal resilience.
entries.simplified: 节庆暖意带来好运，以及顽强不屈的应季韧性。
entries.traditional: 節慶暖意帶來好運，以及頑強不屈的應季韌性。

entries.source: Comfortable winter cloth carries long nights into unexpected adventures.
entries.simplified: 舒适冬布陪伴漫漫长夜走入意想不到的冒险。
entries.traditional: 舒適冬布陪伴漫漫長夜走入意想不到的冒險。

entries.source: Cool royal presence gathers around the sapphire, calm and commanding.
entries.simplified: 蓝宝石周围汇聚着冷冽的王者气息，沉静而威严。
entries.traditional: 藍寶石周圍匯聚著冷冽的王者氣息，沉靜而威嚴。

entries.source: Blue-brushed steel keeps veteran calm beneath quiet war markings inside.
entries.simplified: 蓝色拉丝钢下藏着沉静的战纹，让老兵始终保持镇定。
entries.traditional: 藍色拉絲鋼下藏著沉靜的戰紋，讓老兵始終保持鎮定。

entries.source: Alchemical firestones warm the pouch, and possibly burn your back.
entries.simplified: 炼金火石把袋子烘得暖洋洋，也可能把你的背烧着。
entries.traditional: 鍊金火石把袋子烘得暖洋洋，也可能把你的背燒著。

entries.source: “A small cut can do long work when the edge knows its medicine.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “小小一刀也能成就长久功效，前提是刀锋懂得医术。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “小小一刀也能成就長久功效，前提是刀鋒懂得醫術。” — Suphara

entries.source: Thick lenses once favored by librarians of the Grand Archive.
entries.simplified: 厚重镜片曾深受 Grand Archive 的图书管理员喜爱。
entries.traditional: 厚重鏡片曾深受 Grand Archive 的圖書館員喜愛。

entries.source: Young desert scorpions hide beneath warm sand and strike with heated stingers when disturbed.
entries.simplified: 年幼的沙漠蝎藏在温热沙土下方，受到惊扰时便会以灼热尾刺攻击。
entries.traditional: 年幼的沙漠蠍藏在溫熱沙土下方，受到驚擾時便會以灼熱尾刺攻擊。

entries.source: Mechanical notes teach one shot to leave trouble waiting for the next.
entries.simplified: 机械笔记教你用一发射击让麻烦乖乖等候下一发。
entries.traditional: 機械筆記教你用一發射擊讓麻煩乖乖等候下一發。

entries.source: Marked terrain sketches teach traps to pull prey into worse decisions.
entries.simplified: 标记清晰的地形草图教陷阱把猎物拖入更糟的选择。
entries.traditional: 標記清晰的地形草圖教陷阱把獵物拖入更糟的選擇。

entries.source: Loose, agile pages reward every dodge with rhythm, speed, and renewed motion.
entries.simplified: 松散灵活的书页让每次闪避都化作节奏、速度与重新涌起的动势。
entries.traditional: 鬆散靈活的書頁讓每次閃避都化作節奏、速度與重新湧起的動勢。

entries.source: Tactical notes make each forceful shot stagger enemies before they recover.
entries.simplified: 战术笔记让每一发强力射击都在敌人恢复前令其踉跄。
entries.traditional: 戰術筆記讓每一發強力射擊都在敵人恢復前令其踉蹌。

entries.source: Sharp diagrams widen the hunter's mark until distance feels less protective.
entries.simplified: 锐利图示扩展猎人的标记，直到距离也不再让人觉得安全。
entries.traditional: 銳利圖示擴展獵人的標記，直到距離也不再讓人覺得安全。

entries.source: Cobble-built segments bite twice, catching armor off-guard.
entries.simplified: 拼凑而成的节段会咬上两次，打得护甲措手不及。
entries.traditional: 拼湊而成的節段會咬上兩次，打得護甲措手不及。

entries.source: Old scrolls stay sealed, safe, and less likely to complain.
entries.simplified: 古老卷轴被妥善封存，既安全，也不太会抱怨。
entries.traditional: 古老卷軸被妥善封存，既安全，也不太會抱怨。

entries.source: One divine word waits inside the charm's tight binding.
entries.simplified: 一个神圣词语静候在护符紧密的束缚中。
entries.traditional: 一個神聖詞語靜候在護符緊密的束縛中。

entries.source: A hooked blade that drinks from each cut and keeps swinging for more.
entries.simplified: 钩刃从每道伤口中啜饮，并继续挥舞，渴求更多。
entries.traditional: 鉤刃從每道傷口中啜飲，並繼續揮舞，渴求更多。

entries.source: Golden sprouts smell like soil, growth, and healing.
entries.simplified: 金色嫩芽散发着泥土、生长与治愈的气息。
entries.traditional: 金色嫩芽散發著泥土、生長與治癒的氣息。

entries.source: Golden coils bite their tail, making eternity look fashionable.
entries.simplified: 金色蛇身咬住自己的尾巴，让永恒也显得时髦。
entries.traditional: 金色蛇身咬住自己的尾巴，讓永恆也顯得時髦。

entries.source: Shadow clings to its broad body and makes its outline difficult to read in dark places.
entries.simplified: 暗影附着在它宽阔的身体上，使轮廓在黑暗中难以辨认。
entries.traditional: 暗影附著在它寬闊的身體上，使輪廓在黑暗中難以辨認。

entries.source: Silent shoes turn every step into a blade-dance just before the shadows notice.
entries.simplified: 无声鞋履在暗影察觉前，将每一步化作刀锋之舞。
entries.traditional: 無聲鞋履在暗影察覺前，將每一步化作刀鋒之舞。

entries.source: “Not every shadow means harm. Some are only keeping watch.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “并非每一道阴影都意味着伤害。有些只是在守望。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “並非每一道陰影都意味著傷害。有些只是在守望。” — Suphara

entries.source: Sleek shades help rogues, gamblers, and suspicious strangers look busy.
entries.simplified: 利落的墨镜让 Rogues、赌徒和可疑陌生人看起来都很忙。
entries.traditional: 俐落的墨鏡讓 Rogues、賭徒和可疑陌生人看起來都很忙。

entries.source: Ravenous teeth frame the hood, discouraging hugs.
entries.simplified: 饥渴的利齿环绕兜帽，让人打消拥抱的念头。
entries.traditional: 飢渴的利齒環繞兜帽，讓人打消擁抱的念頭。

entries.source: Angular plates glare outward, because subtle intimidation was unavailable.
entries.simplified: 棱角分明的甲片怒视外界，因为没有更含蓄的威慑方式。
entries.traditional: 稜角分明的甲片怒視外界，因為沒有更含蓄的威懾方式。

entries.source: Ripples often reveal this shelled creature before its body appears.
entries.simplified: 水面涟漪往往会在这只带壳生物现身前暴露它的位置。
entries.traditional: 水面漣漪往往會在這隻帶殼生物現身前暴露它的位置。

entries.source: A black-bound page teaches shadows to finish weakened targets without ceremony.
entries.simplified: 黑封书页教暗影毫不拖泥带水地终结虚弱目标。
entries.traditional: 黑封書頁教暗影毫不拖泥帶水地終結虛弱目標。

entries.source: Three elemental seals leave one shadowed mark, binding fate to the target.
entries.simplified: 三枚元素封印留下一道暗影标记，将命运系于目标。
entries.traditional: 三枚元素封印留下一道暗影標記，將命運繫於目標。

entries.source: Precise strokes reward every vanish and blink with sharper killing discipline.
entries.simplified: 精准笔划让每次消失与闪现都换来更凌厉的杀戮技法。
entries.traditional: 精準筆劃讓每次消失與閃現都換來更凌厲的殺戮技法。

entries.source: Ghostly pages release perfect timing just as concealment slips away.
entries.simplified: 幽灵般的书页在隐匿即将消退之际释放完美时机。
entries.traditional: 幽靈般的書頁在隱匿即將消退之際釋放完美時機。

entries.simplified: 近距离轰击能迅速结束争论。
entries.traditional: 近距離轟擊能迅速結束爭論。

entries.source: Multi-edged steel spins silently, turning precision into sudden battlefield devastation.
entries.simplified: 多刃钢铁无声旋转，将精准化作战场上突如其来的毁灭。
entries.traditional: 多刃鋼鐵無聲旋轉，將精準化作戰場上突如其來的毀滅。

entries.source: “Listen close, lad. The night keeps the rhythm, and the shot lands before the echo finishes.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “仔细听，小子。黑夜掌握着节奏，回声尚未落尽，子弹便已命中。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “仔細聽，小子。黑夜掌握著節奏，回聲尚未落盡，子彈便已命中。” — Suphara

entries.source: A grim little badge that laughs at death with unnecessary confidence.
entries.simplified: 一枚阴森小徽章，以多余得过分的自信嘲笑死亡。
entries.traditional: 一枚陰森小徽章，以多餘得過分的自信嘲笑死亡。

entries.source: Horned skulls radiate dread before courage can gather.
entries.simplified: 长角骷髅在勇气尚未凝聚前便散发恐惧。
entries.traditional: 長角骷髏在勇氣尚未凝聚前便散發恐懼。

entries.source: This tiny skull charm suggests optimism was not invited today.
entries.simplified: 这枚小骷髅护符暗示，今天没有邀请乐观。
entries.traditional: 這枚小骷髏護符暗示，今天沒有邀請樂觀。

entries.source: The glowing skull hums softly, enjoying its malevolent purpose.
entries.simplified: 发光骷髅轻声低鸣，享受着自己恶毒的使命。
entries.traditional: 發光骷髏輕聲低鳴，享受著自己惡毒的使命。

entries.source: Tinted goggles promise exploration, speed, and terrible plans.
entries.simplified: 有色护目镜许诺探索、速度，以及糟透了的计划。
entries.traditional: 有色護目鏡承諾探索、速度，以及糟透了的計畫。

entries.source: One tap, the sound of thunder. Two taps, the might of the winds. Three taps, a storm. – Suphara
entries.simplified: “敲一下，是雷鸣之声。敲两下，是狂风之力。敲三下，便是风暴。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “敲一下，是雷鳴之聲。敲兩下，是狂風之力。敲三下，便是風暴。” — Suphara

entries.source: Silver curves hum with wind-blessed grace and divine lift overhead.
entries.simplified: 银色弧线低鸣，流露出受风祝福的优雅，并带来神圣的升力。
entries.traditional: 銀色弧線低鳴，流露出受風祝福的優雅，並帶來神聖的升力。

entries.source: This slime creeps across wet ground and leaves a faint poisonous sheen behind.
entries.simplified: 这团黏液在湿地上缓慢爬行，身后留下一层淡淡的毒性光泽。
entries.traditional: 這團黏液在濕地上緩慢爬行，身後留下一層淡淡的毒性光澤。

entries.source: Tiny frame, but surprisingly serious pebble-based consequences.
entries.simplified: 小小框架，却能带来出乎意料地严重的石子后果。
entries.traditional: 小小框架，卻能帶來出乎意料地嚴重的石子後果。

entries.source: This cave serpent coils between loose stones and strikes with venomous fangs.
entries.simplified: 这条洞穴毒蛇盘绕在松散石块之间，并以带毒獠牙发动攻击。
entries.traditional: 這條洞穴毒蛇盤繞在鬆散石塊之間，並以帶毒獠牙發動攻擊。

entries.source: “I slowed the shot on purpose, lad. One patient round should end what three hurried ones only annoy.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “我故意让子弹慢下来，小子。耐心的一发，应该能解决仓促三发只会惹恼的东西。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “我故意讓子彈慢下來，小子。耐心的一發，應該能解決倉促三發只會惹惱的東西。” — Suphara

entries.source: Fluffy puffs warm ears that attract judgmental snow spirits.
entries.simplified: 毛茸茸的绒球温暖着双耳，而这双耳总会招来爱评头论足的雪灵。
entries.traditional: 毛茸茸的絨球溫暖著雙耳，而這雙耳總會招來愛評頭論足的雪靈。

entries.source: It never melts, never talks, and absolutely judges your outfit.
entries.simplified: 它永不融化、从不开口，而且绝对会评判你的穿搭。
entries.traditional: 它永不融化、從不開口，而且絕對會評判你的穿著。

entries.source: A radiant emblem resembling the sun. Warm to the touch and brimming with divine energy.
entries.simplified: 一枚形似太阳的辉耀徽记。触感温暖，充盈着神圣能量。
entries.traditional: 一枚形似太陽的輝耀徽記。觸感溫暖，充盈著神聖能量。

entries.source: Gold-tipped sunlight makes each thrust feel approved by dawn.
entries.simplified: 镀金尖端的阳光让每一次突刺都像获得了黎明的认可。
entries.traditional: 鍍金尖端的陽光讓每一次突刺都像獲得了黎明的認可。

entries.source: A radiant sword that gleams like fractured glass. It hungers for swift strikes and punishes those who guard against them.
entries.simplified: 一柄如碎裂玻璃般闪耀的辉光长剑。它渴望迅捷攻击，并惩罚那些试图防住其攻势的人。
entries.traditional: 一柄如碎裂玻璃般閃耀的輝光長劍。它渴望迅捷攻擊，並懲罰那些試圖防住其攻勢的人。

entries.source: Ridiculously quick footwear for adventurers who believe standing still is a personal failure.
entries.simplified: 快得离谱的鞋履，专为那些把原地不动视为个人失败的冒险者而制。
entries.traditional: 快得離譜的鞋履，專為那些把原地不動視為個人失敗的冒險者而製。

entries.source: “Fallen bodies are not finished if the blade knows the right curse.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “倒下的躯体并未结束，只要刀刃懂得正确的诅咒。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “倒下的軀體並未結束，只要刀刃懂得正確的詛咒。” — Suphara

entries.source: Bone clasps and hidden sigils tether life to another vessel.
entries.simplified: 骨质搭扣与隐藏符印将生命拴系于另一具容器。
entries.traditional: 骨質搭扣與隱藏符印將生命拴繫於另一具容器。

entries.source: Ashy footprints follow softly, which is normal enough for spirits.
entries.simplified: 灰烬般的脚印轻轻尾随；对灵体而言，这已经够正常了。
entries.traditional: 灰燼般的腳印輕輕尾隨；對靈體而言，這已經夠正常了。

entries.source: Faint chains bind each stride to a servant's borrowed strength.
entries.simplified: 淡淡锁链将每一步与仆从借来的力量相连。
entries.traditional: 淡淡鎖鏈將每一步與僕從借來的力量相連。

entries.source: Green venom beads along its fangs before it darts from cover.
entries.simplified: 绿色毒液在獠牙上凝成液珠，随后它便会从掩体中猛冲而出。
entries.traditional: 綠色毒液在獠牙上凝成液珠，隨後它便會從掩體中猛衝而出。

entries.source: Small spider machines crawl through cables and scrap while staying close to the ground.
entries.simplified: 小型蜘蛛机械贴近地面，爬过电缆与废料。
entries.traditional: 小型蜘蛛機械貼近地面，爬過電纜與廢料。

entries.source: “Crude work can still be true work, lad. Especially when it has spikes.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “粗糙的活计也能是真本事，小子。尤其是上面带刺的时候。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “粗糙的活計也能是真本事，小子。尤其是上面帶刺的時候。” — Suphara

entries.source: Jagged limbs orbit nearby, humming like a tiny angry chandelier.
entries.simplified: 锯齿般的肢体环绕身旁，低鸣得像一盏微型暴躁吊灯。
entries.traditional: 鋸齒般的肢體環繞身旁，低鳴得像一盞微型暴躁吊燈。

entries.source: Gladiators love helmets that introduce themselves before the wearer does.
entries.simplified: 角斗士钟爱那些能在主人之前先自我介绍的头盔。
entries.traditional: 角鬥士鍾愛那些能在主人之前先自我介紹的頭盔。

entries.source: That jagged grin scares enemies and small children.
entries.simplified: 那副锯齿般的笑容能吓坏敌人，也能吓坏小孩。
entries.traditional: 那副鋸齒般的笑容能嚇壞敵人，也能嚇壞小孩。

entries.source: Spikes crowd the relic's face, turning protection into warning signs.
entries.simplified: 尖刺挤满遗物表面，把防护变成了一整片警告标志。
entries.traditional: 尖刺擠滿遺物表面，把防護變成了一整片警告標誌。

entries.source: Jagged teeth along the sword promise fear before the first cut.
entries.simplified: 剑身排列的锯齿在第一刀落下前便许诺恐惧。
entries.traditional: 劍身排列的鋸齒在第一刀落下前便許諾恐懼。

entries.source: Crystal-bound wings circle close, watching for danger before it lands.
entries.simplified: 水晶束缚的羽翼环绕身旁，在危险落下前先行守望。
entries.traditional: 水晶束縛的羽翼環繞身旁，在危險落下前先行守望。

entries.source: A balanced ward where quiet spirits gather to steady body, mind, and courage.
entries.simplified: 一道均衡的守护结界，沉静的灵体汇聚其中，稳固身体、心神与勇气。
entries.traditional: 一道均衡的守護結界，沉靜的靈體匯聚其中，穩固身體、心神與勇氣。

entries.source: A crooked cap adorned with cursed trinkets. Rumored to enhance volatile magics.
entries.simplified: 一顶歪斜的帽子，缀满受诅咒的小饰物。据说能强化狂烈而不稳定的魔法。
entries.traditional: 一頂歪斜的帽子，綴滿受詛咒的小飾物。據說能強化狂烈而不穩定的魔法。

entries.source: Dry winds carry spores from its round body across the desert path.
entries.simplified: 干燥风流会把它圆形身体上的孢子吹过沙漠小径。
entries.traditional: 乾燥風流會把它圓形身體上的孢子吹過沙漠小徑。

entries.source: Carved from ram ivory and adorned with blossoms, they symbolize renewal and resilience.
entries.simplified: 由公羊角雕成，并以花朵装饰，象征新生与坚韧。
entries.traditional: 由公羊角雕成，並以花朵裝飾，象徵新生與堅韌。

entries.source: Its young trunk is sturdier than it looks, allowing it to knock back creatures that get too close.
entries.simplified: 它年幼的树干比外表更加坚固，足以击退靠得太近的生物。
entries.traditional: 它年幼的樹幹比外表更加堅固，足以擊退靠得太近的生物。

entries.source: Young squid drift through the depths in short, uncertain bursts.
entries.simplified: 幼年鱿鱼以短促而迟疑的爆发动作漂过深海。
entries.traditional: 幼年魷魚以短促而遲疑的爆發動作漂過深海。

entries.source: Spectral wings crown the staff, letting elements answer faster than thought.
entries.simplified: 幽灵羽翼为法杖加冕，让元素快过思绪作出回应。
entries.traditional: 幽靈羽翼為法杖加冕，讓元素快過思緒作出回應。

entries.source: An ornate stall frames each trade with lantern charm and polished market grace. A simple shop space becomes a memorable corner of festival commerce.
entries.simplified: 一座华丽摊位以灯笼魅力与精致市集风格装点每一笔交易。朴素商铺空间由此化作节庆商业中令人难忘的一角。
entries.traditional: 一座華麗攤位以燈籠魅力與精致市集風格裝點每一筆交易。樸素商鋪空間由此化作節慶商業中令人難忘的一角。

entries.source: An honored stall turns a market space into a visible mark of SpiritValer support. Each trade feels tied to a festive pledge and shared legacy.
entries.simplified: 一座荣誉摊位将市集空间化作支持 SpiritValer 的醒目标记。每一笔交易都像与节庆誓言和共同传承相连。
entries.traditional: 一座榮譽攤位將市集空間化作支持 SpiritValer 的醒目標記。每一筆交易都像與節慶誓言和共同傳承相連。

entries.source: The gold catches the light beautifully, and then catches your target.
entries.simplified: 黄金先漂亮地捕住光线，接着再捕住你的目标。
entries.traditional: 黃金先漂亮地捕住光線，接著再捕住你的目標。

entries.source: Starlight gathers through the buckle for magicians who study skyward.
entries.simplified: 星光通过搭扣汇聚，为仰望星空钻研魔法的魔法师所用。
entries.traditional: 星光透過搭扣匯聚，為仰望星空鑽研魔法的魔法師所用。

entries.source: Star lenses reflect dreams, light, and probably your poor decisions.
entries.simplified: 星形镜片映照梦想、光芒，还有你那些糟糕的决定。
entries.traditional: 星形鏡片映照夢想、光芒，還有你那些糟糕的決定。

entries.source: Needle-thin steel slips past defenses and finds painful truths.
entries.simplified: 针尖般纤细的钢刃滑过防御，直抵令人疼痛的真相。
entries.traditional: 針尖般纖細的鋼刃滑過防禦，直抵令人疼痛的真相。

entries.source: Iron-heavy boots root each step in stone, refusing to yield to impact.
entries.simplified: 沉重如铁的靴子将每一步钉在岩石上，拒绝向冲击屈服。
entries.traditional: 沉重如鐵的靴子將每一步釘在岩石上，拒絕向衝擊屈服。

entries.source: Forged in the caverns beneath ancient forests, this weighty chestpiece is said to borrow its endurance from the roots of the world itself. A favorite among front-liners who refuse to budge.
entries.simplified: 这件沉重胸甲锻造于古老森林下方的洞窟，据说从世界根系中借来了耐力。深受那些拒绝后退的前线战士喜爱。
entries.traditional: 這件沉重胸甲鍛造於古老森林下方的洞窟，據說從世界根系中借來了耐力。深受那些拒絕後退的前線戰士喜愛。

entries.source: Stick and stones may break my bones, but together now we can stab things.
entries.simplified: 棍棒和石头也许会打断我的骨头，但把它们合在一起，现在我们就能拿来捅东西。
entries.traditional: 棍棒和石頭也許會打斷我的骨頭，但把它們合在一起，現在我們就能拿來捅東西。

entries.source: “One bolt is a harsh word. A storm of them is an argument no shield enjoys.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “一支弩矢是一句重话。一场弩矢风暴，则是一场没有盾牌愿意听的争论。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “一支弩箭是一句重話。一場弩箭風暴，則是一場沒有盾牌願意聽的爭論。” — Suphara

entries.source: “Lightning loves a path. These blades give it several.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “雷电喜欢路径。这些刀刃一次给它好几条。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “雷電喜歡路徑。這些刀刃一次給它好幾條。” — Suphara

entries.source: A spiraling charm bound in metal and jade, crackling faintly with static. Said to channel the whispers of tempests.
entries.simplified: 一枚由金属与玉石束缚的螺旋护符，隐约噼啪作响。据说能引导暴风的低语。
entries.traditional: 一枚由金屬與玉石束縛的螺旋護符，隱約劈啪作響。據說能引導暴風的低語。

entries.source: “Feathers fall soft, lad. Storm feathers do not.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “羽毛落下时很轻，小子。风暴之羽可不是。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “羽毛落下時很輕，小子。風暴之羽可不是。” — Suphara

entries.source: Ten Spears go to battle and nine shatter. Did that war forge the one that remained? No, all the war did was identify the spear that would not break.
entries.simplified: 十柄长矛奔赴战场，九柄折断。是那场战争锻造了最后一柄吗？不，战争所做的一切，只是认出了那柄不会折断的长矛。
entries.traditional: 十柄長矛奔赴戰場，九柄折斷。是那場戰爭鍛造了最後一柄嗎？不，戰爭所做的一切，只是認出了那柄不會折斷的長矛。

entries.source: Insulated alloys store mana while softening the bite of hostile magic.
entries.simplified: 绝缘合金储存 Mana，同时削弱敌对魔法的侵袭。
entries.traditional: 絕緣合金儲存 Mana，同時削弱敵對魔法的侵襲。

entries.source: Shock-resistant boots channel mana through soles built to stand firm.
entries.simplified: 抗震靴通过稳固鞋底引导 Mana，让穿戴者站稳阵脚。
entries.traditional: 抗震靴透過穩固鞋底引導 Mana，讓穿戴者站穩陣腳。

entries.source: Storm-tempered greaves bolster mana flow and diffuse harsh impacts below.
entries.simplified: 经风暴淬炼的胫甲强化 Mana 流动，并分散来自下方的猛烈冲击。
entries.traditional: 經風暴淬鍊的脛甲強化 Mana 流動，並分散來自下方的猛烈衝擊。

entries.source: Sturdy straw protects farmers, pirates, and anyone avoiding sunburn outside.
entries.simplified: 结实的草帽保护农民、海盗，以及任何在户外躲避晒伤的人。
entries.traditional: 結實的草帽保護農夫、海盜，以及任何在戶外躲避曬傷的人。

entries.source: These glasses shine with golden frames and make you see red.
entries.simplified: 这副眼镜配有闪亮金框，也会让你眼前一片红。
entries.traditional: 這副眼鏡配有閃亮金框，也會讓你眼前一片紅。

entries.source: Bestial notes teach summons to expose weakness before the pack closes in.
entries.simplified: 野兽般的笔记教会召唤物在兽群合围前先暴露敌人的弱点。
entries.traditional: 野獸般的筆記教會召喚物在獸群合圍前先暴露敵人的弱點。

entries.source: Dark currents swirl through the text, dragging curses from every violent spell.
entries.simplified: 黑暗流动在文字间盘旋，从每一道暴烈法术中拖出诅咒。
entries.traditional: 黑暗流動在文字間盤旋，從每一道暴烈法術中拖出詛咒。

entries.source: A heavy rite pulls enemies inward before the well answers with dissonance.
entries.simplified: 一道沉重仪式将敌人向内拖拽，随后由深井以不协和之音作出回应。
entries.traditional: 一道沉重儀式將敵人向內拖拽，隨後由深井以不協和之音作出回應。

entries.source: Soft wind-script carries healing echoes and silencing pressure through summoned magic.
entries.simplified: 柔和的风之文字通过召唤魔法传递治疗回响，以及令敌人沉默的压迫。
entries.traditional: 柔和的風之文字透過召喚魔法傳遞治療回響，以及令敵人沉默的壓迫。

entries.source: Bright resonance hums between master and summon, turning support into shared might.
entries.simplified: 明亮共鸣在主人与召唤物之间低鸣，将支援化作共享力量。
entries.traditional: 明亮共鳴在主人與召喚物之間低鳴，將支援化作共享力量。

entries.source: Linked verses bind spirit to spell, stretching each soul strike farther.
entries.simplified: 相连的诗句把灵魂与法术系在一起，让每一次灵魂打击延伸得更远。
entries.traditional: 相連的詩句把靈魂與法術繫在一起，讓每一次靈魂打擊延伸得更遠。

entries.source: Wooden sunlight rests warm against the back, gentle but alive.
entries.simplified: 木制阳光温暖地贴在背后，温和，却生机盎然。
entries.traditional: 木製陽光溫暖地貼在背後，溫和，卻生機盎然。

entries.source: Twin wings and a dawn crest mark those who shield others.
entries.simplified: 双翼与黎明徽记标示着那些守护他人的人。
entries.traditional: 雙翼與黎明徽記標示著那些守護他人的人。

entries.source: Ancient brass carries divine judgment and resolve that refuses to dim.
entries.simplified: 古老黄铜承载神圣审判与绝不黯淡的决心。
entries.traditional: 古老黃銅承載神聖審判與絕不黯淡的決心。

entries.source: A golden lion face glows when bravery needs encouragement most.
entries.simplified: 每当勇气最需要鼓励时，金色狮面便会发光。
entries.traditional: 每當勇氣最需要鼓勵時，金色獅面便會發光。

entries.source: Bright yellow mitts keep hands warm and morale suspiciously high.
entries.simplified: 亮黄色连指手套温暖双手，也让士气高得可疑。
entries.traditional: 亮黃色連指手套溫暖雙手，也讓士氣高得可疑。

entries.source: A ceremonial weapon bearing the crest of the sun. It channels divine force through strength, turning every strike into radiant judgment.
entries.simplified: 一件承载太阳徽记的礼仪兵器。它以力量引导神圣之力，让每一次打击都化作辉耀审判。
entries.traditional: 一件承載太陽徽記的禮儀兵器。它以力量引導神聖之力，讓每一次打擊都化作輝耀審判。

entries.source: “A small blade can carry a whole sunrise, if you forge it hot enough.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “只要锻得足够炽热，小小的刀刃也能承载整轮朝阳。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “只要鍛得足夠熾熱，小小的刀刃也能承載整輪朝陽。” — Suphara

entries.source: Cheerful petals radiate sunshine, even when the wearer absolutely does not.
entries.simplified: 欢快的花瓣散发着阳光气息，即使佩戴者本人完全不是这样。
entries.traditional: 歡快的花瓣散發著陽光氣息，即使佩戴者本人完全不是這樣。

entries.source: Golden petals and delicate wings gather light before this fairy-like creature casts.
entries.simplified: 金色花瓣与纤细双翼会先汇聚光芒，随后这个仙子般的生物才会施法。
entries.traditional: 金色花瓣與纖細雙翼會先匯聚光芒，隨後這個仙子般的生物才會施法。
