entries.source: A set of cool shades that will keep the sunlight out of your eyes. Don't wear them indoors.
entries.simplified: 一副帅气的墨镜，能挡住刺眼阳光。别在室内戴。
entries.traditional: 一副帥氣的墨鏡，能擋住刺眼陽光。別在室內戴。

entries.source: Slatted lenses block sun, shame, and a surprising amount of doubt.
entries.simplified: 百叶状镜片挡住阳光、羞耻，以及多得令人意外的疑虑。
entries.traditional: 百葉狀鏡片擋住陽光、羞恥，以及多得令人意外的疑慮。

entries.source: Green feelers twitch softly, making polite company reconsider approaching outside.
entries.simplified: 绿色触须轻轻颤动，让讲究礼数的人重新考虑是否要在户外靠近。
entries.traditional: 綠色觸鬚輕輕顫動，讓講究禮數的人重新考慮是否要在戶外靠近。

entries.source: “A fang does not need size. It needs timing, venom, and a fool close enough to learn.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “尖牙无需硕大。它只需要时机、毒液，以及一个靠得够近、能学到教训的蠢货。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “尖牙無需碩大。它只需要時機、毒液，以及一個靠得夠近、能學到教訓的蠢貨。” — Suphara

entries.source: “It is dangerous to go alone, aye. So I made this one simple, sturdy, and ready for your first journey.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “独自上路确实危险，没错。所以我把这把剑做得简单、结实，随时可以陪你踏上第一次旅程。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “獨自上路確實危險，沒錯。所以我把這把劍做得簡單、結實，隨時可以陪你踏上第一次旅程。” — Suphara

entries.source: A kettle-shaped charm that steams faintly. Rumored to house a mischievous spirit.
entries.simplified: 一枚茶壶形护符，隐约冒着蒸汽。据说里面住着一个爱恶作剧的灵体。
entries.traditional: 一枚茶壺形護符，隱約冒著蒸氣。據說裡面住著一個愛惡作劇的靈體。

entries.source: Storm-touched robes braid fire, frost, thunder, and stone into restless spellwork.
entries.simplified: 受风暴触碰的长袍，将火焰、寒霜、雷霆与岩石编入躁动不安的法术。
entries.traditional: 受風暴觸碰的長袍，將火焰、寒霜、雷霆與岩石編入躁動不安的法術。

entries.source: “Wind and thunder are stubborn guests. Treat them firm, and they will fight for you.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “风与雷都是固执的客人。管教得严些，它们就会替你战斗。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “風與雷都是固執的客人。管教得嚴些，它們就會替你戰鬥。” — Suphara

entries.source: Faintly cursed, this mask sometimes shifts when you aren't looking.
entries.simplified: 这副面具有着淡淡的诅咒，有时会在你没注意时悄悄改变形状。
entries.traditional: 這副面具有著淡淡的詛咒，有時會在你沒注意時悄悄改變形狀。

entries.source: Shadow-dark leather made for quick hands and quiet exits.
entries.simplified: 暗如阴影的皮革，专为灵巧双手与悄然脱身而制。
entries.traditional: 暗如陰影的皮革，專為靈巧雙手與悄然脫身而製。

entries.source: The floor keeps secrets better when these pass over it.
entries.simplified: 当这双鞋经过时，连地板都更懂得保守秘密。
entries.traditional: 當這雙鞋經過時，連地板都更懂得保守祕密。

entries.source: Light fabric favors fast escapes over fair fights.
entries.simplified: 轻盈布料偏爱迅速脱身，而不是公平交手。
entries.traditional: 輕盈布料偏愛迅速脫身，而不是公平交手。

entries.source: “Keep pressure on the line, and even brave enemies start counting exits.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “持续给战线施压，就连勇敢的敌人也会开始数出口。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “持續給戰線施壓，就連勇敢的敵人也會開始數出口。” — Suphara

entries.source: A striped helm shaped like a tiger's head. Radiates ferocity and predatory strength.
entries.simplified: 一顶塑成虎头模样的条纹头盔，散发着凶猛气势与掠食者般的力量。
entries.traditional: 一頂塑成虎頭模樣的條紋頭盔，散發著凶猛氣勢與掠食者般的力量。

entries.source: Bulky lenses magnify runes, schematics, and every tiny mistake.
entries.simplified: 厚重镜片会放大符文、设计图，以及每一个细小错误。
entries.traditional: 厚重鏡片會放大符文、設計圖，以及每一個細小錯誤。

entries.source: The contraption blocks glare while making you look prepared.
entries.simplified: 这套装置能挡住强光，同时让你看起来准备得十分充分。
entries.traditional: 這套裝置能擋住強光，同時讓你看起來準備得十分充分。

entries.source: Early faith stood behind SpiritVale before the road was fully built. Quiet pride and visible support remain carried in the name.
entries.simplified: 在 SpiritVale 的道路尚未完全铺就前，早期信念便已站在其身后。安静骄傲与醒目支持依然承载于名字之中。
entries.traditional: 在 SpiritVale 的道路尚未完全鋪就前，早期信念便已站在其身後。安靜驕傲與醒目支持依然承載於名字之中。

entries.source: Two supporters moved forward together under a shared banner. The name shines with loyalty and remembered partnership.
entries.simplified: 两名支持者在共同旗帜下并肩前行。名字因忠诚与被铭记的伙伴关系而闪耀。
entries.traditional: 兩名支持者在共同旗幟下並肩前行。名字因忠誠與被銘記的夥伴關係而閃耀。

entries.source: One adventurer arrived before the crowd and claimed fortune at dawn. Bright luck follows the first answer to the call.
entries.simplified: 一名冒险者在众人之前抵达，于黎明抢先抓住幸运。明亮好运追随第一个回应召唤的人。
entries.traditional: 一名冒險者在眾人之前抵達，於黎明搶先抓住幸運。明亮好運追隨第一個回應召喚的人。

entries.source: A supporter helped lay the first stones of SpiritVale. The name carries a lasting weight of origin and noble recognition.
entries.simplified: 一名支持者帮助铺下 SpiritVale 的第一批基石。名字承载起源的长久重量与高贵认可。
entries.traditional: 一名支持者幫助鋪下 SpiritVale 的第一批基石。名字承載起源的長久重量與高貴認可。

entries.source: One vision shaped a companion worthy of travel and legend. The name bears craft and the rare fortune of leaving something living in the world.
entries.simplified: 一个愿景塑造出值得旅行与传说铭记的伙伴。名字承载工艺，以及在世界中留下活生生创造物的罕见幸运。
entries.traditional: 一個願景塑造出值得旅行與傳說銘記的夥伴。名字承載工藝，以及在世界中留下活生生創造物的罕見幸運。

entries.source: An imagined soul entered the world with story and purpose. The name bears lasting craft and a place in SpiritVale memory.
entries.simplified: 一个想象中的灵魂带着故事与使命进入世界。名字承载长久工艺，并在 SpiritVale 的记忆中拥有一席之地。
entries.traditional: 一個想象中的靈魂帶著故事與使命進入世界。名字承載長久工藝，並在 SpiritVale 的記憶中擁有一席之地。

entries.source: A companion concept became part of the journey. The name carries a warm mark of craft and shared adventure.
entries.simplified: 一个伙伴概念成为旅程的一部分。名字承载温暖工艺与共同冒险留下的印记。
entries.traditional: 一個夥伴概念成為旅程的一部分。名字承載溫暖工藝與共同冒險留下的印記。

entries.source: A true supporter became part of SpiritVale itself. The name carries wayfarer pride and belongs beside the world they helped raise.
entries.simplified: 一名真正的支持者成为 SpiritVale 本身的一部分。名字承载行路者骄傲，属于他们帮助建立的世界。
entries.traditional: 一名真正的支持者成為 SpiritVale 本身的一部分。名字承載行路者驕傲，屬於他們幫助建立的世界。

entries.source: One of the rarest supporters rises under a mark of lasting origin. The name carries legendary weight that speaks before any deed is done.
entries.simplified: 最罕见的支持者之一在长久起源的印记下崛起。名字带着传奇重量，在任何事迹发生前便已先行发声。
entries.traditional: 最罕見的支持者之一在長久起源的印記下崛起。名字帶著傳奇重量，在任何事跡發生前便已先行發聲。

entries.source: Battle took a new form through one creator’s vision. The name bears forgecraft and the rare victory of leaving steel behind.
entries.simplified: 战斗透过一位创造者的愿景获得全新形态。名字承载锻造工艺，以及在世界中留下钢铁的罕见胜利。
entries.traditional: 戰鬥透過一位創造者的願景獲得全新形態。名字承載鍛造工藝，以及在世界中留下鋼鐵的罕見勝利。

entries.source: A light and balanced Axe. Perfect for throwing from a distance. Throw first, axe questions later.
entries.simplified: 一把轻巧而平衡良好的斧头，非常适合从远处投掷。先扔斧头，问题以后再问。
entries.traditional: 一把輕巧而平衡良好的斧頭，非常適合從遠處投擲。先扔斧頭，問題以後再問。

entries.source: Old straps hold forgotten spells and histories that refuse retirement.
entries.simplified: 老旧皮带束缚着被遗忘的法术与拒绝退场的历史。
entries.traditional: 老舊皮帶束縛著被遺忘的法術與拒絕退場的歷史。

entries.source: Navy-blue polish and scarlet trim demand the party's attention before manners arrive.
entries.simplified: 海军蓝的光泽与猩红饰边，在礼貌抵达之前便先夺走聚会上的目光。
entries.traditional: 海軍藍的光澤與猩紅飾邊，在禮貌抵達之前便先奪走聚會上的目光。

entries.source: Cloth and charms carry ancestral protection from a tribal frame.
entries.simplified: 布料与护符从部族框架上传递祖先的庇护。
entries.traditional: 布料與護符從部族框架上傳遞祖先的庇護。

entries.source: Carved primal energy awakens the beast behind the wearer's eyes.
entries.simplified: 雕刻出的原始能量，唤醒佩戴者眼中潜藏的野兽。
entries.traditional: 雕刻出的原始能量，喚醒佩戴者眼中潛藏的野獸。

entries.source: A spirit skull crowns the headdress, warning allies and enemies alike.
entries.simplified: 一颗灵体头骨为这顶头饰加冕，同时警告盟友与敌人。
entries.traditional: 一顆靈體頭骨為這頂頭飾加冕，同時警告隊友與敵人。

entries.source: Soft celestial light follows behind in fading steps. The trail turns travel into graceful procession and leaves blessing in the space between departure and memory.
entries.simplified: 柔和天界光芒在身后化作渐淡足迹。轨迹让旅途成为优雅仪仗，并在离去与回忆之间留下祝福。
entries.traditional: 柔和天界光芒在身後化作漸淡足跡。軌跡讓旅途成為優雅儀仗，並在離去與回憶之間留下祝福。

entries.source: Shadow and ember curl behind each step as a vow written in the dark. The trail turns movement into forbidden ceremony as the ground remembers who crossed it.
entries.simplified: 暗影与余烬在每一步后方卷曲，宛如写在黑暗中的誓言。轨迹将移动化作禁忌仪式，让大地记住谁曾经过。
entries.traditional: 暗影與餘燼在每一步後方捲曲，宛如寫在黑暗中的誓言。軌跡將移動化作禁忌儀式，讓大地記住誰曾經過。

entries.source: This young treant looks like a small sapling until it steps from the path.
entries.simplified: 这名幼年树人看起来只是一株小树苗，直到它从路边迈出脚步。
entries.traditional: 這名幼年樹人看起來只是一株小樹苗，直到它從路邊邁出腳步。

entries.source: A mini loot chest worn by risk-takers. May or may not be trapped.
entries.simplified: 一只由冒险者佩戴的迷你战利品宝箱。可能有陷阱，也可能没有。
entries.traditional: 一只由冒險者佩戴的迷你戰利品寶箱。可能有陷阱，也可能沒有。

entries.simplified: 金色储物箱许诺着财富。
entries.traditional: 金色儲物箱許諾著財富。

entries.source: Ancient clan carvings pull instincts closer to the surface.
entries.simplified: 古老氏族雕纹将本能牵引得更接近表面。
entries.traditional: 古老氏族雕紋將本能牽引得更接近表面。

entries.source: Small devil horns announce mischief before the prank even begins.
entries.simplified: 小小的恶魔角在恶作剧开始前便先宣告了麻烦。
entries.traditional: 小小的惡魔角在惡作劇開始前便先宣告了麻煩。

entries.source: As ruthless as the seas, it is a mercy we grant ourselves.
entries.simplified: 它如海洋般无情；幸好我们把这份慈悲留给了自己。
entries.traditional: 它如海洋般無情；幸好我們把這份慈悲留給了自己。

entries.source: “One barrel is a question. Three is a demand.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “一根枪管是在提问。三根枪管就是命令。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “一根槍管是在提問。三根槍管就是命令。” — Suphara

entries.source: Young turtles rely on their shells while waves carry them along the shore.
entries.simplified: 幼龟依靠龟壳保护自己，并随着海浪沿岸漂行。
entries.traditional: 幼龜依靠龜殼保護自己，並隨著海浪沿岸漂行。

entries.source: Slow, steady shellwork insists panic is simply bad pacing. Don't stomp on the wielder, please.
entries.simplified: 缓慢而沉稳的甲壳工艺坚信，慌张只不过是节奏太差。拜托，别踩使用者。
entries.traditional: 緩慢而沉穩的甲殼工藝堅信，慌張只不過是節奏太差。拜託，別踩使用者。

entries.source: Twin edges move in one rhythm, dancing along night's edge.
entries.simplified: 双刃循着同一节奏移动，在夜色边缘起舞。
entries.traditional: 雙刃循著同一節奏移動，在夜色邊緣起舞。

entries.source: Gold trim declares command, whether anyone actually requested leadership.
entries.simplified: 金色饰边宣告着号令之权，不管有没有人真的要求你来领导。
entries.traditional: 金色飾邊宣告著號令之權，不管有沒有人真的要求你來領導。

entries.source: Polished curves speak of earned honor, not empty arrogance alone.
entries.simplified: 抛光曲线诉说着凭实力赢得的荣誉，而不只是空洞的傲慢。
entries.traditional: 拋光曲線訴說著憑實力贏得的榮譽，而不只是空洞的傲慢。

entries.source: Filters stop toxins, fumes, and several regrettable laboratory smells.
entries.simplified: 过滤器能挡住毒素、烟气，以及几种令人后悔的实验室气味。
entries.traditional: 過濾器能擋住毒素、煙氣，以及幾種令人後悔的實驗室氣味。

entries.source: Mossy antlers hum gently whenever deep woodland wind passes through.
entries.simplified: 覆着苔藓的鹿角每当林深处的风吹过，便会轻柔低鸣。
entries.traditional: 覆著苔蘚的鹿角每當森林深處的風吹過，便會輕柔低鳴。

entries.source: Living roots coil around the crystal, feeding nature into spellwork.
entries.simplified: 活生生的根须盘绕水晶，将自然之力注入法术。
entries.traditional: 活生生的根鬚盤繞水晶，將自然之力注入法術。

entries.source: Woven from living vines and supple bark, these leggings move with the rhythm of the forest. Each step stirs unseen currents, quickening the body as if the wild itself urges you onward.
entries.simplified: 由活藤与柔韧树皮编织而成的绑腿，随着森林的节奏而动。每一步都会搅动无形气流，使身体加速，仿佛荒野本身正在催促你向前。
entries.traditional: 由活藤與柔韌樹皮編織而成的綁腿，隨著森林的節奏而動。每一步都會攪動無形氣流，使身體加速，彷彿荒野本身正在催促你向前。

entries.source: Purple warmth reassures the wearer, like a tiny magical blanket.
entries.simplified: 紫色暖意安抚着佩戴者，就像一条小小的魔法毯。
entries.traditional: 紫色暖意安撫著佩戴者，就像一條小小的魔法毯。

entries.source: A sealed vessel marked with forbidden runes. Whispers echo from within.
entries.simplified: 一只刻有禁忌符文的密封容器，低语声从内部不断回荡。
entries.traditional: 一只刻有禁忌符文的密封容器，低語聲從內部不斷迴盪。

entries.source: Purple spikes handle intimidation better than any glare.
entries.simplified: 紫色尖刺比任何怒视都更擅长威吓。
entries.traditional: 紫色尖刺比任何怒視都更擅長威嚇。

entries.source: Dark strands stitched from forgotten silk, adapted for those who balance power, grace, and grit.
entries.simplified: 以被遗忘的丝线缝成的暗色织物，适合那些在力量、优雅与坚韧之间维持平衡的人。
entries.traditional: 以被遺忘的絲線縫成的暗色織物，適合那些在力量、優雅與堅韌之間維持平衡的人。

entries.source: A sharp axe used to hack away at your target.
entries.simplified: 一把用来狠狠劈砍目标的锋利斧头。
entries.traditional: 一把用來狠狠劈砍目標的鋒利斧頭。

entries.source: A battle-worn flag bearing beast claw marks.
entries.simplified: 一面伤痕累累的战旗，上面留着野兽的爪痕。
entries.traditional: 一面傷痕累累的戰旗，上面留著野獸的爪痕。

entries.source: Rage and duty sleep inside this relic of fallen champions.
entries.simplified: 愤怒与职责沉睡在这件陨落冠军的遗物之中。
entries.traditional: 憤怒與職責沉睡在這件殞落冠軍的遺物之中。

entries.source: A broad iron shield engraved with a sharp emblem. Designed to intimidate and absorb punishment.
entries.simplified: 一面刻有锐利徽记的宽大铁盾，专为威慑敌人并承受惩罚而设计。
entries.traditional: 一面刻有銳利徽記的寬大鐵盾，專為威懾敵人並承受懲罰而設計。

entries.source: Rust-red maps follow stunned prey, guiding heavy arcs toward vulnerable wounds.
entries.simplified: 锈红色路线追随着陷入眩晕的猎物，引导沉重弧击落向脆弱的伤口。
entries.traditional: 鏽紅色路線追隨著陷入暈眩的獵物，引導沉重弧擊落向脆弱的傷口。

entries.source: Blunt warrior doctrine teaches every charge to leave jaws, guards, and courage shaken.
entries.simplified: 钝重的战士教义要求每一次冲锋都震撼下颌、守势与勇气。
entries.traditional: 鈍重的戰士教義要求每一次衝鋒都震撼下顎、守勢與勇氣。

entries.source: A brutal manual for dragging foes into the hungry reach of steel.
entries.simplified: 一本残酷的手册，教人把敌人拖入饥渴钢铁的攻击范围。
entries.traditional: 一本殘酷的手冊，教人把敵人拖入飢渴鋼鐵的攻擊範圍。

entries.source: Pain-stained pages teach survival to bargain loudly when health runs low.
entries.simplified: 染满痛苦的书页教会生存本能在生命垂危时大声讨价还价。
entries.traditional: 染滿痛苦的書頁教會生存本能在生命垂危時大聲討價還價。

entries.source: A scarred route map turns spinning violence into protection and slowing pressure.
entries.simplified: 一张伤痕累累的路线图，将旋转的暴力化作防护与减速压制。
entries.traditional: 一張傷痕累累的路線圖，將旋轉的暴力化作防護與減速壓制。

entries.source: “Spin with care. This cleaver pulls trouble close before it cuts it down.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “旋转时要小心。这把砍刀会先把麻烦拉近，再把它斩倒。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “旋轉時要小心。這把砍刀會先把麻煩拉近，再把它斬倒。” — Suphara

entries.source: Dark timeglass clicks forward with machine-calm precision.
entries.simplified: 黑暗计时玻璃以机械般沉静精准向前咔嗒作响。
entries.traditional: 黑暗計時玻璃以機械般沉靜精准向前咔嗒作響。

entries.source: Bright wristwork proves punctuality can still dress like a joke.
entries.simplified: 明亮腕饰证明，守时依然可以穿得像个笑话。
entries.traditional: 明亮腕飾證明，守時依然可以穿得像個笑話。

entries.source: Wristbound brass points onward despite every terrible plan.
entries.simplified: 绑在手腕上的黄铜指针即使面对每一个糟糕计划，依然坚定指向前方。
entries.traditional: 綁在手腕上的黃銅指針即使面對每一個糟糕計劃，依然堅定指向前方。

entries.source: A tiny hourglass measures time through wonderfully impractical sand.
entries.simplified: 一只微型沙漏透过极不实用却令人愉快的细沙计量时间。
entries.traditional: 一隻微型沙漏透過極不實用卻令人愉快的細沙計量時間。

entries.source: Faint signal runes blink across this wrist receiver in patient silence.
entries.simplified: 微弱信号符文在这只腕部接收器上耐心而安静地闪烁。
entries.traditional: 微弱信號符文在這個腕部接收器上耐心而安靜地閃爍。

entries.source: “Cold bites hardest when you panic. Stand firm, and let it break first.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “你一慌，寒冷就咬得最狠。站稳，让它先崩溃。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “你一慌，寒冷就咬得最狠。站穩，讓它先崩潰。” — Suphara

entries.source: Interlaced threads teach resistance, taunts, and patient punishment in one guarded pattern.
entries.simplified: 交错丝线将抗性、嘲讽与耐心反击编入同一套守御纹样。
entries.traditional: 交錯絲線將抗性、嘲諷與耐心反擊編入同一套守禦紋樣。

entries.source: Gentle threads bind protection and healing into a guardian's steady pattern.
entries.simplified: 柔和丝线将防护与治疗编织成守护者沉稳的纹样。
entries.traditional: 柔和絲線將防護與治療編織成守護者沉穩的紋樣。

entries.source: Arcane threads hum with shielding spells and controlled magical force.
entries.simplified: 奥术丝线低声鸣响，将护盾法术与受控魔力编织在一起。
entries.traditional: 奧術絲線低聲鳴響，將護盾法術與受控魔力編織在一起。

entries.source: Fierce threads knot smoke, fury, and close combat into one reckless pattern.
entries.simplified: 狂烈丝线将烟雾、怒火与近身战斗打结成一套鲁莽纹样。
entries.traditional: 狂烈絲線將煙霧、怒火與近身戰鬥打結成一套魯莽紋樣。

entries.source: Taut threads guide traps and volatile bolts toward distant vulnerable targets.
entries.simplified: 绷紧的丝线引导陷阱与不稳定弩矢，射向远处脆弱的目标。
entries.traditional: 繃緊的絲線引導陷阱與不穩定弩箭，射向遠處脆弱的目標。

entries.source: A tunic lined with shimmering threads and hidden pockets, woven by artisans who channel the latent power of enchanted cards. Perfect for those who collect, combine, or crack them open.
entries.simplified: 一件内衬闪光丝线并藏有暗袋的上衣，由能够引导附魔卡牌潜在力量的工匠织成。非常适合那些喜欢收集、组合或拆解卡牌的人。
entries.traditional: 一件內襯閃光絲線並藏有暗袋的上衣，由能夠引導附魔卡牌潛在力量的工匠織成。非常適合那些喜歡收集、組合或拆解卡牌的人。

entries.source: Soft-soled and rune-etched, these shoes hum faintly with stored enchantments. Those who tread in them leave behind no trace, except the lingering echo of shuffled fate.
entries.simplified: 柔软鞋底刻有符文，因储存的附魔而隐隐低鸣。穿着它们走过的人不会留下任何痕迹，只有洗牌命运久久不散的回响。
entries.traditional: 柔軟鞋底刻有符文，因儲存的附魔而隱隱低鳴。穿著它們走過的人不會留下任何痕跡，只有洗牌命運久久不散的回響。

entries.source: These layered wraps are reinforced with rune-stitched seams and subtle card slots, favored by Weavers who walk the fine line between creation and disassembly.
entries.simplified: 这些层叠裹布以符文缝线与隐蔽卡槽加固，深受行走在创造与拆解边缘的 Weavers 青睐。
entries.traditional: 這些層疊裹布以符文縫線與隱蔽卡槽加固，深受行走在創造與拆解邊緣的 Weavers 青睞。

entries.source: Now you can have a whale of a good time with this soft, cuddly aquatic backpack. It's like having the ocean at your beck and call.
entries.simplified: 现在你可以背上这只柔软可爱的水生背包，尽情享受一段“鲸”彩时光。仿佛整片海洋都随叫随到。
entries.traditional: 現在你可以背上這只柔軟可愛的水生背包，盡情享受一段「鯨」彩時光。彷彿整片海洋都隨叫隨到。

entries.source: This small desert caster spins loose air into a tight magical funnel.
entries.simplified: 这名小型沙漠施法者将松散气流旋成紧密的魔法漏斗。
entries.traditional: 這名小型沙漠施法者將鬆散氣流旋成緊密的魔法漏斗。

entries.source: “A thorn does not slash. It pierces, and then lets the venom speak.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “荆棘并不劈砍。它只会刺入，然后让毒液开口。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “荊棘並不劈砍。它只會刺入，然後讓毒液開口。” — Suphara

entries.source: A heavy-duty hiker's load, complete with bedroll and grit.
entries.simplified: 一套结实耐用的远足行装，铺盖卷与坚韧意志一应俱全。
entries.traditional: 一套結實耐用的遠足行裝，鋪蓋卷與堅韌意志一應俱全。

entries.source: The enchanted bark links the wearer to ancient woodland spirits.
entries.simplified: 附魔树皮将穿戴者与古老森林灵体相连。
entries.traditional: 附魔樹皮將穿戴者與古老森林靈體相連。

entries.source: Flexible willow channels steady spells without losing its gentle swing.
entries.simplified: 柔韧的柳木能稳定引导法术，同时保留温和的摆动。
entries.traditional: 柔韌的柳木能穩定引導法術，同時保留溫和的擺動。

entries.source: “Wind is wild, aye, but even wild things can be turned aside.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “风确实狂野，但再狂野的东西也能被引向别处。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “風確實狂野，但再狂野的東西也能被引向別處。” — Suphara

entries.source: Curved tribal metal returns faithfully after cutting through the air.
entries.simplified: 弯曲的部族金属划破空气后，总会忠实地回到手中。
entries.traditional: 彎曲的部族金屬劃破空氣後，總會忠實地回到手中。

entries.source: Crystal-grown branches stir currents that eyes cannot follow around the hand.
entries.simplified: 水晶中生长的枝杈搅动着肉眼无法追随、盘旋于手边的气流。
entries.traditional: 水晶中生長的枝杈攪動著肉眼無法追隨、盤旋於手邊的氣流。

entries.source: Enchanted leather makes every movement feel swift and precise.
entries.simplified: 附魔皮革让每一个动作都显得迅捷而精准。
entries.traditional: 附魔皮革讓每一個動作都顯得迅捷而精準。

entries.source: Feather-light boots let the wind carry each quiet step forward.
entries.simplified: 轻若羽毛的靴子让风托着每一步无声向前。
entries.traditional: 輕若羽毛的靴子讓風托著每一步無聲向前。

entries.source: Flexible cloth never snags, even when arrows fly mid-roll.
entries.simplified: 柔韧布料从不勾挂，即使箭矢在翻滚途中飞出。
entries.traditional: 柔韌布料從不勾掛，即使箭矢在翻滾途中飛出。

entries.source: Iron wings crown a battered helm built from victory and dominance.
entries.simplified: 铁翼为一顶伤痕累累的头盔加冕，它由胜利与征服铸成。
entries.traditional: 鐵翼為一頂傷痕累累的頭盔加冕，它由勝利與征服鑄成。

entries.source: Heroic shimmer follows the wings, bright with deeds remembered proudly.
entries.simplified: 英雄般的微光追随着双翼，因那些值得骄傲铭记的功绩而闪耀。
entries.traditional: 英雄般的微光追隨著雙翼，因那些值得驕傲銘記的功績而閃耀。

entries.source: This small red spirit flickers above the meadow and flares up when disturbed.
entries.simplified: 这个小型红色灵体在草原上方闪烁，受到惊扰时便会骤然迸发。
entries.traditional: 這個小型紅色靈體在草原上方閃爍，受到驚擾時便會驟然迸發。

entries.source: Hexed soles hum beneath spell-charged feet, one cast after another.
entries.simplified: 受诅咒的鞋底在充满法术力量的脚下低鸣，一次施法接着一次。
entries.traditional: 受詛咒的鞋底在充滿法術力量的腳下低鳴，一次施法接著一次。

entries.source: Storm-heavy pages condense chain lightning into fewer, harsher divine strikes.
entries.simplified: 风暴沉重地压在书页上，将连锁闪电凝聚为次数更少、威力更强的神圣雷击。
entries.traditional: 風暴沉重地壓在書頁上，將連鎖閃電凝聚為次數更少、威力更強的神聖雷擊。

entries.source: Overcharged notes let lightning spend itself again through sudden thunderbolts.
entries.simplified: 过载笔记让闪电通过突如其来的雷击再次释放自身力量。
entries.traditional: 過載筆記讓閃電透過突如其來的雷擊再次釋放自身力量。

entries.source: A calm diagram in the center teaches lightning to blind before leaving.
entries.simplified: 中央那幅沉静图示教会闪电在离去前先致盲目标。
entries.traditional: 中央那幅沉靜圖示教會閃電在離去前先致盲目標。

entries.source: Stone-written runes keep earthen walls standing long enough to slow pursuit.
entries.simplified: 写于岩石之上的符文让土墙屹立得足够长久，以减缓追击。
entries.traditional: 寫於岩石之上的符文讓土牆屹立得足夠長久，以減緩追擊。

entries.source: Strict arcane notes trade casting comfort for sharper, heavier spell impact.
entries.simplified: 严苛的奥术笔记牺牲施法舒适度，换取更锐利、更沉重的法术冲击。
entries.traditional: 嚴苛的奧術筆記犧牲施法舒適度，換取更銳利、更沉重的法術衝擊。

entries.source: Blue script echoes every cast, leaving spare mana humming in its wake.
entries.simplified: 蓝色文字回响着每一次施法，在其后留下仍在低鸣的备用魔力。
entries.traditional: 藍色文字回響著每一次施法，在其後留下仍在低鳴的備用魔力。

entries.source: Elemental sigils raise matching barriers whenever avatar power gathers around the caster.
entries.simplified: 当化身之力汇聚在施法者周围时，元素符印会升起对应的屏障。
entries.traditional: 當化身之力匯聚在施法者周圍時，元素符印會升起對應的屏障。

entries.source: Pointed tradition and a glowing gem make wizardry look official.
entries.simplified: 尖顶传统与一枚发光宝石，让巫术显得格外正式。
entries.traditional: 尖頂傳統與一枚發光寶石，讓巫術顯得格外正式。

entries.source: Young shadow wolves practice hunting with quick bites and sudden dashes.
entries.simplified: 年幼的暗影狼以迅捷咬击与突然冲刺练习狩猎。
entries.traditional: 年幼的暗影狼以迅捷咬擊與突然衝刺練習狩獵。

entries.source: A wolf emblem guards loyalty, ferocity, and the arm behind it.
entries.simplified: 狼之徽记守护忠诚、凶猛，以及持盾的那条手臂。
entries.traditional: 狼之徽記守護忠誠、凶猛，以及持盾的那條手臂。

entries.source: Broken wood survives through nails, hope, and heroic denial.
entries.simplified: 破碎木板依靠钉子、希望与英勇的自我否认继续撑了下来。
entries.traditional: 破碎木板依靠釘子、希望與英勇的自我否認繼續撐了下來。

entries.source: Old flesh and grave soil cling to this burrowing creature as it drags itself through wet ground.
entries.simplified: 陈旧血肉与墓土附着在这只掘穴生物身上，伴随它拖行于潮湿地面。
entries.traditional: 陳舊血肉與墓土附著在這隻掘穴生物身上，伴隨它拖行於潮濕地面。

entries.source: “First light should be swift enough that no one sees it coming.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “第一道曙光应当快到没有人看见它来临。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “第一道曙光應當快到沒有人看見它來臨。” — Suphara

entries.source: Spectral fire burns in the skull's eyes, whispering forgotten names.
entries.simplified: 幽灵火焰燃烧在骷髅眼中，低语着被遗忘的名字。
entries.traditional: 幽靈火焰燃燒在骷髏眼中，低語著被遺忘的名字。

entries.source: Golden crystal glows brightly, probably because subtlety never learned magic.
entries.simplified: 金色水晶明亮发光，大概是因为低调从来没学会魔法。
entries.traditional: 金色水晶明亮發光，大概是因為低調從來沒學會魔法。

entries.source: A set of red and blue glasses that makes your vision blurry. You have no idea what they could be used for.
entries.simplified: 一副红蓝双色眼镜，会让你的视野变得模糊。你根本不知道它能拿来做什么。
entries.traditional: 一副紅藍雙色眼鏡，會讓你的視野變得模糊。你完全不知道它能拿來做什麼。

entries.source: Purple crystal fragments drift around a blade touched by silence.
entries.simplified: 紫色水晶碎片环绕着一柄被寂静触碰的刀刃缓缓漂浮。
entries.traditional: 紫色水晶碎片環繞著一柄被寂靜觸碰的刀刃緩緩飄浮。

entries.source: Softly glowing scripture turns mercy into shelter for the wounded.
entries.simplified: 泛着柔光的经文将慈悲化作庇护伤者的屏障。
entries.traditional: 泛著柔光的經文將慈悲化作庇護傷者的屏障。

entries.source: Gilded pages urge each strike onward until faith hardens into radiance.
entries.simplified: 镀金书页催促每一次攻击向前，直到信念凝成光辉。
entries.traditional: 鍍金書頁催促每一次攻擊向前，直到信念凝成光輝。

entries.source: Bright verses sharpen holy light into judgment that lingers around the faithful.
entries.simplified: 明亮的诗句将圣光磨砺成审判，萦绕在虔诚信徒身旁。
entries.traditional: 明亮的詩句將聖光磨礪成審判，縈繞在虔誠信徒身旁。

entries.source: Gentle hymns fill the pages, deepening grace with every healing prayer.
entries.simplified: 温柔的圣歌写满书页，让每一次治疗祷告都加深恩典。
entries.traditional: 溫柔的聖歌寫滿書頁，讓每一次治療禱告都加深恩典。

entries.source: Threaded verses bend holy light faster, cleaner, and farther than ordinary prayer.
entries.simplified: 交织的诗篇让圣光比寻常祷告更快、更纯净，也能传得更远。
entries.traditional: 交織的詩篇讓聖光比尋常祈禱更快、更純淨，也能傳得更遠。

entries.source: Measured psalms keep hands steady and healing magic moving in perfect cadence.
entries.simplified: 节律严谨的赞美诗让双手保持稳定，使治疗魔法以完美节奏流转。
entries.traditional: 節律嚴謹的讚美詩讓雙手保持穩定，使治療魔法以完美節奏流轉。

entries.source: Silky orange ribbon, warm as a hopeful sunrise.
entries.simplified: 丝滑的橙色缎带，温暖得如同充满希望的朝阳。
entries.traditional: 絲滑的橘色緞帶，溫暖得如同充滿希望的朝陽。

entries.source: Polished amber catches light with a soft sunset glow.
entries.simplified: 抛光琥珀捕捉光线，泛起柔和的落日余辉。
entries.traditional: 拋光琥珀捕捉光線，泛起柔和的落日餘暉。

entries.source: Mystic wards glow beneath a polished jeweled crest.
entries.simplified: 神秘结界在抛光的宝石徽饰下方发光。
entries.traditional: 神祕結界在拋光的寶石徽飾下方發光。

entries.source: Arcane seams draw mana like frost pulling breath from air.
entries.simplified: 奥术接缝牵引魔力，如同寒霜从空气中抽走呼吸。
entries.traditional: 奧術接縫牽引魔力，如同寒霜從空氣中抽走呼吸。

entries.source: Starlit enchantments steady every step through practiced spellwork.
entries.simplified: 星光附魔稳住每一步，让娴熟的施法从容展开。
entries.traditional: 星光附魔穩住每一步，讓嫻熟的施法從容展開。

entries.source: Careful hands move faster when magic knows where to flow.
entries.simplified: 当魔法知晓该流向何处时，谨慎的双手也会动作得更快。
entries.traditional: 當魔法知道該流向何處時，謹慎的雙手也會動得更快。

entries.source: Runed fabric keeps motion, balance, and spellwork in rhythm.
entries.simplified: 符文织物让动作、平衡与施法保持同一节奏。
entries.traditional: 符文織物讓動作、平衡與施法保持同一節奏。

entries.source: Flowing plates carry the wearer through battle with less resistance.
entries.simplified: 流线型甲片减少阻力，带着穿戴者穿行于战场。
entries.traditional: 流線型甲片減少阻力，帶著穿戴者穿梭戰場。

entries.source: Refined armor sharpens movement until each strike lands cleanly under pressure.
entries.simplified: 精制护甲磨砺动作，使每一击即使承受压力也能干净命中。
entries.traditional: 精製護甲磨礪動作，使每一擊即使承受壓力也能俐落命中。

entries.source: Arcane threads hum through the plating, guiding hidden knowledge outward.
entries.simplified: 奥术丝线在甲片间低鸣，引导隐秘知识显现于外。
entries.traditional: 奧術絲線在甲片間低鳴，引導隱祕知識顯現於外。

entries.simplified: 细微的护符礼貌地扭转运气。
entries.traditional: 細微的護符有禮地扭轉運氣。

entries.source: Reinforced armor channels raw might through every committed strike forward.
entries.simplified: 强化护甲将纯粹力量导入每一次坚定向前的攻击。
entries.traditional: 強化護甲將純粹力量導入每一次堅決向前的攻擊。

entries.source: Layered steel outlasts hardship, siege weather, and most bad ideas.
entries.simplified: 层叠钢甲经得住艰难、攻城风雨，以及大多数馊主意。
entries.traditional: 層疊鋼甲經得住艱難、攻城風雨，以及大多數餿主意。

entries.source: Enough arrows to make confidence feel reasonable.
entries.simplified: 箭矢多得足以让这份自信显得合情合理。
entries.traditional: 箭矢多得足以讓這份自信顯得合情合理。

entries.source: Iron remembers every arrow that failed to pass.
entries.simplified: 铁壁记得每一支未能穿透它的箭。
entries.traditional: 鐵壁記得每一支未能穿透它的箭。

entries.source: Old arrows still sleep in its battered wood.
entries.simplified: 古老的箭矢仍沉睡在它伤痕累累的木板中。
entries.traditional: 古老的箭矢仍沉睡在它傷痕累累的木板中。

entries.source: A bow blessed by unseen hands. Its arrows fly true and far, striking with precision no shield can fully deny.
entries.simplified: 一把受无形之手祝福的弓。箭矢飞得又准又远，以任何盾牌都无法完全抵挡的精度命中目标。
entries.traditional: 一把受無形之手祝福的弓。箭矢飛得又準又遠，以任何盾牌都無法完全抵擋的精準命中目標。

entries.source: Frozen veins pulse through an axe that leaves only silence behind.
entries.simplified: 冰冷的脉络在斧中搏动，所过之处只留下寂静。
entries.traditional: 冰冷的脈絡在斧中搏動，所過之處只留下寂靜。

entries.source: “Every legend starts with a tool that can split wood and trouble alike.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “每段传奇，都始于一件既能劈开木头，也能劈开麻烦的工具。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “每段傳奇，都始於一件既能劈開木頭，也能劈開麻煩的工具。” — Suphara

entries.source: Caution: Do not use to clash against other antlers. Instead these antlers are used to draw in the natural energies of the world.
entries.simplified: 注意：请勿用它与其他鹿角相撞。这对鹿角是用来引导世界中的自然能量的。
entries.traditional: 注意：請勿用它與其他鹿角相撞。這對鹿角是用來引導世界中的自然能量的。

entries.source: Crystalline blue edges sharpen thought into focused power.
entries.simplified: 水晶般的蓝色锋缘将思绪磨砺为专注的力量。
entries.traditional: 水晶般的藍色鋒緣將思緒磨礪為專注力量。

entries.source: “Wind on the edge, water at your back. Parry steady, then cut where the tide breaks.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “刃上有风，背后有水。稳稳架开，再朝潮水断裂之处劈下。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “刃上有風，背後有水。穩穩架開，再朝潮水斷裂之處劈下。” — Suphara

entries.source: Cobalt lines hold disciplined spell power in simple form.
entries.simplified: 钴蓝纹路以简洁的形态约束着严谨的法术力量。
entries.traditional: 鈷藍紋路以簡潔形態約束著嚴謹的法術力量。

entries.source: Focus brightens each blue facet from within.
entries.simplified: 专注从内部点亮每一块蓝色切面。
entries.traditional: 專注從內部點亮每一塊藍色切面。

entries.source: Used to store many things. It is designed to carry your burdens.
entries.simplified: 用来存放许多东西。它生来就是替你背负重担的。
entries.traditional: 用來存放許多東西。它生來就是替你背負重擔的。

entries.source: Leather wrapped tight for dust, trouble, and quick escapes.
entries.simplified: 皮革紧紧缠绕，足以应付尘土、麻烦和仓促逃亡。
entries.traditional: 皮革緊緊纏繞，足以應付塵土、麻煩和倉促逃亡。

entries.source: Orange cloth marks the one others follow.
entries.simplified: 橙色布幡标示着众人追随之人。
entries.traditional: 橘色布幡標示著眾人追隨之人。

entries.source: One bright eye watches from a cursed little companion.
entries.simplified: 一只明亮的眼睛从这个受诅咒的小伙伴身上注视着一切。
entries.traditional: 一隻明亮的眼睛從這個受詛咒的小夥伴身上注視著一切。

entries.source: A red plume marks the first spark of trouble.
entries.simplified: 一根红色羽饰标志着麻烦燃起的第一点火星。
entries.traditional: 一根紅色羽飾標誌著麻煩燃起的第一點火星。

entries.source: Bear-shaped padding carries burdens with quiet strength.
entries.simplified: 熊形软垫以沉静的力量替你背负重担。
entries.traditional: 熊形軟墊以沉靜力量替你背負重擔。

entries.source: This plush little cub gently hugs your head; little armor, plenty of charm.
entries.simplified: 这只毛绒小熊轻轻抱住你的脑袋；防护不多，魅力十足。
entries.traditional: 這隻絨毛小熊輕輕抱住你的腦袋；防護不多，魅力十足。

entries.source: Fangs and bone turn fear into a helm.
entries.simplified: 獠牙与白骨将恐惧铸成头盔。
entries.traditional: 獠牙與白骨將恐懼鑄成頭盔。

entries.source: Gaping jaws make this hood look hungry.
entries.simplified: 大张的兽口让这顶兜帽看起来饥肠辘辘。
entries.traditional: 大張的獸口讓這頂兜帽看起來飢腸轆轆。

entries.source: Rugged hide wraps close, wild and untamed.
entries.simplified: 粗犷兽皮紧贴包裹，野性而不受驯服。
entries.traditional: 粗獷獸皮緊貼包覆，野性而不受馴服。

entries.source: Raw power beats through the wild plates, eager for the charge.
entries.simplified: 原始力量在狂野甲片间搏动，迫不及待地迎接冲锋。
entries.traditional: 原始力量在狂野甲片間搏動，迫不及待迎接衝鋒。

entries.source: Torn battle pages teach every shout to carry courage farther.
entries.simplified: 撕裂的战斗书页教会每一声呐喊将勇气传得更远。
entries.traditional: 撕裂的戰鬥書頁教會每一聲吶喊將勇氣傳得更遠。

entries.source: Blood-red ink thrashes across the page, hungry for the next critical strike.
entries.simplified: 血红墨迹在书页上狂乱翻腾，渴求下一次暴击。
entries.traditional: 血紅墨跡在書頁上狂亂翻騰，渴求下一次暴擊。

entries.source: Savage notes reward every fallen foe with momentum, fury, and terrible focus.
entries.simplified: 狂野笔记让每个倒下的敌人都化作冲势、怒火与可怕的专注。
entries.traditional: 狂野筆記讓每個倒下的敵人都化作衝勢、怒火與可怕的專注。

entries.source: A grim manual for ending hesitation when weakened enemies stand too long.
entries.simplified: 一本阴郁的手册，教你在虚弱敌人苟延残喘时彻底斩断犹豫。
entries.traditional: 一本陰鬱的手冊，教你在虛弱敵人苟延殘喘時徹底斬斷猶豫。

entries.source: These gritty boots stomp forward like retreat owes them money.
entries.simplified: 这双沾满尘土的靴子大步向前，仿佛撤退还欠它们钱。
entries.traditional: 這雙沾滿塵土的靴子大步向前，彷彿撤退還欠它們錢。

entries.source: Rugged armor pushes forward, leaving caution somewhere behind the wearer.
entries.simplified: 粗犷的护甲不断向前，把谨慎远远落在穿戴者身后。
entries.traditional: 粗獷的護甲不斷向前，把謹慎遠遠留在穿戴者身後。

entries.source: “Bind the dead tight, lad. Then let them answer faster and hit harder than they did in life.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “把死者绑紧点，小子。然后让他们比活着时回应得更快、打得更狠。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “把死者綁緊點，小子。然後讓他們比活著時回應得更快、打得更狠。” — Suphara

entries.source: Dark steel stays reliable after every ugly fight.
entries.simplified: 乌黑的钢铁在每一场难看的战斗后依然可靠。
entries.traditional: 烏黑的鋼鐵在每一場難看的戰鬥後依然可靠。

entries.source: Forged in the night garden when light and shadow become one. It is said that its edge is sharp enough to sever one from their shadow, while the hilt's warmth soothes the user's wounds.
entries.simplified: 在光与影融为一体的夜之花园中锻造。据说它的锋刃锐利到足以将人与其影子斩离，而剑柄的温暖则能安抚使用者的伤口。
entries.traditional: 在光與影融為一體的夜之花園中鍛造。據說它的鋒刃銳利到足以將人與其影子斬離，而劍柄的溫暖則能撫慰使用者的傷口。

entries.source: Sword-shaped banners make courage easier to follow.
entries.simplified: 剑形旌旗让勇气更容易追随。
entries.traditional: 劍形旌旗讓勇氣更容易追隨。

entries.simplified: 视线闭合；更深的专注由此开启。
entries.traditional: 視線閉合；更深的專注由此開啟。

entries.source: A small fang charm worn for cunning and nerve.
entries.simplified: 一枚小巧的尖牙护符，象征狡黠与胆识。
entries.traditional: 一枚小巧的尖牙護符，象徵狡黠與膽識。

entries.source: A spiked heart charm that pulses too warmly.
entries.simplified: 一枚带刺的心形护符，跳动得过于温热。
entries.traditional: 一枚帶刺的心形護符，跳動得過於溫熱。

entries.source: Crimson wraps cling to life with every strike.
entries.simplified: 猩红裹带随着每一次挥击紧抓生命不放。
entries.traditional: 猩紅纏帶隨著每一次揮擊緊抓生命不放。

entries.source: “A weapon should bloom in the dark, lass. Let the enemy wonder why the night suddenly has teeth.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “武器就该在黑暗中绽放，姑娘。让敌人猜猜，为什么夜色突然长出了牙。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “武器就該在黑暗中綻放，姑娘。讓敵人猜猜，為什麼夜色突然長出了牙。” — Suphara

entries.source: Orange petals keep their warmth through harsh weather.
entries.simplified: 橙色花瓣即使历经恶劣天气，依然留存暖意。
entries.traditional: 橘色花瓣即使歷經惡劣天候，依然保有暖意。

entries.source: Petal-shaped charm bright enough to lift tired spirits.
entries.simplified: 花瓣形护符明亮得足以振奋疲惫的心灵。
entries.traditional: 花瓣形護符明亮得足以振奮疲憊的心靈。

entries.source: Mana channels glimmer across a polished blue shell.
entries.simplified: 魔力脉络在抛光的蓝色甲壳上微微闪烁。
entries.traditional: 魔力脈絡在拋光的藍色甲殼上微微閃爍。

entries.source: “Subtle work has its place. This is not that place.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “细活自有细活的用处。这个可不讲究那些。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “細活有細活的用處。這個可不講究那些。” — Suphara

entries.source: Back-mounted kaboom. Unstable, flashy, probably intentional.
entries.simplified: 背在身后的轰然巨响。不稳定、够显眼，而且多半是故意的。
entries.traditional: 背在身後的轟然巨響。不穩定、夠醒目，而且多半是故意的。

entries.source: Sacred bone hums with magic from forgotten rites.
entries.simplified: 圣骨低鸣着遗忘仪式遗留的魔力。
entries.traditional: 聖骨低鳴著被遺忘儀式所留下的魔力。

entries.source: Jagged fangs crown the memory of a successful hunt.
entries.simplified: 锯齿般的尖牙为一场成功狩猎的回忆加冕。
entries.traditional: 鋸齒般的尖牙為一場成功狩獵的回憶加冕。

entries.source: A brittle dagger of deadwood and bone, eager to splinter into spectral spears.
entries.simplified: 一柄由枯木与白骨制成的脆弱匕首，迫不及待想碎裂成幽灵长矛。
entries.traditional: 一柄由枯木與白骨製成的脆弱匕首，迫不及待想碎裂成幽靈長矛。

entries.source: Fang and marrow leave wounds that refuse to rest.
entries.simplified: 獠牙与骨髓留下久久无法平息的伤口。
entries.traditional: 獠牙與骨髓留下久久無法平息的傷口。

entries.source: “A proper bonk can fix many manners.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “好好敲上一棍，能纠正不少坏规矩。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “好好敲上一棍，能糾正不少壞規矩。” — Suphara

entries.source: Enhances boss skills with extra projectiles and range for stronger area pressure.
entries.simplified: 强化首领技能，增加额外投射物与攻击范围，从而形成更强的区域压制。
entries.traditional: 強化頭目技能，增加額外投射物與攻擊範圍，從而形成更強的區域壓制。

entries.source: Industrial weight turns armor and egos into scrap.
entries.simplified: 工业级的重量把铠甲和自尊一起砸成废料。
entries.traditional: 工業級的重量把鎧甲和自尊一起砸成廢料。

entries.source: Skycloth trims light armor made for quick casting.
entries.simplified: Skycloth 为专为迅捷施法打造的轻甲收边。
entries.traditional: Skycloth 為專供迅捷施法使用的輕甲收邊。

entries.simplified: 羽毛般轻柔的凉鞋让每一步都更加轻快。
entries.traditional: 羽毛般輕柔的涼鞋讓每一步都更加輕快。

entries.source: Wind-threaded shorts keep every stride light.
entries.simplified: 风线织就的短裤让每一步都轻盈自如。
entries.traditional: 風線織就的短褲讓每一步都輕盈自如。

entries.source: Charred bindings hold a cleaver made for brutal work.
entries.simplified: 焦黑绑带牢牢束住一柄专为粗暴活计打造的砍刀。
entries.traditional: 焦黑綁帶牢牢束住一柄專為粗暴活計打造的砍刀。

entries.source: Royal guard steel, plain and reliable.
entries.simplified: 王家卫兵所用的钢刃，朴素而可靠。
entries.traditional: 王家衛兵所用的鋼刃，樸實而可靠。

entries.source: Warped bronze hums faintly as daylight fades.
entries.simplified: 扭曲的青铜随着日光消退而发出微弱低鸣。
entries.traditional: 扭曲的青銅隨著日光消退而發出微弱低鳴。

entries.source: Heavy bronze, simple grit, no wasted glamour.
entries.simplified: 沉重青铜，朴实坚韧，不浪费半点华饰。
entries.traditional: 沉重青銅，樸實堅韌，不浪費半點華飾。

entries.source: Stoic bronze hides the face and keeps its secrets.
entries.simplified: 沉静的青铜遮住面容，也守住其中的秘密。
entries.traditional: 沉靜的青銅遮住面容，也守住其中的祕密。

entries.source: Squishy, buoyant, and suspiciously popular with young adventurers.
entries.simplified: 软乎乎、轻飘飘，而且莫名受到年轻冒险者的追捧。
entries.traditional: 軟綿綿、輕飄飄，而且莫名受到年輕冒險者的追捧。

entries.source: Light shielding for fighters who prefer room to move.
entries.simplified: 轻便的防护，适合想留出活动空间的战士。
entries.traditional: 輕便的防護，適合想保有活動空間的戰士。

entries.source: Red cloth and proud horn promise strength and protection.
entries.simplified: 红布与骄傲的犄角许诺着力量与守护。
entries.traditional: 紅布與驕傲的犄角承諾著力量與守護。

entries.source: Long ears, soft pockets, and far too much innocence.
entries.simplified: 长耳朵、柔软口袋，还有多得过头的天真无邪。
entries.traditional: 長耳朵、柔軟口袋，還有多得過頭的天真無邪。

entries.source: Moon-rabbit ears make quick feet feel quicker.
entries.simplified: 月兔耳朵让轻快的脚步显得更加迅捷。
entries.traditional: 月兔耳朵讓輕快的腳步顯得更加迅捷。

entries.source: A spectral essence trapped within a twisted cage. Its glow flickers like a soul yearning for freedom.
entries.simplified: 一缕幽灵精华被囚禁在扭曲的牢笼中。它的光芒忽明忽暗，如同渴望自由的灵魂。
entries.traditional: 一縷幽靈精華被囚禁在扭曲的牢籠中。它的光芒忽明忽暗，如同渴望自由的靈魂。

entries.source: Cardboard courage stares forward bravely, despite knowing exactly what it is made of.
entries.simplified: 纸板做成的勇气英勇地直视前方，尽管它很清楚自己究竟是什么做的。
entries.traditional: 紙板做成的勇氣英勇地直視前方，儘管它很清楚自己究竟是什麼做的。

entries.source: Polished metal and a proud red plume carry old imperial discipline.
entries.simplified: 抛光金属与骄傲的红色羽冠承载着古老帝国的纪律。
entries.traditional: 拋光金屬與驕傲的紅色羽冠承載著古老帝國的紀律。

entries.source: An ornate mask used in ancient rituals. Rumored to ward off evil spirits.
entries.simplified: 一副用于古老仪式的华丽面具。据说能驱除邪灵。
entries.traditional: 一副用於古老儀式的華麗面具。據說能驅除邪靈。

entries.source: “Do not just swing for your enemies. Swing to protect the circle of folk standing behind you.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “别只顾着把武器挥向敌人。挥动它，也是为了保护身后围成一圈的人。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “別只顧著把武器揮向敵人。揮動它，也是為了保護身後圍成一圈的人。” — Suphara

entries.source: “Cold travels best in chains. Cast once, and let it find the next fool.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “寒意沿着锁链传得最快。施放一次，让它自己去找下一个蠢货。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “寒意沿著鎖鏈傳得最快。施放一次，讓它自己去找下一個蠢貨。” — Suphara

entries.source: Heavy chains solve the problem of spirits leaving before the battle ends.
entries.simplified: 沉重锁链解决了灵体在战斗结束前擅自离场的问题。
entries.traditional: 沉重鎖鏈解決了靈體在戰鬥結束前擅自離場的問題。

entries.source: “A holy blade is still steel, lad. Faith only matters if your arm does too.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “圣刃终究也是钢，小子。你的手臂若没力气，信仰也无济于事。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “聖刃終究也是鋼，小子。你的手臂若沒力氣，信仰也派不上用場。” — Suphara

entries.source: “Do not command chaos. Give it an edge and stand behind it.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “别想着号令混沌。给它开个锋，然后站到它后面去。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “別想著號令混沌。替它開個鋒，然後站到它後面去。” — Suphara

entries.source: Worn by the brave (or confused) poultry knights. Surprisingly durable.
entries.simplified: 由勇敢（或糊涂）的家禽骑士佩戴。意外地耐用。
entries.traditional: 由勇敢（或迷糊）的家禽騎士佩戴。意外地耐用。

entries.source: A bashful chick sits snugly on your head. Its warmth is oddly soothing.
entries.simplified: 一只害羞的小鸡紧贴着坐在你头上。它的温暖莫名令人安心。
entries.traditional: 一隻害羞的小雞緊貼著坐在你頭上。牠的溫暖莫名令人安心。

entries.source: Those teeth are not decorative, which is exactly what worries everyone.
entries.simplified: 那些牙齿可不是装饰，而这恰恰正是让所有人担心的地方。
entries.traditional: 那些牙齒可不是裝飾，而這恰恰就是讓所有人擔心的地方。

entries.source: Golden thread warms the robes, turning gentle gestures into quiet comfort.
entries.simplified: 金色丝线温暖着长袍，让轻柔的手势化作无声慰藉。
entries.traditional: 金色絲線溫暖著長袍，讓輕柔的手勢化作無聲慰藉。

entries.source: Soft glow follows each step, like prayers walking slightly ahead.
entries.simplified: 柔光追随着每一步，仿佛祈祷总是走在前方半步。
entries.traditional: 柔光跟隨著每一步，彷彿祈禱總是走在前方半步。

entries.source: Pale linen and renewal runes carry steady steps toward wounded allies.
entries.simplified: 淡色亚麻与复苏符文承载着走向受伤盟友的沉稳步伐。
entries.traditional: 淡色亞麻與復甦符文承載著走向受傷隊友的沉穩步伐。

entries.source: Soft fog curls around the loop, drifting like it missed a meeting.
entries.simplified: 柔雾缠绕着圆环，飘忽得像是错过了一场会议。
entries.traditional: 柔霧纏繞著圓環，飄忽得像是錯過了一場會議。

entries.source: Gilded pages glow hot enough to sear shadows and steady faith.
entries.simplified: 镀金书页灼热发光，足以烧灼阴影并稳固信仰。
entries.traditional: 鍍金書頁灼熱發光，足以灼燒陰影並穩固信念。

entries.source: Weathered scripture that holds the first prayer sung toward the heavens.
entries.simplified: 饱经风霜的经文，保存着第一声向苍穹唱出的祷告。
entries.traditional: 飽經風霜的經文，保存著第一聲朝天際唱出的禱告。

entries.source: “Write truth in light, and even old darkness has to blink.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “以光书写真理，就连古老的黑暗也得眨眼。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “以光寫下真理，就連古老的黑暗也得眨眼。” — Suphara

entries.source: “I copied Umbra’s curses, not their full hunger. Open it only when you are ready for the dark to answer.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “我抄下了 Umbra 的诅咒，但没把它们全部的饥渴也抄进去。只有当你准备好让黑暗回应时，才把它打开。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “我抄下了 Umbra 的詛咒，但沒把它們完整的飢渴也抄進去。只有當你準備好讓黑暗回應時，才把它打開。” — Suphara

entries.source: “I copied Vitae’s light as best I could. It mends flesh and steadies the living. May it carry you to victory.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “我尽力抄下了 Vitae 的光。它能修补血肉，稳住生者。愿它护送你走向胜利。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “我盡力抄下了 Vitae 的光。它能修補血肉，穩住生者。願它護送你走向勝利。” — Suphara

entries.source: A simple leather-bound book inscribed with common prayers. While plain in form, it channels the user's focus into gentle support magic.
entries.simplified: 一本朴素的皮革封面书籍，记载着常见祷文。外观虽不起眼，却能将使用者的专注引导为温和的辅助魔法。
entries.traditional: 一本樸素的皮革封面書籍，記載著常見禱文。外觀雖不起眼，卻能將使用者的專注引導為溫和的支援魔法。

entries.source: “Fancy blades win praise. Plain ones win fights. Keep it sharp, keep it close, and let the fool bleed first.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “花哨的刀能赢来喝彩。朴素的刀能赢下战斗。磨快它，带近些，让那个蠢货先流血。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “花俏的刀能贏來喝采。樸素的刀能贏下戰鬥。磨利它、帶近些，讓那個蠢貨先流血。” — Suphara

entries.source: Dust, sneezes, and awkward alley smells meet their soft cotton rival.
entries.simplified: 灰尘、喷嚏和巷子里难闻的怪味，都遇上了柔软棉布这个对手。
entries.traditional: 灰塵、噴嚏和巷弄裡難聞的怪味，都遇上了柔軟棉布這個對手。

entries.source: Golden feathers flare brightest when combat leaves no room for hesitation.
entries.simplified: 当战斗容不得半分犹豫时，金色羽毛便绽放出最耀眼的光芒。
entries.traditional: 當戰鬥容不得半分猶豫時，金色羽毛便綻放出最耀眼的光芒。

entries.source: Ruby feathers draw every eye before the first weapon moves.
entries.simplified: 第一件武器尚未挥动，红宝石般的羽毛便已吸引所有目光。
entries.traditional: 第一件武器尚未揮動，紅寶石般的羽毛便已吸引所有目光。

entries.source: Arena champions wore this crown because comfort clearly lost the argument.
entries.simplified: 竞技场冠军戴着这顶王冠，因为舒适显然输掉了争论。
entries.traditional: 競技場冠軍戴著這頂王冠，因為舒適顯然輸掉了爭論。

entries.source: “If judgment must fall, make sure it falls with good aim.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “既然审判必须降临，就确保它落得够准。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “既然審判必須降臨，就確保它落得夠準。” — Suphara

entries.source: After breaking their oaths, these Paladins turned from protectors to crusaders and honed their holy arts against their enemies.
entries.simplified: 这些 Paladins 背弃誓言后，不再担任守护者，而是化身征伐者，将圣术磨砺成对付敌人的利器。
entries.traditional: 這些 Paladins 背棄誓言後，不再擔任守護者，而是化身征伐者，將聖術磨礪成對付敵人的利器。

entries.source: Mana stones rattle inside, making every step sound slightly more expensive.
entries.simplified: Mana 石在里面叮当作响，让每一步听起来都贵了几分。
entries.traditional: Mana 石在裡面叮噹作響，讓每一步聽起來都貴了幾分。

entries.source: “Some hammers break stone. This wee monster breaks the space around it.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “有些锤子能碎石。这只小怪物连周围的空间都能砸碎。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “有些鎚子能碎石。這隻小怪物連周圍的空間都能砸碎。” — Suphara

entries.source: Elemental color runs through winglike shards, shimmering with quiet power.
entries.simplified: 元素色彩流淌于翼状碎片之间，闪烁着沉静的力量。
entries.traditional: 元素色彩流淌於翼狀碎片之間，閃爍著沉靜的力量。

entries.source: Sacred paper keeps spirits away, provided nobody sticks it upside down.
entries.simplified: 圣纸能让灵体退避，前提是没人把它倒着贴。
entries.traditional: 聖紙能讓靈體退避，前提是沒人把它倒著貼。

entries.source: The lock breathes faintly, which most librarians consider a serious problem.
entries.simplified: 锁扣正轻轻呼吸，而大多数图书管理员都认为这问题非常严重。
entries.traditional: 鎖扣正輕輕呼吸，而大多數圖書館員都認為這問題非常嚴重。

entries.source: Twin blades wait quietly, because loud daggers rarely keep their jobs.
entries.simplified: 双刃静静等待着，因为太吵的匕首通常保不住自己的饭碗。
entries.traditional: 雙刃靜靜等待著，因為太吵的匕首通常保不住自己的飯碗。

entries.source: Raven-black feathers spread with a whisper that sounds like bad news.
entries.simplified: 鸦黑羽毛伴着低语展开，听起来像个坏消息。
entries.traditional: 鴉黑羽毛伴著低語展開，聽起來像個壞消息。

entries.source: Blackened hide keeps dull heat close, quickening blood beneath the fingers.
entries.simplified: 焦黑兽皮将闷热紧贴肌肤，催动指间的血液更快流转。
entries.traditional: 焦黑獸皮將悶熱緊貼肌膚，催動指間的血液更快流轉。

entries.source: Each bead holds a sunrise vow, worn smooth by patient hands.
entries.simplified: 每一颗珠子都封存着日出时立下的誓言，被耐心的双手磨得光滑。
entries.traditional: 每一顆珠子都封存著日出時立下的誓言，被耐心的雙手磨得光滑。

entries.source: “Morning light is gentle until you forge spikes into it.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “晨光本来很温柔，直到你给它锻上尖刺。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “晨光本來很溫柔，直到你替它鍛上尖刺。” — Suphara

entries.source: A first-light dagger that balances steel and spellcraft as cleanly as dawn divides night.
entries.simplified: 一柄沐浴初光的匕首，将钢铁与法术技艺平衡得如同黎明划分长夜般利落。
entries.traditional: 一柄沐浴初光的匕首，將鋼鐵與法術技藝平衡得如同黎明劃分長夜般俐落。

entries.source: Those glowing eyes promise mischief, bad decisions, and absolutely no apologies.
entries.simplified: 那双发光的眼睛许诺着恶作剧、糟糕决定，以及绝无半点歉意。
entries.traditional: 那雙發光的眼睛承諾著惡作劇、糟糕決定，以及絕無半點歉意。

entries.source: Violet horns whisper dark ambition, then pretend they said nothing.
entries.simplified: 紫色犄角低语着黑暗野心，随后假装自己什么都没说。
entries.traditional: 紫色犄角低語著黑暗野心，隨後假裝自己什麼都沒說。

entries.source: Raw destructive focus burns through defenses, though the wielder pays for every shortcut.
entries.simplified: 纯粹的毁灭专注会烧穿防御，但持有者也要为每一次捷径付出代价。
entries.traditional: 純粹的毀滅專注會燒穿防禦，但持有者也要為每一次捷徑付出代價。

entries.source: Blue scales, tiny charm, and prehistoric storage make burdens less boring.
entries.simplified: 蓝色鳞片、小巧魅力与史前收纳空间，让负担不再那么无聊。
entries.traditional: 藍色鱗片、小巧魅力與史前收納空間，讓負擔不再那麼無聊。

entries.source: Plain bracers with many slots, waiting for a disciple to define their path.
entries.simplified: 朴素的护腕带有许多插槽，等待一名弟子亲手决定自己的道路。
entries.traditional: 樸素的護腕帶有許多插槽，等待一名弟子親手決定自己的道路。

entries.source: Unadorned training cloth leaves room for power chosen through careful preparation.
entries.simplified: 未经装饰的训练布料，为通过谨慎准备所选择的力量留出空间。
entries.traditional: 未經裝飾的訓練布料，為透過謹慎準備所選擇的力量留出空間。

entries.source: Quiet steps carry the discipline of someone still deciding what they will become.
entries.simplified: 沉静的步伐承载着尚在决定自己将成为什么之人的自律。
entries.traditional: 沉靜的步伐承載著尚在決定自己將成為何種人物的自律。

entries.source: A simple visage masks uncertainty while leaving room for many future answers.
entries.simplified: 一张朴素的面容遮住不确定，也为未来的诸多答案留出余地。
entries.traditional: 一張樸素的面容遮住不確定，也為未來的諸多答案留出餘地。

entries.source: Layered wraps hold steady through practice, mistakes, and the first shape of mastery.
entries.simplified: 层叠裹布在练习、失误与初见雏形的精通中始终稳固。
entries.traditional: 層疊裹布在練習、失誤與初見雛形的精通中始終穩固。

entries.source: Sharp angles and scholar craft keep martial focus close at hand.
entries.simplified: 锐利棱角与学者工艺，让武艺专注始终近在手边。
entries.traditional: 銳利稜角與學者工藝，讓武藝專注始終近在手邊。

entries.source: Blackened steel curves wide, carrying grim weight through every swing.
entries.simplified: 焦黑钢铁弯成宽阔弧线，让每一次挥击都承载着阴沉重量。
entries.traditional: 焦黑鋼鐵彎成寬闊弧線，讓每一次揮擊都承載著陰沉重量。

entries.source: Regret-dark metal and a crimson spike make betrayal feel ceremonial.
entries.simplified: 悔恨般黯黑的金属与猩红尖刺，让背叛也显得像一场仪式。
entries.traditional: 悔恨般黯黑的金屬與猩紅尖刺，讓背叛也顯得像一場儀式。

entries.source: The skull label answers most questions before anyone asks twice.
entries.simplified: 骷髅标签在任何人追问之前，就已经回答了大多数问题。
entries.traditional: 骷髏標籤在任何人追問之前，就已經回答了大多數問題。

entries.source: Two spiked heads mean twice the enthusiasm for breaking hard things.
entries.simplified: 两个带刺锤头，意味着砸碎坚硬事物时拥有双倍的热情。
entries.traditional: 兩個帶刺鎚頭，意味著砸碎堅硬事物時擁有雙倍的熱情。

entries.source: Scaled plates glare forward, making polite conversations much harder nearby.
entries.simplified: 鳞甲恶狠狠地瞪向前方，让附近的礼貌交谈变得困难许多。
entries.traditional: 鱗甲惡狠狠地瞪向前方，讓附近的禮貌交談變得困難許多。

entries.source: A jagged scale-point channels old draconic fury through each thrust.
entries.simplified: 锯齿状鳞尖将古老龙怒灌注进每一次突刺。
entries.traditional: 鋸齒狀鱗尖將古老龍怒灌注進每一次突刺。

entries.source: This helm suggests dragon-slaying confidence, even when confidence came separately.
entries.simplified: 这顶头盔散发着屠龙般的自信，即使那份自信需要另行配备。
entries.traditional: 這頂頭盔散發著屠龍般的自信，即使那份自信需要另行配備。

entries.source: The bat naps upside-down, contributing ominous vibes and occasional usefulness.
entries.simplified: 蝙蝠倒挂着打盹，贡献出不祥气息，以及偶尔的一点用处。
entries.traditional: 蝙蝠倒掛著打盹，貢獻出不祥氣息，以及偶爾的一點用處。

entries.source: A sleepy mole nests overhead, waiting to throw dirt professionally.
entries.simplified: 一只困倦的鼹鼠在头顶筑巢，等着以专业手法扬起泥土。
entries.traditional: 一隻睏倦的鼴鼠在頭頂築巢，等著以專業手法揚起泥土。

entries.source: Smug little storm cat rests there, fully aware it looks important.
entries.simplified: 那只得意洋洋的小风暴猫趴在那里，完全知道自己看起来很重要。
entries.traditional: 那隻得意洋洋的小風暴貓趴在那裡，完全知道自己看起來很重要。

entries.source: The blossom droops sleepily, then remembers battle is happening and helps.
entries.simplified: 花朵困倦地低垂着，随后想起战斗还在继续，便出手相助。
entries.traditional: 花朵睏倦地低垂著，隨後想起戰鬥還在繼續，便出手相助。

entries.source: This pup snoozes warmly until danger gives it barking permission.
entries.simplified: 这只小狗暖洋洋地打着盹，直到危险准许它放声吠叫。
entries.traditional: 這隻小狗暖洋洋地打著盹，直到危險准許牠放聲吠叫。

entries.source: Two blades ride together, because one dramatic entrance was not enough.
entries.simplified: 两把刀并肩而行，因为一次戏剧性的登场显然还不够。
entries.traditional: 兩把刀並肩而行，因為一次戲劇性的登場顯然還不夠。

entries.source: “The dark is not cowardly. It just knows when to bite.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “黑暗并不怯懦。它只是知道该在什么时候咬下去。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “黑暗並不怯懦。它只是知道該在什麼時候咬下去。” — Suphara

entries.source: Sand chewed the brim, but the hat remains annoyingly proud.
entries.simplified: 沙砾啃噬了帽檐，可这顶帽子依旧骄傲得令人恼火。
entries.traditional: 沙礫啃噬了帽緣，可這頂帽子依舊驕傲得令人惱火。

entries.source: “If the ground must complain, make sure it complains under their feet.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “要是大地非得抱怨，就让它在敌人脚下抱怨。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “要是大地非得抱怨，就讓它在敵人腳下抱怨。” — Suphara

entries.source: “Let the earth hold you firm; it will steady you through rock and stone.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “让大地稳稳托住你；无论岩石还是山峦，它都会助你站定。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “讓大地穩穩托住你；無論岩石還是山巒，它都會助你站穩。” — Suphara

entries.source: “Throw the shadow before the darkness knows you’re gone.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “在黑暗察觉你已离开之前，先把影子掷出去。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “在黑暗察覺你已離開之前，先把影子擲出去。” — Suphara

entries.source: Light and shadow braid through twin edges, cutting in perfect rhythm.
entries.simplified: 光与影交织于双刃之间，以完美的节奏切割一切。
entries.traditional: 光與影交織於雙刃之間，以完美節奏切割一切。

entries.source: Wax seals the brew tightly, preventing leaks and suspicious taste tests.
entries.simplified: 蜡封将药液牢牢封住，既防泄漏，也防可疑的偷尝。
entries.traditional: 蠟封將藥液牢牢封住，既防滲漏，也防可疑的偷嚐。

entries.source: Red eyes glare from cruel hide, warmed by darker ambitions.
entries.simplified: 红色双眼从残酷的兽皮中怒视，因更加阴暗的野心而升温。
entries.traditional: 紅色雙眼從殘酷的獸皮中怒視，因更加陰暗的野心而升溫。

entries.source: A burning gem shines at the top, eager for flame.
entries.simplified: 一颗燃烧的宝石在顶端闪耀，迫不及待地渴望火焰。
entries.traditional: 一顆燃燒的寶石在頂端閃耀，迫不及待地渴望火焰。

entries.source: One verdant gem softens the gold, regal without losing warmth.
entries.simplified: 一枚翠绿宝石柔化了金色的威严，使其尊贵却不失温暖。
entries.traditional: 一枚翠綠寶石柔化了金色的威嚴，使其尊貴卻不失溫暖。

entries.source: Calibrated mana splits along the edge, breaking into elemental force.
entries.simplified: 校准后的魔力沿刃缘分流，迸裂成元素力量。
entries.traditional: 校準後的魔力沿刃緣分流，迸裂成元素力量。

entries.source: Opposing forces meet inside the forbidden edge.
entries.simplified: 彼此对立的力量在禁忌之刃中交汇。
entries.traditional: 彼此對立的力量在禁忌之刃中交會。

entries.source: Color shifts along the edge, answering each battlefield with a different threat.
entries.simplified: 色彩沿刃缘变幻，以不同威胁回应每一片战场。
entries.traditional: 色彩沿刃緣變幻，以不同威脅回應每一片戰場。

entries.source: “Winter owns the ground if you let it stay. Plant the frost and make them pay.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “你若任由寒冬停留，大地便归它所有。种下霜冻，让他们付出代价。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “你若任由寒冬停留，大地便歸它所有。種下霜凍，讓他們付出代價。” — Suphara

entries.source: “Mercy has its place. So does ending a problem cleanly.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “仁慈自有其位置。干净利落地结束麻烦也是如此。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “仁慈自有其位置。乾淨俐落地結束麻煩也是如此。” — Suphara

entries.source: A sanctified tome etched with ancient scripture. Its words ripple outward, blessing allies and scouring the unholy with lingering light.
entries.simplified: 一本刻有古老经文的圣化典籍。书中文字如涟漪般向外扩散，赐福盟友，并以久久不散的圣光净除邪祟。
entries.traditional: 一本刻有古老經文的聖化典籍。書中文字如漣漪般向外擴散，賜福隊友，並以久久不散的聖光淨除邪祟。

entries.source: Holy seals coil around the staff, turning patient rites into swift exorcism.
entries.simplified: 神圣封印盘绕在法杖上，将耐心的仪式化作迅捷的驱魔术。
entries.traditional: 神聖封印盤繞在法杖上，將耐心的儀式化作迅捷的驅魔術。

entries.source: The eye watches everything, including choices you hoped it missed.
entries.simplified: 这只眼睛注视着一切，包括那些你希望它没看见的选择。
entries.traditional: 這隻眼睛注視著一切，包括那些你希望它沒看見的選擇。

entries.source: One eye rests while the other handles reputation management nearby.
entries.simplified: 一只眼睛休息，另一只则负责处理附近的名声问题。
entries.traditional: 一隻眼睛休息，另一隻則負責處理附近的名聲問題。

entries.source: Sharp sight lives here, along with very strong bird opinions.
entries.simplified: 锐利的目光寄居于此，连同一套异常强烈的鸟类意见。
entries.traditional: 銳利的目光寄居於此，連同一套異常強烈的鳥類意見。

entries.source: Feathers shape the hood for scouts who enjoy looking judgmental.
entries.simplified: 羽毛塑成这顶兜帽，适合那些喜欢摆出评判神情的斥候。
entries.traditional: 羽毛塑成這頂兜帽，適合那些喜歡擺出評判神情的斥候。

entries.source: A small fang hangs close, because subtle threats still count.
entries.simplified: 一枚小小的尖牙贴身垂挂，因为含蓄的威胁也依然算数。
entries.traditional: 一枚小小的尖牙貼身垂掛，因為含蓄的威脅也依然算數。

entries.source: Lunar darkness coats the curve, drinking blood and mana together.
entries.simplified: 月色的黑暗覆上弯刃，同时啜饮鲜血与魔力。
entries.traditional: 月色的黑暗覆上彎刃，同時啜飲鮮血與魔力。

entries.source: Jade plumes rise from the crown, bright with old forest ceremony.
entries.simplified: 翡翠羽饰从王冠上高高扬起，闪耀着古老森林仪典的光辉。
entries.traditional: 翡翠羽飾從王冠上高高揚起，閃耀著古老森林儀典的光輝。

entries.source: Light feathers favor quick messengers and anyone fleeing consequences outdoors.
entries.simplified: 轻盈羽毛偏爱迅捷的信使，以及任何正在户外逃避后果的人。
entries.traditional: 輕盈羽毛偏愛迅捷的信使，以及任何正在戶外逃避後果的人。

entries.source: Lightweight soles favor agility, panic, and excellent last-second decisions.
entries.simplified: 轻巧鞋底偏爱敏捷、慌乱，以及最后一刻做出的绝妙决定。
entries.traditional: 輕巧鞋底偏愛敏捷、慌亂，以及最後一刻做出的絕妙決定。

entries.source: Balanced soles keep aim steady, even when panic suggests otherwise.
entries.simplified: 平衡的鞋底让瞄准保持稳定，即使慌乱提出了不同意见。
entries.traditional: 平衡的鞋底讓瞄準保持穩定，即使慌亂提出了不同意見。

entries.source: Light shoes will clear the mind but still expect you to walk.
entries.simplified: 轻便的鞋子能让思绪清明，但依然要求你自己走路。
entries.traditional: 輕便的鞋子能讓思緒清明，但依然要求你自己走路。

entries.source: Trouble misses more often when these shoes decide to help.
entries.simplified: 当这双鞋决定帮忙时，麻烦往往更容易扑空。
entries.traditional: 當這雙鞋決定幫忙時，麻煩往往更容易撲空。

entries.source: Simple footwear designed to support raw physical strength.
entries.simplified: 为支撑纯粹肉体力量而设计的朴素鞋履。
entries.traditional: 為支撐純粹肉體力量而設計的樸素鞋履。

entries.source: Sturdy soles support long fights when strain refuses to end.
entries.simplified: 坚实鞋底支撑漫长战斗，即使疲劳迟迟不肯结束。
entries.traditional: 堅實鞋底支撐漫長戰鬥，即使疲勞遲遲不肯結束。

entries.source: Enchanted fronds soften movement until the underbrush seems to help.
entries.simplified: 附魔蕨叶柔化了动作，仿佛连灌木丛都在出手相助。
entries.traditional: 附魔蕨葉柔化了動作，彷彿連灌木叢都在出手相助。

entries.source: Bright red cloth brings celebration, cheer, and mild hat confidence.
entries.simplified: 鲜红布料带来庆典、欢笑，以及一点点来自帽子的自信。
entries.traditional: 鮮紅布料帶來慶典、歡笑，以及一點點來自帽子的自信。

entries.source: Firecrackers crackle happily, making enemies question several nearby decisions properly.
entries.simplified: 爆竹欢快地噼啪作响，让敌人认真反思自己刚才在附近做出的几个决定。
entries.traditional: 爆竹歡快地劈啪作響，讓敵人認真反省自己剛才在附近做出的幾個決定。

entries.source: Turtle charm and tassels promise luck, patience, and a great time.
entries.simplified: 乌龟饰物与流苏许诺着好运、耐心，以及一段欢乐时光。
entries.traditional: 烏龜飾物與流蘇承諾著好運、耐心，以及一段歡樂時光。

entries.source: The ribbon looks cheerful, but the jingling remains suspicious.
entries.simplified: 缎带看起来喜气洋洋，但盒里的叮当声依旧十分可疑。
entries.traditional: 緞帶看起來喜氣洋洋，但盒裡的叮噹聲依舊十分可疑。

entries.source: “Do not fear the flame. Teach fire to behave.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “别惧怕火焰。教会它守规矩。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “別懼怕火焰。教會它守規矩。” — Suphara

entries.source: Warm horns flicker restlessly, like embers practicing dramatic entrances properly.
entries.simplified: 温暖的犄角不安地闪烁，像余烬正在认真排练华丽登场。
entries.traditional: 溫暖的犄角不安地閃爍，像餘燼正在認真排練華麗登場。

entries.source: Engraved with fiery seals, these blades erupt with bursts of flame, scorching enemies in a splash of fire.
entries.simplified: 这些刀刃刻有烈焰封印，出手时会爆发火焰，在一片烈火中灼烧敌人。
entries.traditional: 這些刀刃刻有烈焰封印，出手時會爆發火焰，在一片烈火中灼燒敵人。

entries.source: “A small blade can still start a wild fire.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “小小的刀刃，也能点燃一场燎原大火。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “小小的刀刃，也能點燃一場燎原大火。” — Suphara

entries.source: Tailored for long-distance messengers and nimble thieves, these padded pants never chafe and always breathe, no matter how far or fast you run.
entries.simplified: 这条加垫长裤专为长途信使与敏捷盗贼裁制，无论跑得多远、多快，都不会磨伤皮肤，始终透气舒适。
entries.traditional: 這條加墊長褲專為長途信使與敏捷盜賊裁製，無論跑得多遠、多快，都不會磨傷肌膚，始終透氣舒適。

entries.source: Old metal, loud opinions, and terrible subtlety share one barrel.
entries.simplified: 老旧金属、响亮意见与糟糕透顶的隐蔽性，共用着同一根枪管。
entries.traditional: 老舊金屬、響亮意見與糟糕透頂的隱蔽性，共用著同一根槍管。

entries.source: Leather and stone settle the body before attention sharpens inward.
entries.simplified: 皮革与石块让身体沉静下来，随后专注向内收紧。
entries.traditional: 皮革與石塊讓身體沉靜下來，隨後專注向內收緊。

entries.source: Leaves and roots sit proudly overhead, because nature enjoys accessories.
entries.simplified: 树叶与根须骄傲地坐在头顶，因为大自然也喜欢配饰。
entries.traditional: 樹葉與根鬚驕傲地坐在頭頂，因為大自然也喜歡配飾。

entries.source: Leaf-sewn armor carries soft renewal, sheltering the wearer with forest patience.
entries.simplified: 叶片缝制的护甲蕴含柔和的复苏之力，以森林般的耐心庇护穿戴者。
entries.traditional: 葉片縫製的護甲蘊含柔和的復甦之力，以森林般的耐心庇護穿戴者。

entries.source: Light leafwork shoes keep spellsteps quick and quiet beneath green boughs.
entries.simplified: 轻盈的叶编鞋让施法步伐在绿荫下保持迅捷而无声。
entries.traditional: 輕盈的葉編鞋讓施法步伐在綠蔭下保持迅捷而無聲。

entries.source: Living fibers breathe with each stride, returning strength like rain through roots.
entries.simplified: 活体纤维随着每一步呼吸，像雨水渗入根系般返还力量。
entries.traditional: 活體纖維隨著每一步呼吸，像雨水滲入根系般返還力量。

entries.source: “Master Neoian taught me to keep charging forward. I forged this wall for those who follow him, and for every shield of the 42nd Paladin Legion.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “Master Neoian 教会我要不断向前冲锋。我为追随他的人，也为第42 Paladin 军团的每一面盾牌，锻造了这道壁垒。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “Master Neoian 教會我要不斷向前衝鋒。我為追隨他的人，也為第42 Paladin 軍團的每一面盾牌，鍛造了這道壁壘。” — Suphara

entries.source: “Mark them once with cold, and every step after belongs to you.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “先用寒意标记他们一次，之后的每一步都由你掌控。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “先用寒意標記他們一次，之後的每一步都由你掌控。” — Suphara

entries.simplified: “寒牙留下的教训最深。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “寒牙留下的教訓最深。” — Suphara

entries.source: Cold energy leaks from the helm, discouraging hugs and poor choices.
entries.simplified: 寒气从头盔中渗出，让拥抱和糟糕决定都知难而退。
entries.traditional: 寒氣從頭盔中滲出，讓擁抱和糟糕決定都知難而退。

entries.source: Pale crystal chills the staff, and probably your fingers too.
entries.simplified: 苍白水晶让法杖冰冷刺骨，大概也会冻着你的手指。
entries.traditional: 蒼白水晶讓法杖冰冷刺骨，大概也會凍著你的手指。

entries.source: “Ice is sharper than steel when you teach it discipline.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “只要教会寒冰守纪律，它就比钢铁更加锋利。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “只要教會寒冰守規矩，它就比鋼鐵更加鋒利。” — Suphara

entries.source: Green fruit rattles mysteriously, daring anyone to call it lunch.
entries.simplified: 绿色果实神秘地咔啦作响，挑衅着任何敢把它称作午餐的人。
entries.traditional: 綠色果實神祕地喀啦作響，挑釁著任何敢把它稱作午餐的人。

entries.source: You feel a bit more private with these on. You now have an impressive mustache.
entries.simplified: 戴上它们后，你觉得隐私多了一点。现在你还拥有一撇令人印象深刻的八字胡。
entries.traditional: 戴上它們後，你覺得隱私多了一點。現在你還擁有一撇令人印象深刻的八字鬍。

entries.source: A thick fur-lined hood. Keeps the wearer warm in the coldest regions.
entries.simplified: 一顶衬有厚实毛皮的兜帽。即使在最寒冷的地区，也能让穿戴者保持温暖。
entries.traditional: 一頂襯有厚實毛皮的兜帽。即使在最寒冷的地區，也能讓穿戴者保持溫暖。

entries.source: If you can see this message, you are standing too close to the Game Master. Beware of Bonk!
entries.simplified: 如果你看得到这条信息，说明你离 Game Master 太近了。当心 Bonk！
entries.traditional: 如果你看得到這則訊息，表示你離 Game Master 太近了。當心 Bonk！

entries.source: Greatly increases all stats, Move Speed, and damage reduction. Grants Game Master Cloaking and Resurrection.
entries.simplified: 大幅提高所有属性、移动速度与伤害减免。获得 Game Master Cloaking 和 Resurrection。
entries.traditional: 大幅提高所有屬性、移動速度與傷害減免。獲得 Game Master Cloaking 和 Resurrection。

entries.source: Rotating barrels explain themselves loudly, repeatedly, and with enthusiasm.
entries.simplified: 旋转枪管会以响亮、反复且兴致勃勃的方式说明自己。
entries.traditional: 旋轉槍管會用響亮、反覆而且興致勃勃的方式說明自己。

entries.source: A tiny specter floats overhead, judging your posture in silence.
entries.simplified: 一个小幽灵飘在头顶，无声地评判着你的姿势。
entries.traditional: 一個小幽靈飄在頭頂，無聲地評判著你的姿勢。

entries.source: Blue shards glow in the gnarled staff whenever danger draws near.
entries.simplified: 每当危险临近，蓝色碎片便会在扭曲的法杖上发光。
entries.traditional: 每當危險接近，藍色碎片便會在扭曲的法杖上發光。

entries.source: Responsive gloves follow sudden movement before hesitation catches up fully.
entries.simplified: 灵敏的手套紧随突发动作，在犹豫彻底追上来之前先行一步。
entries.traditional: 靈敏的手套緊隨突發動作，在猶豫完全追上來之前搶先一步。

entries.source: Steady grip and refined balance guide each strike toward accuracy.
entries.simplified: 稳固的握持与精细的平衡，引导每一击精准命中。
entries.traditional: 穩固的握持與精細的平衡，引導每一擊精準命中。

entries.source: Arcane patterns etched in their fabric channel thought into spellcraft.
entries.simplified: 织物上镌刻的奥术纹路，将思绪引导为法术技艺。
entries.traditional: 織物上刻劃的奧術紋路，將思緒引導為施法技藝。

entries.source: Luck gathers around these gloves, especially when planning has failed.
entries.simplified: 幸运聚集在这双手套周围，尤其是在计划已经失败的时候。
entries.traditional: 幸運聚集在這雙手套周圍，尤其是在計畫已經失敗的時候。

entries.source: Crushing might gathers in the grip before each heavy punch.
entries.simplified: 每次沉重拳击之前，碾压般的力量都会汇聚于双手。
entries.traditional: 每次沉重拳擊之前，碾壓般的力量都會匯聚於雙手。

entries.source: Heavy hands meet punishment calmly, turning impact into stubborn resolve.
entries.simplified: 沉重的双手平静承受惩罚，将冲击化作顽强的决心。
entries.traditional: 沉重的雙手平靜承受懲罰，將衝擊化作頑強的決心。

entries.source: Lion-faced gold waits for courage, not victory, to wake it.
entries.simplified: 狮面黄金等待勇气，而非胜利，将它唤醒。
entries.traditional: 獅面黃金等待勇氣，而非勝利，將它喚醒。

entries.source: “Gold makes for fine jewelry, but it looks better when it cracks armor.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “黄金适合做精美首饰，不过用来砸裂铠甲时更好看。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “黃金適合做精美首飾，不過用來砸裂鎧甲時更好看。” — Suphara

entries.source: Polished gold announces the champion's presence before the wearer proves anything.
entries.simplified: 抛光黄金在穿戴者证明自己之前，便先宣告冠军登场。
entries.traditional: 拋光黃金在穿戴者證明自己之前，便先宣告冠軍登場。

entries.source: Light on the head, heavy with everyone else's expectations outside.
entries.simplified: 戴在头上轻若无物，却沉甸甸地承载着外界所有人的期待。
entries.traditional: 戴在頭上輕若無物，卻沉甸甸地承載著外界所有人的期待。

entries.source: “Gold is soft. This hammer is not.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “黄金很软。这把锤子可不软。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “黃金很軟。這把鎚子可不軟。” — Suphara

entries.source: Pirates, merchants, and overconfident gamblers all respect shiny circles.
entries.simplified: 海盗、商人和过度自信的赌徒，都尊重闪亮的圆环。
entries.traditional: 海盜、商人和過度自信的賭徒，都尊重閃亮的圓環。

entries.source: The hand reaches out, which is rude behavior for pottery.
entries.simplified: 那只手伸了出来；对陶器而言，这实在很没礼貌。
entries.traditional: 那隻手伸了出來；對陶器而言，這實在很沒禮貌。

entries.source: Pale teeth gnash silently, because helmets should not need jaws.
entries.simplified: 苍白牙齿无声咬合，因为头盔根本不该长着一副下颌。
entries.traditional: 蒼白牙齒無聲咬合，因為頭盔根本不該長著一副下顎。

entries.source: Rib-like plating channels necrotic force while violet sigils guard the wearer.
entries.simplified: 肋骨般的甲片引导死灵力量，紫罗兰色符印则守护穿戴者。
entries.traditional: 肋骨般的甲片引導死靈力量，紫羅蘭色符印則守護穿戴者。

entries.source: Purple-stained bone soles release toxic resonance with every careful step.
entries.simplified: 染紫的骨质鞋底在每一步谨慎落下时释放毒性共鸣。
entries.traditional: 染紫的骨質鞋底在每一步謹慎落下時釋放毒性共鳴。

entries.source: Spectral cords bind shorn bone, pulsing with hexing protection underneath.
entries.simplified: 幽灵般的绳索束住削切骨片，下方脉动着施咒防护。
entries.traditional: 幽靈般的繩索束住削切骨片，下方脈動著施咒防護。

entries.source: “Curses love old stone. Break the stone, and they lose their hiding place.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “诅咒喜欢藏在古老石头里。砸碎石头，它们就无处藏身。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “詛咒喜歡藏在古老石頭裡。砸碎石頭，它們就無處藏身。” — Suphara

entries.source: Dense shellwork handles punishment with patient, turtle-adjacent confidence.
entries.simplified: 密实的甲壳构造带着耐心而近似乌龟的自信承受打击。
entries.traditional: 密實的甲殼構造帶著耐心而近似烏龜的自信承受打擊。

entries.source: “A reaper’s edge should take only what it can carry.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “死神的锋刃只该收割自己带得走的东西。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “死神的鋒刃只該收割自己帶得走的東西。” — Suphara

entries.source: Balanced steel keeps city guards brave and paperwork slightly easier.
entries.simplified: 平衡良好的钢铁让城卫更勇敢，也让文书工作稍微轻松一点。
entries.traditional: 平衡良好的鋼鐵讓城衛更勇敢，也讓文書工作稍微輕鬆一點。

entries.source: A cheerful forest charm that somehow appeals to assassins.
entries.simplified: 一件欢快的森林饰物，不知为何特别讨刺客喜欢。
entries.traditional: 一件歡快的森林飾物，不知為何特別討刺客喜歡。

entries.source: This scythe gathers spirit from wounds, not wheat from fields.
entries.simplified: 这柄镰刀从伤口中收割灵魂，而不是从田野里收割小麦。
entries.traditional: 這柄鐮刀從傷口中收割靈魂，而不是從田野裡收割小麥。

entries.source: “Aim like the bolt is already there, then let the crank prove you right.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “瞄准时，就当弩矢早已命中；然后让绞盘证明你没错。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “瞄準時，就當弩箭早已命中；然後讓絞盤證明你沒錯。” — Suphara

entries.source: Black iron clasps the crimson relic around a faint inner beat.
entries.simplified: 黑铁扣紧猩红遗物，环绕着内部微弱的搏动。
entries.traditional: 黑鐵扣緊猩紅遺物，環繞著內部微弱的搏動。

entries.source: Heart lenses deflect rejection, or at least make it easier to endure.
entries.simplified: 心形镜片能挡开拒绝，至少也能让它更容易熬过去。
entries.traditional: 心形鏡片能擋開拒絕，至少也能讓它比較容易熬過去。

entries.source: The heart swings gently, making subtlety pack up and leave.
entries.simplified: 心形坠饰轻轻摇摆，让含蓄直接收拾包袱离开。
entries.traditional: 心形墜飾輕輕搖擺，讓含蓄直接收拾包袱離開。

entries.source: “Some flames warm the hearth. Some flames pierce the soul.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “有些火焰温暖炉边。有些火焰刺穿灵魂。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “有些火焰溫暖爐邊。有些火焰刺穿靈魂。” — Suphara

entries.source: Modeled after a savage demon beast, its cursed teeth thirst for battle. Best not to wear it at night.
entries.simplified: 仿照凶残恶魔野兽制成，受诅咒的利齿渴望战斗。最好别在夜里戴它。
entries.traditional: 仿照凶殘惡魔野獸製成，受詛咒的利齒渴望戰鬥。最好別在夜裡戴它。

entries.source: Plain brown cloth helps wanderers avoid people, questions, and invitations.
entries.simplified: 朴素的棕布帮助流浪者躲开人群、问题和邀请。
entries.traditional: 樸素的棕布幫助流浪者避開人群、問題和邀請。

entries.source: The hat glows at night, which makes hiding much less convenient.
entries.simplified: 这顶帽子会在夜里发光，让藏身变得麻烦得多。
entries.traditional: 這頂帽子會在夜裡發光，讓藏身變得麻煩得多。

entries.source: “Hold the light steady. It turns judgment aside when your knees would rather run.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “稳稳托住光芒。它会在你的膝盖更想逃跑时替你挡开审判。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “穩穩托住光芒。它會在你的膝蓋更想逃跑時替你擋開審判。” — Suphara

entries.source: “Mercy and judgment share a handle. Choose carefully.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “仁慈与审判共用一根柄。谨慎选择。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “仁慈與審判共用一根柄。謹慎選擇。” — Suphara

entries.source: Infernal chaos curls through the horn, ignoring every safety lesson.
entries.simplified: 地狱般的混沌盘绕于犄角之中，无视每一条安全教训。
entries.traditional: 地獄般的混沌盤繞於犄角之中，無視每一條安全教訓。

entries.source: Holy iron and savage horns argue across the same visor.
entries.simplified: 神圣铁甲与野蛮犄角在同一面甲上争论不休。
entries.traditional: 神聖鐵甲與野蠻犄角在同一面甲上爭論不休。

entries.source: Curved horns add authority, intimidation, and several doorway problems.
entries.simplified: 弯曲的犄角增添威严、威慑力，以及若干穿门难题。
entries.traditional: 彎曲的犄角增添威嚴、威懾力，以及若干穿門難題。

entries.source: Crude steel works quickly when finesse has wandered off somewhere.
entries.simplified: 粗制钢铁在精巧手法不知溜到哪里去时，依然能迅速解决问题。
entries.traditional: 粗製鋼鐵在精巧手法不知溜到哪裡去時，依然能迅速解決問題。

entries.source: Long reach keeps danger away, which hunters generally appreciate.
entries.simplified: 长长的攻击距离能让危险保持在外，而猎人通常很欣赏这一点。
entries.traditional: 長長的攻擊距離能讓危險保持在外，而獵人通常很欣賞這一點。

entries.source: Gemstone eyes never blink, which somehow makes everything worse.
entries.simplified: 宝石般的眼睛从不眨动，不知为何让一切显得更加糟糕。
entries.traditional: 寶石般的眼睛從不眨動，不知為何讓一切顯得更加糟糕。

entries.source: Heavy iron faith hangs there, making questionable priests look official.
entries.simplified: 沉重的铁制信仰垂在那里，让可疑的祭司也显得颇为正式。
entries.traditional: 沉重的鐵製信仰垂在那裡，讓可疑的祭司也顯得頗為正式。

entries.source: Old ship plating that blocks blows and remembers the ocean.
entries.simplified: 能挡住攻击、也记得海洋的旧船装甲板。
entries.traditional: 能擋住攻擊、也記得海洋的舊船裝甲板。

entries.source: A heavy shield that meets desperate blows with stubborn, unflinching iron.
entries.simplified: 一面沉重的盾牌，以顽固而毫不退缩的钢铁迎接孤注一掷的猛击。
entries.traditional: 一面沉重的盾牌，以頑固而毫不退縮的鋼鐵迎接孤注一擲的猛擊。

entries.source: Orange trim adds style to the business of being hit.
entries.simplified: 橙色饰边为挨打这门差事增添了几分格调。
entries.traditional: 橘色飾邊為挨打這門差事增添了幾分格調。

entries.source: Heavy holy spikes follow behind, ruining chairs and wicked intentions.
entries.simplified: 沉重的神圣尖刺跟随在后，既毁椅子，也毁邪念。
entries.traditional: 沉重的神聖尖刺跟隨在後，既毀椅子，也毀邪念。

entries.source: “Simple iron, sharp points, and no room for negotiation.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “简单的铁、锋利的尖刺，绝无讨价还价的余地。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “簡單的鐵、鋒利的尖刺，絕無討價還價的餘地。” — Suphara

entries.source: Scrap-forged blades choose carnage because elegance never returned their letters.
entries.simplified: 废铁锻成的刀刃选择杀戮，因为优雅从未回过它们的信。
entries.traditional: 廢鐵鍛成的刀刃選擇殺戮，因為優雅從未回過它們的信。

entries.source: Simple, common, effective. Civilization and war were built upon the point of the spear.
entries.simplified: 简单、常见、有效。文明与战争都建立在长矛的尖端之上。
entries.traditional: 簡單、常見、有效。文明與戰爭都建立在長矛的尖端之上。

entries.source: This chained spire looks like a chapel had armor problems.
entries.simplified: 这座缠着锁链的尖塔，看起来像一座在护甲上遇到麻烦的礼拜堂。
entries.traditional: 這座纏著鎖鏈的尖塔，看起來像一座在護甲上遇到麻煩的禮拜堂。

entries.source: Spikes and horns politely warn taverns to reinforce their furniture.
entries.simplified: 尖刺与犄角礼貌地提醒酒馆：最好加固一下家具。
entries.traditional: 尖刺與犄角有禮地提醒酒館：最好加固一下家具。

entries.source: Grim iron holds steady when odds start getting pushy.
entries.simplified: 当胜算开始咄咄逼人时，阴沉的铁甲依然稳如磐石。
entries.traditional: 當勝算開始咄咄逼人時，陰沉的鐵甲依然穩如磐石。

entries.source: Spirit-threaded fibers favor movement, endurance, and freedom over heavy walls.
entries.simplified: 灵丝交织的纤维偏爱机动、耐力与自由，而不是沉重壁垒。
entries.traditional: 靈絲交織的纖維偏愛機動、耐力與自由，而不是沉重壁壘。

entries.source: Soft soles grip shore and stone, refusing to stay anywhere long.
entries.simplified: 柔软鞋底牢牢抓住海岸与岩石，拒绝在任何地方久留。
entries.traditional: 柔軟鞋底牢牢抓住海岸與岩石，拒絕在任何地方久留。

entries.source: Flexible wraps carry spells and strikes smoothly through sand and surf.
entries.simplified: 灵活裹布让法术与攻击顺畅地穿过沙滩与浪潮。
entries.traditional: 靈活裹布讓法術與攻擊順暢地穿過沙灘與浪潮。

entries.source: “A jagged edge takes more than blood when it bites.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “锯齿状的锋刃咬下时，夺走的可不只是鲜血。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “鋸齒狀的鋒刃咬下時，奪走的可不只是鮮血。” — Suphara

entries.source: That glowing rune at the front suggests the joke may be on someone else.
entries.simplified: 帽子前方那枚发光符文暗示着，笑话的对象或许另有其人。
entries.traditional: 帽子前方那枚發光符文暗示著，笑話的對象或許另有其人。

entries.source: Inset gems turn authority into weight, and weight into judgment.
entries.simplified: 镶嵌的宝石将权威化作重量，再将重量化作审判。
entries.traditional: 鑲嵌的寶石將權威化作重量，再將重量化作審判。

entries.source: Small steel solves personal problems before they become public problems.
entries.simplified: 小巧钢刃会在私人问题变成公开问题前将其解决。
entries.traditional: 小巧鋼刃會在私人問題變成公開問題前將其解決。

entries.source: A knightly field manual for turning forward motion into disciplined pressure.
entries.simplified: 一本骑士战地手册，教人将向前推进化作严谨的压制。
entries.traditional: 一本騎士戰地手冊，教人將向前推進化作嚴謹的壓制。

entries.source: Wide diagrams teach formation, pull, and control through every measured sweep.
entries.simplified: 宽大的图示教授如何通过每一次沉稳挥扫掌握阵形、牵引与控制。
entries.traditional: 寬大的圖示教授如何透過每一次沉穩揮掃掌握陣形、牽引與控制。

entries.source: Crackling notes train the body to strike twice before doubt catches up.
entries.simplified: 噼啪作响的笔记训练身体在疑虑追上之前连续出手两次。
entries.traditional: 劈啪作響的筆記訓練身體在疑慮追上之前連續出手兩次。

entries.source: A rescue doctrine bound for knights who bring danger closer before breaking it.
entries.simplified: 一本为骑士装订成册的救援教典，教他们先将危险拉近，再将其击溃。
entries.traditional: 一本為騎士裝訂成冊的救援教典，教他們先將危險拉近，再將其擊潰。

entries.source: Iron-edged pages answer every blocked strike with stubborn, immediate resolve.
entries.simplified: 镶铁书页以顽固而即时的决意回应每一次格挡。
entries.traditional: 鑲鐵書頁以頑固而即時的決意回應每一次格擋。

entries.source: Frontline doctrine teaches taunts to weaken resolve before steel arrives.
entries.simplified: 前线教典教授如何以嘲讽削弱敌人的意志，再让钢铁抵达。
entries.traditional: 前線教典教授如何以嘲諷削弱敵人的意志，再讓鋼鐵抵達。

entries.source: Polished armor makes justice feel shiny, heavy, and slightly theatrical.
entries.simplified: 抛光铠甲让正义显得闪亮、沉重，又带着一点戏剧性。
entries.traditional: 拋光鎧甲讓正義顯得閃亮、沉重，又帶著一點戲劇性。

entries.source: Heavy boots echo honor, because quiet justice apparently stayed home.
entries.simplified: 沉重靴声回荡着荣耀，因为安静的正义显然待在家里。
entries.traditional: 沉重靴聲迴盪著榮耀，因為安靜的正義顯然待在家裡。

entries.source: Solid greaves hold the line when the ground argues back.
entries.simplified: 坚固胫甲守住战线，即使脚下的大地也开始顶嘴。
entries.traditional: 堅固脛甲守住戰線，即使腳下的大地也開始頂嘴。

entries.source: Studded wraps should leave marks, because polite punches rarely get remembered.
entries.simplified: 带铆钉的裹带就该留下印记，毕竟礼貌的拳头很少有人记得。
entries.traditional: 帶鉚釘的裹帶就該留下印記，畢竟有禮的拳頭很少有人記得。

entries.source: Forged to fly with surgical precision, these kunai find weak points at melee or range.
entries.simplified: 这些苦无经过锻造，能以外科手术般的精度飞行，无论近战还是远程都能找到弱点。
entries.traditional: 這些苦無經過鍛造，能以外科手術般的精準飛行，無論近戰還是遠程都能找到弱點。

entries.source: A heavy launcher built for raw impact, hurling explosive payloads that devastate clustered enemies.
entries.simplified: 一具为纯粹冲击力打造的重型发射器，能够投掷爆炸载荷，摧毁成群敌人。
entries.traditional: 一具為純粹衝擊力打造的重型發射器，能夠投擲爆炸載荷，摧毀成群敵人。

entries.source: Sporeling charm gives the mask a face only nature excuses.
entries.simplified: Sporeling 的魅力让这副面具有了一张只有大自然才会原谅的脸。
entries.traditional: Sporeling 的魅力讓這副面具有了一張只有大自然才會原諒的臉。

entries.source: Reduced drag lets each stride answer faster than heavy armor.
entries.simplified: 减少阻力后，每一步都能比沉重护甲更快作出回应。
entries.traditional: 減少阻力後，每一步都能比沉重護甲更快作出回應。

entries.source: Measured movement begins in balanced plates that correct every step.
entries.simplified: 精准的动作始于平衡的甲片，它们会校正每一步。
entries.traditional: 精準的動作始於平衡的甲片，它們會校正每一步。

entries.source: Subtle sigils support focus while your legs handle practical matters.
entries.simplified: 细微的符印帮助维持专注，而双腿负责处理实际问题。
entries.traditional: 細微的符印幫助維持專注，而雙腿負責處理實際問題。

entries.source: Each step invites fortune to trip someone else for once.
entries.simplified: 每一步都邀请幸运偶尔去绊倒别人。
entries.traditional: 每一步都邀請幸運偶爾去絆倒別人。

entries.source: Solid plates turn every step into a threat of force.
entries.simplified: 坚固甲片让每一步都化作力量的威胁。
entries.traditional: 堅固甲片讓每一步都化作力量的威脅。

entries.source: Thick metal carries pressure well, refusing to let steps falter.
entries.simplified: 厚重金属擅长承受压力，拒绝让步伐动摇。
entries.traditional: 厚重金屬擅長承受壓力，拒絕讓步伐動搖。

entries.source: The red plume says valor; the dents say experience.
entries.simplified: 红色羽冠诉说勇武；那些凹痕则诉说经验。
entries.traditional: 紅色羽冠訴說勇武；那些凹痕則訴說經驗。

entries.source: “Vitae’s breath is stronger than any hammer blow. I only gave it form so we all may endure.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “Vitae 的吐息胜过任何锤击。我只是赋予它形体，让我们都能坚持下去。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “Vitae 的吐息勝過任何鎚擊。我只是賦予它形體，讓我們都能堅持下去。” — Suphara

entries.source: Soft steps leave tiny blossoms of renewal wherever the wearer endures.
entries.simplified: 轻柔脚步在穿戴者坚持前行之处，留下细小的复苏花朵。
entries.traditional: 輕柔腳步在穿戴者堅持前行之處，留下細小的復甦花朵。

entries.source: Remember your training. Focus, draw, aim, take a deep breath, and loose.
entries.simplified: 记住你的训练。专注、拉弓、瞄准、深吸一口气，然后放箭。
entries.traditional: 記住你的訓練。專注、拉弓、瞄準、深吸一口氣，然後放箭。

entries.source: These twin jade baubles jingle softly, loudly advertising your supposed luck.
entries.simplified: 这对翡翠小饰物轻轻叮当作响，大声宣扬着你所谓的好运。
entries.traditional: 這對翡翠小飾物輕輕叮噹作響，大聲宣揚著你所謂的好運。

entries.source: Fine strings inspire allies, unless someone requests the same song again.
entries.simplified: 精致的琴弦鼓舞盟友，除非有人又点了同一首曲子。
entries.traditional: 精緻的琴弦鼓舞隊友，除非有人又點了同一首曲子。

entries.source: “For smiting the unworthy, use weight, faith, and a firm grip. E.T.F. wanted all three.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “要惩击不配者，就靠重量、信仰和稳固的握法。E.T.F. 三样都要。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “要懲擊不配者，就靠重量、信仰和穩固的握法。E.T.F. 三樣都要。” — Suphara

entries.source: “Carry light with purpose as your Judgment takes a breath before it falls.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “让光明带着明确的目标随你而行，好让你的 Judgment 在落下前先喘口气。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “讓光明帶著明確的目標隨你而行，好讓你的 Judgment 在落下前先喘口氣。” — Suphara

entries.source: “A good mace is reliable in any hand.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “一把好钉头锤，到了谁手里都可靠。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “一把好釘頭鎚，到了誰手裡都可靠。” — Suphara

entries.source: A compact guard etched for spellcasters who prefer barriers between focus and pain.
entries.simplified: 一面刻有符文的小型护具，为那些宁愿让屏障隔在专注与疼痛之间的施法者打造。
entries.traditional: 一面刻有符文的小型護具，為那些寧願讓屏障隔在專注與疼痛之間的施法者打造。

entries.source: Reinforced robes hold steady under pressure, refusing to let spellwork break.
entries.simplified: 强化长袍在压力下依然稳固，绝不让法术运转崩溃。
entries.traditional: 強化長袍在壓力下依然穩固，絕不讓法術運轉崩潰。

entries.source: Four attunements share one page, arguing until they become a single harmony.
entries.simplified: 四种调谐共处一页，争论不休，直到最终汇成一曲和声。
entries.traditional: 四種調諧共處一頁，爭論不休，直到最終匯成一曲和聲。

entries.source: Arcane diagrams turn simple attacks into distant sparks of disciplined magic.
entries.simplified: 奥术图示将朴素攻击化作远方迸发的严谨魔法火花。
entries.traditional: 奧術圖示將樸素攻擊化作遠方迸發的嚴謹魔法火花。

entries.source: Folded pages mark impossible footwork between one breath and the next.
entries.simplified: 折叠的书页标记着一呼一吸之间那不可思议的步法。
entries.traditional: 摺疊的書頁標記著一呼一吸之間那不可思議的步法。

entries.source: Hidden ley-lines hum beneath the cover, refilling power through fallen foes.
entries.simplified: 隐藏的地脉在封面下低鸣，借倒下的敌人补充力量。
entries.traditional: 隱藏的地脈在封面下低鳴，藉倒下的敵人補充力量。

entries.source: Brittle blue script fractures into cold bursts whenever magic finds a mark.
entries.simplified: 脆弱的蓝色文字在魔法命中目标时碎裂成寒冷爆发。
entries.traditional: 脆弱的藍色文字在魔法命中目標時碎裂成寒冷爆發。

entries.source: Unstable red script waits for impact before blooming into sudden flame.
entries.simplified: 不稳定的红色文字静候冲击，随后骤然绽放为烈焰。
entries.traditional: 不穩定的紅色文字靜候衝擊，隨後驟然綻放為烈焰。

entries.source: Arcane thread pulses softly through the robe, holding gathered magic.
entries.simplified: 奥术丝线在长袍中柔和脉动，稳稳承载汇聚的魔力。
entries.traditional: 奧術絲線在長袍中柔和脈動，穩穩承載匯聚的魔力。

entries.source: Cloud-soft slippers keep steps quiet and thoughts impressively smug.
entries.simplified: 云朵般柔软的拖鞋让脚步悄无声息，也让思绪得意得惊人。
entries.traditional: 雲朵般柔軟的拖鞋讓腳步悄無聲息，也讓思緒得意得驚人。

entries.source: Runed leggings survive study sessions, spell marathons, and chair time.
entries.simplified: 符文长裤经得住学习时光、施法马拉松，以及长时间坐椅子。
entries.traditional: 符文長褲經得住研讀時光、施法馬拉松，以及長時間坐椅子。

entries.source: Filled to the brim with mana crystals. Increases the user's mana reserves.
entries.simplified: 装满了魔力水晶。提高使用者的魔力储量。
entries.traditional: 裝滿了魔力水晶。提高使用者的魔力儲量。

entries.source: Created by Professor Elsi. Take slow steady sips to renew one's mana.
entries.simplified: 由 Professor Elsi 制作。缓慢而平稳地啜饮，以恢复自身魔力。
entries.traditional: 由 Professor Elsi 製作。緩慢而平穩地啜飲，以恢復自身魔力。

entries.source: “Balance is what lets a heavy blow feel easy.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “平衡能让沉重一击显得轻而易举。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “平衡能讓沉重一擊顯得輕而易舉。” — Suphara

entries.source: “A master text should mend, teach, and strike only after the lesson is clear.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “大师之作应当先修复、再教导，只有当教训足够清楚时才出手。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “大師之作應當先修復、再教導，只有當教訓足夠清楚時才出手。” — Suphara

entries.source: “Speed matters, aye, but only if the point knows where it is going.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “速度当然重要，但前提是刀尖知道自己要去哪里。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “速度當然重要，但前提是刀尖知道自己要去哪裡。” — Suphara

entries.source: “Faith and fury both need a steady handle.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “信仰与怒火，都需要一根稳固的握柄。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “信仰與怒火，都需要一根穩固的握柄。” — Suphara

entries.source: “Strike once at the right moment, and the fight thinks twice.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “在正确的时机出手一次，就足以让整场战斗三思而行。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “在正確的時機出手一次，就足以讓整場戰鬥三思而行。” — Suphara

entries.source: “A sidearm should fire like a kept promise: short, firm, and final.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “随身枪械开火时，应当像兑现承诺：简短、坚定、彻底。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “隨身槍械開火時，應當像兌現承諾：簡短、堅定、徹底。” — Suphara

entries.source: “A scythe fed farms before battlefields. This replica harvests strength as it cuts, so treat it with respect.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “镰刀在踏上战场前，先养活了农田。这件复制品会在挥砍时收割力量，所以要敬重它。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “鐮刀在踏上戰場前，先養活了農田。這件複製品會在揮砍時收割力量，所以要敬重它。” — Suphara

entries.source: “A bow waits until distance becomes a mistake.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “弓会静静等待，直到距离本身变成一个错误。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “弓會靜靜等待，直到距離本身變成一個錯誤。” — Suphara

entries.source: “This replica remembers the first Knights of the land in its reach, its balance, and its stubborn spine.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “这件复制品以攻击范围、平衡与顽强的脊骨，铭记着这片土地最初的 Knights。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “這件複製品以攻擊距離、平衡與頑強的脊骨，銘記著這片土地最初的 Knights。” — Suphara

entries.source: “I copied a hero’s blade as close as my hammer allowed. May it give you courage when you need it.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “我尽锤子所能，原样仿造了一位英雄的利刃。愿它在你需要时赐予你勇气。” — Suphara
entries.traditional: “我盡鎚子所能，原樣仿造了一位英雄的利刃。願它在你需要時賜予你勇氣。” — Suphara

entries.source: “Mastery is power that knows when to be quick and quiet.” — Suphara
entries.simplified: “精通，就是懂得何时该迅捷，何时该安静的力量。” — Suphara
