entries.source: This powerful echo moves with the habits of a trained shinobi. Poison gathers around its strikes before it vanishes back into dark corridors.
entries.simplified: 这个强大回声以训练有素的忍者习性行动。毒素会在它的攻击周围汇聚，随后它便消失在黑暗走廊中。
entries.traditional: 這個強大回聲以訓練有素的忍者習性行動。毒素會在它的攻擊周圍匯聚，隨後它便消失在黑暗走廊中。

entries.source: This echo carries the motions of a summoner while grave energy gathers around it.
entries.simplified: 这个回声重复着召唤术士的动作，墓穴能量则在它周围汇聚。
entries.traditional: 這個回聲重複著召喚術士的動作，墓穴能量則在它周圍匯聚。

entries.source: This echo keeps the shape of a warrior and rushes forward with fire gathering around its weapon.
entries.simplified: 这个回声保留着战士的形态，并在武器周围燃起火焰后向前冲锋。
entries.traditional: 這個回聲保留著戰士的形態，並在武器周圍燃起火焰後向前衝鋒。

entries.source: This powerful echo shapes shadow magic with the movements of a trained wizard. Dark energy gathers around it before each spell is released.
entries.simplified: 这个强大回声以训练有素的巫师动作塑造暗影魔法。每道法术释放前，黑暗能量都会在它周围汇聚。
entries.traditional: 這個強大回聲以訓練有素的巫師動作塑造暗影魔法。每道法術釋放前，黑暗能量都會在它周圍匯聚。

entries.source: This powerful echo shapes shadow magic with the movements of a trained wizard. Dark energy gathers around it before each spell is released.
entries.simplified: 这个强大回声以训练有素的巫师动作塑造暗影魔法。每道法术释放前，黑暗能量都会在它周围汇聚。
entries.traditional: 這個強大回聲以訓練有素的巫師動作塑造暗影魔法。每道法術釋放前，黑暗能量都會在它周圍匯聚。

entries.source: Sensors crowd the front of this foundry machine as it searches for movement.
entries.simplified: 这台铸造厂机械的前端挤满传感器，用来搜寻周围动静。
entries.traditional: 這台鑄造廠機械的前端擠滿感測器，用來搜尋周圍動靜。

entries.source: Its narrow nozzle focuses pressure and force into short, direct attacks.
entries.simplified: 狭窄喷嘴会将压力与力量集中成短促而直接的攻击。
entries.traditional: 狹窄噴嘴會將壓力與力量集中成短促而直接的攻擊。

entries.source: Blue younglings drift near the seafloor and reach out with small arms.
entries.simplified: 蓝色幼体漂浮在海床附近，并用细小触手向外探寻。
entries.traditional: 藍色幼體漂浮在海床附近，並用細小觸手向外探尋。

entries.source: Orange younglings are bold and often grab at anything that moves nearby.
entries.simplified: 橙色幼体十分大胆，经常抓住附近任何会动的东西。
entries.traditional: 橘色幼體十分大膽，經常抓住附近任何會動的東西。

entries.source: Purple younglings hide among dim coral and shadowed stone.
entries.simplified: 紫色幼体会躲在昏暗珊瑚与阴影笼罩的岩石之间。
entries.traditional: 紫色幼體會躲在昏暗珊瑚與陰影籠罩的岩石之間。

entries.source: It uses its many arms to steady itself in deep currents while striking targets from a safe distance.
entries.simplified: 它利用众多触手在深层水流中稳住身体，同时从安全距离攻击目标。
entries.traditional: 它利用眾多觸手在深層水流中穩住身體，同時從安全距離攻擊目標。

entries.source: Its bright body is easy to see in clear water, but it attacks before most enemies can approach.
entries.simplified: 它明亮的身体在清澈水中十分醒目，但会在大多数敌人靠近前先行攻击。
entries.traditional: 它明亮的身體在清澈水中十分醒目，但會在大多數敵人靠近前先行攻擊。

entries.source: It waits in darker water and strikes with careful timing when prey moves into range.
entries.simplified: 它潜伏于较暗的水域，待猎物进入攻击范围后把握时机发动袭击。
entries.traditional: 它潛伏於較暗的水域，待獵物進入攻擊範圍後把握時機發動襲擊。

entries.source: This orange sea creature uses its many arms to hold space around its body.
entries.simplified: 这只橙色海洋生物利用众多触手控制身体周围的空间。
entries.traditional: 這隻橘色海洋生物利用眾多觸手控制身體周圍的空間。

entries.source: Darker coloring helps this octopus linger near deeper shadows.
entries.simplified: 较暗的体色帮助这只章鱼潜伏在更深的阴影附近。
entries.traditional: 較暗的體色幫助這隻章魚潛伏在更深的陰影附近。

entries.source: Pale skin helps this octopus blend among broken shells and light stone.
entries.simplified: 苍白皮肤帮助这只章鱼融入破碎贝壳与浅色岩石之间。
entries.traditional: 蒼白皮膚幫助這隻章魚融入破碎貝殼與淺色岩石之間。

entries.source: Broad petals let it drift across lake paths like a floating flower.
entries.simplified: 宽阔花瓣让它如漂浮花朵般飘过湖边小径。
entries.traditional: 寬闊花瓣讓它如漂浮花朵般飄過湖邊小徑。

entries.source: This larger spirit drifts above the ground and slips aside when threatened.
entries.simplified: 这个体型更大的灵体漂浮于地面上方，受到威胁时会迅速闪向一旁。
entries.traditional: 這個體型更大的靈體漂浮於地面上方，受到威脅時會迅速閃向一旁。

entries.source: Rows of hungry leaves snap shut when prey moves within reach.
entries.simplified: 成排饥饿叶片会在猎物进入攻击范围时猛然咬合。
entries.traditional: 成排飢餓葉片會在獵物進入攻擊範圍時猛然咬合。

entries.source: Marsh moisture keeps this poisonous plant active even in deep mud.
entries.simplified: 沼泽湿气让这株有毒植物即使深陷泥泞也能保持活跃。
entries.traditional: 沼澤濕氣讓這株有毒植物即使深陷泥濘也能保持活躍。

entries.source: This rooted wetland plant fires poisonous shots at creatures that stay out of reach.
entries.simplified: 这株扎根湿地的植物会向停留在攻击范围外的生物发射毒性弹射物。
entries.traditional: 這株扎根濕地的植物會向停留在攻擊範圍外的生物發射毒性彈射物。

entries.source: This poisonous worm hides in deep mud until movement overhead brings it to the surface.
entries.simplified: 这条有毒蠕虫藏在深层泥泞中，直到头顶的动静将它引向地表。
entries.traditional: 這條有毒蠕蟲藏在深層泥濘中，直到頭頂的動靜將它引向地表。

entries.source: Poisonous fumes leak from its swollen body as it rolls through the cavern.
entries.simplified: 它滚过洞穴时，膨胀身体中会不断泄出有毒烟雾。
entries.traditional: 它滾過洞穴時，膨脹身體中會不斷洩出有毒煙霧。

entries.source: Tiny drifting plant matter follows warm air across the meadow.
entries.simplified: 细小的漂浮植物碎屑会乘着暖风穿过草原。
entries.traditional: 細小的漂浮植物碎屑會乘著暖風穿過草原。

entries.source: Small floral creatures gather near damp ground and quiet water.
entries.simplified: 这些小型花朵生物聚集在潮湿地面与宁静水边。
entries.traditional: 這些小型花朵生物聚集在潮濕地面與寧靜水邊。

entries.source: This practice target is built to stand still while adventurers test their attacks.
entries.simplified: 这个练习目标被设计成静止不动，供冒险者测试攻击。
entries.traditional: 這個練習目標被設計成靜止不動，供冒險者測試攻擊。

entries.source: This massive undead worm rules wet soil from beneath. The ground rises and breaks apart when it comes near the surface.
entries.simplified: 这条巨型不死蠕虫统治着湿润土壤的地下。每当它接近地表，地面便会隆起并崩裂。
entries.traditional: 這條巨型不死蠕蟲統治著濕潤土壤的地下。每當它接近地表，地面便會隆起並崩裂。

entries.source: Larger rabbits can kick with surprising force when cornered.
entries.simplified: 体型更大的兔子在走投无路时，能踢出惊人的力量。
entries.traditional: 體型更大的兔子在走投無路時，能踢出驚人的力量。

entries.source: Dark-furred sewer rats slip along damp corners and broken stone.
entries.simplified: 深色毛皮的下水道老鼠沿着潮湿角落与破碎石面穿行。
entries.traditional: 深色毛皮的下水道老鼠沿著潮濕角落與破碎石面穿行。

entries.source: Grey sewer rats carry grime through damp tunnels and can leave a foul bite behind.
entries.simplified: 灰色下水道老鼠会把污秽带遍潮湿隧道，并可能留下恶臭的咬伤。
entries.traditional: 灰色下水道老鼠會把污穢帶遍潮濕隧道，並可能留下惡臭的咬傷。

entries.source: Pale sewer rats move quickly across dark floors and vanish into narrow gaps.
entries.simplified: 苍白下水道老鼠会迅速穿过黑暗地面，并消失在狭窄缝隙中。
entries.traditional: 蒼白下水道老鼠會迅速穿過黑暗地面，並消失在狹窄縫隙中。

entries.source: Heated blades spin along this foundry machine as it rushes across the floor.
entries.simplified: 这台铸造厂机械冲过地面时，灼热刀刃会不断旋转。
entries.traditional: 這台鑄造廠機械衝過地面時，灼熱刀刃會不斷旋轉。

entries.source: A crown-like ridge marks this desert scorpion as the ruler of its nest. Heat gathers in its stinger before it strikes.
entries.simplified: 王冠般的脊棱标志着这只沙漠蝎是巢穴的统治者。攻击前，热量会在尾刺中汇聚。
entries.traditional: 王冠般的脊稜標誌著這隻沙漠蠍是巢穴的統治者。攻擊前，熱量會在尾刺中匯聚。

entries.source: Desert heat gathers in its shell and tail, making its raised stinger dangerous to approach.
entries.simplified: 沙漠热量汇聚在它的甲壳与尾部，使高举的尾刺变得极难接近。
entries.traditional: 沙漠熱量匯聚在它的甲殼與尾部，使高舉的尾刺變得極難接近。

entries.source: Young desert scorpions hide beneath warm sand and strike with heated stingers when disturbed.
entries.simplified: 年幼的沙漠蝎藏在温热沙土下方，受到惊扰时便会以灼热尾刺攻击。
entries.traditional: 年幼的沙漠蠍藏在溫熱沙土下方，受到驚擾時便會以灼熱尾刺攻擊。

entries.source: This small seed stirs beneath grass and loose dirt when something comes near.
entries.simplified: 这颗小种子会在草叶与松散土壤下方，因附近的动静而轻轻颤动。
entries.traditional: 這顆小種子會在草葉與鬆散土壤下方，因附近的動靜而輕輕顫動。

entries.source: Shadow clings to its broad body and makes its outline difficult to read in dark places.
entries.simplified: 暗影附着在它宽阔的身体上，使轮廓在黑暗中难以辨认。
entries.traditional: 暗影附著在它寬闊的身體上，使輪廓在黑暗中難以辨認。

entries.source: Deeper darkness gathers around this larger demon as it advances with heavy, direct attacks.
entries.simplified: 更深的黑暗环绕着这个体型更大的恶魔，伴随它以沉重而直接的攻击向前推进。
entries.traditional: 更深的黑暗環繞著這個體型更大的惡魔，伴隨它以沉重而直接的攻擊向前推進。

entries.source: Young sharks chase anything that splashes near the shore.
entries.simplified: 幼鲨会追逐任何在岸边溅起水花的东西。
entries.traditional: 幼鯊會追逐任何在岸邊濺起水花的東西。

entries.source: This shark-like raider uses weapons, but still attacks with the instincts of a sea predator.
entries.simplified: 这名鲨鱼般的掠夺者会使用武器，却依然凭借海洋捕食者的本能发动攻击。
entries.traditional: 這名鯊魚般的掠奪者會使用武器，卻依然憑藉海洋捕食者的本能發動攻擊。

entries.source: This deep-water predator circles below its target before rushing upward to bite.
entries.simplified: 这头深水捕食者会先在目标下方盘旋，随后猛然向上冲刺撕咬。
entries.traditional: 這頭深水捕食者會先在目標下方盤旋，隨後猛然向上衝刺撕咬。

entries.source: This compact machine hides moving parts beneath a rounded shell before charging forward.
entries.simplified: 这台紧凑机械会先把活动部件藏在圆形外壳下，随后向前冲锋。
entries.traditional: 這台緊湊機械會先把活動部件藏在圓形外殼下，隨後向前衝鋒。

entries.source: Ripples often reveal this shelled creature before its body appears.
entries.simplified: 水面涟漪往往会在这只带壳生物现身前暴露它的位置。
entries.traditional: 水面漣漪往往會在這隻帶殼生物現身前暴露它的位置。

entries.source: Giant bones scrape against castle stone as this undead brute advances.
entries.simplified: 巨型骨骼摩擦着城堡石面，伴随这头不死蛮兽向前推进。
entries.traditional: 巨型骨骼摩擦著城堡石面，伴隨這頭不死蠻獸向前推進。

entries.source: Brittle hands trace old spell patterns while grave magic gathers between its bones.
entries.simplified: 脆弱双手描绘着古老法术轨迹，墓穴魔法则在骨骼之间汇聚。
entries.traditional: 脆弱雙手描繪著古老法術軌跡，墓穴魔法則在骨骼之間匯聚。

entries.source: Bones rattle through the woods as this undead fighter moves faster than expected.
entries.simplified: 骨骼在林间咔啦作响，而这名不死战士的移动速度比预想中更快。
entries.traditional: 骨骼在林間喀啦作響，而這名不死戰士的移動速度比預想中更快。

entries.source: This jelly-like slime bounces through wetland mud and leaves poison where it lands.
entries.simplified: 这团果冻般的黏液在湿地泥泞中弹跳，落地之处会留下毒素。
entries.traditional: 這團果凍般的黏液在濕地泥濘中彈跳，落地之處會留下毒素。

entries.source: This large poisonous slime rolls through deep mud and leaves a thick trail behind it.
entries.simplified: 这团巨型有毒黏液滚过深层泥泞，身后留下一道浓厚痕迹。
entries.traditional: 這團巨型有毒黏液滾過深層泥濘，身後留下一道濃厚痕跡。

entries.source: This slime creeps across wet ground and leaves a faint poisonous sheen behind.
entries.simplified: 这团黏液在湿地上缓慢爬行，身后留下一层淡淡的毒性光泽。
entries.traditional: 這團黏液在濕地上緩慢爬行，身後留下一層淡淡的毒性光澤。

entries.source: This serpent ruler coils in deep, dark passages. Its venom is strong enough to keep other cave creatures away.
entries.simplified: 这名蛇族统治者盘踞于幽深黑暗的通道中。它的毒液强到足以让其他洞穴生物远远避开。
entries.traditional: 這名蛇族統治者盤踞於幽深黑暗的通道中。它的毒液強到足以讓其他洞穴生物遠遠避開。

entries.source: This cave serpent coils between loose stones and strikes with venomous fangs.
entries.simplified: 这条洞穴毒蛇盘绕在松散石块之间，并以带毒獠牙发动攻击。
entries.traditional: 這條洞穴毒蛇盤繞在鬆散石塊之間，並以帶毒獠牙發動攻擊。

entries.source: Small serpents slip through narrow cracks and bite when larger creatures pass by.
entries.simplified: 小蛇会穿过狭窄裂缝，并在大型生物经过时扑咬。
entries.traditional: 小蛇會穿過狹窄裂縫，並在大型生物經過時撲咬。

entries.source: The long sensor on its front helps it track targets before it strikes.
entries.simplified: 前端的长形传感器帮助它在攻击前锁定目标。
entries.traditional: 前端的長形感測器幫助它在攻擊前鎖定目標。

entries.source: Cold pressure gathers inside its round body as it rolls across crystal floors.
entries.simplified: 这具圆形躯体滚过水晶地面时，冰冷压力会在内部不断汇聚。
entries.traditional: 這具圓形軀體滾過水晶地面時，冰冷壓力會在內部不斷匯聚。

entries.source: Military plating protects this robot as it advances in direct lines toward its target.
entries.simplified: 军用装甲保护着这台机器人，伴随它沿直线向目标推进。
entries.traditional: 軍用裝甲保護著這台機器人，伴隨它沿直線向目標推進。

entries.source: This larger spirit shapes holy power with steady movements and a calm glow.
entries.simplified: 这个体型更大的灵体以沉稳动作与宁静光芒塑造神圣力量。
entries.traditional: 這個體型更大的靈體以沉穩動作與寧靜光芒塑造神聖力量。

entries.source: This small spirit of light floats quietly through sacred halls.
entries.simplified: 这个小型光之灵体安静地漂浮于神圣大厅中。
entries.traditional: 這個小型光之靈體安靜地漂浮於神聖大廳中。

entries.source: Larger cave spiders claim deeper passages and cover them with venomous webs.
entries.simplified: 体型更大的洞穴蜘蛛占据更深的通道，并用有毒蛛网覆盖其中。
entries.traditional: 體型更大的洞穴蜘蛛占據更深的通道，並用有毒蛛網覆蓋其中。

entries.source: This many-legged machine directs smaller spider robots from the factory floor. Shadow gathers beneath its frame while it prepares to attack.
entries.simplified: 这台多足机械会从工厂地面指挥小型蜘蛛机器人。准备攻击时，暗影会在它的框架下方汇聚。
entries.traditional: 這台多足機械會從工廠地面指揮小型蜘蛛機器人。準備攻擊時，暗影會在它的框架下方匯聚。

entries.source: Metal legs carry this spider machine quickly across broken metal paths.
entries.simplified: 金属长腿载着这台蜘蛛机械迅速穿过破碎的金属通道。
entries.traditional: 金屬長腿載著這台蜘蛛機械迅速穿過破碎的金屬通道。

entries.source: Green venom beads along its fangs before it darts from cover.
entries.simplified: 绿色毒液在獠牙上凝成液珠，随后它便会从掩体中猛冲而出。
entries.traditional: 綠色毒液在獠牙上凝成液珠，隨後它便會從掩體中猛衝而出。

entries.source: Thin legs carry this cave spider quickly across stone before it bites.
entries.simplified: 细长的腿让这只洞穴蜘蛛能在咬击前迅速爬过石面。
entries.traditional: 細長的腿讓這隻洞穴蜘蛛能在咬擊前迅速爬過石面。

entries.source: Small spider machines crawl through cables and scrap while staying close to the ground.
entries.simplified: 小型蜘蛛机械贴近地面，爬过电缆与废料。
entries.traditional: 小型蜘蛛機械貼近地面，爬過電纜與廢料。

entries.source: Sharp plating and furnace heat make this machine dangerous when it accelerates.
entries.simplified: 锋利装甲与熔炉热量让这台机械在加速时格外危险。
entries.traditional: 鋒利裝甲與熔爐熱量讓這台機械在加速時格外危險。

entries.source: Sharp ridges protect this lake creature from curious predators.
entries.simplified: 锋利脊棱保护着这只湖中生物，使好奇的捕食者难以靠近。
entries.traditional: 鋒利脊稜保護著這隻湖中生物，使好奇的捕食者難以靠近。

entries.source: This restless spirit wavers at the edge of sight before appearing somewhere else.
entries.simplified: 这个躁动灵体会在视野边缘摇曳，随后出现在另一处。
entries.traditional: 這個躁動靈體會在視野邊緣搖曳，隨後出現在另一處。

entries.source: Dry winds carry spores from its round body across the desert path.
entries.simplified: 干燥风流会把它圆形身体上的孢子吹过沙漠小径。
entries.traditional: 乾燥風流會把它圓形身體上的孢子吹過沙漠小徑。

entries.source: Its young trunk is sturdier than it looks, allowing it to knock back creatures that get too close.
entries.simplified: 它年幼的树干比外表更加坚固，足以击退靠得太近的生物。
entries.traditional: 它年幼的樹幹比外表更加堅固，足以擊退靠得太近的生物。

entries.source: Young squid drift through the depths in short, uncertain bursts.
entries.simplified: 幼年鱿鱼以短促而迟疑的爆发动作漂过深海。
entries.traditional: 幼年魷魚以短促而遲疑的爆發動作漂過深海。

entries.source: This oversized meadow insect rules the air above lesser swarms. Its rapid dives make it difficult to keep in sight.
entries.simplified: 这只体型过大的草原昆虫统治着较小虫群上方的天空。它迅猛俯冲时极难持续锁定。
entries.traditional: 這隻體型過大的草原昆蟲統治著較小蟲群上方的天空。它迅猛俯衝時極難持續鎖定。

entries.source: Charged air gathers around its narrow frame before it releases a sharp burst of wind.
entries.simplified: 带电空气会在它狭长的框架周围汇聚，随后释放一道锐利的风力冲击。
entries.traditional: 帶電空氣會在它狹長的框架周圍匯聚，隨後釋放一道銳利的風力衝擊。

entries.source: Sunlit petals open when this rooted caster draws in holy magic.
entries.simplified: 当这名扎根原地的施法者吸收神圣魔法时，阳光照耀的花瓣便会绽开。
entries.traditional: 當這名扎根原地的施法者吸收神聖魔法時，陽光照耀的花瓣便會綻開。

entries.source: This radiant bloom-spirit gathers holy light from the bright corners of the glen. Its petals open wider before it releases a powerful spell.
entries.simplified: 这个辉耀的花灵会从林谷明亮的角落汇聚圣光。释放强力法术前，它的花瓣会张得更开。
entries.traditional: 這個輝耀的花靈會從林谷明亮的角落匯聚聖光。釋放強力法術前，它的花瓣會張得更開。

entries.source: Golden petals and delicate wings gather light before this fairy-like creature casts.
entries.simplified: 金色花瓣与纤细双翼会先汇聚光芒，随后这个仙子般的生物才会施法。
entries.traditional: 金色花瓣與纖細雙翼會先匯聚光芒，隨後這個仙子般的生物才會施法。

entries.source: Heavy plating covers this city machine and lets it roll forward like a moving barricade.
entries.simplified: 厚重装甲覆盖着这台城市机械，使其能像移动路障般滚滚向前。
entries.traditional: 厚重裝甲覆蓋著這台城市機械，使其能像移動路障般滾滾向前。

entries.source: This simple target marker is used for aim checks and damage practice.
entries.simplified: 这个简单的目标标记用于检查瞄准与练习伤害。
entries.traditional: 這個簡單的目標標記用於檢查瞄準與練習傷害。

entries.source: Exposed panels and old circuitry cover a sturdy machine that still pushes forward with force.
entries.simplified: 裸露面板与老旧电路覆盖着这台坚固机械，但它依然会以强大力量向前推进。
entries.traditional: 裸露面板與老舊電路覆蓋著這台堅固機械，但它依然會以強大力量向前推進。

entries.source: Coiled limbs channel wind energy through its mechanical body in pulsing waves.
entries.simplified: 盘绕的肢体会让风能以脉冲波动穿过它的机械躯体。
entries.traditional: 盤繞的肢體會讓風能以脈衝波動穿過它的機械軀體。

entries.source: Water surges around its shell whenever it drives forward.
entries.simplified: 每当它向前猛进时，水流便会环绕甲壳翻涌。
entries.traditional: 每當它向前猛進時，水流便會環繞甲殼翻湧。

entries.source: Heat builds across its shell in steady layers before it releases fire magic.
entries.simplified: 热量会在它的甲壳表面层层积聚，随后释放火焰魔法。
entries.traditional: 熱量會在它的甲殼表面層層積聚，隨後釋放火焰魔法。

entries.source: Wind rolls around its shell in heavy pulses whenever it turns or steps forward.
entries.simplified: 每当它转身或向前迈步时，风便会以沉重脉冲环绕甲壳翻滚。
entries.traditional: 每當它轉身或向前邁步時，風便會以沉重脈衝環繞甲殼翻滾。

entries.source: Waterlogged roots keep it steady, even when its cap shakes from a heavy strike. Never skips arm day.
entries.simplified: 浸水根须让它稳稳立住，即使菌盖被沉重攻击震得摇晃。它可从不缺练手臂。
entries.traditional: 浸水根鬚讓它穩穩立住，即使菌蓋被沉重攻擊震得搖晃。它可從不缺練手臂。

entries.source: This sturdy training target is built to endure repeated strikes from practicing adventurers.
entries.simplified: 这个坚固的训练目标被设计成承受冒险者练习时的反复攻击。
entries.traditional: 這個堅固的訓練目標被設計成承受冒險者練習時的反覆攻擊。

entries.source: Autumn leaves crackle along its branches when heat builds beneath the bark.
entries.simplified: 当树皮下方积聚热量时，秋叶便会在枝头噼啪作响。
entries.traditional: 當樹皮下方積聚熱量時，秋葉便會在枝頭劈啪作響。

entries.source: Evergreen branches cover a sturdy body that draws strength from the forest soil.
entries.simplified: 常青树枝覆盖着坚固躯体，并从森林土壤中汲取力量。
entries.traditional: 常青樹枝覆蓋著堅固軀體，並從森林土壤中汲取力量。

entries.source: This young treant carries ember-colored leaves that scatter sparks when it moves.
entries.simplified: 这名幼年树人带着余烬色的叶片，移动时会洒落火花。
entries.traditional: 這名幼年樹人帶著餘燼色的葉片，移動時會灑落火花。

entries.source: This young treant looks like a small sapling until it steps from the path.
entries.simplified: 这名幼年树人看起来只是一株小树苗，直到它从路边迈出脚步。
entries.traditional: 這名幼年樹人看起來只是一株小樹苗，直到它從路邊邁出腳步。

entries.source: Dry autumn leaves crackle along its branches whenever hidden heat builds beneath the bark.
entries.simplified: 每当树皮下方积聚热量时，干燥的秋叶便会在枝头噼啪作响。
entries.traditional: 每當樹皮下方積聚熱量時，乾燥的秋葉便會在枝頭劈啪作響。

entries.source: Its evergreen branches move slowly, but each swing carries the weight of an old forest tree.
entries.simplified: 它的常青枝叶移动缓慢，但每一次挥击都承载着古老森林巨木的重量。
entries.traditional: 它的常青枝葉移動緩慢，但每一次揮擊都承載著古老森林巨木的重量。

entries.source: Trooper models use heavy armor and simple movement to force their way through resistance.
entries.simplified: Trooper 型机器人依靠厚重装甲与简单直接的动作，强行突破一切阻碍。
entries.traditional: Trooper 型機器人依靠厚重裝甲與簡單直接的動作，強行突破一切阻礙。

entries.source: Its heavy shell stores mineral deposits from mineral-rich waters. When it charges, the ground shakes beneath its feet.
entries.simplified: 它沉重的龟壳从富含矿物的水域中积蓄矿物沉积。每当它发动冲锋，脚下的大地都会震动。
entries.traditional: 它沉重的龜殼從富含礦物的水域中積蓄礦物沉積。每當它發動衝鋒，腳下的大地都會震動。

entries.source: Blue-shelled turtles swim steadily and rarely hurry unless threatened.
entries.simplified: 蓝壳海龟游动沉稳，除非受到威胁，否则几乎从不匆忙。
entries.traditional: 藍殼海龜游動沉穩，除非受到威脅，否則幾乎從不匆忙。

entries.source: Green shells help these turtles blend with shoreline plants and shallow water.
entries.simplified: 绿色龟壳帮助这些海龟融入岸边植物与浅水之中。
entries.traditional: 綠色龜殼幫助這些海龜融入岸邊植物與淺水之中。

entries.source: Red-shelled turtles stand out against sand and surf but withdraw quickly when approached.
entries.simplified: 红壳海龟在沙滩与浪花间格外醒目，但一旦有人靠近便会迅速缩回壳中。
entries.traditional: 紅殼海龜在沙灘與浪花間格外醒目，但一旦有人靠近便會迅速縮回殼中。

entries.source: Young turtles rely on their shells while waves carry them along the shore.
entries.simplified: 幼龟依靠龟壳保护自己，并随着海浪沿岸漂行。
entries.traditional: 幼龜依靠龜殼保護自己，並隨著海浪沿岸漂行。

entries.source: These larger cave flyers favor wounded prey and strike with venomous bites.
entries.simplified: 这些体型更大的洞穴飞行生物偏爱受伤的猎物，并以带毒咬击发动攻击。
entries.traditional: 這些體型更大的洞穴飛行生物偏愛受傷的獵物，並以帶毒咬擊發動攻擊。

entries.source: This shadow-touched beast hunts through dark woods with sharp claws and quick movement. Its howl often reaches travelers before its body appears.
entries.simplified: 这头被暗影触碰的野兽以锐利爪牙与迅捷动作穿行于黑暗森林。旅人往往先听见它的嚎叫，随后才看见它的身影。
entries.traditional: 這頭被暗影觸碰的野獸以銳利爪牙與迅捷動作穿行於黑暗森林。旅人往往先聽見它的嚎叫，隨後才看見它的身影。

entries.source: This small desert caster spins loose air into a tight magical funnel.
entries.simplified: 这名小型沙漠施法者将松散气流旋成紧密的魔法漏斗。
entries.traditional: 這名小型沙漠施法者將鬆散氣流旋成緊密的魔法漏斗。

entries.source: This larger wind caster holds position while strong currents circle around it.
entries.simplified: 这名体型更大的风系施法者会坚守原地，任由强劲气流环绕周身。
entries.traditional: 這名體型更大的風系施法者會堅守原地，任由強勁氣流環繞周身。

entries.source: Gusts gather around this drifting demon until the open air becomes its weapon.
entries.simplified: 狂风在这个漂浮恶魔周围汇聚，直到整片开阔空气都化作它的武器。
entries.traditional: 狂風在這個漂浮惡魔周圍匯聚，直到整片開闊空氣都化作它的武器。

entries.source: This tiny blue spirit carries a cool shimmer through meadows and shaded paths.
entries.simplified: 这个微小的蓝色灵体带着清凉微光穿过草原与林荫小径。
entries.traditional: 這個微小的藍色靈體帶著清涼微光穿過草原與林蔭小徑。

entries.source: Purple light bobs through the grass while faint gusts swirl beneath it.
entries.simplified: 紫色光芒在草丛间上下浮动，微弱阵风则在它下方盘旋。
entries.traditional: 紫色光芒在草叢間上下浮動，微弱陣風則在它下方盤旋。

entries.source: This small red spirit flickers above the meadow and flares up when disturbed.
entries.simplified: 这个小型红色灵体在草原上方闪烁，受到惊扰时便会骤然迸发。
entries.traditional: 這個小型紅色靈體在草原上方閃爍，受到驚擾時便會驟然迸發。

entries.source: Yellow light gathers near the ground around this tiny spirit before the earth begins to shift.
entries.simplified: 黄色光芒在这个微小灵体周围贴近地面汇聚，随后大地便开始移动。
entries.traditional: 黃色光芒在這個微小靈體周圍貼近地面匯聚，隨後大地便開始移動。

entries.source: Young shadow wolves practice hunting with quick bites and sudden dashes.
entries.simplified: 年幼的暗影狼以迅捷咬击与突然冲刺练习狩猎。
entries.traditional: 年幼的暗影狼以迅捷咬擊與突然衝刺練習狩獵。

entries.source: Lean wolves stalk the darker forest paths and rush at prey in short bursts.
entries.simplified: 瘦削的狼群潜行于森林深处的幽暗小径，并以短促冲刺扑向猎物。
entries.traditional: 瘦削的狼群潛行於森林深處的幽暗小徑，並以短促衝刺撲向獵物。

entries.source: This great cavern worm pushes through stone and soil near the surface. Poison seeps from its body into the ground around it.
entries.simplified: 这条巨型洞穴蠕虫在接近地表的石土中钻行。毒液从它体内渗出，浸染周围地面。
entries.traditional: 這條巨型洞穴蠕蟲在接近地表的石土中鑽行。毒液從它體內滲出，浸染周圍地面。

entries.source: Rotten fumes follow this burrowing creature through damp cavern soil.
entries.simplified: 腐臭烟气跟随着这只掘穴生物穿过潮湿的洞穴土壤。
entries.traditional: 腐臭煙氣跟隨著這隻掘穴生物穿過潮濕的洞穴土壤。

entries.source: This smaller worm leaves a sour trail through the tunnels it digs.
entries.simplified: 这条较小的蠕虫会在挖出的隧道中留下一道酸臭痕迹。
entries.traditional: 這條較小的蠕蟲會在挖出的隧道中留下一道酸臭痕跡。

entries.source: Old flesh and grave soil cling to this burrowing creature as it drags itself through wet ground.
entries.simplified: 陈旧血肉与墓土附着在这只掘穴生物身上，伴随它拖行于潮湿地面。
entries.traditional: 陳舊血肉與墓土附著在這隻掘穴生物身上，伴隨它拖行於潮濕地面。

entries.source: This crypt ruler drifts between corpse and spirit. Restless dead gather near it as it moves through the darkness.
entries.simplified: 这名墓穴统治者游移于尸骸与灵体之间。它穿过黑暗时，躁动不安的亡者会聚集在身旁。
entries.traditional: 這名墓穴統治者游移於屍骸與靈體之間。它穿過黑暗時，躁動不安的亡者會聚集在身旁。

entries.source: This zombie giant uses its heavy body to block cave paths.
entries.simplified: 这头僵尸巨人利用沉重身躯堵住洞穴通道。
entries.traditional: 這頭殭屍巨人利用沉重身軀堵住洞穴通道。

entries.source: This zombie ruler still carries the shape of command in its ruined body. Lesser corpses gather near it in the cave.
entries.simplified: 这名僵尸统治者残破的躯体依然保留着号令的姿态。较弱的尸骸会在洞穴中聚集于它身旁。
entries.traditional: 這名殭屍統治者殘破的軀體依然保留著號令的姿態。較弱的屍骸會在洞穴中聚集於它身旁。

entries.source: Small zombies stumble through the cave and keep moving until their bodies break.
entries.simplified: 小型僵尸在洞穴中蹒跚前行，直到身体彻底破碎才会停下。
entries.traditional: 小型殭屍在洞穴中蹣跚前行，直到身體徹底破碎才會停下。

entries.source: Rusted gear and old training guide this undead soldier through simple attacks.
entries.simplified: 锈蚀装备与残存训练，引导这名不死士兵发动简单攻击。
entries.traditional: 鏽蝕裝備與殘存訓練，引導這名不死士兵發動簡單攻擊。

entries.source: Seen any Essence around? Bring me Essence and a piece of gear, and I can help reshape what sleeps inside it.
entries.simplified: 看到精华了吗？给我带来精华和装备，我就能
entries.traditional: 看到精華了嗎？給我帶來精華和裝備，我就能

entries.source: Every item has potential, but not an endless amount. Spend only what you can afford.
entries.simplified: 每件物品都有潜力，但不是无限的。只花你
entries.traditional: 每件物品都有潛力，但不是無限的。只花你

entries.source: Chaos, Destruction, Flow, Growth, Rebirth... each Essence changes gear in its own strange way. I'm just here to facilitate the process, for better or worse.
entries.simplified: 混沌、破坏、流动、成长、重生……每个精华都以
entries.traditional: 混沌、破壞、流動、成長、重生……每個精華都以

entries.source: Most people don't understand the potential sleeping in their gear.
entries.simplified: 大多数人不理解他们装备中沉睡的潜力。
entries.traditional: 大多數人不理解他們裝備中沉睡的潛力。

entries.source: Power is easy. Self-control is the expensive part.
entries.simplified: 力量很容易。自我控制是昂贵的部分。
entries.traditional: 力量很容易。自我控制是昂貴的部分。

entries.source: Essence can reshape gear, but every change spends potential.
entries.simplified: 精华可以重塑装备，但每次改变都会消耗潜力。
entries.traditional: 精華可以重塑裝備，但每次改變都會消耗潛力。

entries.source: A little Essence, a little nerve, and suddenly your gear can slay anything.
entries.simplified: 一点精华，一点勇气，突然你的装备就能杀死任何东西。
entries.traditional: 一點精華，一點勇氣，突然你的裝備就能殺死任何東西。

entries.source: Substats are suggestions. Perfect substats are a myth.
entries.simplified: 副属性只是建议。完美的副属性是个神话。
entries.traditional: 副屬性只是建議。完美的副屬性是個神話。

entries.source: If the result is perfect, credit me. If not, blame the Essence.
entries.simplified: 如果结果完美，功劳是我的。如果不是，怪精华。
entries.traditional: 如果結果完美，功勞是我的。如果不是，怪精華。

entries.source: Chaos doesn't make mistakes. It makes "surprises."
entries.simplified: 混沌不会犯错。它制造"惊喜"。
entries.traditional: 混沌不會犯錯。它製造"驚喜"。

entries.source: By Suphara's hammer, fresh gear! Bring me weapons, armor, artifacts, and the right refining materials, and I can make them stronger.
entries.simplified: 以苏法拉的锤子起誓，崭新的装备！给我带来武器、盔甲、神器和
entries.traditional: 以蘇法拉的錘子起誓，嶄新的裝備！給我帶來武器、盔甲、神器和

entries.source: Every item can be refined all the way to +10. Naturally, the higher it goes, the more likely the forge will make you pay for it.
entries.simplified: 每件物品都可以精炼到+10。自然地，等级越高，
entries.traditional: 每件物品都可以精煉到+10。自然地，等級越高，

entries.source: If an upgrade fails, the item drops by one level. I call that "character building."
entries.simplified: 如果强化失败，物品会降低一个等级。我把这叫做"性格
entries.traditional: 如果強化失敗，物品會降低一個等級。我把這叫做"性格

entries.source: Want safer upgrades? Use better materials. Want cheaper upgrades? Suphara help you, because I can only do so much.
entries.simplified: 想要更安全的升级？使用更好的材料。想要更便宜的升级？Suphara
entries.traditional: 想要更安全的升級？使用更好的材料。想要更便宜的升級？Suphara

entries.source: Risk makes the reward worth swinging for.
entries.simplified: 风险让奖励值得为之奋斗。
entries.traditional: 風險讓獎勵值得為之奮鬥。

entries.source: The forge can lift your gear to glory, or knock it down a peg.
entries.simplified: 锻炉可以将你的装备提升至荣耀，或者将其降低一个等级。
entries.traditional: 鍛爐可以將你的裝備提升至榮耀，或者將其降低一個等級。

entries.source: Weapons, armor, artifacts... they all scream differently under the hammer.
entries.simplified: 武器、盔甲、神器……它们在铁锤下都发出不同的声音。
entries.traditional: 武器、盔甲、神器……它們在鐵錘下都發出不同的聲音。

entries.simplified: 铛！铛！铛！
entries.traditional: 鐺！鐺！鐺！

entries.source: You bring the gear, I'll bring the consequences.
entries.simplified: 你带来装备，我带来后果。
entries.traditional: 你帶來裝備，我帶來後果。

entries.source: Every upgrade is a gamble. That's what makes it fun.
entries.simplified: 每次强化都是一场赌博。这就是它有趣的地方。
entries.traditional: 每次強化都是一場賭博。這就是它有趣的地方。

entries.source: I don't sharpen blades. I awaken them.
entries.simplified: 我不磨锐刀刃。我唤醒它们。
entries.traditional: 我不磨銳刀刃。我喚醒它們。

entries.source: Good gear takes heat. Great gear survives it.
entries.simplified: 好的装备需要热量。伟大的装备能承受它。
entries.traditional: 好的裝備需要熱量。偉大的裝備能承受它。

entries.source: Come to test your luck, or your patience?
entries.simplified: 你是来考验运气还是耐心的？
entries.traditional: 你是來考驗運氣還是耐心的？

entries.source: We're just one hammer swing from greatness... or dust.
entries.simplified: 我们距离伟大只差一锤之力……或者灰烬。
entries.traditional: 我們距離偉大只差一錘之力……或者灰燼。

entries.source: Refinement is simple: heat, pressure, materials, and lots of loud clanging.
entries.simplified: 精炼很简单：热、压力、材料和大量响亮的敲击声。
entries.traditional: 精煉很簡單：熱、壓力、材料和大量響亮的敲擊聲。

entries.source: A safe upgrade costs more for a reason.
entries.simplified: 安全升级花费更多是有原因的。
entries.traditional: 安全升級花費更多是有原因的。

entries.source: Need refining materials? I've got Shards and Chunks for weapons, armor, and artifacts.
entries.simplified: 需要精炼材料吗？我有武器、盔甲和
entries.traditional: 需要精煉材料嗎？我有武器、盔甲和

entries.source: Vulkanite is for weapons, Gravion is for armor, and Lunaris is for artifacts. Mix them up and the blacksmith will laugh at both of us.
entries.simplified: 火山石用于武器，重力石用于盔甲，月光石用于神器。
entries.traditional: 火山石用於武器，重力石用於盔甲，月光石用於神器。

entries.source: Shards get you started, Chunks help you push further. Crystals? Oh, no, no. Those are above my pay grade.
entries.simplified: 碎片能帮你入门,块状物能让你走得更远。晶体?哦,不,不。
entries.traditional: 碎片能幫你入門,塊狀物能讓你走得更遠。晶體?哦,不,不。

entries.source: Need more stones? The forge doesn't feed itself.
entries.simplified: 需要更多石头吗？锻炉不会自己运转。
entries.traditional: 需要更多石頭嗎？鍛爐不會自己運轉。

entries.source: Stronger gear starts with the right materials, and maybe a little bit of faith.
entries.simplified: 更强大的装备从正确的材料开始，也许还需要一点
entries.traditional: 更強大的裝備從正確的材料開始，也許還需要一點

entries.source: I sell what the blacksmith uses to gamble with. You're just funding his habit.
entries.simplified: 我出售铁匠用来赌博的东西。你只是在资助他的习惯。
entries.traditional: 我出售鐵匠用來賭博的東西。你只是在資助他的習慣。

entries.source: One upgrade away from greatness... or regret. I supply both.
entries.simplified: 距离伟大只差一次升级......或遗憾。我两样都供应。
entries.traditional: 距離偉大只差一次升級......或遺憾。我兩樣都供應。

entries.source: Vulkanite, Gravion, Lunaris. Three fancy rocks, endless bad decisions.
entries.simplified: 火山岩、重力岩、月光岩。三块华丽的石头，无尽的糟糕决定。
entries.traditional: 火山岩、重力岩、月光岩。三塊華麗的石頭，無盡的糟糕決定。

entries.source: Shards are cheap. Chunks are not. Confidence remains free.
entries.simplified: 碎片很便宜。块状物不便宜。信心始终是免费的。
entries.traditional: 碎片很便宜。塊狀物不便宜。信心始終是免費的。

entries.source: Don't blame me if the hammer says no. I only sell rocks.
entries.simplified: 如果锤子说不，别怪我。我只卖石头。
entries.traditional: 如果錘子說不，別怪我。我只賣石頭。

entries.source: Every masterpiece starts with materials. Every disaster does too, technically.
entries.simplified: 每件杰作都从材料开始。严格来说，每场灾难也是如此。
entries.traditional: 每件傑作都從材料開始。嚴格來說，每場災難也是如此。

entries.source: Bring me enough junk, and I'll make it a design choice.
entries.simplified: 给我带来足够的废料，我会把它变成设计选择。
entries.traditional: 給我帶來足夠的廢料，我會把它變成設計選擇。

entries.source: I see you brought monster parts. Brave choice, but the smell is always questionable.
entries.simplified: 我看到你带来了怪物部位。一个勇敢的选择,但气味总是令人怀疑。
entries.traditional: 我看到你帶來了怪物部位。一個勇敢的選擇，但氣味總是令人懷疑。

entries.source: Nothing says style like wearing something that tried to kill you.
entries.simplified: 没有什么比穿着曾试图杀死你的东西更能展现风格的了。
entries.traditional: 沒有什麼比穿著曾試圖殺死你的東西更能展現風格的了。

entries.source: Bring me the strange bits. I'll make them socially acceptable.
entries.simplified: 把奇怪的碎片带给我。我会让它们变得能被社会接受。
entries.traditional: 把奇怪的碎片帶給我。我會讓它們變得能被社會接受。

entries.source: Yes, I can work with this. No, I don't want to know where it came from.
entries.simplified: 好的，我可以用这个。不，我不想知道它从哪里来的。
entries.traditional: 好的，我可以用這個。不，我不想知道它從哪裡來的。

entries.source: Fashion is temporary. Monster goo stains are forever.
entries.simplified: 时尚是短暂的。怪物粘液污渍永远存在。
entries.traditional: 時尚是短暫的。怪物粘液污漬永遠存在。

entries.source: A little thread, a little glue, and suddenly everyone pretends this was intentional.
entries.simplified: 一点线，一点胶水，突然间每个人都假装这是有意的。
entries.traditional: 一點線，一點膠水，突然間每個人都假裝這是有意的。

entries.source: You slay it, I stitch it into fashion.
entries.simplified: 你杀死它,我把它缝成时尚。
entries.traditional: 你殺死它,我把它縫成時尚。

entries.source: Monster bones? Plant goo? Weird little claws? Yes, yes, and absolutely yes.
entries.simplified: 怪物骨头？植物粘液？奇怪的小爪子？是的，是的，绝对是的。
entries.traditional: 怪物骨頭？植物黏液？奇怪的小爪子？是的，是的，絕對是的。

entries.source: One adventurer's junk is my next masterpiece.
entries.simplified: 一个冒险者的垃圾是我的下一件杰作。
entries.traditional: 一個冒險者的垃圾是我的下一件傑作。

entries.simplified: 大自然的令人厌恶的残余物？那是我的专长。
entries.traditional: 大自然的令人厭惡的殘餘物？那是我的專長。

entries.source: I make fashion out of things most people refuse to touch. You're welcome.
entries.simplified: 我用大多数人拒绝接触的东西制作时尚。不客气。
entries.traditional: 我用大多數人拒絕接觸的東西製作時尚。不客氣。

entries.source: If it's weird, sticky, or sharp, I can probably turn it into a hat.
entries.simplified: 如果很奇怪、粘稠或锋利，我可能可以把它变成一顶帽子。
entries.traditional: 如果很奇怪、粘稠或銳利，我可能可以把它變成一頂帽子。

entries.source: Don't call it junk. Call it aggressively unfinished fashion.
entries.simplified: 别叫它垃圾。把它叫做激进的未完成时尚。
entries.traditional: 別叫它垃圾。把它叫做激進的未完成時尚。

entries.source: Some materials whisper to me. Most just smell terrible.
entries.simplified: 有些材料对我低声细语。大多数只是闻起来很糟糕。
entries.traditional: 有些材料對我低聲細語。大多數只是聞起來很糟糕。

entries.source: The Echoing Spire does not open for curiosity. Bring a Spire Compass, and I will reveal the path upward.
entries.simplified: 回响尖塔不会因好奇心而打开。带来一个尖塔罗盘，然后
entries.traditional: 迴響尖塔不會因好奇心而打開。帶來一個尖塔羅盤，然後

entries.source: This place was built to contain unstable mastery. Those who enter without an anchor rarely return as themselves.
entries.simplified: 这个地方是为了封存不稳定的掌握而建造的。那些进入时没有
entries.traditional: 這個地方是為了封存不穩定的掌握而建造的。那些進入時沒有

entries.source: I also shape what the Spire leaves behind. Memory, resonance, nightmare... all useful materials, if handled correctly.
entries.simplified: 我也塑造尖塔留下的东西。记忆、共鸣、梦魇...
entries.traditional: 我也塑造尖塔留下的東西。記憶、共鳴、夢魘...

entries.source: Bring me what you recover from the Spire, and I may craft something worthy of your ascent.
entries.simplified: 把你从尖塔中恢复的东西带给我，我可能会打造出值得的东西
entries.traditional: 把你從尖塔中恢復的東西帶給我，我可能會打造出值得的東西

entries.simplified: 尖塔包含不稳定的精通。
entries.traditional: 尖塔包含不穩定的精通。

entries.source: The Compass points upward. Whether that is good news depends on you.
entries.simplified: 指南针指向上方。这是否是好消息取决于你。
entries.traditional: 指南針指向上方。這是否是好消息取決於你。

entries.source: If the echoes begin speaking in your voice, descend immediately.
entries.simplified: 如果回声开始用你的声音说话，立即下降。
entries.traditional: 如果迴聲開始用你的聲音說話，立即下降。

entries.source: Umbral Fragments are made of nightmares. Naturally, adventurers keep bringing me bags of them.
entries.simplified: 暗影碎片由噩梦组成。自然地，冒险者们不断地带来
entries.traditional: 暗影碎片由噩夢組成。自然地，冒險者們不斷地帶來

entries.source: Memory Fragments, Resonance Cores, Umbral Fragments... the Spire breaks many things into useful pieces.
entries.simplified: 记忆碎片、共鸣核心、暗影碎片……尖塔摧毁了许多
entries.traditional: 記憶碎片、共鳴核心、暗影碎片……尖塔摧毀了許多

entries.source: I can craft with nightmare, yes. No, you should not ask why.
entries.simplified: 我可以用噩梦来制作，是的。不，你不应该问为什么。
entries.traditional: 我可以用噩夢來製作，是的。不，你不應該問為什麼。

entries.source: Another challenger. The Spire has been patient.
entries.simplified: 又一位挑战者。尖塔一直很耐心。
entries.traditional: 又一位挑戰者。尖塔一直很耐心。

entries.simplified: 你在寻求另一次上升吗？
entries.traditional: 你在尋求另一次上升嗎？

entries.simplified: 失控的上升导致崩溃。
entries.traditional: 失控的上升導致崩潰。

entries.simplified: 此结构调节高级力量。
entries.traditional: 此結構調節高級力量。

entries.source: Bring a Spire Compass, or bring an excellent excuse. The Spire accepts only one of those.
entries.simplified: 带来一个尖塔指南针，或者带来一个很好的理由。尖塔只接受
entries.traditional: 帶來一個尖塔指南針，或者帶來一個很好的理由。尖塔只接受

entries.source: The Library remembers every fool who thought the Spire was only a tower.
entries.simplified: 图书馆记得每一个认为尖塔只是一座塔的傻瓜。
entries.traditional: 圖書館記得每一個認為尖塔只是一座塔的傻瓜。

entries.source: Power echoes differently up there. Try not to echo back.
entries.simplified: 力量在那里回响得不同。尽量不要回声。
entries.traditional: 力量在那裡迴響得不同。盡量不要回聲。

entries.source: The path is stable for now, but I would not mistake that for safety.
entries.simplified: 这条路现在还算稳定，但别把那当成安全。
entries.traditional: 這條路現在還算穩定，但別把那當成安全。

entries.source: Ascension is permitted. Wisdom is optional, apparently.
entries.simplified: 允许晋升。智慧似乎是可选的。
entries.traditional: 允許晉升。智慧似乎是可選的。

entries.source: Gems remember more than they show. Bring me a gem and Lunaris Shards, and I can help awaken what sleeps within.
entries.simplified: 宝石记得的比它们显示的要多。给我带来一颗宝石和月光碎片，然后
entries.traditional: 寶石記得的比它們顯示的要多。給我帶來一顆寶石和月光碎片，然後

entries.source: A gem can be refined all the way to +10. Of course, the brighter it shines, the more fragile its structure becomes.
entries.simplified: 宝石可以精炼到+10。当然，它闪耀得越亮，
entries.traditional: 寶石可以精煉到+10。當然，它閃耀得越亮，

entries.source: If refinement fails, the gem drops by one level. This is called balance, or tragedy, depending on who paid for it.
entries.simplified: 如果精炼失败，宝石会降低一个等级。这被称为平衡,
entries.traditional: 如果精煉失敗，寶石會降低一個等級。這被稱為平衡,

entries.source: When set into an artifact, a refined gem can sing with greater power. Please do not sing back unless invited.
entries.simplified: 当精致的宝石嵌入神器时，它能以更强大的力量歌唱。请
entries.traditional: 當精緻的寶石鑲嵌在神器中時，它能以更強大的力量歌唱。請

entries.source: Each crystal remembers the light it once held.
entries.simplified: 每个水晶都记得它曾经拥有的光芒。
entries.traditional: 每個水晶都記得它曾經擁有的光芒。

entries.source: A flawless glow is never forced. It is persuaded, cautiously, with expensive materials.
entries.simplified: 完美的光泽从不强求。它需要小心翼翼地引导，用昂贵的
entries.traditional: 完美的光澤從不強求。它需要小心翼翼地引導，用昂貴的

entries.source: If the gem brightens, thank the resonance. If it fails, perhaps you shouldn't keep hitting it.
entries.simplified: 如果宝石发亮，感谢共鸣。如果失败，也许你不应该
entries.traditional: 如果寶石發亮，感謝共鳴。如果失敗，也許你不應該

entries.source: Artifacts hold power. Gems teach them memory.
entries.simplified: 神器蕴藏力量。宝石教会它们记忆。
entries.traditional: 神器蘊藏力量。寶石教會它們記憶。

entries.source: All things hum with resonance. I only help them find their note.
entries.simplified: 万物都在共鸣中嗡鸣。我只是帮助它们找到自己的音符。
entries.traditional: 萬物都在共鳴中嗡鳴。我只是幫助它們找到自己的音符。

entries.source: Extraction is mercy; refinement, a form of prayer.
entries.simplified: 提取是怜悯；精炼是祈祷的一种形式。
entries.traditional: 提取是憐悯；精煉是祈禱的一種形式。

entries.source: The glow you seek isn't mine to grant. It's the gem's choice to awaken.
entries.simplified: 你寻求的光芒不是我能赐予的。那是宝石苏醒的选择。
entries.traditional: 你尋求的光芒不是我能賦予的。那是寶石甦醒的選擇。

entries.source: Pressure births clarity, just as struggle shapes the soul.
entries.simplified: 压力孕育清晰，如同斗争塑造灵魂。
entries.traditional: 壓力孕育清晰，如同鬥爭塑造靈魂。

entries.source: Listen closely... the stone will tell you when it's ready.
entries.simplified: 仔细听... 石头会告诉你什么时候准备好了。
entries.traditional: 仔細聽... 石頭會告訴你什麼時候準備好了。

entries.source: Lunaris is gentle enough to keep the gem whole, and powerful enough to bring it to life.
entries.simplified: Lunaris既温柔到能保持宝石完整，又强大到足以带来
entries.traditional: Lunaris既溫柔到能保持寶石完整，又強大到足以帶來

entries.source: Every gem has a voice, and some are simply very dramatic.
entries.simplified: 每颗宝石都有自己的声音，有些宝石简直非常戏剧化。
entries.traditional: 每顆寶石都有自己的聲音，有些寶石簡直非常戲劇化。

entries.source: Jewelcrafting is patience, pressure, and pretending the cracking sound was expected.
entries.simplified: 珠宝加工需要耐心、压力，还要假装那个裂纹声
entries.traditional: 珠寶加工需要耐心、壓力，還要假裝那個裂紋聲

entries.source: Come here when your body is broken, your mana is empty, or your status effects have become unbearable.
entries.simplified: 当你的身体受损、魔法值为空或你的状态效果时来这里
entries.traditional: 當你的身體受損、魔法值為空或你的狀態效果時來這裡

entries.source: I can restore your health and mana completely, and cleanse every effect clinging to you.
entries.simplified: 我可以完全恢复你的生命值和法力，并清除所有附着的效果
entries.traditional: 我可以完全恢復你的生命值和法力，並清除所有附著的效果

entries.source: Yes, every effect. Even the helpful ones. Healing is not known for being picky.
entries.simplified: 是的，每个效果。甚至有益的也是。治疗并不以
entries.traditional: 是的，每個效果。甚至有益的也是。治療並不以

entries.source: Rest a moment, breathe, and try not to immediately run back into danger. I know you will, but please try.
entries.simplified: 休息一下，深呼吸，尽量不要立即冲回危险中。
entries.traditional: 休息一下，深呼吸，盡量不要立即衝回危險中。

entries.source: Healing isn't just for the body. Sometimes, your mind forgets how to breathe.
entries.simplified: 治疗不仅仅是为了身体。有时候，你的心灵忘记了如何呼吸。
entries.traditional: 治療不僅僅是為了身體。有時候，你的心靈忘記了如何呼吸。

entries.source: Do not worry. Most adventurers arrive here looking worse.
entries.simplified: 别担心。大多数冒险者来到这里看起来更糟糕。
entries.traditional: 別擔心。大多數冒險者來到這裡看起來更糟糕。

entries.simplified: 光明无判地恢复。
entries.traditional: 光明無判地恢復。

entries.source: Take one deep breath before the next battle. It may be the smartest thing you do today.
entries.simplified: 在下一场战斗前深呼吸一次。这可能是最聪明的做法
entries.traditional: 在下一場戰鬥前深呼吸一次。這可能是最聰明的做法

entries.source: Sit a while. You'll feel stronger soon.
entries.simplified: 坐一会儿。你很快就会感到更强大。
entries.traditional: 坐一下。你很快就會感到更強大。

entries.source: The earth does not rush, and neither should your recovery.
entries.simplified: 大地不急，你的恢复也不应急促。
entries.traditional: 大地不急，你的恢復也不應急促。

entries.source: You've done enough. Rest now, and let the light grant you succor.
entries.simplified: 你做得够多了。现在休息吧，让光明给予你慰藉。
entries.traditional: 你做得夠多了。現在休息吧，讓光明給予你慰藉。

entries.source: The roots whisper of battles fought. You're not the only one carrying scars.
entries.simplified: 树根低语着曾经的战役。你不是唯一承载伤痕的人。
entries.traditional: 樹根低語著曾經的戰役。你不是唯一承載傷痕的人。

entries.source: This wound is fresh, but will mend in time. Let me help it fade.
entries.simplified: 这道伤口很新鲜，但终会愈合。让我帮助它消褪。
entries.traditional: 這道傷口很新鮮，但終會癒合。讓我幫助它消褪。

entries.source: Health, mana, curses, blessings... I clean the whole slate.
entries.simplified: 生命值、法力、诅咒、祝福……我把一切都清空。
entries.traditional: 生命值、法力、詛咒、祝福……我把一切都清空。

entries.source: Maybe you should try to de-escalate the situation next time.
entries.simplified: 也许你下次应该尝试缓和局势。
entries.traditional: 也許你下次應該嘗試緩和局勢。

entries.source: I can mend the wounds. Your life choices are beyond my reach.
entries.simplified: 我可以治愈你的伤口。但你的人生选择超出了我的能力。
entries.traditional: 我可以治癒你的傷口。但你的人生選擇超出了我的能力。

entries.source: Stand with purpose. Advancement begins when you choose what kind of strength you are reaching for.
entries.simplified: 坚定而立。当你选择何种力量时，进步才开始
entries.traditional: 堅定而立。當你選擇何種力量時，進步才開始

entries.source: Prove your readiness through action. Words are easy; growth is earned.
entries.simplified: 通过行动证明你的准备。言语容易；成长需要赚取。
entries.traditional: 透過行動證明你的準備。言語容易；成長需要賺取。

entries.source: Look ahead, but do not ignore where you stand now. Advancement begins here.
entries.simplified: 向前看，但不要忽视你现在所处的位置。进步始于此。
entries.traditional: 向前看，但不要忽視你現在所處的位置。進步始於此。

entries.source: Carry your experience with you. It is the foundation for what comes next.
entries.simplified: 把你的经验带在身边。这是接下来一切的基础。
entries.traditional: 把你的經驗帶在身邊。這是接下來一切的基礎。

entries.source: Keep moving forward. Every battle should teach you something about the path ahead.
entries.simplified: 继续前进。每场战斗都应该教会你一些关于这条道路的东西
entries.traditional: 繼續前進。每場戰鬥都應該教會你一些關於這條道路的東西

entries.source: Train with intention. Power without direction will only carry you so far.
entries.simplified: 有目标地训练。没有方向的力量只能带你走这么远。
entries.traditional: 有目標地訓練。沒有方向的力量只能帶你走這麼遠。

entries.source: Listen to what your experience has shown you. Growth is built from more than victory.
entries.simplified: 听取你的经验向你展示的内容。成长建立在不止于
entries.traditional: 聆聽你的經驗向你展示的內容。成長建立在不止於

entries.source: Take the next step when you are ready. Do not mistake hesitation for patience.
entries.simplified: 当你准备好时，迈出下一步。不要把犹豫与耐心搞混。
entries.traditional: 當你準備好時，邁出下一步。不要把猶豫與耐心搞混。

entries.source: Refine your skills before you seek greater power. Advancement rewards preparation.
entries.simplified: 在追求更强力量之前，完善你的技能。进步奖励准备。
entries.traditional: 在追求更強力量之前，完善你的技能。進步獎勵準備。

entries.source: Choose your path carefully. The strength you pursue will shape the way you fight.
entries.simplified: 谨慎地选择你的道路。你所追求的力量将塑造你的方式，
entries.traditional: 謹慎地選擇你的道路。你所追求的力量將塑造你的方式，

entries.source: Let each lesson settle before you reach for the next. Mastery is built in layers.
entries.simplified: 让每一课在继续下一课前沉淀下来。精通是在
entries.traditional: 讓每堂課在你追求下一堂課之前先沉澱下來。精通是在

entries.source: Hold steady. The path upward is clearer when your purpose is firm.
entries.simplified: 保持坚定。当你的目标坚定时，向上的道路会更清晰。
entries.traditional: 保持堅定。當你的目標堅定時，向上的道路會更清晰。

entries.source: Welcome! I'm Mira, from the Magical Item Retrieval Association. You can call me Mira; everyone does.
entries.simplified: 欢迎！我是米拉，来自魔法物品回收协会。你可以叫我
entries.traditional: 歡迎！我是米拉，來自魔法物品回收協會。你可以叫我

entries.source: I manage your personal storage, so you can deposit items and withdraw them later on your other characters.
entries.simplified: 我管理你的个人存储，所以你可以存入和取出物品
entries.traditional: 我管理你的個人存儲，所以你可以存入和提取物品

entries.source: No, I am not a maid. I just happen to be very good at keeping everyone's belongings in perfect order.
entries.simplified: 不，我不是女仆。我只是非常善于照顾所有人
entries.traditional: 不，我不是女僕。我只是非常善於照顧所有人

entries.source: Welcome! Would you like to access your Mira Vault today?
entries.simplified: 欢迎！您今天想要访问您的Mira保险库吗？
entries.traditional: 歡迎！您今天想要訪問您的Mira保險庫嗎？

entries.source: I can open your storage whenever you need it.
entries.simplified: 我可以在你需要时随时打开你的存储空间。
entries.traditional: 我可以在你需要時隨時打開你的儲存空間。

entries.source: Your items are safe, sorted, and we only slightly judge your inventory habits.
entries.simplified: 你的物品很安全，整理有序，我们只是略微评判一下你的背包习惯。
entries.traditional: 你的物品很安全，整理有序，我們只是略微評判一下你的背包習慣。

entries.source: The Magical Item Retrieval Association is a very official name for a very useful service.
entries.simplified: 魔法物品寻回协会是一个非常正式的名称，用于
entries.traditional: 魔法物品尋回協會是一個非常正式的名稱，用於

entries.source: Your valuables are in safe hands.
entries.simplified: 你的贵重物品安全妥当。
entries.traditional: 你的貴重物品安全妥當。

entries.source: Don't worry, your items will be right where you left them.
entries.simplified: 别担心，你的物品会保留在你离开时的位置。
entries.traditional: 別擔心，你的物品會保留在你離開時的位置。

entries.source: Need something transferred between characters? I've got you covered.
entries.simplified: 需要在角色之间转移物品吗？我来帮你。
entries.traditional: 需要在角色之間轉移物品嗎？我來幫你。

entries.source: Would you like to deposit or withdraw today?
entries.simplified: 您今天想存款还是取款？
entries.traditional: 您今天想存款還是取款？

entries.source: Welcome to the Magical Item Retrieval Association. How can I assist you today?
entries.simplified: 欢迎来到魔法物品回收协会。今天有什么办法可以帮你吗？
entries.traditional: 歡迎來到魔法物品回收協會。今天有什麼辦法可以幫你嗎？

entries.source: Mira keeps things simple: you bring the items, I keep them safe.
entries.simplified: 米拉保持简单：你带来物品，我把它们保管好。
entries.traditional: 米拉保持簡單：你帶來物品，我把它們保管好。

entries.source: No lost luggage, no mystery fees, no questions about why you need six identical hats.
entries.simplified: 没有丢失的行李，没有神秘费用，没有关于你为什么需要六个相同物品的问题
entries.traditional: 沒有遺失的行李、沒有神秘費用、沒有關於你為什麼需要六個相同物品的問題

entries.source: Storage is much easier when you bank with the Magical Item Retrieval Association.
entries.simplified: 当你使用魔法物品取回协会进行银行业务时,存储会变得容易得多。
entries.traditional: 當你使用魔法物品取回協會進行銀行業務時,存儲會變得容易得多。

entries.source: Looking for a real test? I manage arena matches for adventurers who want to fight other adventurers.
entries.simplified: 在寻找真正的考验吗?我为想要
entries.traditional: 在尋找真正的考驗嗎?我為想要

entries.source: You can queue for battle here, and if you have allies with you, I can help send you in together.
entries.simplified: 你可以在这里排队进行战斗,如果你带有盟友,我可以帮助
entries.traditional: 你可以在這裡排隊進行戰鬥,如果你帶有盟友,我可以幫助

entries.source: The arena is not about monsters, treasure, or excuses. It is about skill, timing, and making your opponents regret standing against you.
entries.simplified: 竞技场不是关于怪物、宝藏或借口。这是关于技能,
entries.traditional: 競技場不是關於怪物、寶藏或藉口。這是關於技能,

entries.simplified: 在寻找战斗吗?
entries.traditional: 在尋找戰鬥嗎?

entries.source: Fight clean, fight smart, and try not to embarrass yourself.
entries.simplified: 干净地战斗,聪明地战斗,尽量不要让自己丢脸。
entries.traditional: 乾淨地戰鬥,聰明地戰鬥,盡量不要讓自己丟臉。

entries.source: Every match teaches something, even the ones you lose.
entries.simplified: 每场战斗都教会一些东西,即使是你输掉的那些。
entries.traditional: 每場戰鬥都教會一些東西,即使是你輸掉的那些。

entries.source: If you're ready, step in. If not, train until you are.
entries.simplified: 如果你准备好了,就进入。如果没有,训练到你准备好。
entries.traditional: 如果你準備好了,就進入。如果沒有,訓練到你準備好。

entries.simplified: 向前迈进。证明你的力量。
entries.traditional: 向前邁進。證明你的力量。

entries.source: The arena awaits. What will it be?
entries.simplified: 竞技场在等你。你的决定是什么?
entries.traditional: 競技場在等你。你的決定是什麼?

entries.source: You've got that look... ready for battle?
entries.simplified: 你有那样的表情...准备好战斗了吗?
entries.traditional: 你有那樣的表情...準備好戰鬥了嗎?

entries.source: Queue up when you're ready. The arena will find your match.
entries.simplified: 准备好后排队。竞技场会为你找到对手。
entries.traditional: 準備好後排隊。競技場會為你找到對手。

entries.source: Bring allies if you trust them. Bring confidence if you trust yourself.
entries.simplified: 如果你信任他们,就带上盟友。如果你信任自己,就带上信心。
entries.traditional: 如果你信任他們,就帶上盟友。如果你信任自己,就帶上信心。

entries.source: A good fighter watches the field. A great one knows when to retreat.
entries.simplified: 好的战斗者观察战场。伟大的战斗者知道何时退出。
entries.traditional: 好的戰鬥者觀察戰場。偉大的戰鬥者知道何時退出。

entries.source: Victory starts before the first strike.
entries.simplified: 胜利在第一次打击之前开始。
entries.traditional: 勝利在第一次打擊之前開始。

entries.source: The arena does not care how strong you think you are.
entries.simplified: 竞技场不在乎你认为自己有多强。
entries.traditional: 競技場不在乎你認為自己有多強。

entries.source: Welcome to Nevaris. The last bastion of hope.
entries.simplified: 欢迎来到Nevaris。希望的最后堡垒。
entries.traditional: 歡迎來到Nevaris。希望的最後堡壘。

entries.source: Warning: Reports of undead activity have increased in the southern region.
entries.simplified: 警告:南方地区的不死活动报告已增加。
entries.traditional: 警告:南方地區的不死活動報告已增加。

entries.source: I used to be an adventurer like you... until that cursed Vorpal Hare.
entries.simplified: 我曾经是像你一样的冒险家...直到那个诅咒的Vorpal Hare。
entries.traditional: 我曾經是像你一樣的冒險家...直到那個詛咒的Vorpal Hare。

entries.simplified: 负责任地研磨。
entries.traditional: 負責任地研磨。

entries.source: Undead warning: bring light, bring courage, and do not listen to voices from the dark.
entries.simplified: 亡灵警告：带上光芒、带上勇气，不要听从 黑暗中的声音。
entries.traditional: 亡靈警告：帶上光芒、帶上勇氣，不要聽從 黑暗中的聲音。

entries.source: New adventurers: running away is a valid strategy if you survive long enough to use it.
entries.simplified: 新冒险者：如果你能活得足够久 那么逃跑就是一个有效的策略。
entries.traditional: 新冒險者：如果你能活得足夠久 那麼逃跑就是一個有效的策略。

entries.source: If you hear strange noises from the woods, congratulations. The woods heard you first.
entries.simplified: 如果你听到森林里传来奇怪的声音，恭喜。森林听到了你
entries.traditional: 如果你聽到森林裡傳來奇怪的聲音，恭喜。森林聽到了你

entries.source: Nevaris welcomes all adventurers. The wilderness has not agreed to this policy.
entries.simplified: nevaris欢迎所有冒险家。荒野还没有同意这一政策。
entries.traditional: nevaris歡迎所有冒險家。荒野還沒有同意這一政策。

entries.source: If you're finding it tough out there, maybe try refining your gear.
entries.simplified: 如果你觉得困难，也许试试改进你的装备吧。
entries.traditional: 如果你覺得困難，也許試試改進你的裝備吧。

entries.source: Notice: Wild creatures ahead. Some are cute. All have poor manners.
entries.simplified: 注意：前方有野生生物。有些很可爱。都没有礼貌。
entries.traditional: 注意：前方有野生生物。有些很可愛。都沒有禮貌。

entries.source: Warning: If it hops, buzzes, crawls, or stares too long, assume it bites.
entries.simplified: 警告：如果它跳跃、嗡鸣、爬行或凝视过久，请假设它会咬人。
entries.traditional: 警告：如果它跳躍、嗡鳴、爬行或凝視過久，請假設它會咬人。

entries.source: Beware the Bunny. This is not a joke. The last person laughed too.
entries.simplified: 当心那只兔子。这不是玩笑。上一个笑的人也是如此。
entries.traditional: 當心那隻兔子。這不是玩笑。上一個笑的人也是如此。

entries.source: You are now leaving the safe zone. Check your gear, your supplies, and your confidence.
entries.simplified: 你现在正在离开安全区。检查你的装备、物资和你的
entries.traditional: 你現在正在離開安全區。檢查你的裝備、物資和你的

entries.source: Adventure this way. Regret may also be this way.
entries.simplified: 冒险就在这边。遗憾也可能在这边。
entries.traditional: 冒險就在這邊。遺憾也可能在這邊。

entries.source: Field bosses may appear when you least want company.
entries.simplified: 野外boss可能在你最不希望有伙伴的时候出现。
entries.traditional: 野外boss可能在你最不希望有夥伴的時候出現。

entries.source: There are no quests posted here. There is, however, always plenty of trouble nearby.
entries.simplified: 这里没有发布任何任务。不过，总是有很多麻烦
entries.traditional: 這裡沒有發布任何任務。不過，總是有很多麻煩

entries.source: Need a new look? I can guide you to the styling mirror and help reshape your appearance.
entries.simplified: 需要改变外观吗？我可以引导你到造型镜前，帮助你重塑你的
entries.traditional: 需要改變外觀嗎？我可以引導你到造型鏡前，幫助你重塑你的

entries.source: Hair, face, colors, style... most things can be changed. Your name, however, is staying exactly where it is.
entries.simplified: 头发、脸部、颜色、风格...大多数东西都可以改变。但你的名字，
entries.traditional: 頭髮、臉部、顏色、風格...大多數東西都可以改變。但你的名字，

entries.source: Think of it as reinvention, not regret. I do accept regret as a reason.
entries.simplified: 把它看作是重新定义自己，而不是遗憾。不过我也接受遗憾作为理由。
entries.traditional: 把它看作是重新定義自己，而不是遺憾。不過我也接受遺憾作為理由。

entries.source: Feeling bold, or just bored? Either way, let's make it work.
entries.simplified: 感到大胆，还是只是无聊？不管怎样，让我们把它做好。
entries.traditional: 感到大膽，還是只是無聊？不管怎樣，讓我們把它做好。

entries.source: I can change your look, not your name. Some mistakes are beyond my scissors.
entries.simplified: 我可以改变你的外观，但改不了你的名字。有些错误超出了我剪刀的范围。
entries.traditional: 我可以改變你的外觀，但改不了你的名字。有些錯誤超出了我剪刀的範圍。

entries.source: A new hairstyle can solve many problems. Not all of them, but enough to justify the visit.
entries.simplified: 新发型可以解决许多问题。并非全部，但足以证明
entries.traditional: 新髮型可以解決許多問題。並非全部，但足以證明

entries.source: Nothing says fresh start like pretending this was always your style.
entries.simplified: 没有什么比假装这一直是你的风格更能说明"全新开始"。
entries.traditional: 沒有什麼比假裝這一直是你的風格更能說明「全新開始」。

entries.source: Step into the mirror. Step out with better decisions.
entries.simplified: 踏入镜中。做出更好的决定后走出来。
entries.traditional: 踏入鏡中。做出更好的決定後走出來。

entries.source: Your face is not permanent. Your reputation might be, but we can work around it.
entries.simplified: 你的脸不是永久的。你的声誉可能是，但我们可以想办法
entries.traditional: 你的臉不是永久的。你的聲譽可能是，但我們可以想辦法

entries.source: Style is the strongest kind of magic. Let's cast some.
entries.simplified: 风格是最强大的魔法。让我们施展吧。
entries.traditional: 風格是最強大的魔法。讓我們施展吧。

entries.source: It's still you, just better dressed.
entries.simplified: 还是你，只是穿得更好看了。
entries.traditional: 還是你，只是穿得更好看了。

entries.source: New look, new you? Or just hiding from your past?
entries.simplified: 新的外表，新的你？还是只是躲避你的过去？
entries.traditional: 新的外表，新的妳？還是只是躲避妳的過去？

entries.source: A snip here, a tint there. No one has to know what you used to look like.
entries.simplified: 这里剪一下，那里染一下。没人需要知道你以前长什么样。
entries.traditional: 這裡剪一下，那裡染一下。沒人需要知道你以前長什麼樣。

entries.source: You bring the face, I bring the flair.
entries.simplified: 你带来脸蛋，我带来风格。
entries.traditional: 你帶來臉蛋，我帶來風格。

entries.source: Some call it vanity. I call it reinvention.
entries.simplified: 有人称之为虚荣。我称之为重塑。
entries.traditional: 有人稱之為虛榮。我稱之為重塑。

entries.source: Your enemies won't recognize you. That's the idea.
entries.simplified: 你的敌人不会认出你。这就是重点。
entries.traditional: 你的敵人不會認出你。這就是重點。

entries.source: Change can be scary, but not when it's this fabulous.
entries.simplified: 改变可能令人害怕，但这样的华丽改变除外。
entries.traditional: 改變可能令人害怕，但這樣的華麗改變除外。

entries.source: I keep watch over special experience events. Speak with me, and I'll tell you whether bonus experience is active.
entries.simplified: 我守护着特殊经验事件。与我交谈，我会告诉你
entries.traditional: 我守護著特殊經驗事件。與我交談，我會告訴你

entries.source: I manage vending stalls for adventurers who want to sell items while they are away.
entries.simplified: 我管理冒险者的销售摊位，这些冒险者想在他们
entries.traditional: 我管理冒險者的銷售攤位，這些冒險者想在他們

entries.source: Pay the stall fee, choose a shop name, and your vending spot will open for other adventurers to browse.
entries.simplified: 支付摊位费用，选择商店名称，你的销售位置将开放
entries.traditional: 支付攤位費用，選擇商店名稱，你的銷售位置將開放

entries.source: Your stall stays active for 48 hours, but you can release it early if you are done selling.
entries.simplified: 你的摊位保持活跃 48 小时，但如果你
entries.traditional: 你的攤位保持活躍 48 小時，但如果你

entries.source: Rent a spot. Stand still. Hope people notice you.
entries.simplified: 租一个位置。静静站着。希望别人注意到你。
entries.traditional: 租一個位置。靜靜站著。希望別人注意到你。

entries.source: The market doesn't care about your feelings. Only your prices.
entries.simplified: 市场不在乎你的感受。只在乎你的价格。
entries.traditional: 市場不在乎你的感受。只在乎你的價格。

entries.source: Location, location, location. This one's available.
entries.simplified: 位置，位置，位置。这个可用。
entries.traditional: 位置，位置，位置。這個可用。

entries.source: I've seen vendors stand here for 48 hours and sell nothing. Inspiring.
entries.simplified: 我见过商贩在这里站了48小时，却一无所获。令人敬佩。
entries.traditional: 我見過商販在這裡站了48小時，卻一無所獲。令人敬佩。

entries.source: You're not just selling items. You're selling the dream of selling items.
entries.simplified: 你不仅仅是在出售物品。你在出售出售物品的梦想。
entries.traditional: 你不僅僅是在出售物品。你在出售出售物品的夢想。

entries.source: Forty-eight hours. Make it count, or at least make it awkward for passersby.
entries.simplified: 四十八小时。让它有价值，或者至少让经过的人感到尴尬。
entries.traditional: 四十八小時。讓它有價值，或者至少讓經過的人感到尷尬。

entries.source: Every great merchant started somewhere. Most of them started cheaper than you.
entries.simplified: 每一位伟大的商人都从某个地方开始。他们中的大多数开始的价格都比
entries.traditional: 每一位偉大的商人都從某個地方開始。他們中的大多數開始的價格都比

entries.source: The stall is neutral ground. What happens after the purchase is between you and the buyer.
entries.simplified: 摊位是中立区域。购买后发生的事只是你的事
entries.traditional: 攤位是中立區域。購買後發生的事只是你的事

entries.source: I don't judge what you sell. I judge whether you can afford the rent.
entries.simplified: 我不评判你卖什么。我评判你能否负担租金。
entries.traditional: 我不評判你賣什麼。我評判你能否負擔租金。

entries.source: Looking to cross the water? I sail from Wayfarer's Landing to Stormreef Isle whenever you're ready.
entries.simplified: 想要渡水吗？我从Wayfarer's Landing航行到Stormreef Isle
entries.traditional: 想要渡水嗎？我從Wayfarer's Landing航行到Stormreef Isle

entries.source: Stormreef is the first stop out there. Keep your footing, watch the waves, and we will arrive there safely.
entries.simplified: Stormreef是那边的第一站。保持平衡，留意海浪，
entries.traditional: Stormreef是那邊的第一站。保持平衡，留意海浪，

entries.simplified: 需要前往风暴礁岛的通行证吗？
entries.traditional: 需要前往風暴礁島的通行證嗎？

entries.source: Stormreef's a fine place, if you like salt, wind, and danger with excellent scenery.
entries.simplified: 如果你喜欢盐、风和危险，风暴礁是个很好的地方，具有卓越的
entries.traditional: 如果你喜歡鹽、風和危險，風暴礁是個很好的地方，具有卓越的

entries.source: Sea's calm enough today. That is as close to a promise as sailors make.
entries.simplified: 今天海面平静得足够了。这已经是水手能给出的最接近承诺的东西了。
entries.traditional: 今天海面平靜得足夠了。這已經是水手能給出的最接近承諾的東西了。

entries.source: Wayfarer's Landing behind us, Stormreef ahead. Simple route, rough water.
entries.simplified: Wayfarer's Landing 在我们身后,Stormreef 在前方。简单的航线,水流湍急。
entries.traditional: Wayfarer's Landing 在我們身後,Stormreef 在前方。簡單的航線,水流湍急。

entries.source: Step aboard when you're ready. The island is not getting any closer.
entries.simplified: 准备好了就上船吧。岛屿不会自己靠近的。
entries.traditional: 準備好了就上船吧。島嶼不會自己靠近的。

entries.source: Stormreef Isle is waiting. So are the things living there, unfortunately.
entries.simplified: 风暴礁岛在等待。不幸的是，那里的生物也在等待。
entries.traditional: 風暴礁島在等待。不幸的是，那裡的生物也在等待。

entries.source: I can take you across. I guarantee you will enjoy the crossing.
entries.simplified: 我可以把你送过去。我保证你会喜欢这次航行。
entries.traditional: 我可以把你送過去。我保證你會喜歡這次航行。

entries.source: The boat floats, the route is open, and I only worry when the sea gets too quiet.
entries.simplified: 船漂浮着，路线开放，我只在大海变得太
entries.traditional: 船漂浮著，路線開放，我只在大海變得太

entries.source: Heading out? Check your supplies before we leave shore.
entries.simplified: 要出发了？在我们离开海岸之前检查一下你的物资。
entries.traditional: 要出發了？在我們離開海岸之前檢查一下你的物資。

entries.source: First rule of sailing: respect the water. Second rule: hold on when I say hold on.
entries.simplified: 航海的第一条规则：尊重海水。第二条规则：当我说的时候 抓牢。
entries.traditional: 航海的第一條規則：尊重海水。第二條規則：當我說的時候 抓牢。

entries.source: The world is wide, and your path will often lead you far from safety.
entries.simplified: 世界广阔，你的道路常常会把你带到远离安全的地方。
entries.traditional: 世界廣闊，你的道路常常會把你帶到遠離安全的地方。

entries.source: Take this Waystone. It is attuned to Nevaris, and will carry you back here when you need to return.
entries.simplified: 拿走这块路石。它已与涅瓦瑞斯同调，会把你送回这里
entries.traditional: 拿走這塊路石。它已與涅瓦瑞斯同調，會把你送回這裡

entries.source: Across the land, you will find Waypoints bound to other places. Discover them, and your Waystone will remember their locations.
entries.simplified: 遍布这片大地，你将发现与其他地方相连的路标点。发现
entries.traditional: 遍布這片大地，你將發現與其他地方相連的路標點。發現

entries.source: If your own path ever feels wrong, return to me. I can reset your attributes and skills, so you may begin again.
entries.simplified: 如果你的道路曾感到不对，回到我这里。我可以重置你的属性
entries.traditional: 如果你的道路曾感到不對，回到我這裡。我可以重置你的屬性

entries.source: If your path feels wrong, I can help you walk another.
entries.simplified: 如果你的道路感觉错误，我可以帮助你走另一条。
entries.traditional: 如果你的道路感覺錯誤，我可以幫助你走另一條。

entries.source: There is no shame in beginning again with clearer purpose.
entries.simplified: 以更清晰的目标重新开始并无羞愧。
entries.traditional: 以更清晰的目標重新開始並無羞愧。

entries.source: I do not change who you are, only how you choose to grow.
entries.simplified: 我不改变你是谁，只改变你如何选择成长。
entries.traditional: 我不改變你是誰，只改變你如何選擇成長。

entries.source: Sometimes we take the wrong steps. Let me show you the way.
entries.simplified: 有时我们走错了路。让我为你指引方向。
entries.traditional: 有時我們走錯了路。讓我為你指引方向。

entries.source: Come to return, or to begin again?
entries.simplified: 你是来回归，还是要重新开始？
entries.traditional: 你是來回歸，還是要重新開始？

entries.source: Your Waystone remembers more roads than your feet ever could.
entries.simplified: 你的路标石记得的道路比你的双脚能走过的还要多。
entries.traditional: 你的路標石記得的道路比你的雙腳能走過的還要多。

entries.source: Find a Waypoint, and the path back becomes easier.
entries.simplified: 找到一个路标点，回程的路就会变得更容易。
entries.traditional: 找到一個路標點，回程的路就會變得更容易。

entries.source: Attributes can be reshaped. Skills can be relearned. The choice remains yours.
entries.simplified: 属性可以重新塑造。技能可以重新学习。选择权仍在你手中。
entries.traditional: 屬性可以重新塑造。技能可以重新學習。選擇權仍在你手中。

entries.source: A path is not a prison. Turn back, change course, and continue.
entries.simplified: 道路不是囚笼。回头、改变方向，继续前行。
entries.traditional: 道路不是囚籠。回頭、改變方向，繼續前行。

entries.source: Nevaris is bound to your Waystone now. Let it be your anchor.
entries.simplified: Nevaris现已绑定到你的路标石。让它成为你的锚点。
entries.traditional: Nevaris現已綁定到你的路標石。讓它成為你的錨點。

entries.source: Cards can bind powerful magic into gear. I can loosen that bond and remove them for a bit of coin.
entries.simplified: 卡牌可以将强大的魔法绑定到装备上。我可以松开这个绑定并移除
entries.traditional: 卡牌可以將強大的魔法綁定到裝備上。我可以鬆開這個綁定並移除

entries.source: Bring me the gear, and I will separate what was woven into place.
entries.simplified: 把装备拿给我，我会分离其中织入的东西。
entries.traditional: 把裝備拿給我，我會分離其中織入的東西。

entries.source: Think carefully before you bind a card. Think less carefully if you have enough coin to undo it.
entries.simplified: 在绑定卡牌前要仔细思考。如果你有的话就不那么仔细地思考
entries.traditional: 在綁定卡牌前要仔細思考。如果你有的話就不那麼仔細地思考

entries.source: Pulling magic loose isn't easy. Or cheap.
entries.simplified: 抽取魔法并不容易。也不便宜。
entries.traditional: 抽取魔法並不容易。也不便宜。

entries.source: Choose the card you want removed, and try not to look embarrassed.
entries.simplified: 选择你要移除的卡牌，尽量不要显得尴尬。
entries.traditional: 選擇你要移除的卡牌，盡量不要顯得尷尬。

entries.source: Some call this delicate work. I call it cleaning up after adventurers.
entries.simplified: 有些人称这为精细活。我称之为收拾冒险家留下的烂摊子。
entries.traditional: 有些人稱這為精細活。我稱之為收拾冒險家留下的爛攤子。

entries.source: If the card was a mistake, congratulations. You have found the correct counter.
entries.simplified: 如果卡牌是个错误，恭喜你。你找到了正确的对策。
entries.traditional: 如果卡牌是個錯誤，恭喜你。你找到了正確的對策。

entries.source: You fused the wrong card, didn't you? It happens.
entries.simplified: 你融合了错误的卡牌，不是吗？这种事会发生。
entries.traditional: 你融合了錯誤的卡牌，不是嗎？這種事會發生。

entries.source: I separate what others swear was permanent.
entries.simplified: 我将他人发誓永恒的东西分开。
entries.traditional: 我將他人發誓永恆的東西分開。

entries.simplified: 让我们解除那张卡的绑定。
entries.traditional: 讓我們解除那張卡的綁定。

entries.source: Undoing bad choices is my full-time job.
entries.simplified: 撤销坏决定是我的全职工作。
entries.traditional: 撤銷壞決定是我的全職工作。

entries.source: Cards cling tightly once bound. Fortunately, I am very persuasive.
entries.simplified: 卡牌一旦绑定就会紧紧粘合。幸运的是，我很有说服力。
entries.traditional: 卡牌一旦綁定就會緊緊粘合。幸運的是，我很有說服力。

entries.source: A little coin, a careful hand, and now you can choose a better option.
entries.simplified: 一枚小硬币，一只灵巧的手，现在你可以选择更好的选项。
entries.traditional: 一枚小硬幣，一隻靈巧的手，現在你可以選擇更好的選項。

entries.source: Bound magic always leaves a thread. I simply know where to pull.
entries.simplified: 束缚的魔法总是留下一条线。我只是知道在哪里拉。
entries.traditional: 束縛的魔法總是留下一條線。我只是知道在哪裡拉。

entries.source: There is no shame in changing your mind. There is usually a fee, though.
entries.simplified: 改变主意没有什么可羞愧的。不过通常需要支付费用。
entries.traditional: 改變主意沒有什麼可羞愧的。不過通常需要支付費用。

entries.source: Softly glowing scripture turns mercy into shelter for the wounded.
entries.simplified: 泛着柔光的经文将慈悲化作庇护伤者的屏障。
entries.traditional: 泛著柔光的經文將慈悲化作庇護傷者的屏障。

entries.source: Gilded pages urge each strike onward until faith hardens into radiance.
entries.simplified: 镀金书页催促每一次攻击向前，直到信念凝成光辉。
entries.traditional: 鍍金書頁催促每一次攻擊向前，直到信念凝成光輝。

entries.source: Bright verses sharpen holy light into judgment that lingers around the faithful.
entries.simplified: 明亮的诗句将圣光磨砺成审判，萦绕在虔诚信徒身旁。
entries.traditional: 明亮的詩句將聖光磨礪成審判，縈繞在虔誠信徒身旁。

entries.source: Gentle hymns fill the pages, deepening grace with every healing prayer.
entries.simplified: 温柔的圣歌写满书页，让每一次治疗祷告都加深恩典。
entries.traditional: 溫柔的聖歌寫滿書頁，讓每一次治療禱告都加深恩典。

entries.source: Threaded verses bend holy light faster, cleaner, and farther than ordinary prayer.
entries.simplified: 交织的诗篇让圣光比寻常祷告更快、更纯净，也能传得更远。
entries.traditional: 交織的詩篇讓聖光比尋常祈禱更快、更純淨，也能傳得更遠。

entries.source: Measured psalms keep hands steady and healing magic moving in perfect cadence.
entries.simplified: 节律严谨的赞美诗让双手保持稳定，使治疗魔法以完美节奏流转。
entries.traditional: 節律嚴謹的讚美詩讓雙手保持穩定，使治療魔法以完美節奏流轉。

entries.source: Briefly protect yourself and allies by invoking your faith. Praise the light!
entries.simplified: 祈求信仰，短暂保护自己与盟友。赞美圣光！
entries.traditional: 祈求信仰，短暫保護自己與隊友。讚美聖光！

entries.source: Leap through the air and fire downward, striking enemies below before landing with evasive grace.
entries.simplified: 跃至空中向下射击，在优雅闪避落地前击中下方敌人。
entries.traditional: 躍至空中向下射擊，在優雅閃避落地前擊中下方敵人。

entries.source: Sharpen your focus and reflexes, increasing AGI and DEX for a short time.
entries.simplified: 凝聚专注与反应力，短时间提高 AGI 和 DEX。
entries.traditional: 凝聚專注與反應力，短時間提高 AGI 和 DEX。

entries.source: The summon radiates angelic grace, increasing healing received by nearby allies.
entries.simplified: 召唤物散发天使恩典，提高附近盟友受到的治疗效果。
entries.traditional: 召喚物散發天使恩典，提高附近隊友受到的治療效果。

entries.source: Push your magic beyond safe limits, increasing Magic Attack and Cast Speed at the cost of higher MP use.
entries.simplified: 将魔力推至安全极限之外，以更高 MP 消耗为代价，提高魔法攻击与施法速度。
entries.traditional: 將魔力推至安全極限之外，以更高 MP 消耗為代價，提高魔法攻擊與施法速度。

entries.source: The summon radiates protective armor, increasing nearby allies' All Resistance while shielding itself with Protection.
entries.simplified: 召唤物散发防护装甲，提高附近盟友的所有抗性，并以防护保护自身。
entries.traditional: 召喚物散發防護裝甲，提高附近隊友的所有抗性，並以防護保護自身。

entries.source: Rain arrows over a wide area, striking enemies repeatedly and forcing them to scatter.
entries.simplified: 向大范围降下箭雨，反复命中敌人并迫使他们四散。
entries.traditional: 向大範圍降下箭雨，反覆命中敵人並迫使他們四散。

entries.source: Perform an auto attack against the target.
entries.simplified: 对目标发动一次普通攻击。
entries.traditional: 對目標發動一次普通攻擊。

entries.source: Increases the damage dealt by your auto attacks.
entries.simplified: 提高自动攻击造成的伤害。
entries.traditional: 提升普通攻擊造成的傷害。

entries.source: Auto attacks have a chance to automatically fire Strafing Volley.
entries.simplified: 自动攻击有概率自动施放 Strafing Volley。
entries.traditional: 普通攻擊有機率自動施放 Strafing Volley。

entries.source: Swing twice in wide arcs, cutting through enemies in front of you.
entries.simplified: 以宽阔弧线连续挥击两次，斩击前方敌人。
entries.traditional: 以寬闊弧線連續揮擊兩次，斬擊前方敵人。

entries.source: Increases attack with axes, swords, and scythes, and raises critical chance.
entries.simplified: 提升使用斧、剑与镰刀时的攻击力，并提高暴击率。
entries.traditional: 提升使用斧、劍與鐮刀時的攻擊力，並提高暴擊率。

entries.source: Hurl your axe in a brutal arc, striking the target before it snaps back into your grasp.
entries.simplified: 沿残暴弧线掷出斧头，命中目标后猛然弹回手中。
entries.traditional: 沿殘暴弧線擲出斧頭，命中目標後猛然彈回手中。

entries.source: Unleash a spinning slash that damages nearby enemies and pulls them toward you.
entries.simplified: 释放旋转斩击，伤害附近敌人并将他们拉向自己。
entries.traditional: 釋放旋轉斬擊，傷害附近敵人並將他們拉向自己。

entries.source: Wrap an ally in divine protection, forming a barrier based on their maximum health.
entries.simplified: 以神圣防护包裹一名盟友，形成基于其最大生命值的屏障。
entries.traditional: 以神聖防護包覆一名隊友，形成基於其最大生命值的屏障。

entries.source: Smash the target with a crushing blow, with a chance to stun them.
entries.simplified: 以碾压般的一击猛砸目标，并有概率使其眩晕。
entries.traditional: 以碾壓般的一擊猛砸目標，並有機率使其暈眩。

entries.source: Enter a reckless battle state, greatly increasing combat power while abandoning restraint.
entries.simplified: 进入不顾一切的战斗状态，大幅提高战斗能力，同时彻底舍弃克制。
entries.traditional: 進入不顧一切的戰鬥狀態，大幅提高戰鬥能力，同時徹底捨棄克制。

entries.source: Torn battle pages teach every shout to carry courage farther.
entries.simplified: 撕裂的战斗书页教会每一声呐喊将勇气传得更远。
entries.traditional: 撕裂的戰鬥書頁教會每一聲吶喊將勇氣傳得更遠。

entries.source: Blood-red ink thrashes across the page, hungry for the next critical strike.
entries.simplified: 血红墨迹在书页上狂乱翻腾，渴求下一次暴击。
entries.traditional: 血紅墨跡在書頁上狂亂翻騰，渴求下一次暴擊。

entries.source: Savage notes reward every fallen foe with momentum, fury, and terrible focus.
entries.simplified: 狂野笔记让每个倒下的敌人都化作冲势、怒火与可怕的专注。
entries.traditional: 狂野筆記讓每個倒下的敵人都化作衝勢、怒火與可怕的專注。

entries.source: A grim manual for ending hesitation when weakened enemies stand too long.
entries.simplified: 一本阴郁的手册，教你在虚弱敌人苟延残喘时彻底斩断犹豫。
entries.traditional: 一本陰鬱的手冊，教你在虛弱敵人苟延殘喘時徹底斬斷猶豫。

entries.source: Unleash a flurry of strikes around you, cutting down nearby enemies in rapid motion.
entries.simplified: 在身边释放疾风骤雨般的连续斩击，迅速击倒附近敌人。
entries.traditional: 在身邊釋放疾風驟雨般的連續斬擊，迅速擊倒附近敵人。

entries.source: Increases attack with daggers, swords, twinblades, and katars, while improving Attack Speed.
entries.simplified: 提升使用匕首、剑、双刃武器与拳刃时的攻击力，并提高攻击速度。
entries.traditional: 提升使用匕首、劍、雙刃武器與拳刃時的攻擊力，並提高攻擊速度。

entries.source: Empower your attacks with jagged strikes, giving them a chance to apply Bleeding.
entries.simplified: 让攻击附带锯齿般的伤口，使其有概率施加流血。
entries.traditional: 讓攻擊附帶鋸齒般的傷口，使其有機率施加流血。

entries.source: Bless nearby allies with divine protection, raising all attributes for a short time.
entries.simplified: 以神圣防护祝福附近盟友，短时间提高所有属性。
entries.traditional: 以神聖防護祝福附近隊友，短時間提高所有屬性。

entries.source: Teleport to a target location, slipping out of danger and repositioning with precision.
entries.simplified: 传送至目标地点，脱离危险并精准调整位置。
entries.traditional: 傳送至目標地點，脫離危險並精準調整位置。

entries.source: Spend stored Rage to recover health instantly and keep regenerating for a short time.
entries.simplified: 消耗已储存的怒气，立即恢复生命值，并在短时间内持续恢复。
entries.traditional: 消耗已儲存的怒氣，立即恢復生命值，並在短時間內持續恢復。

entries.source: Give in to relentless violence, trading control for speed, pressure, and sustain.
entries.simplified: 放任无休止的暴力，以控制力换取速度、压制力与续航。
entries.traditional: 放任無休止的暴力，以控制力換取速度、壓制力與續航。

entries.source: The summon radiates bloodlust, granting nearby allies HP siphon while giving itself Multistrike.
entries.simplified: 召唤物散发嗜血气息，赋予附近盟友 HP汲取，并使自身获得多重攻击。
entries.traditional: 召喚物散發嗜血氣息，賦予附近隊友 HP汲取，並使自身獲得多重攻擊。

entries.source: Hurl a sharpened lance of bone that pierces through flesh and spirit alike.
entries.simplified: 掷出锋利骨矛，同时贯穿血肉与灵魂。
entries.traditional: 擲出鋒利骨矛，同時貫穿血肉與靈魂。

entries.source: Rupture the ground with jagged bone spikes, impaling enemies caught above them.
entries.simplified: 使锯齿状骨刺破土而出，刺穿上方敌人。
entries.traditional: 使鋸齒狀骨刺破土而出，刺穿上方敵人。

entries.source: Deliver an absurdly powerful bonk to the target. Some lessons require blunt force.
entries.simplified: 对目标使出威力荒谬的一记 Bonk。有些教训只能靠钝器。
entries.traditional: 對目標使出威力荒謬的一記 Bonk。有些教訓只能靠鈍器。

entries.source: Enhances boss skills with extra projectiles and range for stronger area pressure.
entries.simplified: 强化首领技能，增加额外投射物与攻击范围，从而形成更强的区域压制。
entries.traditional: 強化頭目技能，增加額外投射物與攻擊範圍，從而形成更強的區域壓制。

entries.source: Unleash lightning that jumps between enemies, shocking each target it chains through.
entries.simplified: 释放会在敌人之间跳跃的闪电，电击其连锁经过的每一个目标。
entries.traditional: 釋放會在敵人之間跳躍的閃電，電擊其連鎖經過的每一個目標。

entries.source: Blend into shifting shadows, hiding from sight until you attack, cast, or take a hit.
entries.simplified: 融入流动暗影，在攻击、施法或受到伤害前保持隐形。
entries.traditional: 融入流動暗影，在攻擊、施法或受到傷害前保持隱形。

entries.source: Increases Magic Attack with books, staffs, and maces, while improving Healing.
entries.simplified: 提升使用书籍、法杖与钉头锤时的魔法攻击，并强化治疗。
entries.traditional: 提升使用書籍、法杖與釘頭鎚時的魔法攻擊，並強化治療。

entries.source: Detonate unstable flames around the target, dealing Fire magic damage and applying Burning.
entries.simplified: 引爆目标周围的不稳定火焰，造成火魔法伤害并施加灼烧。
entries.traditional: 引爆目標周圍的不穩定火焰，造成火魔法傷害並施加灼燒。

entries.source: Deepen your bond with summoned allies, improving summon damage and healing power.
entries.simplified: 加深你与召唤盟友之间的联系，提高召唤物伤害与治疗能力。
entries.traditional: 加深你與召喚隊友之間的聯繫，提高召喚物傷害與治療能力。

entries.source: Bathe the ground in holy light, burning enemies who remain within the consecrated area.
entries.simplified: 以圣光沐浴地面，灼烧停留在祝圣区域内的敌人。
entries.traditional: 以聖光沐浴地面，灼燒停留在祝聖區域內的敵人。

entries.source: Drop a pillar of light that purifies the surrounding area, burning the unworthy and healing the righteous.
entries.simplified: 降下一道净化周围区域的光柱，灼烧不配者并治疗正义之人。
entries.traditional: 降下一道淨化周圍區域的光柱，灼燒不配者並治療正義之人。

entries.source: Radiate unwavering resolve, increasing nearby allies' Melee, Ranged, and Magic damage.
entries.simplified: 散发坚定不移的决意，提高附近盟友的近战、远程与魔法伤害。
entries.traditional: 散發堅定不移的決意，提高附近隊友的近戰、遠程與魔法傷害。

entries.source: Bind stolen bone and life into a grim barrier, shielding yourself through your summon.
entries.simplified: 将夺来的骨骼与生命束缚成阴森屏障，通过召唤物保护自己。
entries.traditional: 將奪來的骨骼與生命束縛成陰森屏障，透過召喚物保護自己。

entries.source: Detonate a Skeleton summon in a burst of necrotic force, causing nearby enemies and summons to explode on death.
entries.simplified: 引爆一个 Skeleton 召唤物，释放死灵冲击，使附近敌人与召唤物在死亡时爆炸。
entries.traditional: 引爆一個 Skeleton 召喚物，釋放死靈衝擊，使附近敵人與召喚物在死亡時爆炸。

entries.source: Mark an enemy with corpse magic, causing them to erupt with decay when death claims them.
entries.simplified: 以尸骸魔法标记一名敌人，使其在死亡降临时爆发腐败力量。
entries.traditional: 以屍骸魔法標記一名敵人，使其在死亡降臨時爆發腐敗力量。

entries.source: Mark a summon with corpse magic, causing it to explode when destroyed.
entries.simplified: 以尸骸魔法标记一个召唤物，使其被摧毁时爆炸。
entries.traditional: 以屍骸魔法標記一個召喚物，使其被摧毀時爆炸。

entries.source: Raise your guard and counter. Blocks attacks and hits back with a stunning blow!
entries.simplified: 架起防御并进行反击。格挡攻击，并以一记令人眩晕的重击还击！
entries.traditional: 架起防禦並進行反擊。格擋攻擊，並以一記令人暈眩的重擊還擊！

entries.source: Release a retaliatory strike, stunning enemies caught in the force of your counter.
entries.simplified: 释放报复性斩击，使受到反击力量波及的敌人眩晕。
entries.traditional: 釋放報復性斬擊，使受到反擊力量波及的敵人暈眩。

entries.source: Rip into the target with a savage follow-up strike after landing a critical hit.
entries.simplified: 在打出暴击后，以凶残的追加攻击撕裂目标。
entries.traditional: 在打出暴擊後，以凶殘的追加攻擊撕裂目標。

entries.source: Increases the damage dealt by critical hits.
entries.simplified: 提升暴击造成的伤害。
entries.traditional: 提升暴擊造成的傷害。

entries.source: Turn your charge into a rallying surge, granting nearby allies Might and Protection.
entries.simplified: 将冲锋化作鼓舞人心的推进，为附近盟友赋予威能与防护。
entries.traditional: 將衝鋒化作鼓舞人心的推進，為附近隊友賦予威能與防護。

entries.source: Purify an ally with holy clarity, protecting them from Poison, Blind, and Silence.
entries.simplified: 以神圣净化清除盟友身上的污秽，使其免受毒、致盲与沉默。
entries.traditional: 以神聖淨化清除隊友身上的污穢，使其免受毒、致盲與沉默。

entries.source: Purify nearby allies, removing Poison, Blind, and Silence while granting brief immunity.
entries.simplified: 净化附近盟友，移除毒、致盲与沉默，并短暂赋予对应免疫。
entries.traditional: 淨化附近隊友，移除毒、致盲與沉默，並短暫賦予對應免疫。

entries.source: Spin forward in a violent cyclone, pulling enemies inward and shredding them with repeated strikes.
entries.simplified: 化作狂暴旋风向前旋转，将敌人拉入中心并以连续攻击撕裂他们。
entries.traditional: 化作狂暴旋風向前旋轉，將敵人拉入中心並以連續攻擊撕裂他們。

entries.source: Call down holy judgment, damaging enemies and leaving them exposed to both physical and Magic punishment.
entries.simplified: 降下神圣审判，伤害敌人，并使其更易受到物理与魔法惩罚。
entries.traditional: 降下神聖審判，傷害敵人，並使其更易受到物理與魔法懲罰。

entries.source: Twist sacred rites into shadow magic, pulling enemies inward before tearing through them with corrupted force.
entries.simplified: 将神圣仪式扭曲成暗影魔法，先把敌人拉向中心，再以腐化力量撕裂他们。
entries.traditional: 將神聖儀式扭曲成暗影魔法，先把敵人拉向中心，再以腐化力量撕裂他們。

entries.source: Rip into the target with savage slashes, causing Bleeding while fueling your Rage.
entries.simplified: 以凶猛爪击撕裂目标，造成流血并积累怒气。
entries.traditional: 以凶猛爪擊撕裂目標，造成流血並累積怒氣。

entries.source: Bind yourself to an ally, sharing healing and HP siphon between both bonded souls.
entries.simplified: 将自己与一名盟友绑定，在两个相连的灵魂之间共享治疗与 HP汲取。
entries.traditional: 將自己與一名隊友綁定，在兩個相連的靈魂之間共享治療與 HP汲取。

entries.source: The summon radiates necrotic power, empowering nearby allies' Undead damage while weakening enemies.
entries.simplified: 召唤物散发死灵力量，强化附近盟友的不死伤害，并削弱敌人。
entries.traditional: 召喚物散發死靈力量，強化附近隊友的不死傷害，並削弱敵人。

entries.source: A necrotic aura weakens nearby enemies against undead power.
entries.simplified: 死灵光环会削弱附近敌人对不死力量的抗性。
entries.traditional: 死靈光環會削弱附近敵人對不死力量的抗性。

entries.source: Unleash a coil of undead energy, harming enemies while restoring summoned allies.
entries.simplified: 释放一圈不死能量，伤害敌人的同时恢复召唤盟友。
entries.traditional: 釋放一圈不死能量，傷害敵人的同時恢復召喚隊友。

entries.source: Strike enemies with undead energy, damaging them and leaving Decay behind.
entries.simplified: 以不死能量攻击敌人，造成伤害并留下衰败。
entries.traditional: 以不死能量攻擊敵人，造成傷害並留下衰敗。

entries.source: Mend a summoned ally with undead energy, restoring its strength through dark power.
entries.simplified: 以不死能量修复召唤盟友，通过黑暗力量恢复其战斗能力。
entries.traditional: 以不死能量修復召喚隊友，透過黑暗力量恢復其戰鬥能力。

entries.source: Release a burst of necrotic force, rotting nearby enemies and leaving a decaying field behind.
entries.simplified: 释放死灵冲击，腐化附近敌人并留下持续衰败的区域。
entries.traditional: 釋放死靈衝擊，腐化附近敵人並留下持續衰敗的區域。

entries.source: A lingering necrotic field damages enemies over time, spreading Decay and Desecration.
entries.simplified: 残留的死灵区域会持续伤害敌人，并传播衰败与 Desecration。
entries.traditional: 殘留的死靈區域會持續傷害敵人，並傳播衰敗與 Desecration。

entries.source: Spin into a scythe assault, carving nearby enemies while spreading Decay through each strike.
entries.simplified: 旋转挥舞镰刀发动猛攻，切割附近敌人，并让每次攻击传播衰败。
entries.traditional: 旋轉揮舞鐮刀發動猛攻，切割附近敵人，並讓每次攻擊傳播衰敗。

entries.source: Toggle a withering aura that decays nearby enemies and weakens their healing.
entries.simplified: 切换一道枯萎光环，使附近敌人受到衰败并削弱其治疗效果。
entries.traditional: 切換一道枯萎光環，使附近敵人受到衰敗並削弱其治療效果。

entries.source: Radiate unyielding faith, reducing incoming damage for nearby allies.
entries.simplified: 散发不屈信仰，减少附近盟友受到的伤害。
entries.traditional: 散發不屈信仰，減少附近隊友受到的傷害。

entries.source: Brace yourself with quick protection, raising your chance to block the next attack.
entries.simplified: 迅速架起防护，提高格挡下一次攻击的概率。
entries.traditional: 迅速架起防護，提高格擋下一次攻擊的機率。

entries.source: Strip the target clean of buffs and harmful statuses, returning them to a neutral state.
entries.simplified: 清除目标身上的所有增益与有害状态，使其回归中立状态。
entries.traditional: 清除目標身上的所有增益與有害狀態，使其回歸中立狀態。

entries.source: Channel your divine might and rain down radiant swords on your unworthy foes!
entries.simplified: 引导神圣威能，向不配的敌人降下辉耀之剑！
entries.traditional: 引導神聖威能，向不配的敵人降下輝耀之劍！

entries.source: Radiate divine power, strengthening nearby allies while empowering your own healing and holy protection.
entries.simplified: 散发神圣力量，强化附近盟友，同时增强自身治疗与神圣防护。
entries.traditional: 散發神聖力量，強化附近隊友，同時增強自身治療與神聖防護。

entries.source: Allows you to wield a weapon in each hand.
entries.simplified: 允许双手各装备一件武器。
entries.traditional: 允許雙手各裝備一件武器。

entries.source: Mastery over Earth lets you assume this avatar state, increasing Earth damage while making you more resistant to attacks.
entries.simplified: 对地的精通让你进入此 化身状态，提高地伤害并增强自身抗打击能力。
entries.traditional: 對地的精通讓你進入此 化身狀態，提高地傷害並增強自身抗打擊能力。

entries.source: Strike a single foe with crushing Earth magic and attune yourself to Earth.
entries.simplified: 以沉重的地魔法攻击单个敌人，并使自身与地调谐。
entries.traditional: 以沉重的地魔法攻擊單個敵人，並使自身與地調諧。

entries.source: Shake the battlefield with violent tremors, stunning enemies caught in the upheaval.
entries.simplified: 以猛烈震动撼动战场，使卷入动荡的敌人眩晕。
entries.traditional: 以猛烈震動撼動戰場，使捲入動盪的敵人暈眩。

entries.source: Rupture the ground with jagged stone, striking enemies and leaving them exposed to Fire.
entries.simplified: 使锯齿状岩石破土而出，攻击敌人并使其更易受到火伤害。
entries.traditional: 使鋸齒狀岩石破土而出，攻擊敵人並使其更易受到火傷害。

entries.source: Raise a wall of solid stone, blocking space and shaping the battlefield around you.
entries.simplified: 升起一面坚固石墙，阻挡空间并改变周围战场格局。
entries.traditional: 升起一面堅固石牆，阻擋空間並改變周圍戰場格局。

entries.source: Place an evolving barrier on an ally, absorbing damage before erupting with sacred power.
entries.simplified: 为盟友施加会不断进化的屏障，吸收伤害后爆发神圣力量。
entries.traditional: 為隊友施加會不斷進化的屏障，吸收傷害後爆發神聖力量。

entries.source: Bless an ally's armor with holy light, changing their armor element to Holy.
entries.simplified: 以圣光祝福盟友的护甲，将其护甲元素改为神圣。
entries.traditional: 以聖光祝福隊友的護甲，將其護甲元素改為神聖。

entries.source: Imbue your attacks with the Earth element.
entries.simplified: 使攻击获得地元素。
entries.traditional: 使攻擊獲得地元素。

entries.source: Imbue your attacks with the Fire element.
entries.simplified: 使攻击获得火元素。
entries.traditional: 使攻擊獲得火元素。

entries.source: Imbue your attacks with the Holy element.
entries.simplified: 使攻击获得神圣元素。
entries.traditional: 使攻擊獲得神聖元素。

entries.source: Imbue your attacks with the Poison element.
entries.simplified: 使攻击获得毒元素。
entries.traditional: 使攻擊獲得毒元素。

entries.source: Imbue your attacks with the Shadow element.
entries.simplified: 使攻击获得暗影元素。
entries.traditional: 使攻擊獲得暗影元素。

entries.source: Imbue your attacks with the Undead element.
entries.simplified: 使攻击获得不死元素。
entries.traditional: 使攻擊獲得不死元素。

entries.source: Imbue your attacks with the Water element.
entries.simplified: 使攻击获得水元素。
